store_data.about_the_game:
A creative game blending Turn-Based Strategy + Bullet Hell + Backpack-Like Mechanics.

As the king of a coastal island, you will command your soldiers to defend the last beach defense in a zombie-infested apocalypse.

🎒 Easy to Learn, Strategy Matters

The game features turn-based combat, but the outcome of each round depends on how you arrange your troops in the "backpack."

Each soldier occupies a different number of grid slots:

🧙 Mage, ⚔️ Swordsman, 🛡️ Hammer-Shield Bearer, 🙏 Cleric, 💉 Doctor, 🦍 Giant, 🏴‍☠️ Pirate, ⚡ Lightning Mage, 🔮 Summoner, 🎺 Horn Blower, 🎣 Fisherman…

With over 12 unique soldier types, you must strategically arrange your forces within a limited grid space—just like organizing a backpack—to fend off wave after wave of zombie attacks.

💣 Bullet Hell + Tower Defense-Style Line

When battle begins, your soldiers automatically attack, forming a dense bullet hell firing net.

Zombies surge from the beach ahead. You must allocate resources, position your troops wisely, and combine their skills to ensure your line holds.

Each wave brings deadlier enemies → testing your real-time strategy and long-term planning.

🎁 Relaxed Progression, Positive Feedback

Can’t get past a wave? No problem!

Every battle earns you resources → open chests → upgrade the King and your soldiers.

The game features 8 difficulty levels:

Earn soldier shards with each run

Upgrade existing soldiers

Unlock higher-tier units

From a basic Swordsman → legendary Summoner, every step of growth is clear and rewarding.

🃏 Rich Soldier Combinations (Partial List)

Soldier Trait

🧙 Mage High frequency bullet attacks

⚔️ Swordsman Front-line damage dealer

🛡️ Hammer-Shield Bearer Shotgun-style melee fighter

🙏 Cleric Shield support

💉 Doctor Healing support

🦍 Giant High HP + high damage

🏴‍☠️ Pirate Mine / explosive damage

⚡ Lightning Mage Laser-penetration damage

🔮 Summoner Large-area summon damage

🎺 Horn Blower Attack speed buff support

🎣 Fisherman Economy / resource gain

Each run is a Backpack-Like strategy puzzle: How do you fit the most powerful combination into limited backpack space?

Additionally, every soldier type, when upgraded to max level, transforms into a super soldier with an ultimate ability.

🌟 Why You’ll Love It

Backpack-Like + Turn-Based Combat → every slot counts

Bullet Hell satisfaction → watch your soldiers unleash barrages to mow down zombie hordes

Zombie theme + Beach defense → lighthearted yet challenging

8 difficulty levels → fun for casual players and hardcore strategists alike

Shard collection & unit evolution → satisfying progression and collection

Every loss has value → keep resources, keep opening chests

🎯 Perfect for you if you like:

Strategy games and Backpack-Like titles (e.g., Backpack Hero, Backpack Battles)

Zombie themes but not pure action games

Turn-based, bullet hell, tower defense, or survivor-like games

Short sessions (10–15 minutes per run) with meaningful decisions and growth

🏝️ Welcome to the Last Beach

💀 The world has fallen to zombies, but your island still stands.

🎒 Arrange every soldier in your backpack wisely

💣 Command the bullet hell barrage

⚔️ With strategy and growth, fight back the endless undead tide

🔥 How many waves can you survive? 🔥

store_data.detailed_description:
A creative game blending Turn-Based Strategy + Bullet Hell + Backpack-Like Mechanics.

As the king of a coastal island, you will command your soldiers to defend the last beach defense in a zombie-infested apocalypse.

🎒 Easy to Learn, Strategy Matters

The game features turn-based combat, but the outcome of each round depends on how you arrange your troops in the "backpack."

Each soldier occupies a different number of grid slots:

🧙 Mage, ⚔️ Swordsman, 🛡️ Hammer-Shield Bearer, 🙏 Cleric, 💉 Doctor, 🦍 Giant, 🏴‍☠️ Pirate, ⚡ Lightning Mage, 🔮 Summoner, 🎺 Horn Blower, 🎣 Fisherman…

With over 12 unique soldier types, you must strategically arrange your forces within a limited grid space—just like organizing a backpack—to fend off wave after wave of zombie attacks.

💣 Bullet Hell + Tower Defense-Style Line

When battle begins, your soldiers automatically attack, forming a dense bullet hell firing net.

Zombies surge from the beach ahead. You must allocate resources, position your troops wisely, and combine their skills to ensure your line holds.

Each wave brings deadlier enemies → testing your real-time strategy and long-term planning.

🎁 Relaxed Progression, Positive Feedback

Can’t get past a wave? No problem!

Every battle earns you resources → open chests → upgrade the King and your soldiers.

The game features 8 difficulty levels:

Earn soldier shards with each run

Upgrade existing soldiers

Unlock higher-tier units

From a basic Swordsman → legendary Summoner, every step of growth is clear and rewarding.

🃏 Rich Soldier Combinations (Partial List)

Soldier Trait

🧙 Mage High frequency bullet attacks

⚔️ Swordsman Front-line damage dealer

🛡️ Hammer-Shield Bearer Shotgun-style melee fighter

🙏 Cleric Shield support

💉 Doctor Healing support

🦍 Giant High HP + high damage

🏴‍☠️ Pirate Mine / explosive damage

⚡ Lightning Mage Laser-penetration damage

🔮 Summoner Large-area summon damage

🎺 Horn Blower Attack speed buff support

🎣 Fisherman Economy / resource gain

Each run is a Backpack-Like strategy puzzle: How do you fit the most powerful combination into limited backpack space?

Additionally, every soldier type, when upgraded to max level, transforms into a super soldier with an ultimate ability.

🌟 Why You’ll Love It

Backpack-Like + Turn-Based Combat → every slot counts

Bullet Hell satisfaction → watch your soldiers unleash barrages to mow down zombie hordes

Zombie theme + Beach defense → lighthearted yet challenging

8 difficulty levels → fun for casual players and hardcore strategists alike

Shard collection & unit evolution → satisfying progression and collection

Every loss has value → keep resources, keep opening chests

🎯 Perfect for you if you like:

Strategy games and Backpack-Like titles (e.g., Backpack Hero, Backpack Battles)

Zombie themes but not pure action games

Turn-based, bullet hell, tower defense, or survivor-like games

Short sessions (10–15 minutes per run) with meaningful decisions and growth

🏝️ Welcome to the Last Beach

💀 The world has fallen to zombies, but your island still stands.

🎒 Arrange every soldier in your backpack wisely

💣 Command the bullet hell barrage

⚔️ With strategy and growth, fight back the endless undead tide

🔥 How many waves can you survive? 🔥

store_data.about_the_game:
SZKELETAL: Estrogen Dracul's Potato Hunger is an absolutely shameless, parodic "yet another Vampire Survivors clone". You play as Kiszczak - a tragicomic character who, after fleeing to Romania for beating up a local bum, has been reduced by chronic potato hunger to the form of Count Dracul. Your task is brain-dead simple: gobble up potatoes, beat up bums and haters, and try not to die, or at least not to fall asleep in front of the screen.

This tragic, AI-slop masterpiece is an interactive, independent monument built for Polish "ludologists" (yes, self-proclaimed game scholars), local industry gatekeepers, and all the rest of the cringeworthy internet drama. Never heard of a Polish ludologist? Good for you. In fact, it's probably for the best - you can easily go ahead and have a thoroughly mediocre time playing this game without understanding a single shred of the inside jokes and local humor surrounding it. Other than that, the game itself is also a highly satirical jab at the mythical project "Skel... let's just say Skeletal: Deadly Shuffle - a game resembling cheap flash creations with very low verticality, directed by a Romanian fugitive.

SZKELETAL was originally a free, browser-based piece of junk, and now (thanks to the naivety and deep pockets of backers) it proudly lands on Steam to peacefully collect virtual dust in your Gabe-blessed library.


🥔 DOES IT EVEN HAVE ANY GAMEPLAY?

Ever played Vampire Survivors? Well, imagine the same thing, but with worse balance, more boring gameplay, and content that's orders of magnitude poorer. You mow down hordes of assets, level up, and upgrade a trashy digital arsenal. With every level, the game throws more enemies at you while you pray the engine (originally cobbled together in HTML and JS with heavy support from hallucinating AI) will survive the tension.

🤡 WHO (AND WHAT) ARE YOU ACTUALLY FIGHTING?

Do you think the game will throw some advanced AI at you? Right. Enemies just blindly walk straight ahead. On your path, you will meet the cream of online game drama, self-proclaimed experts, and hordes of haters generated by soulless algorithms.

Basic Haters, Ludolols and Other Phenomena:

  • Dadgamer: The plague of gaming. Moves in a sine wave pattern to make it even harder to hit.

  • Chat's Maciek: Brainless fanatic. Slow, but attacks in groups and desperately tries to surround you.

  • Baiter: Deceptive opponent. Stops dead in his tracks, only to perform a sudden charge at you.

  • Troll: Fast and chaotic. Zigzags, aggressively predicts your movement, and explodes on contact.

  • Digger: Drama spreader. Very fast linear movement. Upon death, splits into two smaller haters.

  • Skeletal: A relic of abandoned lore. Extremely slow, triple-fed, absolutely immune to knockback and slows.

  • Bum: Ranged fighter. Keeps his distance, avoids direct confrontation, and cowardly throws bottles at you.

  • Siege Syndrome: Spawns in a perfect ring. Tough and slow. Explodes after about 40 seconds, detonating everything around.

  • Elden Hater: Elite tough guy. Performs a special attack every 7 seconds: charges, shoots projectiles, or summons support.

  • Lumberfuck: The guardian of woodland cringe. Throws rainbow axes that leave a toxic trail. Watch out, or he will cancel you!

  • Snake Beater: A mobile shrine. Follows you around like a stray dog. Heals you once a minute... as long as you let him beat your snake.

  • Scumanda: Once the Count's beloved. Now she returns straight from the drama world to contemptuously hurl explosive potatoes at him.

  • Arkadickuss: Self-proclaimed polymath. Shoots a Glitch-Laser straight out of his bulging eyes. A hit completely scrambles your senses, causing you to temporarily lose control of your movement and the remains of your dignity.

  • Cow: Passive, just chews grass. You can slaughter her for a few measly potatoes, but why hurt a cow?

  • Angry Cow: A side effect of your heartless slaughter of innocent ruminants. Fast, furious, and completely immune to slows. It will just charge straight into your face and demolish your sanity.


⚔️ WHAT DO YOU SHOOT WITH?

You start your epic, whopping few-minute crusade with pride - wielding a crude Potato Masher that only tickles mobs horizontally (no range for verticality), and at a pathetically short distance. If, by some miracle, you don't close the game after a minute or two, you will upgrade your weapons to include:

  • Spit-Poison: An automatic weapon spitting toxic venom at the nearest enemy. Can be upgraded with pierce, speed, or multi-shot perks.

  • Orbital Potatoes: Artifacts spinning around the Count (because every game in this genre must have something boring floating around you).

  • Mental Explosion: A periodic outburst of internet drama lore, scattering toxic brain projectiles in all directions.

  • Ludologist's Lightning: An automatic electrical attack that shocks the nearest enemy and eagerly jumps to other poor souls.


🎁 LUDOBOXES AND PICKUPS

To prevent you from falling completely asleep out of boredom, defeated bosses drop LudoBoxes - invitations to a ludological roulette where you can draw another level of verticality or a brand-new Card of Destiny. Mobs will also occasionally drop Pickups - trash that triggers an instant, often life-saving effect.

You can pick up things like:

  • Countess's Plate - A relic of lost love. Instantly restores full hunger points.

  • Gluttony - A short indulgence during which the Count exhibits a powerful, magnetic attraction to scattered potatoes.

  • LudoGod's Shield - A transcendental aura of 'God Complex' that guarantees Dracul complete, stress-free invulnerability for a few seconds.

  • Bum's Sneakers - A speed boost on demand. Run away like you just mugged a bum in the park - fast and completely devoid of honor.

  • BanWave - The final verdict of a streaming platform moderator. Instantly annihilates all nearby haters around the Count.

  • Chill Out - Triggers 'Extreme Cringe', drastically slowing down all enemies on the screen.

  • LudoBox - The aforementioned invitation to the ludological roulette. Drops only from Bosses and guarantees a free upgrade to higher tiers of verticality or one of the Cards of Destiny.


🃏 CARDS OF DESTINY

The salt of the earth. In the game you can also collect the iconic Cards of Destiny. These collectibles act like double-edged swords - granting minor (or massive) buffs and sometimes painful debuffs, cast only on your command by throwing them directly onto the shovel.

At the moment, you will find cards such as:

  • Abyss of Nothingness - The ultimate existential vacuum cleaner. For a dozen seconds, it ruthlessly sucks in absolutely everything: mobs, loot, the remains of your dignity, and hopes for a high score. No batteries required; warranty expires at the moment of use.

  • Cardboard Decoy - Places a proud cardboard cutout with a matching IQ to your character. Enemies fall for it for a dozen seconds, which says more about them than they would care to admit.

  • Roll of Destiny - A total surprise. Much like a garbage loot box in a AAA game, except this miserable consolation is actually free. Draws a brand-new card in an available slot.

  • Thunderous Strike - Oh my god, what just happened? The card calls down an instant, exceptionally malicious thunderstorm.

  • Quiet Hours - Hey, quiet down! We're turning off the lights because it's 10 PM. Besides, the village ran out of coal for electricity long ago.

  • Point of Verticality - Use to automatically, without an ounce of effort, ascend to a higher level of verticality.

  • Chill Out - Freeze the blood in your enemies' veins with your unmatched cringe. Tactical embarrassment makes them move much slower for a while.

  • Tolerable Day - Is it day already, or just morning? Doesn't matter. The card simply rewinds the clock to 8:00 AM so you can peacefully resume doing whatever you were doing before.

  • Deadly Shuffle - Blasts all your current cards into outer space and draws brand-new ones in all available deck slots. However, there's a cheeky 21.37% chance that one of the new cards will be Dracul's Demise. Good luck with the roulette.

  • Dracul's Demise - Had enough of this suffering and want an early ticket to Potato Heaven? Use this card to instantly "log out" of the session and end your agony on your own terms.

  • Weather Forecast - Rain? Storm? No way. According to my premium forecast, not a single drop will fall for the next 12 hours. A guarantee as reliable as the Romanian pension system.

  • Baboon's Mockery - A card with the same combat utility as self-proclaimed game scholars. Completely useless, only generating a brief, mocking monkey cackle.

  • Delicious Potatoes - Suddenly, those gathered potatoes taste so good again that you forget about the remains of your honor, which you didn't have anyway. Receive double points of verticality for the next blissful 20 seconds.

  • Countess's Plate - Your go-to hunger solver when pride loses to primal instincts. Instantly restores full hunger and saves your butt from a potato starvation death.

  • LudoGod's Shield - A transcendental bubble on demand. Pop it and enjoy wonderful immortality for a brief period, especially when you start feeling soft.

  • Bum's Sneakers - A speed boost on demand. Run away like you just mugged a bum in the park - fast and completely devoid of honor.

  • Beat the Bum! - Grants a massive buff to pummel bums, haters, and others with doubled strength. Violence in this game isn't a question, it's the only answer.

  • Count's Gluttony - Activate to attract all that potato trash with your gaze alone for 3 precious seconds, without having to bend down and dirty your hands.

  • BanWave - Play the card, and haters near Dracul are banned instantly. They vanish from the live stream chat faster than they can write "give me back my money".

  • and more cards, hopefully already in the works...


🏆 WHAT DOES THE STEAM VERSION OFFER?

If you already had the displeasure of trying the browser version, know that it will forever remain a frozen, free piece of trash.

On Steam, you get a fully-fledged, native port on the ElectronJS engine, packed with what matters most in such games:

  • those famous Steam Achievements - earning the virtual BUM SLAYER badge is an absolute ludonarrative must!

  • global and local leaderboards - before script kiddies completely ruin them,

  • new random events - like thunderstorms paralyzing both the player and nearby mobs,

  • an implemented and moderately polished system of Cards of Destiny,

  • a dynamic Day/Night and Weather cycle - survive the night where you'll see far less, and experience vertical rain that will only affect your deep irritation with said effect,

  • Minimap system: Shoving a radar into the corner of the screen so you know roughly where those stationary obstacles (like shrines or ruined buildings) are.

  • Support for multiple other languages - so the naive suckers who decide to invest in this crap won't have to struggle with the simplest languages of the world, like Polish, Romanian, or, god forbid, English,

  • and a whole handful of other junk that backers naively paid for.


What else (perhaps) will this piece of junk be improved with before the final release in 2026? Empty promises...

If there is even enough patience for this project... (which I personally doubt, but as they say, fools have all the luck), then besides standard patching of a ton of bugs and other cosmetic QoL trifles, such crazy fantasies rot in the depths of the developer backlog as:

✨ New Mechanics and World Expansion (More features to break):

  • Perk Reroll: The ability to reshuffle skills upon level-up, bound by some nerf or other penalty.

  • More destructible junk on the map: Blatant cluttering of the arena with some tombs or other stationary rubbish, besides what the crowdfunders already sponsored. Break this contraption and maybe, out of its grace, it will drop you some more potatoes, Ludoboxes, or other equally useless trinkets.

  • Gaming collectibles, for those who enjoyed searching for feathers in Assassin's Creed, or other packages in GTA.

🎨 Audiovisuals (So-called Eye Candy):

  • Lifting of "Chat's Maciek": Malicious repainting of Maciek's sprite, so his mug looks even more like that retarded, original emote from the streaming platform.

  • Soundtrack expansion: Spewing out more soulless tracks from AI and hooking them into the code, so that this pixel cacophony drills a hole in your stomach at least a bit less during those longer sessions.

🌌 Very long-term plans (The zone of pipe dreams, AI limits and chronic lack of time):

  • Flood of new mobs - game scholars and ludolols: As the name suggests, some of you have an eminently perverse need to see a much larger number of your favorite "ludologists" in the game to beat up.

  • New arsenal: Some more beating sticks, fancy skills, or at least evolutions of the junk that is already here.

  • New perks and cards of destiny: More colorfully glowing bonuses dropping from slain mobs, so Estrogen Dracul has any reason to bend down at all.

  • Local co-op - because two on the couch is always more fun

  • and whatever else comes to mind in an act of desperation...


However, I warn you in advance and officially wash my hands of this: I don't promise that any of this will ever see the light of day!

The code is already barely held together by zip ties and spit, so you understand - all of the above are just empty promises to keep fools happy. Buy at your own risk, because refunds are a waste of everyone's time!

  • Delicious Potatoes - Suddenly, those gathered potatoes taste so good again that you forget about the remains of your honor, which you didn't have anyway. Receive double points of verticality for the next blissful 20 seconds.

  • Countess's Plate - Your go-to hunger solver when pride loses to primal instincts. Instantly restores full hunger and saves your butt from a potato starvation death.

  • LudoGod's Shield - A transcendental bubble on demand. Pop it and enjoy wonderful immortality for a brief period, especially when you start feeling soft.

  • Bum's Sneakers - A speed boost on demand. Run away like you just mugged a bum in the park - fast and completely devoid of honor.

  • Beat the Bum! - Grants a massive buff to pummel bums, haters, and others with doubled strength. Violence in this game isn't a question, it's the only answer.

  • Count's Gluttony - Activate to attract all that potato trash with your gaze alone for 3 precious seconds, without having to bend down and dirty your hands.

  • BanWave - Play the card, and haters near Dracul are banned instantly. They vanish from the live stream chat faster than they can write "give me back my money".

  • and more cards, hopefully already in the works...


🏆 WHAT DOES THE STEAM VERSION OFFER?

If you already had the displeasure of trying the browser version, know that it will forever remain a frozen, free piece of trash.

On Steam, you get a fully-fledged, native port on the ElectronJS engine, packed with what matters most in such games:

  • those famous Steam Achievements - earning the virtual BUM SLAYER badge is an absolute ludonarrative must!

  • global and local leaderboards - before script kiddies completely ruin them,

  • new random events - like thunderstorms paralyzing both the player and nearby mobs,

  • an implemented and moderately polished system of Cards of Destiny,

  • a dynamic Day/Night and Weather cycle - survive the night where you'll see far less, and experience vertical rain that will only affect your deep irritation with said effect,

  • Minimap system: Shoving a radar into the corner of the screen so you know roughly where those stationary obstacles (like shrines or ruined buildings) are.

  • Support for multiple other languages - so the naive suckers who decide to invest in this crap won't have to struggle with the simplest languages of the world, like Polish, Romanian, or, god forbid, English,

  • and a whole handful of other junk that backers naively paid for.


What else (perhaps) will this piece of junk be improved with before the final release in 2026? Empty promises...

If there is even enough patience for this project... (which I personally doubt, but as they say, fools have all the luck), then besides standard patching of a ton of bugs and other cosmetic QoL trifles, such crazy fantasies rot in the depths of the developer backlog as:

✨ New Mechanics and World Expansion (More features to break):

  • Perk Reroll: The ability to reshuffle skills upon level-up, bound by some nerf or other penalty.

  • More destructible junk on the map: Blatant cluttering of the arena with some tombs or other stationary rubbish, besides what the crowdfunders already sponsored. Break this contraption and maybe, out of its grace, it will drop you some more potatoes, Ludoboxes, or other equally useless trinkets.

  • Gaming collectibles, for those who enjoyed searching for feathers in Assassin's Creed, or other packages in GTA.

🎨 Audiovisuals (So-called Eye Candy):

  • Lifting of "Chat's Maciek": Malicious repainting of Maciek's sprite, so his mug looks even more like that retarded, original emote from the streaming platform.

  • Soundtrack expansion: Spewing out more soulless tracks from AI and hooking them into the code, so that this pixel cacophony drills a hole in your stomach at least a bit less during those longer sessions.

🌌 Very long-term plans (The zone of pipe dreams, AI limits and chronic lack of time):

  • Flood of new mobs - game scholars and ludolols: As the name suggests, some of you have an eminently perverse need to see a much larger number of your favorite "ludologists" in the game to beat up.

  • New arsenal: Some more beating sticks, fancy skills, or at least evolutions of the junk that is already here.

  • New perks and cards of destiny: More colorfully glowing bonuses dropping from slain mobs, so Estrogen Dracul has any reason to bend down at all.

  • Local co-op - because two on the couch is always more fun

  • and whatever else comes to mind in an act of desperation...


However, I warn you in advance and officially wash my hands of this: I don't promise that any of this will ever see the light of day!

The code is already barely held together by zip ties and spit, so you understand - all of the above are just empty promises to keep fools happy. Buy at your own risk, because refunds are a waste of everyone's time!

Survive this boring AI-slop, pee in the sink, and become the hobo of game scholarship!

store_data.about_the_game:
An impossible mirror. A group of teenagers with unique powers. And a series of puzzles where everyone has the “right” place… even though no one knows why.

In this narrative logic puzzle game, you must arrange characters and objects according to strange rules of coexistence: who can’t stand noise, who needs company, which objects can never be touched, or which people are hiding connections you don’t yet understand.

Every solution seems trivial.

Until you start to notice a pattern.

The story follows The Singular Ones, a group of teenagers marked by extraordinary abilities and very human wounds, who end up trapped around a mysterious mirror capable of altering whatever it reflects. As they try to understand what it truly is, the mirror seems to understand them first.

Solve puzzles designed to produce that “I’ve got it!” satisfaction, constantly discover new rules and mechanics, and unravel a supernatural mystery where the relationships between characters are as important as logic.

store_data.about_the_game:
Warning

Lost Mind contains flashing lights, themes that may be sensitive to some players (depression, mild mentions of suicide), and movement/distortion of objects and camera.

If ANY of these cause discomfort, please do not play.

What is Lost Mind?

The world you're playing in is not real. It never was.

Every platform, every void, every enemy — they all exist inside the mind of a girl named Ashley, fighting battles no one else can see. Her story is yours to piece together. We won't tell you what happened. We think you already know.

Lost Mind is a collectathon-based roguelite set across procedurally generated maps of floating glass platforms suspended in a cosmic void. Each run is a new attempt. Each death means one thing:

She got lost again.

How it plays

Collect all the stars scattered across the map. When the last one is picked up, a door of light appears at the main platform — your way out, your next step forward.

But the moment that door opens, the world starts to collapse. Platforms fall. The map crumbles. You have seconds to reach safety before everything she built falls apart beneath her feet.

As you progress:

  • Maps grow larger through procedural generation

  • More platforms, more stars, more chaos

  • The color of the world shifts — the shop grows darker, the music heavier

  • The soundtrack evolves from electrifying breakcore into something far more unsettling

Between levels — intermissions

Between each level, the game pauses for a moment of choice. These Intermissions cycle in a pattern:

  • 1st: Choose a new enemy to add to your run

  • 2nd: Choose an enemy + a Curse + an Upgrade

  • 3rd: Choose an enemy + 3 Upgrades

Every choice you make shapes the run — and shapes how hard she has to fight.

Upgrades

Upgrades improve Ashley's survivability, mobility, or unlock entirely new mechanics. Some examples:

  • Extra hits — absorb more damage before going down

  • Mobility upgrades — move faster, jump farther, react quicker

  • The Bible — removes a random Curse from your inventory every 6 levels. A small mercy in a merciless run.

The enemies

They are not monsters. They are her.

  • Laziness — The comfort of giving up.

  • Gloob — Shame.

  • Robson — Running from her problems.

  • Train — Time passing. Childhood fading.

  • Paranoia — What if. What if. What if.

  • Maskarada — The smile she wore for everyone.

  • Violence — Bullying. Verbal, physical, virtual...

  • And more!

Curses

Curses make the world harder — or make her harder to control. They're tied to the enemies that inspired them, and to the parts of herself she's still fighting.

  • Low Self-Esteem — Tied to Doppel. She laughs at you. You start believing her.

  • Fitness / Greediness / Sleepiness / Halfness — Tied to Laziness. Four ways to slow you down... or... speed you up?

  • Quick Blur — Tied to Paranoia. "Is it... Following me? Is it running faster!?"

  • Slippery — Some platforms lose all friction. Momentum becomes your enemy.

  • Faster Chaos — The collapse accelerates the moment the door opens. No grace period.

  • Hot Stuff — Using your ability fills a heat meter. Max heat kills you instantly.

  • Console — Your field of vision shrinks to a tiny portable screen. Nostalgia has a price.

  • Inclined Platforms — Nothing stays flat. Nothing stays still.

  • And much much more!

Did you know?

  • The stars represent fragments of hope. They don't come to her — she has to find every single one before anything changes.

  • The door of light collapsing the world around it isn't just a difficulty mechanic. The moment she finds a way out, everything gets harder. That's intentional.

  • The soundtrack was designed to feel detached from the lore on purpose — so players who just want to run can vibe. But listen carefully as the levels stack up.

  • Curses exist because sometimes we choose our own burdens, convinced they make us stronger.

Lost Mind is currently a work in progress. The mind is still being built and rebuilt.

store_data.about_the_game:
S.H.I.F.T. is About to Begin!

Welcome to the most prestigious, dynamic, and "definitely-asks-the-fewer-questions" cargo branch in the logistics world! Your shift is starting! Lace up your steel-toe boots, loosen up that back support belt, and take your position against the absolute avalanche of cargo about to rain down from the pipes. Once the S.H.I.F.T. whistle blows, forget the rulebook; this is a logistics playground where the laws of physics bend, packages come alive, and pure chaos rules!

Game Features

  • Zero Stress, Maximum Fun: No need to rush while sorting through hundreds of packages raining from the pipes—just vibe and enjoy the chaos! There are no rules and no order here; just pure, unadulterated package-sorting madness.

  • Live Cargo & High-Risk Deliveries: Handle "exotic" live cargo making weird noises from inside the box, or chuck ticking, high-danger packages into the disposal area to watch them blow. After all, this is your playground!

  • Package Kicking & Box Basketball: Using a ladder to stack shelves is so last season. Find the perfect angle, put some power into your legs, and yeet those packages across the warehouse! Or better yet, shoot some hoops into the sorting bins and break your own basketball record. Let the physics engine do the funny work!

  • Shady Business from the Mezzanine: Don't just stick to your daily quotas. Grab high-paying side hustles from your computer—smuggle the mafia's "special" packages through customs clean as a whistle, or blow the whistle on sketchy cargo by tipping off the cops to stir up some drama. The choice is yours!

  • Design Your Ultimate Workspace: Spend your hard-earned cash to rip out old conveyor belts and upgrade your system. Once the shift ends, customize your very own chill room and workspace. Shape your chaotic work environment and your quiet sanctuary exactly the way you want!

About the Game

Do you enjoy chaos? Unreasonable amounts of loot? Killing bosses that are 10 times as big as you?

Welcome to Crystalyn, a bullet-hell looter shooter where getting stupidly powerful is not a bug, it's the whole point.

Push your build to the limit

Upgrade a big skill tree, collect boss drops, and equip gear that turns you into a walking destruction machine.

There is no such thing as too many bullets. I checked.

Fight. Loot. Upgrade. Repeat.

Drop into maps with increasing difficulty, slaughter everything that moves, grab their loot, and bring it back to the lobby. Upgrade. Equip. Prestige. Go back in. Do it again. The enemies won't get a break, and you won't get bored.

Infinite ways to get stronger

Upgrade the skill tree, buy new weapons, collect better boss drops, use incantations, prestige and earn ultra powerful cards. You are only getting stronger, until the whole screen is covered in bullets.

It never stops

More difficulty settings, more maps, more chaos. The game does not slow down. Neither should you.

store_data.about_the_game:
Mini Gladiators is a single-player, physics-driven gladiator roguelite with survivors-like combat, movement-only controls, and deeply reactive arena chaos. Move through the battlefield, let your gladiator attack automatically, and shape each run with weapons and upgrades that change how enemies collide, fly, and crash into each other.

Every run is a build puzzle disguised as chaos: pick your next combat group, take on physics-based challenges, earn gold, and push your gladiator one fight closer to glory.

Features

  • Physics-driven impacts. Every impact is simulated, with damage and knockback driven by force, mass, and speed.

  • Movement-only controls. You move, your gladiator attacks automatically. Focus on the arena, your build, and the chain reactions unfolding around you.

  • Every run is a build puzzle disguised as chaos. Experiment with weapons and upgrades that reshape how enemies collide, scatter, and crash through the arena.

  • Choose your next fight. Face different combat groups and challenges on your path to glory. Each choice tests your build in a different way.

  • Complete physics-based challenges. Earn gold by completing special arena objectives built around impacts, collisions, and chain reactions.

  • Short runs, lasting progression. Designed for quick sessions, with compact fights, satisfying clears, and long-term upgrades that keep your gladiator growing between runs.

store_data.about_the_game:
Aboard your ship, destroy the hordes of aliens attacking you by choosing your weapons and upgrades as you play, and defeat the final boss! In this roguelite, each ship has a different weapon layout, giving each one its own unique playstyle. Then create your ship and develop your own strategy!

Survive three 4-minute waves of enemies punctuated by events and bosses, then defeat the final boss to complete the level. Killing enemies generates small stars that you can collect to level up. Each time you level up, you can add or upgrade a weapon or a stat upgrade. Weapons fire automatically, but they can only fire within a certain angle, so their placement is crucial to determine your ship's playstyle!

When a weapon reaches level 5, it can evolve into a new form (each weapon has 3 possible evolutions), which changes its behavior to some extent, increasing the number of possible builds.

Complete quests given by the (kinda dumb) inhabitants of the surrounding planets to level up faster.

You can permanently upgrade your ships using a currency that carries over between games.

A custom ship editor unlocks as you progress, allowing you to create your own strategies! Should you focus on offense with 8 different weapons, on defense with plenty of health and regeneration, or on luck to get better upgrades...? It’s up to you to try!

The game features:

  • 3 increasingly difficult levels, each with its own besitary

  • 11 base weapons, 33 weapon evolutions

  • 7 ships and a ship editor to create your own

store_data.about_the_game:
ABOUT THIS GAME

ABOUT THIS GAME

Welcome to the world’s most serious chicken warfare simulator.

In Ruler of the Roost, heavily armed chickens battle across the farm to become the last bird standing. Peck your enemies into oblivion, dodge explosive eggs, survive catastrophic poultry-based weaponry, and uncover horrors the barnyard was never meant to contain.

Fight solo or enter chaotic multiplayer battles with friends as the farm erupts into feather-filled warfare.

This is not your grandmother’s chicken coop.

FEATURES

🐔 FEATHERED BATTLE ROYALE CHAOS
Drop into multiplayer matches where every chicken fights for survival. Scavenge weapons, collect absurd power-ups, and claw your way to the top of the pecking order.

🥚 EGGSPLOSIVE COMBAT
Launch devastating egg grenades, unleash electrified poultry weaponry, trigger catastrophic explosions, and turn your enemies into extra crispy casualties.

👑 BECOME THE RULER OF THE ROOST
Only one chicken can rule the coop. Will you rise as an undefeated rooster warlord… or end up as roadside rotisserie?

⚠️ TOTALLY NORMAL CHICKENS
Face aggressive hens, tactical roosters, and entities High Command refuses to acknowledge publicly.

📻 IMMERSIVE BARNYARD BROADCASTS
Tune into the best hits the farmyard can offer with radio station 98.7 The Crispy Frequency.

💀 RIDICULOUS WAYS TO DIE
Get pecked to death. Exploded by eggs. Vaporized by electricity. Or discover far worse fates that cannot legally be classified as “standard chicken-related incidents.”

🔥 TACTICAL POULTRY WARFARE
Master fast-paced movement, ridiculous physics, chaotic weapons, and advanced chicken combat techniques.

REMEMBER

  • The Geneva Convention never mentioned chickens.

  • If you can hear clucking, it’s already too late.

  • Invincibility will not protect you from everything.

  • The rooster sees all.

Now get in the coop, soldier. The Peckoning has begun.

store_data.about_the_game:
Cypris is a dark, erotic kinetic novel centered on corruption, mind control, and forbidden desire.

You are Vincent Mercer, a brilliant psychologist carrying a ancient divine blessing — a seductive power that slowly warps the minds and bodies of women around you, turning them into devoted, lust-filled slaves to your will.

Tired of fighting his nature, Vincent finally embraces his gift. What begins as subtle manipulation in the therapy room soon spirals into total domination as he systematically claims the women in his life.

With stunning high-quality illustrations and a deep, intriguing narrative, Cypris follows Vincent’s descent into godhood as he corrupts five beautiful and uniquely captivating women:

  • Erika (39), a neglected, elegant housewife yearning to be truly seen.

  • Emma (19), Erika's innocent but curious daughter.

  • Zoe (22), your loyal and secretly obsessive assistant.

  • Lucie (21), a talented but insecure young actress.

  • And others yet to be revealed.

As the mysterious entity Cypris awakens within him, Vincent learns that he was never meant to resist.

He was born to rule.

store_data.about_the_game:
Market Chain 98 is a retro incremental simulation that puts you right back in front of a classic CRT monitor, where you manage growing numbers and make strategic market decisions. Designed with a classic 90s desktop aesthetic, everything happens inside an expanding operating system interface. Your goal? Turn a single small business into a massive global Market Chain.

START SMALL, THINK BIG


Begin by managing a small bodega in Brooklyn. Upgrade your cash register, increase your stock capacity, and clear out customer queues. As your income increases second by second, new windows will open, revealing new markets and turning your desktop into a complex management dashboard.

DEEP INCREMENTAL MECHANICS


This isn't just an idle clicker; it's built on solid math, economy balancing, and strategy:

  • Bank & Loans: Need quick cash to expand? Take out bank loans, but watch your debt limits and interest rates carefully. Aggressive growth can sometimes eat into your profit margins.
  • Logistics & Hubs: Connect your businesses. By establishing logistics Hubs, you gain market discounts, lower your operational costs, and optimize your entire supply chain.
  • IPO & The Portfolio: Once your company reaches its peak, go public (Prestige). Use the permanent points you earn to access your Portfolio, unlocking powerful, permanent upgrades that will make your next market run much faster and more efficient.

store_data.about_the_game:
This is definitely not a proper pilgrimage.

You were once a young deacon of the Church of Nature. To save the bishop who once helped you, you were forced to sign a contract with a mysterious woman named Yingying, who holds an enormous debt over you.

She possesses long snow-white hair and a seductive, alluring figure. But what’s far more terrifying is that she is a powerful Telepath. She can easily read your deepest desires, shame, and hesitation — and she delights in exploiting them in the most wicked ways.

"Oh my… Father, your heart is beating so fast. And here… Even though your mouth says no, your body and mind are being so honest and adorable♡"

In her luxurious penthouse apartment, this elegant white-haired beauty uses her sweet voice, soft body, and absolute advantage of mind-reading to slowly drag you into an inescapable abyss of desire.

By day, you must still maintain your sacred image in the church, preaching to the believers. At night, you fall into Yingying’s hands, caught in a fierce psychological struggle between faith, shame, and lust.

Game Features:

  • A story-rich, hilarious, and darkly humorous light idle game

  • A dominant, perverted white-haired beauty debt collector with mind-reading abilities — Yingying

  • Highly invasive and delicate dual mental and physical training

  • Intense psychological conflict between faith collapse and awakening desire

  • High-quality illustrations and multiple thick interactive H scenes

This is not merely a transaction of the flesh. It is the complete process of your soul being seen through, toyed with, and defiled.

When you kneel before the altar in prayer, is Yingying sitting on the distant sofa, smiling as she listens to your forbidden memories of her body?

She has no intention of letting you go. And you… are finding it increasingly difficult to resist this feeling of being utterly controlled.

store_data.about_the_game:
CLIMB THE IMPOSSIBLE

Nexfall is a chaotic multiplayer parkour game where 1–6 players compete through a massive fantasy world filled with deadly traps, precision platforming and unpredictable skill battles.

Master difficult jumps, survive dangerous obstacles and sabotage your opponents while fighting your way through dangerous routes and handcrafted challenges.

One mistake can cost you the run.

MASTER PRECISION PARKOUR

Every movement matters.

Traverse a massive fantasy map packed with:

  • Precision jumps

  • Moving obstacles

  • Trap-filled paths

  • Dangerous shortcuts

  • Momentum-based movement

  • Challenging platforming sections

Skill and consistency are the key to victory.

BUILD YOUR SKILL DECK

Create your own loadout by combining abilities from multiple categories:

  • Offensive

  • Protection

  • Support

Disrupt enemy movement, defend yourself from incoming attacks or create complete chaos during critical moments.

No two matches feel the same.

CHAOTIC MULTIPLAYER

Compete online with up to 6 players in intense free-for-all multiplayer matches.

Expect:

  • Constant sabotage

  • Unpredictable encounters

  • Brutal knockbacks

  • Clutch recoveries

  • Competitive movement gameplay

  • Chaotic moments with friends

Trust nobody.

COMPETE FOR THE FASTEST RUN

Master the map, improve your routes and compete for the best times.

Features include:

  • Competitive leaderboards

  • Replayable runs

  • High skill ceiling gameplay

  • Route optimization

  • Skill-based progression

Every second matters.

A DARK FANTASY WORLD

Explore a handcrafted fantasy environment inspired by ruined kingdoms, ancient structures and dangerous parkour routes.

Nexfall combines fast-paced multiplayer gameplay with a dark fantasy atmosphere focused on movement, chaos and competition.

WILL YOU SURVIVE THE CHAOS?

Precision parkour is only the beginning.

The real challenge is everyone else.

store_data.about_the_game:
Peg Cascade is a polished neon arcade-idle game built around satisfying drops, escalating upgrades, score-chasing, timed progression, and creative Custom Board play.

Drop balls into glowing peg boards, trigger cascading score chains, and build your way through increasingly powerful upgrade paths. Every run starts simple: a few balls, a board full of pegs, and a score target. Then the screen comes alive with multipliers, charged effects, faster drops, and waves of bouncing arcade chaos.

In Sandbox, progression unfolds board by board while your score keeps climbing. Complete the target, keep the cascade running, continue upgrading, and let the board turn into a glowing score machine. Sandbox is built for players who enjoy watching numbers rise, experimenting with upgrade paths, and pushing a board far beyond the clear requirement.

For a sharper challenge, Timed Race turns each board into a clean speedrun-style clear. The clock starts on your first peg hit and stops when the board is complete, giving you records to chase across different Prestige tiers.

Peg Cascade also features a major Custom Board mode. Build your own peg layouts, test different shapes, create your own cascade playgrounds, and share board layouts with friends. Import a friend’s board, try their design, compare results, and see who can make the most chaotic, efficient, or ridiculous cascade.

Designed to be easy to understand and satisfying to optimize, Peg Cascade blends idle-game progression with arcade-style feedback. It is about watching the board light up, finding stronger upgrade paths, letting the score run wild, shaving time off your clears, building custom layouts, and sharing the cascade with other players.

Key Features:

- Drop balls into neon peg boards and watch the cascade build

- Progress through 10 standard boards, each with its own scoring challenge

- Upgrade across four paths: Core, Cascade, Precision, and Charge

- Play Sandbox mode for steady progression, experimentation, and long-running score growth

- Keep Sandbox boards running after completion to push your score higher

- Play Timed Race mode to chase faster clears and better records

- Prestige through speed tiers from 50% to 100%

- Track records by Prestige tier

- Unlock a full Sandbox-only Custom Board mode

- Build your own peg layouts and experiment with board shapes

- Export Custom Board layouts and send them to friends

- Import shared Custom Boards and try other players’ creations

- Built-in original soundtrack with randomized playlist playback

- Polished arcade presentation with glowing effects, responsive UI, and fullscreen desktop support

- Simple to start, satisfying to optimize

You were given a mission by an unknown deity, to collect the time energy hoarded by these strongholds and restore a stable reality. As you go on with your journey, you will learn new styles of fighting, along with new ways of manipulating time energy. 

Developer Note:

store_data.about_the_game:
You are Aurora, a young witch who loves alchemy, dreaming of changing the coven she was born into.

However, one horrible day, her coven, The Circle of Moira, was massacred by the Inquisition during a brutal and unexplained attack. So, Aurora decides to investigate in order to understand and find the secrets buried in Rosevale.

Accompanied by Oz, the mysterious familiar of her deceased grandmother, Aurora must gather clues, explore various areas of Rosevale, craft potions, and confront five suspects tied to the tragedy thanks to the intellect and the magic of Oz.

Yet the more she searches for the truth, the more she begins to question not only what happened... But also Oz, her family, her coven, and even herself.

In this semi-open world, you can explore various areas of Rosevale, unlocking new locations as you progress through confrontations with suspects. From the deepest caves of Rosevale to the small town of Gembury, the region is filled with unique flora and fauna that may prove useful during your journey.

And sometimes, you may discover mysterious orbs that only Oz can collect, allowing you to offer them to your deity in exchange for blessings.

Alchemy is the key to unlocking the door to hidden secrets. Gather unique plants, catch magical fish, buy vials, and brew a variety of potions in order to make your way towards your suspects.

Unlock new recipes throughout each chapter and use them wisely to gather clues, uncover treasures, and solve puzzles. Nothing will keep you from discovering the truth.

Each chapter revolves around confronting a suspect, but you cannot accuse someone without clues or evidence. You must collect informations, build your reasoning, try to uncover the suspect’s motive, and decide how to approach each interrogation.

However, depending on your questions and the way you handle each suspect, they may choose to answer or remain silent.

Guilty or innocent. In the end, the balance of justice will literally rest in your hands.

Not everyone in Rosevale knew where the coven was hidden. Therefore, only a few individuals could truly be considered suspects for Oz and Aurora.

One of them revealed the coven’s location to the Inquisition. But who?

Jasper the Alchemist?

Evelyn Bloodwhisper the Witch?

Lum the Familiar?

Jonathan Lumier, leader of the Inquisition of Gembury?

Or perhaps, as Oz suggests…

Walter, Aurora’s best friend.

The Circle of Moira has always been filled with secrets, many that Aurora never knew about.

Perhaps this investigation will bring her closer to the truth behind the creation of the Circle, the reasons why the Inquisition decided to attack. And the truth about their own goddess, Moira.

Hello everyone, you can call me Ice! I've been making video games for many years out of passion for deep storytelling, atmosphere, and worldbuilding, without ever really sharing them publicly. Now, I've decided to share my worlds and creations with others and hopefully make a living from it.

If you'd like to learn more about Herald of Moira or my other projects, feel free to follow me on social media (you can find the links on the right side of the Steam page).

I'm always open to feedback, suggestions, and discussions, so don't hesitate to stop by!

I hope you'll enjoy your journey through Herald of Moira.

Obstacles is a thoughtful and tactical bullet hell where everything only moves when you move. Pick between one of six different player characters and try for a high score!

Three things will increase as you collect gems; your score, your streak, and the number of obstacles in the game! As your streak rises your score will increase more and more rapidly, but be careful! If you get hit by an obstacle your streak will reset to zero.

Each player character has their own special ability, Blue can reverse the direction of obstacles, Green is sturdier and has more health, Pink can teleport to her heart, Cyan lets there be more gems on the screen, Purple gets a random ability from every other colour, and Red can summon friendly obstacles to help out.

store_data.about_the_game:
PIXEL KITTEN DESKTOP is a cozy desktop pet experience where a tiny pixel cat lives right on your screen.

Your kitten is always there with you: walking around, dozing off, asking for food, showing little emotes, and reacting to its own needs throughout the day. It is more than a simple animated sticker. Your cat has persistent stats, autonomous behaviors, growth stages, inventory items, and its own little life on your desktop.

A tiny cat that feels alive

Watch your kitten roam freely across your desktop, sleep in place, meow for attention, and choose its own actions based on hunger, thirst, energy, cleanliness, mood, health, and affection.

Its behavior changes over time, creating the feeling of a small companion quietly living beside you while you work, study, or relax.

Raise and care for your kitten

Take care of your cat through simple, cozy interactions:

  • Feed it when it gets hungry

  • Give it water when it feels thirsty

  • Play to improve its mood

  • Brush it to keep it clean

  • Pet it to build affection

  • Let it rest and recover energy

  • Use medicine when its health is low

As you spend more time together, your kitten grows from a young cat into a larger adult companion.

Collect different pixel cats

Adopt your own kitten through a random draw system and discover a wide variety of pixel cat appearances.

  • 43 collectible cat variants

  • Different rarity tiers

  • Persistent collection progress

  • Multiple saves for different cats

Build a cozy desktop space

Open the in-game manager panel to check on your cat and customize its daily life.

  • Shop for food, bowls, beds, toys, and other items

  • Place furniture on the desktop

  • Manage inventory and saves

  • Browse your cat collection

  • Adjust settings and language options

Placed items are not just decorative. Your kitten can interact with them as part of its daily routine.

Designed for a calm, everyday companion vibe

PIXEL KITTEN DESKTOP is not a high-pressure management game. It is a light, relaxing desktop companion made to bring warmth and personality to your screen.

Whether you are working, studying, or just hanging out online, your little pixel kitten is there to keep you company.

Features

  • Cozy pixel-art desktop pet

  • Autonomous cat behavior system

  • 7 persistent care stats

  • 43 cat variants to discover

  • Growth from kitten to adult

  • Shop, inventory, and collection systems

  • Furniture placement on desktop

  • Multiple save slots

  • Chinese and English support

Space Invasion Infinite takes the simple, satisfying formula of classic alien wave shooters and transforms it into a build-driven arcade survival experience. Hold the line, move left and right, and blast through endless invading waves — then reshape every run with powerful upgrades, brutal bullet effects, and game-changing augments.

Build your turret

Discover dozens of upgrades, branching upgrade paths, deadly projectile modifiers, and powerful augments that evolve the way your turret fights. Stack synergies, create broken combinations, and survive longer with every run.

Face escalating threats

Battle a wide variety of enemies with distinct attacks and behaviors, spawning in handcrafted wave combinations that keep every run unpredictable. Deadly bosses bring unique mechanics and punishing attack patterns designed to break your defenses.

Grow stronger over time

Unlock new turrets, higher difficulties, gameplay modifiers, and permanent upgrades as you push further and master the invasion.

store_data.about_the_game:
Prove that you are human.


Are You Human? is a short absurd puzzle game set inside a retro Korean web portal inspired by early-2000s PC cafes, old login pages, and pixel Flash games.

You begin on what looks like an ordinary website. Then one checkbox turns into a full interrogation. To reach the end, you must survive 10 rounds of randomized CAPTCHA minigames, complete a fake sign-up process, and pass a chain of increasingly unreasonable identity checks.

How It Plays


  • Clear 10 randomized CAPTCHA rounds before the site will let you continue.
  • Minigames include slide puzzles, spot-the-difference challenges, rhythm tiles, AI dodging, Gomoku, mazes, fruit slicing, memory matching, and other short puzzle tests.
  • Failure can push you backward through the process, including during sign-up and identity verification.
  • After the CAPTCHA sequence, you still need to handle account creation, terms, email verification, phone verification, and face/ID photo checks.
  • Reach the ending and the in-game board through the login, guest login, or sign-up routes.

Features


  • Retro Korean Web 1.0 presentation with blue headers, cream backgrounds, pixel UI, and fake browser pages.
  • A compact run-based structure built around short CAPTCHA and verification challenges.
  • Steam achievements for clearing key steps, clearing without failure, resetting records, and more.
  • Steam leaderboard support for fastest clear time.
  • Supports Korean, English, Japanese, and Simplified Chinese.

The goal is simple: log in, sign up, verify yourself, and convince the website that you are definitely a human.

A casino on your desktop that never stops paying.


CHIPSTACK is an idle casino overlay. It sits on your desktop, earns chips every second, and grows your bankroll whether you're playing or not. The more you have, the faster it grows. Leave it running while you work, jump in for a quick hand between tasks, or go deep configuring strategies and chasing modifier combos. No real money. No microtransactions. No ads. Just an ever-growing pile of chips.

IDLE INCOME THAT COMPOUNDS


Your chipstack grows passively every second the game runs. Upgrade your income rate. Prestige to permanently multiply it — and it stacks every time you prestige. Even when CHIPSTACK is closed, you earn offline income. Open the game tomorrow to a bigger bankroll than you left.

AUTO-PLAY YOUR WAY


Blackjack, slots, and roulette have full auto-play — but it plays with your bets, your strategy, and your rules.

Configure everything:

  • Set your bet amount or use percentage-of-bankroll sizing
  • Choose a betting strategy — Flat, Martingale, Reverse Martingale, D'Alembert, Fibonacci, Percentage, or build a custom sequence
  • Set stop conditions — stop on jackpot, balance drop %, profit target, spin count, or streak break
  • Run at Normal, Fast (2x), or Turbo (5x) speed

You're not watching a bot. You're building a system, tuning it, and watching it perform.

CONFIGURE THE HOUSE RULES


CHIPSTACK gives you full control over the rules of each game:

Blackjack:
  • 1, 2, 4, 6, or 8 deck shoe
  • 3:2 or 6:5 blackjack payout
  • Hit Soft 17 or Stand on Soft 17
  • American (dealer peeks) or European (no peek)
  • Surrender on or off
  • Live Hi-Lo card count with true count display

Roulette:
  • European wheel — 37 pockets (0-36), 2.7% house edge
  • American wheel — 38 pockets (0, 00, 1-36), 5.26% house edge
  • Full bet grid — straights, splits, streets, corners, dozens, columns

Slots:
  • 5 themes with different volatility profiles — Classic, Neon, Pharaoh, Cosmic, Dragon
  • 1, 3, 5, or 8 active paylines
  • Cascading reels, expanding wilds, sticky wilds, 4-tier progressive jackpot

PLAY WITH MODS — OR WITHOUT


Toggle Classic Mode for a pure casino experience with real odds. Or equip up to 5 modifier cards that break the rules in your favor.

Collect 29 modifiers across 5 rarities:

  • Remove all 2s, 3s, and 4s from the blackjack deck
  • Make skull symbols trigger bonus spins instead of losses
  • Double the progressive jackpot build speed
  • Get 50% of your bet back when roulette lands on zero
  • Split any two cards, not just pairs

Discover hidden synergy combos when the right modifiers are equipped together. Some combinations break the game wide open — if you can find them.

LEARN REAL CARD COUNTING


CHIPSTACK uses real blackjack rules and real basic strategy. Turn on the Hi-Lo running count and true count display to learn how card counting works. Watch the auto-player make optimal decisions for every hand. Test betting systems across thousands of automated hands and see for yourself whether Martingale or Kelly Criterion actually works with your chosen house rules.

THREE MORE GAMES BETWEEN TASKS


Quick games that take 30 seconds to a few minutes — perfect for loading screens, queues, or while watching something:

  • Neon Heist — Flip tiles to find loot, dodge hidden alarms, escape with your haul. Four security levels. Push your luck or cash out safe.
  • Video Poker — Jacks or Better 9/6 with hold and draw.
  • Hi-Lo — Guess higher or lower. Build streak multipliers and cash out before you bust.

PRESTIGE, CLIMB, COMPETE


Cash out your bankroll to prestige. Start over with a permanent income multiplier that compounds every time. Unlock Turbo speed, extra modifier slots, loss rebates, and the Casino Owner title. Compete on global Steam leaderboards for the highest chipstack, biggest single win, and longest win streak. Compare your bankroll with friends.

store_data.about_the_game:
Build it, blow it up, and build it again

Perihelion lets you run your own rocket engine shop from the ground up. Take over an abandoned desert airfield and design realistic, unique engines. Test them (until you fly too close to the sun) while racing companies to land contracts from in-game aerospace companies. Or, you could just export it straight into your favorite space game and see it fly for yourself.

Make your company whatever you want it to be

Build ridiculous multi-meganewton heavy-lift engines, or weedy engines made just for small-satellite launchers. There’s no definitive answer, only what works. Size your own chambers, define your own nozzle cooling methods, pick a propellant combination, assemble turbopumps, optimize for a specific altitude, and more.

Compete to be the best

Coming next year as a part of the 1.0 release, be the best in the business and compete for lucrative, varied contracts. You decide what to do to win!

Export your engines to other games

Space games can feel limiting when the engine choices are predetermined, not what you want, and not optimal for the rocket you are looking to build. Perihelion's Engine Export feature, along with a standalone companion mod for each supported game, lets you be as creative as you like while also helping you design engines that are optimal for what you're trying to do.

Four empires. One map. Real opponents. No mercy.

Hexagon Imperium is a cross-platform multiplayer turn-based strategy game where up to 4 real players command rival empires on a procedurally generated hexagonal battlefield. Fast enough for a lunch break. Deep enough to keep you up at night.

⚔️ REAL PLAYERS. REAL STRATEGY.

No bots to exploit. No predictable AI patterns. Every opponent thinks, bluffs, and adapts. Every match is different because every player is different.

Seamless cross-platform play — battle opponents on PC, browser, and mobile in the same lobby.

Each match drops 4 factions onto a unique 20×12 hex map with cities, ports, forests, mountains, and a treacherous interior sea. No two games play the same.

Control the map. Control the war.

🏰 FOUR FACTIONS

OCEANIA — Maritime dominance from the blue corner

EURASIA — Continental power, iron and blood

EASTASIA — Eastern expansion, relentless and precise

BROTHERHOOD — Desert wolves, unpredictable and deadly

Every faction starts equal. What separates winners from losers is you.

🪖 ARMIES THAT GROW WITH YOUR AMBITION

Small squads become artillery. Artillery becomes armored columns. Control ports and launch naval operations. Merge forces for devastating assaults.

Infantry → Artillery → Tanks as your armies scale up

Naval units for sea control and coastal strikes

Merge armies to concentrate overwhelming force

Cities and ports generate reinforcements every turn

store_data.about_the_game:
You find a mysterious box full of home videos in your parents' attic. A box that your parents really don't want you to open. What are they hiding?

  In this explorative FMV game, you play the 25-year-old son who returns to his childhood home. You will unravel a family secret through the '90s videotapes of your parents' rock band, their letters and other objects. While doing that, you learn more about them, their band's mysterious lead singer Tanja, and yourself. Who was she, and what was her relationship to your parents?

  Burning Bridges is a two-to-three-hour-long narrative game focused on the characters and their relationships with each other. Ultimately, you can decide whether and how to confront your parents about the secret you have just uncovered.

You play in a 3D-scanned environment where you will find videotapes that we shot using original camcorders from the '90s. The vintage, analogue feel will transport you right back in time!

Burning Bridges is one of the first narrative movie games, bringing the worlds of games, movies and music together in a very unique way.

store_data.about_the_game:
PLAY WITH FRIENDS

Welcome to the world of Killer Maid Cafe, a cozy horror co-op cooking game where you run a cute maid cafe! Play with up to 4 players total in this anime-style, friendslop-esque cooking simulator! You and your fellow maids have to run a maid cafe together, working hard to serve customers with all sorts of pastries and coffee. 

HARVEST HEARTS

But that’s not all! You have to keep your customers happy and distracted so that you can harvest their hearts! Feast on hearts, upgrade your skills and make sure to have some leftover to pay your evil landlord with - or your heart will be next!

BAKE HEARTY GOODS

Cook up anything from cookies to cakes to serve your hungry customers. Brew coffee and draw latte art for extra tips. If the customers don’t like your cooking, you can always eat them instead!

DANCE AND TAKE PHOTOS

Customers are here for the full maid cafe experience! Make sure to take pictures with them and put on a show, either alone or with other maids to maximize your customers’ happiness levels! Build your reputation photo by photo, dance by dance to get more customers to visit your cafe!

CLEAN MESSES

Use a broom or feather duster to keep your cafe clean. Clean up coffee spills, cookie crumbs or customer remains off your polished floor. A tidy floor today keeps the police at bay!

store_data.about_the_game:
WizKitty and the Tower of Doom, Gloom, and Other Bad Stuff is a roguelike deckbuilder where your deck doesn’t fight, it crafts the weapon that does.

Every run is a puzzle of modifiers, upgrades, rerolls, prefixes, suffixes, and trying to bully RNG into giving you the perfect item.

Build a ridiculous weapon. Smash your way up the tower. Laugh in the face of RNG.

Inspired by the strategic decision-making of Slay the Spire, the escalating “one more run” energy of Balatro, and the item-crafting obsession of Path of Exile, WizKitty is built for players who love broken builds, surprising synergies, and losing sleep to one more run.

Features

  • Deckbuilding meets weapon crafting

    • Use your cards to add, remove, upgrade, reroll, and transform weapon modifiers.

  • Every weapon tells a story

    • Turn a sad little stick into a blazing, overpowered mistake that somehow works.

  • Chase broken builds

    • Stack synergies, exploit weird interactions, and push your weapon far past reasonable behavior.

  • Climb the Tower of Doom, Gloom, and Other Bad Stuff

    • Face enemies, unlock new possibilities, and discover increasingly strategic ways to win.

  • A tiny wizard cat with very big ambitions

    • WizKitty may be small, but the weapons are not.

store_data.about_the_game:
Set in a fictional version of the 1930s Mediterranean coast, this flying adventure follows a couple of casino swindlers who must go their separate ways after a failed heist.

Play as Charles, a WWI veteran pilot searching for Anna, your partner in crime. Fly through beautiful, contemplative landscapes, follow intimate clues, and walk through picturesque coastal villages to uncover her whereabouts.

Discover a deeper understanding of your relationship as you embark on a multilayered journey filled with introspection, melancholy, and soul-searching.

Experience the tranquil joy of coastal aviation. Crosswinds offers a relaxing, visually captivating escape where you pilot a seaplane over idyllic Mediterranean towns. Let the stunning art style and gentle atmosphere guide you into a meditative state of mind as you drift above picturesque cliffs and sunlit waves.

In Crosswinds, your decisions carry real weight. The intricate balance between love and ambition shifts with every choice you make, directly reshaping the narrative. Forge your own path through adult relationships where nothing is black and white. Your insights will not only steer the romance toward multiple distinct endings, but also dictate which side quests and optional missions open up—or close forever—along your journey.

Pour a cup of coffee and settle in. With its distinct European comic-book art style and a soothing jazz soundtrack, Crosswinds delivers a relaxing café-like feeling. Explore picturesque coastal settings at your own leisure in a game designed to be savored, one sip at a time.

store_data.about_the_game:
Have you ever felt that, everything is FAKE in other stock market simulations?

FUNEX is programmed to change this. What is different in FUNEX?

  • No ALGORITMIC PRICING mechanism.

  • No FIXED NEWS results.

  • No FAKE TRADES.

What does FUNEX offer you is, has never seen in any game - in stock market games history.

  • REAL TRADING with a REAL ORDER BOOK mechanism.

  • ORDERS go to the REAL and ALIVE market.

  • In order to BUY or SELL, your ORDER has to be MATCHED with another market participant.

  • All AI FUNDS decide for themselves with different strategies.

  • Fast real market, sometimes with real surprises.

  • Economics, Sector, Stock; news.

  • Market, Limited, Stop Loss; orders.

  • Basic changing DIVIDENDS mechanism - paid every day.

  • Live CANDLESTICK CHARTS of STOCKS and the FUNEX INDEX.

  • 22 AI FUNDS competing with unique strategies.

  • 18 STOCKS.

  • 9 SECTORS.

  • 1 STOCK INDEX

FUNEX has no unneccessary details. Instead, provides a real market with a real order matching mechanism. But don't think it is a very simple game. Actually, in every VIRTUAL DAY;

  • Up to 4.000 strategy evaluations of AI FUNDS

  • Up to 2.000 real orders send by AI FUNDS

happen. So, it is a TOTAL CHAOS.

How does the game work?

  • 60 seconds of VIRTUAL DAYS.

  • 10 seconds of BREAKS.

  • Day, Week, Month, Year; data calculations and charts.

  • 1-4 NEWS in every virtual day, effective in 1 or 2 virtual days.

  • Up to 100 virtual years of game play.

Why does FUNEX have ORDER BOOK TRADING?

In real markets, you see and trade in an ORDER BOOK. Thats the real mechanism. So, trading with a VIRTUAL PRICE on screen, has no EDUCATIONAL value and is not realistic. With ORDER BOOK TRADING, you BUY and SELL in a simulated real market.

Current FUNEX game does not have other instruments than STOCKS, but still feels far more realistic than other stock market games. Because, they miss the core mechanics of the real markets. STOCK MARKETS work on ORDERS and MATCHING. So, if a game does not have ORDER MATCHING mechanism, it won't feel realistic.

Why does FUNEX have ORDER MATCHING PRICING mechanism of AI TRADERS, in stead of ALGORITHMIC PRICING mechanism?

We are gamers since the late 80's. We know the game history. And we have been playing; simulation, tycoon, strategy, business; games more than last 30 years. There has been very good stock market games. But they were all missing the same thing; REAL SIMULATION of MARKET MECHANISM. Of course, not every game is suitable for such a mechanism. But, if a TRADING GAME is being designed, it has to have a real mechanism.

FUNEX is the game what we really want to play. So, we designed a game which we also will play. Something feels real.

Designing an ALGORITHMIC PRICING mechanism, is much much easier than creating a REAL ORDER MATCHING ENGINE. In order to create a perfect mechanism, we spent very long weeks. The system in FUNEX is a REAL EXCHANGE working in your computer.

In FUNEX, every NEWS change the DIVIDENDS of; whole MARKET, whole SECTOR or single STOCK. Some AI FUNDS trade NEWS or DIVIDENDS with different strategies. Some others don't care about NEWS or DIVIDENDS, but they trade the CHART. Some are DAY TRADERS. Some are SCALPERS. Some are looking for LOW LIQUDITY to trade and there are other strategies of different 22 AI FUNDS.

Also, LIQUIDITY or STOCK BALANCE of AI FUNDS also effect their tradings. If the market is full of STOCKS in their pockets, what happens if a GOOD NEWS comes? No movement right? Even, some will sell to the fresh buyers. Like real markets. Or, does an OVERSOLD MARKET have much more selling pressure with BAD NEWS? Not much. Right?

AI STRATEGIES on a REAL ORDER BOOK with REAL TRANSACTIONS create a very realistic simulation. A REAL EXCHANGE working on your computer.

FUNEX has a very REAL feeling. It is because of the core game mechanics. Only ALGORITMIC parts of the game are; NEWS generation with DIVIDEND effects and AI DECISIONS.

If you expect to make money by just buying the highest dividend or good news, FUNEX may have surprises for you. Because, AI FUNDS are all PROFIT MINDED and are ready to crash your positions. They hate loosing money. This is not your grandmothers easy any stock market simulation.

FUNEX is a DEMAND/SUPPLY game, affected by NEWS and DIVIDENDS; but also, TECHNICAL ANALYSIS and INTRADAY TREND. So, CHAOS is big like real markets. There is no guaranteed strategy to make money. And, any working strategy, may not work as the game evolves. Like real markets.

Why arent't there STARTING CASH options for; EASY, NORMAL, HARD; level optimisation?

Markets are different for different sizes of cash. Like in the real life, you have a minimum cash to trade, which has almost no effect in prices. At the same time, you have no liquidity problem. You BUY or SELL what you want, as your order sizes are small. Market provides you, what you want.

But, as if you grow your money, like 10X, you will see that you will have effect on prices; at the same time, it will be harder to BUY or SELL your positions. Because, in FUNEX; if you are going to BUY, there should be enough SELLERS. Or vice versa. (Or, you drive prices to BUY or SELL what you want. But be careful, driving the price generally results with loss. AI FUNDS in FUNEX are not fools. They will take advantage of the opportunity.)

If you make 100X of your starting cash, congratulations! But now, you have to be a MARKET MAKER in order to BUY or SELL. Because, LIQUIDITY won't be enough for you. (In other simulations, you send an order as big as %10 market cap of a stock and it is instantly filled without changing the price. In FUNEX, if you drive the prices, sellers may not sell and wait for you to drive prices more.)

As your cash grows, now you are the MARKET MAKER or even the BIG BOSS of the market. And things really get harder as you grow.

Why do you think they always drive stock markets to balloon levels in real life? Because, BIG MONEY has LIQUIDITY problems. In FUNEX, you will also feel that liquidity problem as your portfolio grows..

Basicly, in the beginning, you are in EASY LEVEL, because your CASH is low.

As your CASH is 10X, now you can consider that it is NORMAL LEVEL as your CASH is medium.

If your CASH is 100X, it is the HARD LEVEL - which you may enjoy first - as you drive prices very easy - but then you may crash your computer; as you may easily loose money. (Please don't harm your computer. Just be calm and try to trade better.)

Why does FUNEX looks simple?

Actually, it is not simple. We could have developed a very detailed game without a real market mechanism. And it would be like other games. Instead, we developed something real. Up to 40.000 strategy checks every minute, is something really detailed actually.

But, we will develop this game every year and we will publish more detailed versions. As of course - we won't use ALGORITMIC PRICING - it needs very long time to optimise the new markets. (Like Funex 2, Funex 3...etc. But, older games won't be absolute. Because, we will suggest every new player to start with the first game. Because, Funex is not just a game, it is also a TRAINING SIMULATOR.)

What we plan is, to create the FOOTBALL MANAGER of STOCK MARKET SIMULATION GAMES.

Why doesn't FUNEX have more STOCKS or AI FUNDS?

Currently, we are talking about 20.000 strategy checks per minute. It makes, including the break, close to 2.000.000 checks per hour. In stead of increasing the STOCKS and AI FUNDS number, we are actually focused on additional details for the game. As different markets in future versions come, we may see 1.000.000 strategy checks per minute. Of course, there will be more AI FUNDS. But, we plan to hold STOCK numbers low. Think about, a future version checks 1.000.000 times per minute and then we decide to make it 1000 stocks? You will need a super computer. (With an Algoritmic price mechanism, it is possible. But, with REAL ORDER MATCHING system, it needs very strong computers.)

Also, as we test the game, even checking 22 STOCKS is not an easy job. Because, FUNEX is a very fast game. So, you won't feel like needing more stocks.

We tried to hold everything simple in order to use the processor efficiently. In such detailed simulations, optimisation is very important. And for future versions, its a safe base.

How long has FUNEX been tested?

We have been testing the game more than 100 playing hours. We created a game to enjoy. So, we also continuously play it. Current version is completely bug free and last version. But, if a problem occurs, we will update it.

FUNEX is for which gamers?

Actually, this game has a great EDUCATIONAL VALUE. If you have children interested in with financial markets, teach them to play FUNEX. User interface is easy for even a children. This will be first step to be a good TRADER. And, as the future versions evolve, you will teach more.

Even if you are an adult or even if you are a market professional, you will still enjoy the game and it also has EDUCATIONAL VALUE for you too. We are market professionals and it even teachs us. (For example, we were mostly of MARKET ORDER guys in real life. After this game, we mostly send LIMITED ORDERS. This game changed our trading style.)

Who designed FUNEX?

FUNEX was designed by ARIEL BURAK KAPLAN. He is a/an; economist, stock market expert, technical analyst, political analyst and a life time gamer. This game is work of a real stock market expert. He has an experience of more than 30 years in financial markets.

FUNEX was designed in TURKEY. Which is probably the WILDEST market in the world with continuous CRISIS and KILLER VOLATILITY. So, CRISIS is our life. And our EXCHANGE is the HARDEST one. We are not from CHILDRENS PARK. We are from WILD LIFE.

Do you have any plans for more games other than FUNEX?

Yes! Sales volume will determine our time allocation for new games. We have more than 100+ game ideas. So, any game you buy, will create time for us to build new games. And, all of them will have new and unseen game mechanics.
