store_data.about_the_game:
Phylactery Slayer is a 2D action roguelike where every pixel of the world is destructible and death is just the beginning. No sprites. No indestructible tiles. Every wall, every ceiling, every surface is excavatable at the atomic level. Carve tunnels, open impossible shortcuts, bury your enemies alive.

You play a cursed hunter whose body is a cluster of particles that bounces, stretches, and crushes against the world. Your mind is the phylactery, an artifact that remembers what you forget when you die, transferring power to your next life.

Four game modes. One dungeon that remembers everything.

CORE FEATURES

Fully destructible pixel-by-pixel world. Every wall has a bitmask. The terrain remembers what you broke.

Five digging tools: free chisel, wide chisel, pickaxe, ramp, and staircase. Sculpt your own path or use it as a trap against other players.

Liquids with real cellular automata physics. Water, acid, and magma flow, fall, and fill containers.

Three playable classes with sixteen base spells. Forge system: combine two spells plus runes and gems to generate thousands of unique forged spells with non-linear stats.

Four procedural dungeon styles: organic caves via cellular automata, classic rectangular ruins, Castlevania-style linear corridors, volcanic grid mazes. Each biome is structurally distinct.

Fifteen enemy types and ten unique bosses with three phases each.

Permadeath with purpose. Essence persists between runs. Artifacts persist. Purchased talents persist. Death is a step, not an end.

Interactive bestiary with animated technical sheets, talent tree with one hundred talents per class, full spell codex.

Unique render based on pure particles, no sprites. An aesthetic unlike anything else.

EXPLORATION MODE (Single Player)

The solitary dungeon. You against the world and against yourself. The pure roguelike: no connection, no lag, no distractions. You delve through procedural dungeons on your own, discover every enemy, defeat every boss, master forged spells.

Pure permadeath with meta-progression via essence and artifacts. Access to all classes, talents, and forged spells. Your own pace: pause, map, escape whenever you want. Interactive bestiary and full spell codex.

For you if you love Hades, Dead Cells, or any classic roguelike and seek individual mastery.

TEAM MODE (Co-op for 2-4 players)

The shared dungeon. What we break, we break together. Pure co-op with no invasions. You and up to three friends cross the same dungeon. The team phylactery is shared. The death of a teammate does not end the run; survivors can revive you by spending essence.

Essence and loot shared between the team. Forged spells can combine ingredients from multiple players. Tactical roles: tank, caster, digger, sniper. No invasions ever, a safe space for pure coordination. Integrated voice chat and tactical pings.

For you if you want real cooperative co-op and just want to explore in peace, distribute roles, build synergistic loadouts.

WORLD MODE (Co-op plus PvP Invasion)

The open dungeon. Your team isn't the only thing alive in there. The flagship mode of the game.

Cooperative co-op just like Team Mode, but your dungeon is connected to the cross-server pool. At any moment, another team of up to four players can invade your run with their own builds, their own forged spells, and a single objective: kill you and steal your loot.

Asymmetric contextual PvP. Defenders know the map and have resources, but they're worn down from the PvE. Invaders enter fresh with full HP and optimized builds, but blind to the state of the world.

Intelligent matchmaking. The game decides when to offer you as a target based on your HP, accumulated gold, depth reached, and difficulty relative to the available invader pool. No getting invaded constantly.

Rewards. If defenders survive the invasion: double essence and a guaranteed rare artifact. If invaders eliminate the defending team: the loot from their entire run plus access to the next biome. In case of timeout draw, both sides lose something small.

Counter-mechanic. The Sealing Phylactery, a rare item, grants five minutes of invasion immunity. For sessions when you just want to explore in peace.

For you if you crave Dark Souls invasion tension but in a team. You enjoy high stakes and emergent stories.

ARENA MODE (Competitive PvP, 1v1, 2v2 and 4v4)

Zero PvE. Zero procedural dungeon. Your build versus theirs, that's it. The dedicated competitive space.

Pre-designed arenas, also destructible, with three layouts: small, medium, and large. Three game modes available. Duel: 1v1 combat, three minutes, focused on pure build mastery. Pair: 2v2, five minutes, focused on duo synergy. Skirmish: 4v4, seven minutes, focused on team strategy.

Pre-built loadout: you bring two forged spells and one gear set. The talents and class books of your meta-progressed character apply. Arenas are destructible: you can carve cover, open flanks, seal off passages. Liquids and environmental traps active. Best-of-three rounds in Duel, single round in Pair and Skirmish.

Ranked competitive MMR system and casual queues. Five ranks: Bronze, Silver, Gold, Diamond, Immortal. Cosmetic rewards per season including custom skeletons, palettes, and banners. Global and regional leaderboards.

For you if you love fighting games, MOBAs, or competitive shooters. You want to test your builds against human minds without PvE friction.

Pure permadeath with meta-progression via essence and artifacts. Access to all classes, talents, and forged spells. Your own pace: pause, map, escape whenever you want. Interactive bestiary and full spell codex.

For you if you love Hades, Dead Cells, or any classic roguelike and seek individual mastery.

TEAM MODE (Co-op for 2-4 players)

The shared dungeon. What we break, we break together. Pure co-op with no invasions. You and up to three friends cross the same dungeon. The team phylactery is shared. The death of a teammate does not end the run; survivors can revive you by spending essence.

Essence and loot shared between the team. Forged spells can combine ingredients from multiple players. Tactical roles: tank, caster, digger, sniper. No invasions ever, a safe space for pure coordination. Integrated voice chat and tactical pings.

For you if you want real cooperative co-op and just want to explore in peace, distribute roles, build synergistic loadouts.

WORLD MODE (Co-op plus PvP Invasion)

The open dungeon. Your team isn't the only thing alive in there. The flagship mode of the game.

Cooperative co-op just like Team Mode, but your dungeon is connected to the cross-server pool. At any moment, another team of up to four players can invade your run with their own builds, their own forged spells, and a single objective: kill you and steal your loot.

Asymmetric contextual PvP. Defenders know the map and have resources, but they're worn down from the PvE. Invaders enter fresh with full HP and optimized builds, but blind to the state of the world.

Intelligent matchmaking. The game decides when to offer you as a target based on your HP, accumulated gold, depth reached, and difficulty relative to the available invader pool. No getting invaded constantly.

Rewards. If defenders survive the invasion: double essence and a guaranteed rare artifact. If invaders eliminate the defending team: the loot from their entire run plus access to the next biome. In case of timeout draw, both sides lose something small.

Counter-mechanic. The Sealing Phylactery, a rare item, grants five minutes of invasion immunity. For sessions when you just want to explore in peace.

For you if you crave Dark Souls invasion tension but in a team. You enjoy high stakes and emergent stories.

ARENA MODE (Competitive PvP, 1v1, 2v2 and 4v4)

Zero PvE. Zero procedural dungeon. Your build versus theirs, that's it. The dedicated competitive space.

Pre-designed arenas, also destructible, with three layouts: small, medium, and large. Three game modes available. Duel: 1v1 combat, three minutes, focused on pure build mastery. Pair: 2v2, five minutes, focused on duo synergy. Skirmish: 4v4, seven minutes, focused on team strategy.

Pre-built loadout: you bring two forged spells and one gear set. The talents and class books of your meta-progressed character apply. Arenas are destructible: you can carve cover, open flanks, seal off passages. Liquids and environmental traps active. Best-of-three rounds in Duel, single round in Pair and Skirmish.

Ranked competitive MMR system and casual queues. Five ranks: Bronze, Silver, Gold, Diamond, Immortal. Cosmetic rewards per season including custom skeletons, palettes, and banners. Global and regional leaderboards.

For you if you love fighting games, MOBAs, or competitive shooters. You want to test your builds against human minds without PvE friction.

store_data.about_the_game:
Descend. Forge. Remember.

ECHORIS is a 2D side-scrolling metroidvania set deep within a vertical megastructure built by giants who no longer remember why. Drop level by level through forgotten corridors. Fight what was left behind. Reforge the weapons you find — until  the shaft itself bends to your will.

Explore the Shaft

The world is one vast vertical structure, half-built and half-ruined. Unlock relics that reshape how you move — dash through narrow gaps, walljump across fissures, breathe in poisoned water, slip through shadow. Every gate is locked behind a stat or an ability, and every path leads somewhere deeper.

Every Weapon Hides a World

Each blade carries a voice — the Ego of the soul who once wielded it. Step inside any weapon to enter its Item World. Descend the Memory Strata. Defeat the bosses that guard each layer. Reclaim  the Memory Shards they leave behind, slot them into your weapon's Identity, and listen as its voice grows clearer. Five Temperaments — Forge, Iron, Rust, Spark, Shadow — shape what kind of soul each blade becomes. No two weapons will ever grow the same way.

Worlds That React

Water flows. Oil spreads. Fire spreads further. Lightning leaps between conductors. Frost crawls  across pools. Every floor is a chemistry set, and every weapon is a way to disturb it. Throw a flask of oil into a torchlit corridor and watch it run. Slash a water-vase above an electrified pool. The room becomes a tactic.

Emergent Systems

  • Five elemental temperaments combine with terrain, fluids, and enemy weaknesses in ways the designer never scripted

  • Procedural dungeons stitched from handcrafted rooms, never the same twice

  • Item World runs reward both efficient builds and obsessive completionists

Descend Together (In Development)

The deeper Item Worlds were never meant to be faced alone. Cooperative descent is planned for a post-launch update — friends in the same blade, the same strata, the same fall.

Made For

  • Players who love interconnected, gate-locked 2D exploration

  • Loot hunters who chase endless depth and weapon mastery

  • Anyone drawn to vast vertical worlds and the silence left by lost civilizations

The shaft remembers you. Your weapons remember more.

store_data.about_the_game:
Encroached is a strategy game where you defend your villages by a building a defence. For each village you lose, the enemy borders encroach and their numbers increase for the next battle. To build your defence, you are given a fixed number of decisions before each battle.

The game's core strategic element lies in slowing down the enemy enough to survive the last battle.

  • You are only given a fixed number of choices before each battle. There is no gold based economy.

  • 8 different unit types to rally - swordsmen, archers, guerillas, etc.

  • 8 structure types to bolster the defence - towers, fences, traps, etc.

  • 16 different modifiers that you can play on any turn to tilt the scales in your favour.

You already know what to do... ;)

store_data.about_the_game:
You open your eyes to the smoking wreckage of your spaceship. Your suits only have a couple minutes of oxygen left. All around you is an alien planet, dominated by steep cliffs, floating islands, and seemingly-bottomless chasms.

To survive, place down ropes to scale the terrain around you, carefully choosing your own path across the planet. Refill your oxygen from glowing alien flowers and continue upward. Revive your crewmate when they fall.

Features

  • 3 distinct biomes, from a lush forest to wind-swept pilars of rock, up to ominous islands that float upside-down in the highest reaches of the atmosphere

  • 6 alien lifeforms, with journal notes and observations revealed as you study each one

  • Play as 2 distinct characters: the Engineer, excellent at building platforms and long ropes, and the Pilot, a daredevil with a jetpack and double jump

  • Online co-op, with the ability to save your progress at any point

  • An infinite supply of ropes! Place them strategically, make daring midair throws, or cover every inch of the map

Trailer music by Roberto Quispe

store_data.about_the_game:
Colony of the Forsaken is a survival colony sim about trying to keep a small group of villagers alive long enough to turn a rough camp into a place that can survive.

During the day, you gather resources, expand the village, cook, farm, build, explore, and prepare for nightfall. You can search enemy camps, uncover hidden places, and bring back loot that helps the colony grow, including spell recipes your villagers can learn and use. The idea is simple: use the daylight well, because the night will test whatever you built.

Maps and starting villagers are procedurally generated, so each run begins a little differently. You are not starting from the exact same situation every time.

At night, enemy waves attack your base. That is where your defenses, preparation, and villagers really matter. If you hold the line, morning gives you a chance to recover, collect rewards from the enemies you defeated, and sometimes recruit new villagers.

Instead of controlling a single villager, you manage multiple of them. Each one has their own attributes, skills, needs, spells and long-term growth. They need food, water, rest, and care if you want them working well. Over time, they improve in skills like building, mining, cooking, fishing, farming, alchemy, and spellcasting. If a villager dies, they are gone for good.

You can also tame animals and keep them as part of the farm, and they reproduce naturally over time.

One of the main things I want to push in Colony of the Forsaken is the spell system. Villagers learn spells through recipes found in night loot and through exploration, and each villager can carry up to five spells. That means the colony changes over time based on who survives, what they learn, and how you choose to use them.

Colony of the Forsaken is still in development, and I want to be honest about that. I am still building and improving it. What matters most to me right now is getting the core loop right: build during the day, survive the night, and make every villager feel important.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Therapist Will See You Now

Dark Thoughts is a bullet heaven about fighting the literal dark thoughts inside your head. You pick a damaged hero, wield their trauma as their weapon and ability, and take an arsenal into a domain of dread; apathy, grief, anger, hate, shame, fear. They all await. Survive long enough and you'll be forced to face the heavy hitters of trauma head-on.

Twelve Heroes, None of Them Stable

  • DJ Introverto: Never leaves his fortress. Crippling anxiety will do that to you. 

  • Sr. Shitposter: Spent years radicalizing senior citizens online and his family at home. All he’s got to show for it is panic attacks.

  • PorkiPanda the Influencer: A pathological liar. But it’s a feature not a bug. It pays off in spades as a slimy Influencer.

  • Kar Krash Karen: was rear-ended into a rage disorder at a red light and ever since has been in suburban samurai training thanks to tutorials online.

  • Danny Doomscroller: his dad let him get online way too young, now he spreads conspiracies in Discord all day. But finally those FPS skills can shine! 

  • Psycho L. Bin: she’s a hallucinogenic enthusiast that has acquired devastating mental abilities but they came at a cost. 

  • Stikipanda: He’s driven by the rage that consumes him, with a brother like Porki it’s not a surprise he’s unhinged. 

  • Short King: aka Li’l Sane is Karen’s offspring and protege, his blade isn’t as long but his bitterness makes it cut very deep. 

  • Sin Bin: like her twin sister she is also mentally gifted but she earned her powers the old school way she signed a deal with the Devil. 

  • NYX91: is the updated Technomancer model and is built for this. But it also records every kill and is coded to analyze them incessantly.

  • SE7EN11: was replaced by the updated Technomancer model and was left out to pasture, now its devotion goes unnoticed and outbursts are frequent.

  • Plaxico: is a dyslexic subterranean hellhound that loves to hunt but gets bored easily. 

Nine Domains of the Diagnosis

Each map is a mental battlefield, with a host of hostiles and with dark thoughts flying from all directions you’ll be hard pressed to complete each maps duration. 

  • Apathetica: the land of apathy, doze off at your own discretion as that’s when the dark thoughts make their move. 

  • Gala of Grief: where dreams go to die as evident by the sea of decay. Death patrols this land with laser focus.

  • Ragebait Ridge: the place you go to deal with loss. You can rage all you want, it’s never coming back. 

  • Loathe Land: not the place you want to reside as hate is everywhere and loathing isn’t good for the skin. 

  • The Hole In My Heart: heartbreak is never easy, it takes time to heal and you need to evolve to move forward. 

  • Shame Spiral Street: a rundown pocket of the city that is beyond shameful. 

  • Fearmonger Farm: if you get dropped off here you’ll be eating crow. But don’t be afraid, they’ll eat you too. 

  • Voices In Your Head: they sit up there and judge you, tear you down but all you need to do is stand strong. 

  • Dystopia: the hardest map is also the most inevitable one, our downfall is your downfall. 

Afflictions Become Your Weapons

Each hero comes equipped with afflictions that turn into a weapon and ability when on the battlefield. Leveraging their afflictions to battle the mental anguish is how you take control and evolve. Max out their afflictions and they’ll evolve into a powerful God-like combo. But how your Heroes progress is up to you, you make the choices in the end so it’s all on you. 

A Clinical Journal of Failure

Every run you’ll find both sanity and happiness. Sanity will keep you alive but happiness is deeper than that. You need to collect happiness and then administer it between runs. Applying happiness to your Mental Health is imperative to your long-term success. Keep an eye on your Case File to ensure you’re progressing positively and with over 100+ accolades to keep you chasing your therapists adoration. 

An Album You Earn and Keep

Alongside the game Dark Thoughts there’s also a full-length 15 track album by the creator, Pastor Fussycat. Pastor is a long-time music producer and has been releasing music for many years. For Dark Thoughts he went back into his discography and remixed his best mentally-anguished songs specifically for this game. He then crafted a new lead track to spearhead the album appropriately titled Dark Thoughts.

But, the only way to unlock the entire album for download for free?

Complete all 10 maps in the game. 

Coming Q4 2026

Please Wishlist!

Complete all 10 maps in the game.

The art style uses stylized black-and-white horror illustration with distorted faces and unsettling figures, to represent these internal states. There is no blood, gore, sexual content or realistic violence. Combat is against abstract/monstrous enemies. The game contains disturbing imagery and explores mental health themes in a non-graphic, metaphorical way.

store_data.about_the_game:
Who says desktop pets can only be cute and cuddly? We’re going to cram a hardcore, deep, pocket-sized dungeon right onto the edge of your screen!

Desktop Dungeon: Abyss Squad is a quirky genre-blend that perfectly fuses side-scrolling action, idle progression, and desktop pet interaction.

We know how exhausting daily life can be, and nobody has the energy for high-intensity, soul-crushing grinds in traditional mazes anymore. So, why not let "Little Triangle" take over a small corner of your PC screen? It will lead you into a subterranean animal kingdom full of conspiracies, hacking and slashing in the background to farm monsters and loot epic gear for you—turning your desktop into an epic underground adventure of danger and plunder!

Desktop-Level Multiplayer: Screen-Crossing Team-Ups & Mass Clears

Who says desktop pets are just for solo play? The new version officially introduces multiplayer functionality!

  • One-Click Cross-Screen Party: Invite your friends' desktop pets to "cross over the screen" and enter your dungeon with a single click.

Gear & Visual Transmog System: Ever-Changing Characters, Zero Visual Boredom

Tired of looking at the same old thing after idling for too long? We’ve implemented a seamless character-switching and gear visual transmog system:

  • Real-Time Visual Gear: Every piece of epic gear, helmet, or armor you drop can be genuinely "worn," changing your character's appearance in real time.

An Armory of Hundreds of Weapons: Sit Back and Watch the Chaos Unfold

  • Unique Idle Combat Styles: Don't worry about idling being boring. When the game sits on your desktop, different weapon types will completely shift the visual flow and style of the combat.

Scheming Animal Factions: No Allies, Only Interests

Deep underground, several massive factions of native subterranean animals have been fighting in the shadows for centuries over core energy resources. When you, an abrupt adventurer, break their silence, how will you respond to these formidable foes? Venture deep into the most perilous chasms, where legendary treasures await in the dark!

The pitch-black underground caves are waiting for the very first ray of outside light. Add Desktop Dungeon: Abyss Squad to your Wishlist now and unlock the ultimate desktop slacking combo!

store_data.about_the_game:
Build Your Chess Legacy

Grand Chess Manager: Road to Grandmaster is a chess career and club management simulation where your success is shaped by much more than the next move on the board.

Create your player, begin your journey in the chess world, enter tournaments, improve your skills, and fight your way toward the grandmaster title. At the same time, you are responsible for building a serious chess club: developing players, hiring coaches, managing transfers, balancing finances, upgrading facilities, and making decisions that can define an entire career.

This is a game about long-term progression, pressure, planning, and ambition. Every match matters, but so does every decision you make away from the board.

Create and Develop Your Player

Start your career by creating your own chess player and shaping their path over time. Improve key chess abilities such as opening knowledge, tactics, strategy, calculation, positional understanding, middlegame play, and endgame technique.

Your player’s form, motivation, confidence, stamina, and mental strength all affect performance. A strong career is not built in one tournament. It is built through training, preparation, recovery, and the ability to keep improving after both victories and defeats.

Compete in a Living Chess World

Enter tournaments, climb the rankings, chase ELO milestones, and work your way from smaller events toward major international stages. Follow results, rivalries, news, world rankings, player stories, and important moments across the chess world.

Tournaments are not just isolated matches. They are opportunities to earn money, reputation, experience, and titles. Choose carefully where to compete, how to prepare, and when to take risks.

Manage Your Chess Club

Your club is the foundation of your long-term success. Build a squad, follow player development, manage morale, and decide who deserves a place in your future plans.

Scout promising talent, sign players, handle transfer offers, negotiate salaries, and strengthen your squad season by season. A successful club needs more than one star. It needs depth, structure, and a plan.

Train, Hire Coaches, and Improve Facilities

Hire coaches to improve different areas of your players’ game. Use training systems, tactics puzzles, opening study, endgame work, and long-term development plans to turn potential into results.

Upgrade facilities such as the training complex, youth academy, analysis center, health center, tournament hall, and admin building. Better facilities can improve training speed, youth development, match learning, stamina, sponsorship income, and tournament organization.

Handle the Business Side of Chess

Prize money alone will not keep your club alive. Manage salaries, coach wages, facility maintenance, sponsorship deals, tournament costs, and monthly income.

A bold investment can accelerate your growth, but poor financial planning can create pressure fast. Decide when to spend, when to save, and when the future of the club is worth the risk.

Make Decisions On and Off the Board

You will face more than match results. Player morale, sponsor pressure, transfer opportunities, media attention, academy prospects, facility projects, and unexpected events can all change the direction of your career.

A stronger coach may improve development. A new facility may shape the next generation. A risky tournament may bring prize money and reputation, or expose your weaknesses. Every choice has a cost.

Road to Grandmaster

Grand Chess Manager: Road to Grandmaster is for players who enjoy chess, sports management, career progression, and strategic decision-making.

Train carefully. Spend wisely. Build your club. Trust your players. Chase the grandmaster title and create a chess legacy that lasts.

store_data.about_the_game:
Trebuchet Simulator is a physics simulation game where you control a massive siege engine that fires a metal ball. Adjust your mechanical parameters to launch devastating projectiles and destroy the enemy castle to win.

To breach these fortresses, you’ll need to master the math of momentum. Keep a close eye on the castle's life bar, step up to the configuration panel, and calibrate your machine to deliver maximum kinetic devastation. Will your projectile soar gracefully over the battlements, or will a poorly calculated arm send your metal ball crashing into the dirt? The math is in your hands.

Key Features

  • Complete Physics Customization: Fine-tune the anatomy of your trebuchet. Adjust the length of the long arm, short arm, sling, weight arm, and the overall height of the pivot.

  • Mass & Trajectory Tuning: Balance the heavy counterweight mass against your metal projectile's mass, then dial in the base angle and release angle to find the perfect destructive arc.

  • Real-Time Feedback: Track your siege progress with an on-screen castle life bar UI that reacts to every shattering impact.

  • Tailored User Experience: Play your way. Choose your preferred measurement units (meters, feet, or inches) and scale the configuration panel UI to perfectly fit your screen.

store_data.about_the_game:
In a world shattered by the Void's invasion,

the counterattack begins from the Demon Castle, the last refuge standing at the edge of ruin.

Demon Ark is an idle build RPG built around endless experimentation and proof through battle.

Dispatch your heroes, face your limits, and redesign the perfect party.

■ You Design. Your Heroes Prove It.

Expeditions and battles play out automatically. But victory itself is not automatic.

Which jobs to combine, and which hero should carry which gear, is entirely up to you.

Review the results, find what went wrong, and rebuild your party for the next attempt.

■ Jobs Have No Hard Limits

Experiment with countless combinations created by 14 main jobs and 14 sub-jobs.

Give fragile damage dealers the survivability they need, or turn support heroes into the core of your battle plan.

Build a stable party with proven combinations, or complete your own strange setup that no one else would think of.

■ How Do I Use This Weird Gear?

Randomized gear options can be ordinary, surprising, or just plain confusing.

But in Demon Ark, no option is meant to be thrown away.

Even the strangest piece of gear can become a core item that unlocks your party's potential once you find the right hero and sub-job for it.

Read the gear, discover the fit, and create a new build.

■ Make Each Auto Expedition Safer and Faster

Check who fell first, which enemy stopped your party, and whether your farming speed is good enough.

Build a party that survives longer, or push farming efficiency with specialized gear setups in dungeons you have already stabilized.

store_data.about_the_game:
Panzer Island is a pixel anime-styled top-down strategy game with a reactive turn system: nothing moves until you do, and every step counts.

You play as Erika, a scientist who wakes on a ruined island with no memory and three AI military units who only half-remember her. Guide them across drone-patrolled battlefields while fragmented logs and quiet conversations piece together the truth about what happened here.

Move freely with no time pressure. Drones react to every step and attack, plan your route, use terrain, and reach your objective with as much HP as you can spare. Upgrade your units between missions. Unlock the story.

Chapters 1-3 are available now. Chapter 1 (10 stages) is free.

A strategy game about consequences.

Panzer Island is a 2D top-down strategy game built around a single mechanic: every step triggers a reaction. Autonomous drones patrol the battlefield and attack the moment a unit enters their detection range, not at the end of a round, but after each individual movement step. Sprint through open ground and you'll arrive at the objective with half your HP gone. Thread through cover and you might make it clean. The route you choose is the decision.

Three units. One scientist. No memories.

You command three AI soldiers: Katyusha (tank), Nadeshiko (helicopter), and Maria (ship). They were factory-reset in the same catastrophe that took Erika's memory. They don't know what happened. Neither do you. Logs scattered across the battlefield, and fragments of dialogue between missions, add up to a story that the game does not explain for you, you put it together yourself.

Key features:

  • Reactive turn system: move freely with no time pressure; drones react to each step

  • Three distinct units with different move profiles, HP, and combat roles

  • Skill progression: upgrade units between missions with earned XP

  • Original anime character art and pixel-art battlefields

  • Story told through dialogue cutscenes between stages

  • English, Japanese, and German localizations included

  • Chapters 1-3 available now (30 stages); Chapter 1 (10 stages) free; full game planned at 5 chapters, 3 endings

Legend of Warrior Mage Taoist Game Introduction

Legend of Warrior Mage Taoist is an exciting side-scrolling action adventure game featuring classic class systems. Step into the role of famous Three Kingdoms generals, slay monsters on ancient bamboo battlefields, and embark on an exhilarating journey filled with fluid combats and thrilling battles!

Core Gameplay: Exciting Stages & Nonstop Combat Fun

Smooth Side-Scrolling Combat

Control Zhao Yun wielding a spear to move freely and dash across bamboo battlefields. Defeat foes with sharp spear attacks, and chain dodges, basic strikes and skills seamlessly to unleash stunning combos. Feel powerful combat impacts and experience the heroic thrill of fighting fearlessly on the battlefield.

Unlock Powerful Skills Gradually

Unlock formidable skills as you level up, ranging from single-target thrusts to full-screen AOE attacks with gorgeous visual effects. Mix different skills to defeat hordes of enemies and massive bosses, and create diverse combat styles.

Stage Challenges and Boss Fights

Start your journey from bamboo forest stages and conquer countless levels. Face various opponents including ordinary soldiers and huge corrupted bosses. Each stage features unique terrains and enemy layouts. Boss battles test your positioning and skill timing to push your gaming skills to the limit.

Featured Systems: Diverse Progression & Rich Content

All-Round Character Development

Four core development systems are available: equipment, skills, martial souls and spirit pets. Upgrade gear to raise combat power, enhance skills for stronger effects, activate martial souls for attribute bonuses, and summon spirit pets to fight alongside you. Two additional distinctive characters are waiting to be unlocked for brand-new combat experiences.

Rewarding Draws and Welfare Systems

Obtain rare martial souls, spirit pets and crafting materials through special gacha gameplay. Daily sign-ins, limited events and quests offer abundant resources to boost your strength steadily, allowing free-to-play players to enjoy smooth gaming progress easily.

Traditional Chinese Martial Arts Style

Enjoy ink-style bamboo landscapes and silhouette-style character designs. Skill effects embody traditional oriental aesthetics. Passionate battle sounds and unique character designs perfectly restore ancient battlefield vibes, bringing you an immersive heroic gaming experience.

Gaming Experience

In Legend of Warrior Mage Taoist, you will fight bravely as a renowned ancient general and defeat all enemies with exquisite combat moves. Experience pure joy of side-scrolling action games through smooth combos and thrilling boss duels. Abundant development systems help you grow stronger continuously and evolve from a rookie warrior into an invincible battlefield legend. More characters and interesting contents are ready for you to explore. Join now and start your glorious legendary adventure!

store_data.about_the_game:
Gridiron Football GM is a deep American football management simulation. Run the front office of a pro football franchise. Build a dynasty across decades. Make every roster decision, every cap call, every trade, every draft pick. Then call every play before the snap. You are not the quarterback. You are the front office.

The GM Loop

Every season is a full cycle. Hire coordinators and position coaches. Scout a procedurally generated college class. Run a seven-round draft against AI general managers who play the cap, the depth chart, and the trade market with the same competence you do. Build your roster through free agency with salary-cap math that constrains the AI as much as it constrains you. Restructure contracts. Hit the franchise tag. Manage dead money. Negotiate restricted free agency. Play the compensatory pick game. Trade with opposing GMs whose AI evaluates every asset by team-specific

positional value, surplus and need. Find the deals where both sides come out ahead. Watch the AI counter-offer when you lowball. Then play the season. Every offensive and defensive snap lets you call audibles in a pre-snap menu. You watch the play unfold as a structured trace. Every decision, every spatial outcome, every result. Read it like a box score. Win games. Win the playoffs. Win the championship. Watch a young quarterback you drafted in year one develop into the franchise centerpiece across a decade, then retire into the Hall of Fame.

Do it again. The league lives without you. So does your dynasty.

How It Simulates Football

  • Calibrated to real pro football data.

  • The match engine targets twelve metric slices against real play-by-play statistics. Plays per game, pass rate, completion percentage, yards per carry, sack rate, interception rate, drive outcomes by down and distance, top-tier quarterback completion-over-expected spread. Every band has a published target. Drift is treated as a bug.

  • Deterministic from seed. Same seed produces byte-identical play traces. Replay a season ten times to study a critical fumble. Share a dynasty with a friend by sharing a seed.

  • Procedural names and procedural draft classes.

  • Every league is a fresh universe. Draft classes never get stale. Roster updates are never needed. Generate as many leagues as you want, with as many seasons as you can play.

  • The structured trace.

  • Every play emits a readable log. The formation. The coverage. The spatial anchors. Why the AI called what it called. Where each player ended up. Why the play succeeded or failed. A football-literate player should be able to read the trace alone and explain the game.

Who This Is For

  • Football fans who want a franchise sim where the simulation respects the sport.

  • People who care about scheme fit, coverage shells, and pre-snap decision-making.

  • Players who want a multi-decade dynasty where the league still feels alive in year fifteen.

  • Anyone who values a deterministic, calibrated, one-time-price product without microtransactions or paid roster updates.

store_data.about_the_game:
When Westminster stops believing, the only thing left to vote on is who you'll trust when the doors close.

No Confidence Hearts is an Adult Romance Visual Novel set inside 10 Downing Street during a twelve-week countdown to a cross-bench vote of no confidence that could topple the government—and everyone's career with it. You play as Rupert Aldwyn, the Prime Minister's Director of Political Strategy: calm, surgical, and responsible for keeping the building standing while polling collapses, the lobby circles, and the opposition counts signatures.

Between morning briefings and late-night backchannels, three women enter Rupert's orbit—each with her own power, her own agenda, and her own way of testing what "confidence" really means.

Meet the Cast




Annabel Sheringham — "The Motion"
Conservative Shadow Chief Secretary to the Treasury and the operational architect behind the cross-bench no-confidence push. Polished, formidable, and strategically relentless. She and Rupert share a history neither of them has named in nineteen years, and as the vote approaches, their renewed connection becomes a fault line between duty and desire.



Genevieve Holcombe — "The Lobby"
The Times' Political Editor, embedded in Number 10 to write a definitive series on the government's slow-motion collapse. Years ago, she published a career-defining piece that helped derail Rupert's ambitions. Now she's back with corridor access, an audio recorder, and a talent for asking questions that feel like invitations and indictments at once.



Effie Lockhart — "The Brief"
Rupert's junior Special Adviser—brilliant, fast, and relentlessly precise, treating people and politics like models that return hard probabilities. She brings urgency to the job and a closeness to Rupert that begins as mentorship and threatens to become the most dangerous kind of workplace secret.

Key Features


  • A high-stakes Westminster romance thriller where every conversation is strategy and every relationship has consequences
  • Single-choice romance structure with three distinct routes: The Brief, The Lobby, or The Motion
  • Institutional tension as intimacy—private moments unfolding inside public power
  • Three interlocking calendars of pressure converging on a single devastating vote
  • Each romance route includes explicit adult scenes

Every night, challengers enter the club to take your crown.

In RR, you are the reigning champion of a neon cyberpunk nightclub, defending the dancefloor against escalating waves of rivals through rhythm, movement, and precision.

Move on beat. Survive. Dominate.

Every action must sync to the music. Move, attack, and dash across a deadly grid where timing is everything. Your BPM is both your health and the song’s tempo: hit the rhythm to heal and speed up the music, miss the beat or take damage, and your BPM drops as you weaken.

Chain perfect attacks to build your combo meter and unleash Fever Mode, giving you a short burst of double damage and reduced incoming damage. Defeat enemies to earn EXP and coins, then visit the hidden alley shop to buy permanent and temporary upgrades that shape future runs.

The music gets faster. The enemies get meaner. The dancefloor never stops.

Will you remain the king of the club?

Features

  • Rhythm-based movement and combat where every step, attack, and dash happens on the beat

  • Fast-paced top-down arcade survival with grid-based action and bullet-hell intensity

  • BPM health system, where playing well heals you and accelerates the music

  • Combo-driven Fever Mode for explosive power spikes

  • Coins, EXP, and upgrade choices between runs

  • Permanent and temporary upgrades that change how you survive

  • Escalating enemy waves and music-driven difficulty

  • Neon cyberpunk nightclub atmosphere with pixel-art visuals

Controls

  • WASD — Move on beat

  • E — Dash in the facing direction

  • Shift + WASD — Directional dash

Spirimonz is a game where you hunt evil spirits and capture ghostly companions that will assist you and follow you on every new mission. In a world that blends light horror with a cartoon-inspired atmosphere, explore haunted locations, uncover the types of spirits lurking within them, and banish them before they turn against you...

Spirimonz is a paranormal investigation game in which you explore a small town in third-person view (TPS) and choose which haunted house will become your next mission. Each investigation then takes place in first-person view (FPS), where you must gather clues and identify the evil spirit haunting the location.

To solve each case, search for evidence, study paranormal activity, and make use of your Spirimonz companions. Up to five companions can accompany you at the same time, each offering unique abilities that help you progress through investigations and uncover the identity of the spirit.

Once you have gathered enough clues and are confident in your conclusion, you can attempt to capture the spirit. A successful capture will transform the creature into a new Spirimonz that can join your collection and help you tackle future investigations.

Every successful mission rewards you with money that can be used to unlock new haunted environments, encounter rarer spirits, and expand your team of ghostly companions.

• Explore a small town that serves as your investigation hub.
• Investigate haunted houses and paranormal locations.
• Gameplay that combines third-person exploration with first-person investigations.
• Gather clues and identify different types of evil spirits.
• Capture spirits and turn them into collectible Spirimonz companions.
• Bring up to 5 Spirimonz on each mission.
• Earn money and unlock new locations with greater rewards.
• Discover rare companions and expand your collection.
• A unique blend of light horror and cartoon-inspired visuals.

store_data.about_the_game:
ABOUT THIS GAME

Dead Relay is a first-person retro survival horror game inspired by the PSX era.

You are sent to a remote communication facility after a series of signal failures across the region. The previous technician never returned. The relay is dead, the main doors are sealed, and the building’s systems behave as if someone is still operating them from inside.

At first, your job is simple: restore power, check the lines, open locked doors, and find a way out. But the deeper you go, the clearer it becomes — this is not a normal equipment failure.

The signal is still active.
The system is still listening.
And the man on the phone is not as human as he sounds.

Explore offices, staff rooms, archives, laboratories, cable corridors, and restricted sectors. Search for keys, fuses, codes, tools, and encrypted logs while trying to survive the things being released inside the facility.

FEATURES

  • Retro PSX-inspired horror
    Low-poly environments, grimy photo-based textures, harsh lighting, and old-school survival horror atmosphere.

  • Classic survival horror progression
    Locked doors, codes, fuses, shortcuts, backtracking, limited resources, and environmental puzzles.

  • First-person exploration
    Search the facility room by room, read terminal logs, inspect notes, and piece together what happened.

  • Techno-horror story
    A dead relay station, an unknown signal, digitized consciousness, alien experiments, and a missing technician who became part of the system.

  • Limited combat
    Weapons can help you survive, but they will not make you safe.

  • Atmospheric facility design
    Staff rooms, security areas, server rooms, bio labs, archive rooms, locker rooms, cable tunnels, and sealed sectors.

STORY

You are not a soldier.
You are not a hero.

You are an electrician called to restore a broken relay.

The previous technician left notes behind. The logs mention signal failures, unauthorized commands, and a manual override no one admits using. Doors close by themselves. Incubators open remotely. Terminals display entries that were never typed.

Then the phone rings.

The voice says he wants to help.

But he already belongs to the relay.

store_data.about_the_game:
BAUSFIGHT is the ultimate pixel-art battleground! Dive into a fast-paced, top-down multiplayer arena where survival demands quick reflexes, precise positioning, and mastering unique character classes.

Quick skill based matches

All the adrenaline of a competitive multiplayer game, none of the homework.

WORK IN PROGRESS: Join the Discord server to participate in upcoming closed playtests and shape development!

You can find it in right bottom Socials section

CORE FEATURES

  • Play With or Against Friends/Randoms: Take full control of how you match up. Instantly host your own public or private Steam lobby to settle scores with your crew and other players, or browse and jump into active sessions from the in-game menu to test your skills against randoms.

  • Distinct Character Classes: Play your way. Choose from unique classes featuring specialized active abilities, movement mechanics, and traits to outsmart your opponents.

  • Stylized Cosmetic Loot: Stand out in the arena! Unlock and equip a massive variety of skins, vibrant weapons and charming companion pets.

  • Pure Retro Vibes: Enjoy highly responsive, real-time physics PvP combat wrapped in beautifully stylized pixel art.

GAMEPLAY MODES

  • Three Unique Game Modes: Experience combat across multiple game types:

    • Battle Royale: Fight for survival in up to 24-player elimination matches.

    • The Pits: Engage in high-stakes, rapid, best-of-X skirmishes.

    • Capture the Flag: Coordinate with your team to secure objectives while defending your own base.

  • Flexible Squads & Party Sizes: Queue up completely solo or group up with a squad of up to 4 players. Lobby hosts can fully customize party and team sizes to tailor the match dynamics perfectly.

  • Compare your actual decision against the statistically optimal one
  • See the EV of each alternative action you could have taken

  • Learn from your mistakes without paying for them in your balance

store_data.about_the_game:
Trigger. Rotate. Collect. Find the exit.




Faraday Corridors is a cerebral, minimalist tactical grid puzzle in which you guide one or several pawns through corridors:



- by flipping switches



- by rotating tiles
- by holding down pressure plates,
- sometimes with no way to turn back



Goal: collect every energy cell and reach the exit — first of all...



...then as fast as possible for speedrun fans

40 levels. 4 families of triggers that combine.


For speedrunners, four medals to earn on each level: bronze, silver, gold and platinum.


From the crystal-clear tutorial of Chapter I to the most extreme puzzles, the difficulty ramps up gradually, without ever sacrificing readability.

Key features:


  • 🎯 40 puzzle levels spread across 5 chapters of increasing difficulty

  • 🔄 4 families of triggers that combine : switches, room rotators, pressure plates, single-use switches

  • 👥 Multi-pawn coordination : freely switch between your pawns to combine their paths

  • 🏆 Bronze / silver / gold / platinum medals on every level

  • ⚡ Rush Mode : smooth, accelerated continuous movement to speedrun the solutions you've cracked

  • 💎 Progressive reveal : some levels unveil themselves step by step

  • 💥 Breakable rooms : when the last pawn leaves a cell, it vanishes forever

  • 🎨 Neon Glacial art direction : icy palette, vivid gold accents, procedural electric arcs

  • 🎮 Controller support, optimized for Steam Deck

store_data.about_the_game:
All In Fresh is a game about ingredients.

More precisely, it's a game about what you think you know about ingredients.

The goal is simple: bid on ingredients at the market. Each ingredient has a quality. The quality is hidden. You read the clues, estimate the value, and decide what to pay.

If the decision is still yours to make.

Four players. One table. Everyone bids at the same time. Everyone reveals at the same time. Nobody knows what anyone else offered. Maybe nobody knows what that ingredient is actually worth.

But someone will guess right.

That person usually wins.

You buy ingredients to cook. Two ingredients, one recipe. The higher the quality, the greater the reward.

Some recipes are public. Some recipes are known to exist.

Their formulas are not.

Every successful bid sends a cut into the prize pool.

The pool belongs to whoever places the lowest winning bid in the final round.

So two competing rationalities sit at the same table: bid high enough to get what you want, or bid low enough to take the pool.

These goals tend to contradict each other. How you balance them is your problem.

You can use items to uncover clues. You can watch how your opponents bid. You can choose to double down — when you're certain your read is correct.

Or when you think you're certain.

These two states look identical until the settlement screen.

The ability to judge the true value of something

is worth something everywhere.

A match runs about six to eight minutes.

Long enough to make a lot of money.

Long enough to lose it.

The game contains:

  • Seven ingredient categories, hundreds of specific varieties

  • A hidden quality system

  • Recipes that are public, and recipes that aren't

  • A prize pool everyone at the table wants

  • A doubling mechanic you will probably regret

  • A clue system that will not give you the answer

  • Four possibly real players, all of whom think they read it right

Spend the least. Cook the best.

Good luck. You'll most likely need it.

Good thing this is just a game.

What if it isn't?

store_data.about_the_game:
The Spire of Deny is not merely a rogue-like deck-builder; it is a solitary pilgrimage through the remnants of memory and obsession.

Game Features

"Thought-Friends": Enemies or Echoes?

There are 16 unique "Thought-Friends" inhabiting the Spire. Once vibrant souls, they are now trapped by their own obsessions and absurd rituals, distorted by the fog of oblivion. Defeating them is not your only path. By utilizing the Bestiary to uncover their backgrounds, you may find solutions that transcend simple combat.

Every encounter is laced with dialogue that will either bring a smile to your face or leave you with a lingering sense of melancholy. This dynamic, story-driven interaction transforms the Spire into a grotesque world that is simultaneously cold, warm, and tinged with black humor.

Classless Deck-Building: The Power of "Thought-Cards"

Forget rigid classes. With around 100 cards—centered on "Thought-Cards"—you define the core of your deck. From the traditional "Poison" archetype to the sinister "Vile" build, or even the aggressive "Armor-Piercing" style, the choice is yours. Every deck you build imbues your ascent with a unique soul.

The Dual-Vitality System: A Gamble of Embers and Life

Beyond mere HP, you must manage your scarce supply of "Embers." These are essential for exploring the Spire and act as your bargaining chips against death. You can consume Embers to evade formidable foes or to strengthen your deck. Tread carefully: as you ascend to higher floors, the "Thought-Friends" will grow increasingly ferocious. Every bit of Ember you spend determines how much further you can climb.

A Grotesque World of Wit and Heart

Guided by 25 unique achievements and dual endings, you must uncover the truth behind this freezing structure. The combination of random combat encounters and the dynamic Ember system ensures that every climb is an entirely new experience. Even a seemingly weak foe may become a terrifying threat on the upper floors. Are you prepared to uncover the secret of the "True" ending?

The Lore

In this world, the collective memory—once rich with culture, poetry, and deep human connection—has been sealed away within a monolithic structure known as the "Spire of Deny." You awaken at the base of this freezing tower, the world around you turned to dust. To make matters worse, you find that most of your past has been erased. Your only lead is the solitary, towering Spire that reaches defiantly into the clouds. To reclaim those stolen memories, lost verses, and the profound bonds that once existed, you have no choice but to begin this grueling, solitary ascent.

The Spire, however, is not empty. It is prowling with powerful adversaries distorted by "Oblivion." These monsters are not manifestations of pure evil; they are the "Thought-Friends" who were once vibrant in life but have now become lost in their own obsessions. Having lost their tether to the world outside, they have grown chaotic and aggressive over the long years, doomed to repeat the absurd rituals they cared for most in life, day after day, within the walls of the tower.

If you’re lucky, your new friends might just offer a helping hand—or a secret recipe—to help your little business bloom.

The Garrison

Your base of operations in Sinir. Recruit and manage your heroes, each bringing unique strengths to the battlefield.

Assign heroes to combat parties, send them on gathering expeditions, or let them rest and train. Every decision compounds, small choices today shape a mighty legion tomorrow.

Combat

Your party moves, attacks, and casts spells automatically. Position your team, pick your targets, and let the battle unfold.

Farm resources, collect loot, and strengthen your roster.

Boss Encounters

Each boss comes with their own unique mechanics that will push your squad to its limits. Victory means exclusive loot and bragging rights.

What awaits you:

Party Combat — Assemble groups of heroes and fight monsters automatically 

Gathering — Send heroes to explore Sinir and collect rare resources 

Crafting — Forge weapons, brew potions, and enchant relics 

Progression — Level up, unlock abilities, and gear up your heroes 

Boss Raids — Face colossal enemies guarding the deepest secrets of Sinir 

Idle & Active — Play your way. Rewards come either way.

This is the very first public version of Arcane Idle, built by a single developer in their spare time. Much more is planned, new heroes, regions, crafting systems, story content, and quality-of-life improvements are all on the roadmap.

Your feedback shapes what gets built next. Thank you for being here from the start.

store_data.about_the_game:
Run, jump, swim, dive, climb, wall-run, vault, roll, flip, balance, crouch, crawl, walk, slide, bounce, hang, swing, zipline, and more through hand-crafted and randomly generated locations and challenges for a new experience every time!  Enjoy unlimited, re-playable time trials, races, trick score, tag, hide and seek, hidden objects, mazes, puzzles, and more!

Play together or against each other in localized 2 player challenges!

Explore open worlds with no borders!  Wildlife roaming the landscape with a dynamic weather system of day, night, dawn, dusk, rain, clouds, and fog with the option to turn off scenery or shadows to greatly optimize performance for lower end machines!  Pickup wild edibles and catch small animals to replenish your health and energy!  Hidden objects randomly scattered around every location!

Accumulate Career Points (CP) from winning challenges to unlock new locations.  Collect Attribute Gems (AG) to upgrade your characters speed, strength, endurance, toughness, and intelligence! 

Speed:  Increases movement and tricking

Strength:  Increases jump height and ability to handle higher falls

Endurance:  Gain more energy and oxygen

Toughness:  Heal faster and take less damage from falls

Intelligence:  Acquire more Career Points (CP) per activity completed 

Manage health, energy, and oxygen levels!  If you fall from too high you get hurt, if you sprint for too long you run out of energy, and if you stay underwater for too long you lose oxygen!  Beware of fire, cacti, and lava!  Every action has consequences!

Check your map for the best route to your next checkpoint or use as a non-fast paced, relaxing gameplay method to find hidden objects!

In depth Mayan themed tutorial/training location to teach beginner's how to play the game!

Primarily designed to be played in third person but first-person, look-back, and top-down orthographic point of views are also available!

Customize the appearance of your character!  Skin, eyes, hair, top/bottom clothing, and shoes (Or no shoes!)  Progress and customization is automatically saved!

Many more surprises await as you explore and keep moving forward!

store_data.about_the_game:
Civilization collapsed after a nuclear war. Roads are dead, cities are isolated, and survival depends on those who risk everything to deliver vital resources.

In No Road Home, you play as a former soldier turned apocalypse courier, tasked with reconnecting the last surviving communities — one delivery at a time.

🛻 Your vehicle is the key to survival

The vehicle is more than transport — it's your mobile base. You physically load cargo, and the weight affects fuel consumption, handling, and stability. One mistake on the road can mean losing the entire delivery.

⛽ Fuel decides everything

Gasoline is scarce and turns every decision into a risk. When the tank runs dry, you're forced to explore abandoned buildings and dangerous zones just to survive.

🎯 Brutal and tactical combat

Ammunition is rare. Every bullet counts. Fights against bandits and mutants demand split-second decisions, and retreat is often the only realistic option.

📡 The danger you cannot see

Mutated creatures are nearly invisible, bending light around them. Your radio device emits audio signals when they are close — no UI markers, just sound and instinct.

🌍 The world rebuilds through deliveries

Explore an open world with multiple routes, ambushes, and enemy-controlled zones. Every successful delivery rebuilds bonds between settlements and unlocks essential upgrades.

Inspired by Death Stranding, S.T.A.L.K.E.R., Escape from Tarkov, Mad Max and Pacific Drive, the game combines survival, driving, and tactical combat in a hostile world.

Every road is a risk. Every delivery matters.

store_data.about_the_game:
EVIDENCE is an atmospheric neo-noir detective thriller where you work as a detective inside the corrupt and exhausted Nova City Department.

Investigate murders, narcotics trafficking, underground casinos, disappearances, arson cases, robberies, and strange incidents that slowly begin connecting into something far bigger.

Use evidence, photographs, witness statements, CCTV footage, forensic reports, and your own theories to build cases on an interactive detective board.

In EVIDENCE, there are no “correct markers.”
You decide:

  • which evidence matters

  • who to trust

  • which connections make sense

  • who deserves to be accused

Wrong conclusions destroy cases.
Weak theories leave holes.
And false connections may cost you your career.

But sooner or later, separate investigations begin to overlap.

Archives.
Missing witnesses.
Burned documents.
The same names.
The same people appearing across different cases.
Messages with no sender.
And one strange word that appears more and more often:

FEATURES:

  • Interactive investigation board

  • Non-linear detective gameplay

  • Dynamic evidence connections

  • Secret conspiracy board

  • Atmospheric neo-noir presentation

  • Multiple case outcomes and ratings

  • Wiretap and surveillance systems

  • Psychological investigation flow

  • Corruption, informants, and internal pressure

  • Large interconnected case system

  • Immersive detective workspace simulation

In Nova City, every case leaves a trace.

The only question is —
will you be able to see the whole picture.

A mysterious epidemic is spreading through a world where reality is slowly crumbling.

Explore a hand-drawn, cartoon-style isometric world populated by unsettling creatures.

As students disappear and monsters emerge from human emotions, you must survive, unravel the mystery of the epidemic, and confront the growing darkness within the world of BLIGHTFALL.

Build ability decks, discover enemy weaknesses, and absorb the abilities of defeated foes to evolve your playstyle.

## FEATURES

* A strategic, ability-based combat system that blends timing and quick-time events (QTEs).

* Play as multiple characters with distinct abilities and fighting styles.

* Absorb defeated enemies to unlock new powers and gameplay possibilities.

* Discover hidden enemy weaknesses and complete your encyclopedia.

* Manage your resources and survive in a world in ruins.

* Experience a psychological story centered on revenge, hatred, and the loss of a dear friend.

* Interact with the environment during combat.

* Discover secrets, optional areas, and mysterious events throughout this world.

- The combat system combines deck building with precise timing. Choose your attacks carefully, chain skills, and seize opportunities at the right moment to inflict maximum damage.

Each playable character offers a different approach:

* One focuses on absorbing abilities.

* Another sacrifices health to unleash devastating attacks.

* Yet another specializes in ranged abilities and analyzing enemies.

- There will also be a trinity system: piercing, shield, and aerial attacks that will interact to maximize damage.

store_data.about_the_game:
SAUVE LE SHÉRIF es un jeu de déduction sociale dans un Far West où chaque voix peut te trahir.** Imagine un saloon. Pas n'importe lequel. Deux saloons, en fait — au Nord, au Sud — séparés par une rue poussiéreuse. Tu es là, avec 4 à 9 autres joueurs.

Quelqu'un parmi vous est le shérif. Quelqu'un parmi vous veut sa peau. Et toi ? Tu sais ce que tu es, mais tu ne sais rien des autres. C'est ça, Sauve le Shérif.

LES RÔLES Au début de chaque partie, tu reçois ton rôle en secret :

Le Shérif, l'unique défenseur de la loi. Tu possèdes une balle d'argent : un seul tir, instantané, mortel. Mais si tu rates, ou si tu la tires sur un innocent, tu es exposé. Et désarmé.

Les Hors-la-loi, vous êtes plusieurs, vous vous reconnaissez. Votre mission : éliminer le shérif et prendre le contrôle de la ville. Mais attention, vous devez convaincre les villageois que vous êtes des leurs.

Les Citoyens, vous ne savez rien. Pas votre voisin, pas le tireur d'à côté. Vous devez identifier les hors-la-loi par la voix, le comportement, les mensonges. Et soutenir le shérif sans même savoir qui il est.

LA VOIX FAIT TOUT avec le chat vocal en proximité . Quand tu es au Saloon Nord, tu n'entends que les gens du Saloon Nord. Si tu traverses la rue pour rejoindre le Sud, tu changes de cercle d'oreilles. Et c'est ça qui fait que ce jeu n'est pas comme les autres :  chaque saloon devient sa propre chambre des secrets. Qui a accusé qui en ton absence ? Pourquoi le type qui jurait son innocence dans le Nord a-t-il disparu vers le Sud juste après ?

LE DUEL À chaque cycle, un duel éclate : un joueur du Nord contre un joueur du Sud. Face à face. Choix simultanés. 5 secondes pour décider. Tirer ou Pacifier ? Si tu tires sur un innocent qui voulait la paix, tu deviens suspect. Si tu pacifies un hors-la-loi, tu lui laisses la vie sauve. Si vous tirez tous les deux, le hasard décide. Si vous pacifiez tous les deux, vous repartez vivants — mais avec un doute persistant. C'est le dilemme du prisonnier, en plein Far West, avec ta voix qui tremble pendant le compte à rebours.

LES CONDITIONS DE VICTOIRE :

Shérif & Citoyens : élimine tous les hors-la-loi.

Hors-la-loi : élimine le shérif, ou atteins la majorité dans la ville..

EN BREF

4 à 10 joueurs 

10 à 15 minutes par partie 

Free-to-play

Cosmétiques achetables (chapeaux, pistolets...)

Chat vocal proximité (voix EOS intégrée)

Rejoins le saloon. Et que le meilleur menteur gagne.

Le Shérif, l'unique défenseur de la loi. Tu possèdes une balle d'argent : un seul tir, instantané, mortel. Mais si tu rates, ou si tu la tires sur un innocent, tu es exposé. Et désarmé.

Les Hors-la-loi, vous êtes plusieurs, vous vous reconnaissez. Votre mission : éliminer le shérif et prendre le contrôle de la ville. Mais attention, vous devez convaincre les villageois que vous êtes des leurs.

Les Citoyens, vous ne savez rien. Pas votre voisin, pas le tireur d'à côté. Vous devez identifier les hors-la-loi par la voix, le comportement, les mensonges. Et soutenir le shérif sans même savoir qui il est.

LA VOIX FAIT TOUT avec le chat vocal en proximité . Quand tu es au Saloon Nord, tu n'entends que les gens du Saloon Nord. Si tu traverses la rue pour rejoindre le Sud, tu changes de cercle d'oreilles. Et c'est ça qui fait que ce jeu n'est pas comme les autres :  chaque saloon devient sa propre chambre des secrets. Qui a accusé qui en ton absence ? Pourquoi le type qui jurait son innocence dans le Nord a-t-il disparu vers le Sud juste après ?

LE DUEL À chaque cycle, un duel éclate : un joueur du Nord contre un joueur du Sud. Face à face. Choix simultanés. 5 secondes pour décider. Tirer ou Pacifier ? Si tu tires sur un innocent qui voulait la paix, tu deviens suspect. Si tu pacifies un hors-la-loi, tu lui laisses la vie sauve. Si vous tirez tous les deux, le hasard décide. Si vous pacifiez tous les deux, vous repartez vivants — mais avec un doute persistant. C'est le dilemme du prisonnier, en plein Far West, avec ta voix qui tremble pendant le compte à rebours.

LES CONDITIONS DE VICTOIRE :

Shérif & Citoyens : élimine tous les hors-la-loi.

Hors-la-loi : élimine le shérif, ou atteins la majorité dans la ville..

EN BREF

4 à 10 joueurs 

10 à 15 minutes par partie 

Free-to-play

Cosmétiques achetables (chapeaux, pistolets...)

Chat vocal proximité (voix EOS intégrée)

Rejoins le saloon. Et que le meilleur menteur gagne.
store_data.short_description: Sauve le Shérif 4 à 10 joueurs. Deux saloons. Une seule règle : ne fais confiance à personne. Chat vocal en proximité, duels en face-à-face, et un dilemme à chaque tir : pacifier ou abattre.

LOVECORE RHYTHM is a mature five-lane rhythm game. The art behind the playfield uncovers itself as you hit notes, finish a track and the scene is permanently unlocked in your gallery.

Use A · S · D · F · G to hit notes scrolling down the lanes. Taps, holds, and bombs to dodge. Land the timing for a Perfect, clip the window for a Good, miss it and your combo dies. Chain hits to climb the score multiplier and chase the S rank.

  • 18 tracks, multiple difficulty tiers — Hard and Expert variants per scene.

  • Unlockable gallery — clear a track to keep the art. Each character ships with several scenes.

  • Stackable modifiers — Hidden, Sudden Death, Minimal UI, and an adaptive difficulty that eases off if you're slamming into the same wall.

  • Practice mode — drop A/B markers with Q/E, loop the trouble section until it's clean.

  • Built-in chart editor — author your own scenes with waveform display, grid snap, and play-from-cursor preview.

  • Replays and local leaderboard — every good run is saved. Watch it back, beat it later.

  • Audio/input calibration — dial in latency for your setup, from Bluetooth headphones to mechanical keyboards.

Explicit sexual content. Every piece of art is revealed through gameplay, no skip to end button. You play it, you unlock it.

store_data.about_the_game:
Chronicles of The Sinner is a first-person psychological survival horror that plunges you into a suffocating atmosphere of dread and isolation.

You play as a lone investigator dispatched to uncover the source of unsettling, inexplicable sounds echoing from a long-abandoned orphanage. What was supposed to be a routine check quickly devolves into a desperate, waking nightmare.

Immerse yourself in a realistic survival horror experience where your greatest enemy might be your own brain. Scavenge for scarce resources, manage your tools, and fight to keep your sanity intact. As the shadows lengthen, horrific events will warp your perception of reality - making you question every sound, every shadow, and every step.

  • Adaptive Terror: You are not alone. The entities lurking in the dark react dynamically to your movement, the noise you make, and how you behave. Adapt or perish.

  • High Stakes: No hand-holding. Every choice you make carries weight, and every single mistake could be your last.

Navigate through interconnected, semi-open environments where exploration is key to survival. Search for hidden pathways, solve puzzles, experiment with your surroundings, and piece together the gruesome history rotting within the orphanage walls… and deep beneath them.


What truly happened here? Why was it abandoned?

Dare to find the answers before the orphange devours you entirely...

store_data.about_the_game:
In the summer of the year 197, sunlight glides over the yellow fields of the Prevalis Province,

Republic of Illyria. White, tile-roofed houses peek out from the corners of cornfields and trees

that line the side of the highway - you didn’t even know there were cicadas this close to the

coast. You lean back in your seat, eyes lazily losing themselves in the blurry motion of the

landscape moving by. For the rest of your life, this is what your memories of childhood are going

to look like. Then, you suddenly lose consciousness and wake up in a dark room.

7KOMADA is a 3D, free-roam, murder-mystery, detective, ‘talk-em-up’ VN set

in a backwater of an alternate universe Europe. You and your class’s graduation trip to Athens has

been cut short by a novel 19-man kidnapping - and as you all wake up trapped in the lobby of a

seemingly abandoned mansion, you take it upon yourself to figure out what’s going on. Explore

the halls, collect evidence, ‘pal around’ under intense mental stress, and try to feel good about

surgically extracting information from people who don’t want to give it to you. Most

importantly: keep yourself safe.

  • A 'killing game' designed on the basis of classic social deduction games like Werewolf / Mafia.

  • A living cast of 18 true-to-life embarrassing teenagers, each with their own individual webs of alliance and enmity.

  • An open-ended trial system replete with minigames.

  • Familiar people in an unfamiliar paracosm - fully developed with its own rules, history, and metaphysics over the span of several years - of which the game's setting comprises only a small and unimportant part.

  • A fully-featured mansion with its own secrets to explore and areas to uncover, some of which are completely optional.

  • Next-Gen Chūnibyō Simulation

  • A 'friendship' system which rewards interaction with the characters - and can even alter the story.

  • 7 days, 7 chapters. Upon early-access release, the first three will be playable.

  • Two endings planned.

  • Authentic slavjank by an all-Yugoslav dev team of maniacs.

  • Social commentary, or something.

  • A 3D world that looks and plays well, constructed entirely within RPGMaker MZ. No, I'm not kidding.

store_data.about_the_game:
Pew Pew Magic Wizard Fighter is a chaotic, high-intensity 1v1 isometric battle game built for fast-paced arcade action. Master a roster of 8 unique wizards and dive into destructible arenas where spatial control is everything.

The Grand High Wizard Council has mandated a “reduction in wizards” of the local area. A general reduction spell has been cast over the realm. The final step comes down to using Pew Pew Magic to personally disable each wizard’s protective aura. Your chosen wizard has been given the task of carrying out the order and so must travel to each location and "fire" the representative stationed there.

Master Pew Pew Magic to defeat your foes in 1-on-1 Retro Arcade-style battle

Wreck the place as battle ensues to the eclectic electronic action score by inflexi0n

Unleash your unique special abilities to turn the tide as you out-maneuver your rival in high-stakes, "one-screen" combat

Get the upper hand by grabbing power-ups that will briefly grant you boosted abilities such as super speed, invincibility, or homing blasts

Is This For You?

• The Squad: This is a "run it back" game. If you're looking for something that’s easy to pick up during a Friday night session, where you can jump straight into a match without a half-hour tutorial, this is it.

• The Retro Purist: If you miss the era when games were defined by tight controls and distinct 16-bit aesthetics rather than bloated maps and endless menus, you’ll feel right at home here.

• The Duelist: You like the tension of a 1v1. You understand that getting close means landing shots easier, but it also means putting yourself in the line of fire. It’s about that "just one more round" energy.

Not For You If:

• You’re looking for a sprawling open world or a deep, dialogue-heavy story.

• You want to "out-grind" your opponents with gear instead of out-playing them in the arena.

• You’re looking for a Co-Op / Team experience: This is a pure 1-on-1 dueling game. If you’re looking to team up with friends against the computer or other players, that isn't the core loop here.

store_data.about_the_game:
One Day. One Resort. Two Women. Every Touch Counts.

Touch Me 2 drops you into a single sun-soaked day at a luxury tropical resort with two women—shy, sweet Dani and the bold, shameless MILF Monique. Touch them. Read them. Keep them both happy—or watch everything fall apart.

This isn't a click-through slideshow. You interact directly: touch their bodies, watch their reactions, and manage two rising gauges in real time. Give one too much attention and the other gets jealous. Push too far too fast and you'll get shut down. The gameplay is simple to learn but demands your full attention across all 11 stages.

What You're Getting

  • Real-Time Touch Gameplay: Click body zones on both characters simultaneously. Each zone has a valid range that shifts as arousal builds—what works at 20% won't work at 80%. Floating hearts, color-shifting gauges, and cursor feedback tell you how you're doing.

  • 11 Stages of Escalation: The game takes place over one day at the same resort. What changes isn't the location—it's them. Clothes come off, boundaries drop, and what they'll let you touch evolves from innocent to explicit across every stage.

  • Jealousy System: Touch the same woman three times in a row and the other one gets angry. Her gauge drops. Neglect either one for too long and you lose. Balancing attention is the core challenge.

  • Reward Scenes: Beat each stage and you're rewarded with a fully voiced visual novel scene—story, dialogue, character development, and animated sequences between Dani, Monique, and the MC.

store_data.about_the_game:
DOM 1400 Mare Nostrum is a deep naval strategy and economic simulator set in the 15th-century Mediterranean. It is not just a trading game, but an academic-grade simulation running beneath a ruthless tactical naval interface.

Build Your Merchant Empire: Start with a single, modest vessel and rise through the ranks to command massive fleets. The game world doesn't magically spawn goods: explore 50 historical cities, each with its own life, religion, and needs. Buy raw materials cheaply where they are abundant and sell them where there is scarcity. The economy is driven by a strict law of supply and demand: the population is divided into three social classes with dynamic daily needs. If the price of fish skyrockets, the poor will fall back on meat, disrupting the entire market!

Demographics and Malthusian Traps: Prosperity inevitably leads to population growth, but resources in the 15th century are brutally finite. If a trade hub's population outgrows its food supply, the city will plummet into a Malthusian trap: prices will soar, and the population will drastically decline. The moral choice is yours: will you save the populace by importing cheap grain, or ruthlessly exploit the famine by selling bread at exorbitant prices to desperate Patricians?

Command Brutal 2D Naval Battles: The sea is not a flat canvas, but is governed by rigorous vectorial wind physics. Defend your precious cargo from rival factions or the assaults of fearsome Barbary corsairs. Choose your tactics based on your fleet: a Galley is expensive and carries few goods, but thanks to its oars, it ignores the wind and is devastating in ramming; a mighty Carrack can transport enormous wealth, but if it gets caught in the 'dead wind' (bolina morta), it becomes an easy target. Manage sails, positioning, and artillery: ram, board, fire, or attempt a desperate escape.

Navigate a Deep Political World: Trade does not happen in a political vacuum. Your interactions with the 4 main religious and cultural blocs (Catholic, Orthodox, Islamic, and Jewish) will shape your destiny. Deal with dynamic AI merchants governed by specific personality archetypes (Ambitious, Prudent, Honorable). Face state protectionism, pay customs tariffs, bribe authorities, or forge alliances to monopolize the lucrative African Gold and Silk markets.

Rise to Power or Plunder the Seas: Ascend through 6 tiers of social progression. Grow from a humble captain to a powerful ruler, expanding your faction's influence toward total dominance of the Mare Nostrum. Prefer to break the rules? Lower your colors, get rich living outside the law, and become the ruthless terror of the seas.

Full Modding Support: From day one, DOM 1400 was developed to give total freedom to the community. Thanks to a completely open architecture, you can create your own Mods by simply editing plain text files. No stats are hardcoded: you can rebalance ship costs, alter the economy, or even create entirely new maps, expanding the game from the base 50 cities up to 1000! The Mediterranean is literally in your hands.
