YOU ARE A SOLDIER, NOT A HIKER OR A SCAVENGER

This is a fast-paced hardcore arcade: you come here to enjoy total intensity without boring limits. You are the master of your mission: you decide how to progress, what to prioritize, and how to survive in an environment that never forgets your impact. GPS-lock weapons for your arsenal, earn COPS currency to fund your war, and manage your licenses to pilot armor. Unleash your killstreaks to retreat to the safety of a bunker and deploy drones with total immunity.

PREPARE TO FACE ONE OF THE MOST REALISTIC, INTENSE, AND TACTICAL AIs ON THE MARKET

THIS PROJECT IS BEING DEVELOPED BY A SINGLE PERSON. I, FRANCISCO TRILLA SÁNCHEZ

I have designed this experience to annihilate the downtime of the genre. In the Krasniy-Zavod sector, there are no gas rings, absurd waiting times, or endless walks where nothing happens; here, you land shooting from the very first second in an ultra-high-density battlefield that wants you dead. Every tactical threat is active the moment you touch the ground, forcing you to dodge heavy artillery and enemy drones in a frantic hardcore combat experience where danger is real every five seconds.

I have eliminated any artifice to deliver the purest and most brutal form of immersive, fast, and intense tactical combat. Every mechanic has been created and focused on offering you unprecedented immersion, where precision and realism are the only pillars that hold up the battlefield.

HIGH-INTENSITY TACTICAL HELMET CAM COMBAT

OPERATOR UNIFORMS: 100% MILITARY AND TACTICAL SKINS

All my uniforms, both for male and female operators, strictly comply with authentic combat standards. In Iron Offensive, I provide no room for arcade designs or out-of-place colors; every skin is real military gear designed to integrate perfectly into the combat environment. The female operators also use 100% military uniforms within the game, with no absurd colors, as I maintain an absolute tactical equipment standard for everyone.

MAXIMUM COOPERATION: FPV KAMIKAZE DRONES, RAPTORS, UGVs, AND HIMARS-STYLE ARTILLERY

The game completely changes its mechanical rules whether you play solo or deploy in a squad of up to four friends. Iron Offensive introduces dynamic tactical roles based on real military hardware tools, allowing players to take control of advanced technology in the middle of combat.

Tactical Deployment and Arsenal Control: On the battlefield, you are not limited to foot infantry. You can pilot heavy armor directly on the ground, coordinate destructive attacks by calling in HIMARS-style heavy artillery fire, or deploy FPV kamikaze drones and Raptor recon drones to decimate enemy positions from the air.

Mobile Support Operator and UGV Control: If you play as a team, one squad member can equip and deploy an unmanned ground vehicle (UGV) drone modified with a logistics cargo basket. This device becomes a mobile resupply point in the middle of the firefight. As long as the team protects the ground drone and the teammate operating it, any soldier who stays close to the UGV basket will receive continuous ammo resupplies. Ran out of RPG rockets in the middle of an assault on an enemy BTR? Don't go looking for boxes around the map: take cover next to your teammate's ground drone, reload your heavy weaponry instantly, and open fire again. Hardcore cooperation at an arcade pace.

WEIGHT MANAGEMENT AND ADVANCED REAL-TIME BALLISTICS

Before launching into the raid, you decide the price of your power. In the armory, you can configure your loadout using standard issue gear, unlocks, or items bought with your COPS. Choose your primary weapon, secondary, a third slot dedicated to anti-tank weaponry (bazookas), and the drone type with its payload (C4, kamikaze, etc.). You can customize zoom sights, add armor plates to your vest, or upgrade your ammo quality to armor-piercing rounds.

The Law of Physics on the Frontline: Every decision in the menus has a direct impact on the gameplay loop. The more geared and armored you drop into the battlefield, the heavier your operator will be, increasing your combat fatigue. If you decide to go light—for example, only with your primary weapon, no secondary, no bazooka, and no drones—you will move at extreme speed, sprint faster, and take much longer to tire out. You decide whether to play as a human tank or a lightning-fast ghost.

In-Game Weapon Modification Without Pauses: Adaptation in the midst of chaos is immediate. If the situation changes during the match, you don't need to exit or wait to respawn. Press a button, open your weapon's interactive menu in real-time right on the field, and modify its components with a couple of quick clicks: swap ammo types on the fly to armor-piercing, or instantly toggle between your unlocked sights to switch from a long-range zoom to a short-range quick target acquisition. The frontline changes in seconds; so does your weaponry.

Simplified Ammo Logistics: In Iron Offensive, you don't come to count bullets in a boring way. Weapons have unlimited standard ammo on the frontline at no base cost; your operational capital is invested in paying to upgrade the caliber quality and the projectiles you load into your rifles, bazookas, drones, or armor.

A DYNAMIC AND LIVING MAP

All objectives operate simultaneously. Whether you want to focus on high-intensity combat, sabotage enemy assets, or hunt for intel, the choice is yours. The environment is persistent: if you secure technical blueprints today, the map will dynamically update for your next raid, forcing you to find the physical components to complete the cycle. Central Command knows 90% of what happens in the sector. The remaining 10% consists of hidden objectives and high-value secrets that will never appear on your HUD until you physically interact with them. Finding these secrets is the key to obtaining the highest economic rewards.

PHOTOREALISM AND COMBAT FATIGUE

The perspective reacts through a physical fatigue model. Explosions crack your helmet cam lens, and the signal flickers under suppressive fire. I have merged the best of the genre: speed, intensity, and tactical difficulty in a dynamic battlefield full of bombs, artillery, and gunfire everywhere (which constantly slow you down and make everything harder), combined with raw physical consequences like combat fatigue and blurred vision when a hit lands. Aiming, shooting, and overall movement are fast, but real exhaustion will affect your senses in this continuous combat hell. It's an uncompromising tactical experience where every bullet counts.

INDOORS VS. OUTDOORS: THE HUNT FOR ELITE GEAR

The intensity of the battle changes radically depending on your position. While the outdoors is a chaos of AI artillery fire, tracers, enemy drones, and constant pressure, buildings offer a completely different kind of tension. Inside the structures, open warfare stops to make room for tactical terror. Among automated mines and traps, you will find the most powerful equipment, such as bazookas and heavy weaponry.

USE OR GEOLOCATE WITH GPS LOCK

When you find superior gear or tactical intel, you face a critical decision: use it immediately to survive or mark it for the future. You have the ability to GPS-lock the items you find; by locking them, you secure that information in your navigation system. If you decide to extract it, you must use your GPS to geolocate the object and send the coordinates to Central Command. After a successful mission, a recovery drone will pick up the marked equipment to secure it in your permanent arsenal.

PROGRESSION, COPS ECONOMY, AND PILOTING LICENSES

Your success on the field translates into immediate operational capital. Completing objectives and taking down enemies grants you the in-game currency called COPS. Use your earnings to expand your jurisdiction, buying access to new industrial sectors and larger areas of the map. Progression allows you to acquire tactical accreditation cards and buy piloting contracts. All heavy vehicles (like Leopard, Abrams, Bradley series tanks, or BTRs) scattered neutrally across the battlefield from the start of the match will strictly require you to have previously purchased or extracted these piloting licenses to be used; otherwise, you won't be able to start them.

KILLSTREAKS AND THE TACTICAL IMMUNITY BREATHER

In this hell of crossfire, achieving killstreaks gives you the opportunity to deploy powerful remote-controlled tactical assets depending on the operator you choose. By chaining 7 to 8 enemy kills, you can activate drones or UGVs that will give you a crucial breather of up to 5 minutes. When deploying this ground drone, it crouches and moves super fast through narrow areas and chokepoints to gather intel and hack data in total peace. While you control these devices remotely, your human operator is physically protected in a bunker or armored room out of danger: the AI cannot kill you during this use, offering you a mental break to relax before returning to foot infantry.

THE EXTRACTION PROTOCOL: DYNAMIC TP-LINK SYSTEM

Extraction is not a static defense; it's a battle for data. To finish the mission and secure your gathered intel, your COPS, and the geolocated gear you GPS-locked, you must master the sector's shifting signal.

Mobile Intel Zones: Intel collection points are dynamic. These TP-Link zones relocate every five or six minutes, forcing you to maintain tactical movement and reposition your squad to stay connected. You can extract data on the move thanks to the GPS you carry: if you enter the radius of a TP-Link mounted on a tank or BTR, the vehicle will serve as a mobile shield against the AI's artillery fatigue while you perform the extraction without stopping.

The Final Link and the 50-Meter Rule: As the mission reaches its climax, the mobile zones disappear, leaving a single final antenna for extraction. To transmit the data and consolidate the victory of everything you locked, you must strictly be within the 50 to 100-meter radius of this last safe extraction zone when the match timer hits zero.

OPERATIONAL MISSION TIMER AND 5-SECOND RESPAWN

Time is your only judge. Each raid has an operational window of 20 to 40 minutes to complete objectives and transmit data. This is a session limit per match, not a product access restriction. In this game, completing objectives and fighting constantly is crucial. Falling in combat is not the end; thanks to the rapid respawn system, you will drop back in just five seconds to rejoin the fight. If you get killed with one minute left in the match and you were in the final radius, you will respawn in 5 seconds and have just enough time to make an agonizing sprint back to the extraction radius to save your loot. Furthermore, on the respawn screen, if you earned a tank via killstreak and it's available on the map, you can click it to respawn directly mounted on its tracks instantly. You only lose the mission and your belongings if the match clock runs out completely and you failed to be inside the final extraction radius.

EXTREME TACTICAL OPTIMIZATION

I have extremely optimized Iron Offensive to achieve terminal photorealism without the need for a supercomputer. Deploy in EPIC quality (50% 3D resolution) with absolute combat fluidity. The base tactical requirement only demands an AMD Ryzen 5 2600, 16 GB of RAM, and a GTX 1650 (4 GB). My shielded system guarantees that every frame serves the action, opening the battlefield to millions of players discarded by poorly optimized releases.

DEVELOPED SOLO BY FRANCISCO TRILLA SÁNCHEZ

GAMESTRILLA

store_data.about_the_game:
Step into the vibrant, idealistic spirit of the 1980s and 1990s, and build your own jade business in an era full of opportunity.

A chance encounter draws you into the world of jadeite rough stones and traditional jade carving craftsmanship. From bargain hunting at street markets to bidding fortunes at elite auctions, you’ll select raw stones, gamble on hidden quality, design carvings, and craft exquisite ornaments as you grow your reputation and wealth from nothing.

But fortune is never guaranteed. One perfect cut could make you rich overnight, while a single bad gamble may cost you everything.

The game features jadeite trading, stone-opening and gambling mechanics, jade carving, shop management, and market-driven strategy. Your instincts for market trends, calculated risks, and sheer luck will shape every decision you make.

Will you become a cautious and successful jade merchant, dedicate yourself to mastering traditional carving as a legendary artisan, or lose yourself chasing the myth of the perfect Imperial Green jade?

store_data.about_the_game:
You begin with calluses, not a crown.

Idle Crown is a medieval idle RPG with no energy bars, no premium currency,
and no real-world clock between you and the next level. Just fifteen
skills, a Holding you raise stone by stone, and an XP curve built for the
long haul.

Fifteen skills, deep progression


  • Chop pine to heartwood, mine tin to runite, forge bronze swords through sovereign-tier blades.
  • Fish minnows to leviathans, hunt rabbits to drakes, cook simple meals into royal feasts.
  • Combat, Piety, and Stewardship round out the lord's craft, each with passives that bend every other skill.

Early levels move quick. The endgame is measured in days. Past 99, Mastery
branches (Yield, Pace, Fortune) open for every skill,
fully respec-able.

Raise a Holding


Twelve buildings on a 20×20 plot, each granting permanent speed bonuses.
Upgrade tiers climb from pine planks to voidstone. A maxed Holding is
months of work. A centerpiece you can point at when someone asks what
you've been doing all winter.

Workers in parallel


Climb the rank ladder (Serf → Freeman → Yeoman → King) to unlock
workers who run skills beside you. At high ranks they outpace the lord
himself.

23 permanent upgrades


Sink coin into yield, speed, XP, crit, coin gain, minion slots, forge
efficiency, sell prices, boss cooldowns, and more. Each ranks up the
deeper you invest. Push the offline cap from 12 hours to 36. Slot a fifth
minion. A treasury that always has a reason to grow.

100 achievements, written like a chronicle


Every achievement is named and written in voice, with no dry "kill 100 X"
copy. Hidden achievements stay hidden until earned. Each ships with a
hand-rendered gold-on-parchment icon.

Built for Steam


  • 39 leaderboards: speedrun, per-skill XP, Mastery, lifetime XP, longest streak
  • Local saves with five rolling backups, plus full JSON import/export
  • Friend Rich Presence so your liege can see what skill you're grinding
  • Offline catchup up to 36 hours, so a workday doesn't wipe a play-day

Serf to Sovereign. Take your time. The throne is patient.

store_data.about_the_game:
Step into frozen moments in time and piece together the truth. All Possible Suspects is a point-and-click deduction game of observation and logic, where you must analyze intricate, static scenes to reconstruct a series of diverse and unusual occurrences.

All the keywords you need are already provided. Your task is to use reason, observation, and logical deduction to arrange them correctly and solve the mystery.

How It Works

Every scenario is a logic puzzle captured in a single, motionless instant.
  • Observe the Scene: Look closely at characters, items, and the environment to understand the context of what just happened.
  • Analyze the Clues: Gather information from the frozen moment to figure out the relationships, motives, and sequence of events.
  • Fill in the Blanks: Use the provided list of keywords to complete the sentences in your notebook, successfully reconstructing the narrative of the event.

Key Features

  • Diverse Scenarios: Explore a wide variety of unique situations, strange anomalies, and intricate puzzles that go far beyond standard crime scenes.
  • Pure Deductive Logic: With the keywords already provided, your success depends entirely on your ability to observe, reason, and make connections.
  • Interactive Thinking Grid: Slot the correct words into your notebook to answer the crucial questions of who, what, how, and why.
  • Play at Your Own Pace: There are no timers or quick-time events. Take your time to study the details, formulate your theories, and solve each puzzle at your own speed.

store_data.about_the_game:
We took the deckbuilder roguelite and split every card in half. In Trait, each card carries two effects - swipe left for one, swipe right for the other. Block or attack. Buff yourself or burn the enemy. There's no wrong answer, but there's always a better one, and you have to figure out which.

Build a deck that plays to your instincts. Every card you pick up reshapes what the next swipe means — stack Burn effects for slow-cook damage, layer shields and Thorns for a reactive fortress, or go all-in on raw Strength and hope nothing hits back.

Monsters don't just stand there. Slimes buff themselves every turn. Skeletons cycle between attacks and debuffs. Mimics start stuffing curse cards into your deck.

Between fights, upgrade your cards at rest sites or pick new ones from reward pools. Every upgrade tips the scales: your Spark now applies double Thorns, your Inferno consumes all your Burn stacks and converts them into a single devastating hit. Small numbers become big numbers. That's the fun part.

Features

  • Two Traits, One Card - Every card has a left swipe and a right swipe. The direction you choose defines your strategy, and no two runs play the same way twice.

  • A Deck That Grows With You - Start with a basic set of cards and add new ones after each fight. Upgrade them at rest sites to push their numbers further or unlock stronger versions of their effects.

  • Monsters That Fight Back - Slimes that buff, burn, shield, explode, and reflect damage. Bats that heal off your pain. Rats that turtle behind armor. Skeletons that debuff you before the big swing. Losts of creatures, lots of strategies.

  • Status Effects That Stack - Burn, Thorns, Vulnerable, Surge, Wildfire, Iron Skin - layer buffs and debuffs to create combos that snowball across a fight. Every effect interacts with the damage pipeline, so a well-timed debuff can double your output.

  • Intent-Driven Combat - See what every enemy plans to do before they do it. Read the board, weigh your options, and commit to the swipe. No hidden information, just pressure.

  • Roguelite Runs Through a Shifting Dungeon - Stages of weighted encounters mean every run shuffles the lineup. The same deck won't carry you twice.

Alien Disclosure: The Phrases of Fate™ is a missing-words game in which players take on the role of either a US President or alien envoy, tasked with announcing to the world that extraterrestrials are real and that they have made contact.
With scenarios spanning peaceful intent, hostility, and the cosmic visitors wanting to make a deal, it's your job to pick the right words to fit the gaps in your malfunctioning autocue to secure the fate of the world, earning achievements for nailing a stirring speech for the mood or even doing the opposite and going for surreal calamity instead.

The game features 100% human-made art in addition to 3,000+ original human-recorded audio clips for watching speeches back and listening in to multiverse history in the making.

Current Build Status:

Promo Wrestling World is launching in Early Access. The current review build is v0.9.0-beta.1, a playable Early Access beta that includes the core promotion management loop, booking, roster management, rival companies, titles, storylines, simulation systems, and long-save progression.

This is not the final 1.0 version. Expect balance changes, UI polish, bug fixes, and feature expansion during Early Access.

Promo Wrestling World is a deep wrestling management simulation about booking shows, building stars, managing money, and surviving in a living wrestling industry.

Take control of a promotion and run the business week by week. Book matches, shape storylines, manage contracts, track morale, handle injuries, build championships, and watch rival companies fight for the same audience and talent.

Key Features

• Book weekly TV, major events, matches, promos, angles, vignettes, and story beats.

• Manage a roster of wrestlers with popularity, morale, fatigue, ego, contracts, chemistry, and push status.

• Build long-running storylines with heat, momentum, rivalries, stables, betrayals, and title chases.

• Track championships with prestige, reign histories, defenses, vacancies, and title lineages.

• Run the business side: cash, wages, sponsors, TV deals, PPV strategy, venues, production costs, and market pressure.

• Compete against rival promotions that run shows, bid on talent, grow, fold, and reshape the wrestling world.

• Follow your dynasty through milestones, awards, Hall of Fame candidates, legacy score, and long-term history.

• Edit the world directly with the World Editor: promotions, workers, titles, regions, venues, teams, relationships, match    types, media formats, and more.

• Start in different eras with era-specific economics, fan expectations, media formats, and industry flavor.

• Watch new promotions emerge during long saves with founders, colors, logos, rosters, finances, ambition, and their own histories.

Early Access Focus

Promo Wrestling World is already playable as a full single-player management sandbox, but it is still growing. Early Access will focus on balance, usability, long-save stability, better onboarding, expanded world simulation, deeper booking tools, and community-requested improvements.

If you enjoy dense management games, long-term saves, wrestling booking, business pressure, and watching a fictional sports-entertainment world evolve over time, Promo Wrestling World is built for you.

store_data.about_the_game:
Hi, I’m Mark, and I love nighttime and lights, and I know a lot of you do too, so I decided to make a game about it. Twinkle is a relaxing, hand-drawn puzzle game about uncovering a world hidden in an endless night.

SPREAD THE LIGHT

You start in complete darkness with just one light. Jump from lamp to lamp as a light spirit who can travel anywhere the light touches. Spread twinkle and slowly reveal a world filled with forgotten memories, dancing squirrels, and maybe a ghost.

WHAT'S HIDDEN IN THE DARK?

Each time you light something, you'll uncover more of the world and its inhabitants. Explore, learn about the world, or just click on a rubber ducky!

HEAD INSIDE

An endless night has fallen in this world since people lost their twinkle. Take a dive into their minds to light up the place; travel through memories, scattered thoughts and dreams to help them :)

PUZZLE AND RELAX

Hey, I want you to relax, but I also want you to have some fun while exploring, so there are puzzle elements throughout the game. Use lights and shadows to find new stuff, use items accordingly, and connect plugs to sockets to keep the lights on.

store_data.about_the_game:
Mafia is a tense, 10-player psychological thriller of social deduction and strategy. In this digital adaptation of the classic parlor game (also known as Werewolf), you are randomly assigned to a secret role. Trust no one, question everyone, and remember: your closest ally might be the one holding the knife. 

  • THE CITY TEAM (7 Players): The backbone of society. Your goal is to root out the criminals before they take over completely.

    • 6 Citizens: Use logic, observe player behavior, and debate fiercely during the day to vote out suspects.

    • 1 Sheriff: The City's secret weapon. Each night, investigate one player to discover their true allegiance. Guide your fellow citizens without painting a target on your own back.

  • THE MAFIA TEAM (3 Players): The shadows in the night. Your goal is to outnumber the citizens through deception and stealth.

    • 2 Regular Mafia: Coordinate with your team under the cover of darkness to eliminate a player every night.

    • 1 Don: The mastermind. The Don searches for the Sheriff each night to eliminate the biggest threat to the family.

Key Features:

  • Single-Player Mode: Sharpens your skills anytime in a full 10-player match against 9 sophisticated NPCs designed to bluff, accuse, and deduce.

  • ⚡Online Multiplayer Coming Soon: We are actively working on a robust online matchmaking and lobby system! Soon, you'll be able to queue up with friends or face off against players worldwide in the ultimate digital battle of wits.

  • Day & Night Cycles: Plot in silence during the Night phase, then argue, bluff, and accuse during the high-stakes Day voting phase.

  • Pure Psychological Warfare: No complicated filler roles—just pure, unadulterated deduction. Use logic to save the city, or manipulation to destroy it.

  • No Two Games Alike: With randomized roles and human psychology at play, every match spins a completely unique strategy.

store_data.about_the_game:
Awakening in the Dark

When you open your eyes, you remember neither your name nor how you got here. There is only one thing you know: this is a cold, eerie, and dark basement where every corner is shaped by agony. The smell of rust and blood in the air is the only remaining evidence of the horrific tortures you endured. Your mind has completely shut itself down to block out the trauma you experienced.

Time is Running Out, Obey the Rules

Escaping this basement won't be easy. To unlock the doors, activate rusty mechanisms, and survive, you must interact with every object around you and push through the escape routes. But beware; every step you take, every sound you make, draws his attention.

Gameplay

In this claustrophobic survival horror game, players must survive the deadly traps set by the psychopath who kidnapped them and find a way out of this underground dungeon. Escaping from here will not be easy; you must interact with every object around you to unlock doors and activate rusty mechanisms, and crawl through narrow ventilation shafts in search of an exit.

Key Features

  • Single-Player Psychological Horror

Fear not only the darkness, but also the mind games your own sanity plays on you, and face that unknown monstrosity that could appear behind you at any moment.

  • Collect Memory Fragments

Piece together who you are and the dark secrets of your past by finding cryptic notes and clues scattered around.

  • Deadly Environmental Puzzles

Increase your chances of survival by solving complex mechanisms, lightbulbs, and buttons in the torture rooms with the right logic.

  • Immersive Tension and Atmosphere

Feel the suffocating despair of the basement to your very bones with narrow ventilation shafts, rusty doors, and dim lighting.

4769400.name: Just a stroll in the forest

store_data.about_the_game:
A weekend getaway. A harmless treasure hunt. A desperate rescue mission.

You arrive at the dense, suffocating edge of the woods expecting a cheerful reunion with your girlfriend, Steph, who went missing during a girls' weekend trip. Instead, you find an abandoned campsite, scattered gear, and a trail of frantic notes.

The "treasure hunt" Steph and her friends were following wasn't a game at all. It was a trap.

They unlocked something ancient. Now, they are trapped in a living nightmare, and the clock is ticking. To save Steph and escape with your lives, you must piece together the clues of a ritual gone horribly wrong.

The rules of the forest are simple but cruel: Gather the stolen gems. Return them to the cursed, gold-laden coffin. Or become a permanent part of the woods.

Key Features

  • Atmospheric Psychological Horror: Explore a beautifully eerie, Unreal Engine-powered forest where the shadows stretch and every snapping twig could mean your demise.

  • Piecing Together the Mystery: Discover letters, and your own characters audio/narrative to reconstruct the final hours of the girls' weekend and find Steph’s location.

  • High-Stakes Relic Hunting: Track down the scattered gems hidden across haunted landmarks, all while keeping your wits about you when you first hear the creatures.

  • The Cursed Coffin: Your only safe haven—and your ultimate objective. Get the 8 gems that are scattered around the forest and escape. 

  • Immersive Survival: No heavy weaponry, just your wits, a flashlight, and the desperate drive to save the woman you love.

Will you break the curse, or will you take their place in the coffin?

store_data.about_the_game:
Raise dinosaurs. Fulfill orders. Survive your coworkers.

Overhatched is a chaotic 1–4 player local & online co-op management party game where you and your team hatch, raise, and sell dinosaurs from increasingly ridiculous production facilities.
Think fast, work together, and try not to destroy your operation in the process.
Every facility becomes a frantic balancing act of physical inventory management, fishing, farming, feeding, logistics, and teamwork gone horribly wrong.
One missed task can send the whole operation spiraling.

HATCH. RAISE. SELL.

Build your dinosaur business from the ground up.
Order supplies, hatch eggs, raise dinosaurs to maturity, fulfill customer orders, and load completed shipments onto the truck before time runs out.
But raising dinosaurs isn't easy.
Different species require entirely different production chains:
🦕 Herbivores need crops you must grow and maintain.
🦖 Carnivores require livestock breeding and meat processing.
🐟 Piscivores demand freshly caught fish that must be cleaned and prepared.
Every dinosaur is another logistical problem waiting to happen.

MANAGE YOUR FACILITY

Each level is a fully operational dinosaur facility located in unique environments ranging from farmers markets to crowded city warehouses to remote island operations.
Use your facility's:
- Supply ordering computer
- Receiving docks
- Shipping bays
- Forklifts
- Crop plots
- Fishing docks
- Incubators
- Nurserys
- Livestock pens
- Processing stations
Everything arrives on large pallets, forcing you to manage valuable floor space while keeping supplies accessible and production flowing.
Or... you know... pile everything in the middle and regret it later.

Operation Scoville is a twin-stick shooter, tower defense, roguelike. Rutabaga III, the leader of the Vegetable Rebellion has assigned you to a covert solo operation. Play as Habanero Jr. and protect gardens across the world from the human warmongers. Although you're going in solo, you'll have the help of many traps and power ups to defeat the evil humans.

Enemies:

Fight a variety of different enemies with their own behaviors:

Soldier | Shotgunner | Ninja | Bomber | Saboteur | Machinegunner

Towers:

Make use of several different traps and towers to help you in your fight:

Barbed Wire | Road Block | Landmine | Bear Trap | Gas Canister | Shotgun Turret | Machinegun Turret | Mortar

Defeat every wave of enemies in a level without running out of life in your garden to advance to the next level. Between levels, you may purchase upgrades and traps with money you've gained in battle. Now that you've seen your competition, and your tools, let's hope you can fend off the human onslaught.

Isle Of Nexaryth

Step into a dangerous fantasy world filled with ancient creatures, powerful bosses, and hidden secrets.

Isle Of Nexaryth is an open-world fantasy adventure where players experience survival, exploration, and progression through the eyes of a young dragon struggling to survive in the brutal lands of Nexaryth Island.

Begin your journey as a small and vulnerable dragon, then grow stronger by hunting creatures, exploring mysterious regions, and overcoming deadly threats spread across the island. Discover ancient ruins, dark caves, forgotten lands, dense forests, and dangerous territories hiding secrets deep within the world.

As you progress, you will level up, face stronger enemies, and prepare yourself for massive boss battles. Each boss features unique attack patterns, combat mechanics, and battle environments that will test your strength and survival skills.

The island of Nexaryth is divided into multiple dangerous regions, each with its own atmosphere, wildlife, enemies, and mysteries to uncover. Exploration plays a major role in the experience, rewarding players who venture into hidden and dangerous areas.

Features

  • Open-world dragon adventure

  • Play as a young dragon struggling to survive

  • Large-scale boss battles

  • Creature hunting and progression system

  • Leveling and combat system

  • Exploration-focused gameplay

  • Fantasy environments and atmospheric world design

  • Ancient ruins, caves, and hidden locations

  • Multiple dangerous regions to explore

  • Progression-based gameplay experience

  • Single-player fantasy adventure

Will you uncover the mysteries of Nexaryth… or become another lost creature swallowed by the island?

store_data.about_the_game:
Dark Eyes: Super Soldier 2 returns to the Dark Eyes universe, continuing the story of the Super Soldier and his fight for humanity's survival.

After the events of the first game, the war is far from over. The Dark Eyes — known as the Delma — have returned, stronger and more dangerous than ever. Standing above them is the Alpha, an elite Dark Eyes commander whose presence threatens the future of Earth itself.

But the enemy isn't the only battle ahead.

The Super Soldier continues to struggle with the consequences of the Super Soldier Program. Due to the unusually high concentration of Delma blood flowing through his body, he remains caught between human and something else. Because of his condition, he is forced to serve within a secretive division of the Earth Space Defense Force: Shadow Force, the ESDF's classified special operations unit.

As war spreads across the battlefield, hidden truths, dangerous missions, and inner conflicts begin to surface. The fight against the Delma becomes more personal than ever.

Fast-paced and chaotic combat

Fight through intense missions filled with overwhelming enemy forces and large-scale battles alongside the ESDF army.

Experience a mix of gameplay styles:

  • Fast and brutal combat encounters against massive enemy groups

  • Large-scale battlefield missions alongside allied troops

  • Optional stealth sections for tactical approaches

  • Platforming and environmental challenges involving lasers, hazards, and traversal sequences

Customize your combat style with a massive arsenal:

  • Pistols

  • Assault rifles

  • Shotguns

  • Grenade launchers

  • Silenced weapons

  • Experimental prototypes

  • Captured Delma weaponry

Unlock powerful abilities and suit technology:

  • Boost packs

  • Automatic laser cannons

  • Energy shields

  • Rocket packs

Use tactical equipment:

  • Explosive grenades

  • EMP grenades

  • Smoke grenades

Upgrade your weapons, suit systems, and abilities to create a build that matches your playstyle. Invest in speed, firepower, defense, stealth, or advanced technology and shape your own Super Soldier.

Fight the Delma. Face the Alpha. Confront what the Super Soldier Program turned you into.

store_data.about_the_game:
HackMeNow is a terminal-style hacking puzzle game where every command matters.

You are dropped into AngrySysOps OS, a fictional Linux-like system full of logs, hidden files, fake services, compromised hosts, rogue processes, firewalls, black-site systems, and a watching intelligence that does not want you to reach the truth.

Across 15 levels, you will investigate incidents, follow evidence, decode secrets, bypass traps, manipulate simulated systems, and uncover a cyber-mystery that escalates far beyond a simple training exercise.

This is not a button-mashing hacking fantasy. HackMeNow is built around observation, logic, command-line thinking, and careful decision-making.

• Terminal-style gameplay built around Linux-inspired commands

• 15 handcrafted levels with escalating cyber puzzles

• Logs, filesystems, hidden paths, encoded clues, and simulated services

• Hacking, forensics, social engineering, firewall evasion, rogue AI, black-site infiltration, and final exfiltration arcs

• Timed challenges, tripwires, honeypots, and puzzle fail states

• Keyboard-first gameplay for players who enjoy command-line logic

• Designed for beginners and curious players, but with enough depth for technical minds

store_data.about_the_game:
When one feels out of step with the world because of certain differences, how does one discover one’s own strengths and worth? When communication with others proves impossible, how does one perceive and accept the other by attuning to their frequency?

Jules, a Arctic tern capable of emitting sounds between 10 and 1,000 hertz, is unable to attract the female of his choice because his vocal frequency is lower than that of the other males in his flock. Jules always considered himself an outsider within the flock; though well looked after, he could never quite fit in. Thanks to his exceptionally keen sense of sound, Jules discovered an artists’ village by the coast and befriended the artist Santi and other creatives. Through repeated attempts and adjustments, they eventually established a unique mode of communication and became close companions. When the Arctic terns migrated to Antarctica, Jules, having left his companions behind, faced new adventures and experiences.

Set against hand-drawn natural landscapes, experience the distinctive scenery of the coast, the artists’ village, the painter’s studio, and the waters of the Arctic and Antarctic. Immerse yourself in the daily life and communication patterns of the Arctic terns, emit your own frequency, and interact with creatures of different frequencies.

store_data.about_the_game:
Collect Honey and Grow Your Hive

Control a single bee and collect honey and pollen from flowers.

Bring the honey back to your hive. Pollen becomes experience points.

Your goal is to collect as much honey as possible within the time limit.

Level Up with Pollen and Strengthen Your Bee with Cards

Collect pollen to level up.
Choose one card from a set of three and strengthen your bee’s abilities.
Improve movement speed, gathering speed, carrying capacity, flower rewards, and more to create your own playstyle.

Unlock Skills with Honey

The honey you collect is both your score and a resource for future growth.
After each run, use honey to unlock skills, strengthen your bees and hive, and prepare for your next challenge.

Unlock New Bees with Pollen

Collected pollen can also be used to unlock new bees.

Each bee has different abilities, allowing you to enjoy the game with a variety of playstyles.

Pollen can also be used to unlock new maps.

From Manual Gathering to an Automated Swarm

At first, you gather honey alone as a single bee.
But as you unlock skills, worker bees will begin helping you gather automatically.
Enjoy the sense of growth as your swarm expands and your hive becomes more and more lively.

store_data.about_the_game:
Game Story

Human deep-space probes accidentally enter an unknown space fully overrun by invasive alien spores. Mutated spore creatures reproduce endlessly and threaten humanity’s interstellar routes. As a warship commander, your mission is to wipe out spore swarms, accumulate resources to strengthen your fleet and explore every corner of the infected cosmos.

Core Gameplay

This is an incremental idle combat game with no fixed levels. Navigate your warship freely across boundless open space and destroy wandering spores to gain star coins instantly. Your unlocked talents grant passive offline income even when you’re away from the game, and your resource gain multiplies continuously as you upgrade your build.

Full Progression System

  • Talent Tree: Spend star coins from defeated spores to unlock three branches of talents: damage boost, shield durability and resource multiplier. Each upgrade raises your clearing efficiency significantly.

  • New Abilities: Unlock active & passive skills alongside talent progression, including area explosion, pulse sweep, full-screen wipe and shield counterattack to boost your spore-harvesting power.

  • Captain Collection: Recruit unique captains with exclusive buffs using star coins. Some boost coin income, others enhance firepower or shorten skill cooldowns for varied builds.

  • New Maps & Creatures: Advance your talent tree to unlock brand-new space zones, each with exclusive high-tier spores that drop far more star coins than early-game variants.

Core Game Goal

There is no final ending in this incremental title. Your ultimate objective is to unlock all talents, collect every captain, discover all space maps and complete the full spore encyclopedia. Optimize your talent and captain combinations to maximize your ship’s clearing speed and harvest massive amounts of star coins effortlessly.

Game Features

  • Exponential incremental economy: Your earning rate scales permanently with upgrades; grind early, earn massive idle profits later.

  • Diverse build options: Mix talents and captains to build attack-focused, burst damage or passive farming playstyles.

  • Long-term collection content: Unlock dozens of spores, captains and maps step by step for endless long-run fun.

  • Casual idle design: Play actively to clear swarms online, or earn resources automatically while offline.

store_data.about_the_game:
Get lost on purpose.

Blissflow is a first person journey through infinite procedural architecture. Dash through neon corridors, navigate towering mazes, and hunt glowing orbs across dreamscapes that never generate the same layout twice.

Every run builds a unique world from fluorescent halls, flooded liminal corridors, and vast geometric voids. Whether you're chasing flow state or just drifting, the architecture keeps shifting around you.

THREE MODES OF DRIFT

Flow — Momentum-driven vertical navigation. Dash, slide, and freerun through towers of abstract geometry. Chase wandering orbs across platforms that stretch into the sky.

Maze — Procedural labyrinths that grow larger and stranger as you progress. Navigate shifting architectural styles, from clean minimalist corridors to crystalline, organic caves.

Labyrinth — Atmospheric orb hunts through sprawling, interconnected chambers. Navigate by instinct through fog, color, and sound.

THE PILGRIMAGE

String your runs together into a roguelite journey. Choose your path between modes, manage your lives, and push deeper as the architecture evolves. Difficulty scales with you. Save and resume anytime.

NOT ALL DREAMS ARE PEACEFUL

Wandering Sentinels occupy select areas, adding a rhythmic layer of tension to your navigation. Outmaneuver them or leave them behind.

YOUR PACE

Toggle Zen Mode at any time to remove all hazards. Blissflow adapts to how you want to play, focused traversal or pure ambient exploration.

store_data.about_the_game:
Restore the lighthouse. Break the loop. Save the future.

You wake up on a stormy island at night to find the lighthouse dark.

Out at sea, a ship is approaching the island and will crash unless the beacon is restored. The previous lighthouse keeper is gone, leaving behind journals, notes, and the responsibility of the island to you.

But the night refuses to end. Mysterious beings have taken control of the island, forcing you to relive the events. Strange visions reveal fragments of travelers from the future trying to preserve their future.

Their message remains the same: They cannot save you, but you can save them.

Explore the island with your trusty lantern, uncover the truth behind the keeper’s disappearance, and restore the lighthouse before time runs out. Use physics-based interactions to carry objects, operate mechanisms, solve puzzles, and find a way to break the endless loop.

Journal

Time Fractures

The Storm

store_data.about_the_game:
The Dark Inside Me - Chapter III: Before the Angels Send Us Back

A next-generation psychological horror adventure game from a horror movie director, built around a dynamic interactive scenario where every decision shapes the journey.

Game Episodes

Episode 1: Her Signs
Episode 2: Sick Minds
Episode 3: Rainy Roads
Episode 4: The Things We Buried
Episode 5: Auschwitz: What Remains
Episode 6: My Sins, Your Faults
Episode 7: Happy Birthday

The Dark Inside Me is a unique 2.5D third-person psychological horror adventure experience that blends cinematic storytelling with dynamic gameplay and emotionally driven choices.

The game is designed to reflect the true nature of the player through difficult moral decisions, psychological pressure, and emotionally intense situations. Every action, dialogue and choice influences the flow of the story and shapes the outcome of the journey.

Built upon a dynamic scenario system, the gameplay changes according to the player’s decisions, puzzle-solving methods, and interactions throughout the game. Puzzles can be solved in multiple ways, and every choice affects future events, characters, and consequences.

The game constantly challenges players with moral dilemmas and psychological conflicts, revealing how far they are willing to push their limits.

Some decisions permanently affect future chapters, relationships, and the emotional state of the characters. Players must face the consequences of every sacrifice they make.

It is said that everyone has angels. One leads us toward the light, while the other drags us into darkness. Throughout life, we make our own choices — and now, you will make them through The Dark Inside Me.

The Dark Inside Me blurs the thin line between madness and reality, darkness and light, love and hatred, forgiveness and vengeance.

You awaken in a hospital room, handcuffed to a bed. Detectives outside speak about a terrifying incident and question how you could still be alive after what happened. One of them says it would have been better if they had found you dead.

You remember almost nothing. To uncover the truth, you must seek for the truth.

RIG THE ELECTION

Yo, you ever wanted to rig a local election with your buddies and cause total mayhem while doing it? Then Mandatum is your game!

LIE. CHEAT. WIN.

You and your crew have one job: make sure The Boss wins the election no matter what. Fair play? Nah. History is written by the winners, right? So we’re doing whatever it takes.

AVOID THE POLICE

The Boss is literally your everything. Keep that man alive, keep him smiling, and most importantly — keep him far away from the Policeman. If he goes down… the whole thing falls apart fast and things get really messy.

WORK TOGETHER

You each play a different role — every single one is wonderfully chaotic in its own way. Unique abilities, shady tools, and some very questionable life choices. But that’s the fun! You gotta use your skills together or you’re all in trouble.

CAUSE CHAOS

This isn’t a solo hero game. You win as a team or you fail as a team. Expect lots of voice chat, crazy plans, last-second saves, and laughing like crazy when everything goes wonderfully wrong.

If you love chaotic co-op games full of coordination, funny moments, and ridiculous teamwork… Mandatum is seriously addictive.

  • Bug fix - maybe

store_data.about_the_game:
Born from the acclaimed mobile hit Trail of Gods: The Cursed Island, this PC edition expands the experience for players who fell in love with its brutal combat, haunting 1-bit aesthetic, and cursed world.

Originally released on mobile and praised for delivering a compact Souls-inspired adventure unlike anything else on the platform, Trail of Gods now arrives on Steam with the same relentless spirit, rebuilt for a bigger screen and a new generation of explorers.

The Gods Are Gone

They didn't die. They left, and whatever held the world together left with them. What remains is crumbling castles, poisoned land, and the people too stubborn or too broken to follow. You wake up in the middle of it with nothing.

Trail of Gods is a pocket-sized action role-playing game. Play it for five minutes or get lost in this small world for hours.

One Button

Everything you do in a fight comes from a single button. Press it to block. Hold it to charge. Let go to strike. How long you hold and which way you release decides what happens: a quick tap blocks, a short hold is a light attack, a long hold is a heavy one, and a fast flick rolls you out of danger.

Block at the right moment, then strike back instantly to counter. The window is tight. Learn it or die learning it.

Every Gram Counts

Your equipment has real weight, and it changes everything. A full suit of knight armor keeps you alive but slows you down. Torn clothes and a sharp dagger leave you open but fast. What you carry decides how quickly you walk, run, roll, and swing.

Heavy gear has its own trick: carry more than 5 kg and rolling into an enemy deals damage. Your dodge becomes a weapon.

Take What You Find

Find different ways to fight with, and fight your way through with strong and heavy gear or light fast and fragile stealth-mode.

You're not alone out here. Mercenaries wander the world. Hire them for free. They fight at your side and they don't ask questions.

Features

  • Minimalistic visuals

  • Single-button combat built entirely on timing and positioning

  • Weight system that ties your gear to your speed and playstyle

  • Several weapon classes with distinct animations and feel

  • Several gear sets with defense, weight, and charisma stats

  • Charisma system that changes how the world treats you

  • Hire mercenaries to fight at your side

  • Supports mouse + keyboard and gamepad

  • Small enough for a break. Deep enough to stay

store_data.about_the_game:
LAST ZONE is a brutal co-op survival game set in a post-Soviet world.

The world has fallen into chaos, where every step is a fight for survival. You will face hordes of mutants, ruthless factions, and constant resource shortages. Team up with friends to turn ruins into an impregnable fortress, craft equipment, and fight back against the wasteland itself.

Your goal is simple: survive, secure your place, and uncover what turned this world into hell.

Co-op in LAST ZONE is all about teamwork: while one player searches for supplies, another builds defenses, and a third fights off mutants. Only by working together can you transform ruins into a stronghold capable of resisting the horrors of the wasteland.

Infected zones are the richest — and the deadliest — places in the world. Face hordes of mutants with unique behaviors and abilities. Use tactics, monitor radiation levels, and always watch your corners: only those who stay alert survive here.

The countryside is the perfect place to hide. Or die.
Explore the atmosphere of abandoned villages. Supplies are scarcer here than in the cities, but so are your chances of surviving alone. Fortify an old rural house, defend yourself from mutants in the fields, and use the terrain to protect your shelter. You are the хозяин here — until night falls.

Building is your key to survival. Gather resources, construct walls and defensive structures, and turn abandoned buildings into fortified bastions capable of withstanding mutant raids and unwanted visitors.

Panel apartment blocks are grim concrete labyrinths where every apartment may hide either valuable loot or certain death. Search every floor, move carefully through stairwells, and try not to get trapped inside these endless concrete boxes.

Rivers and lakes are more than just scenery — they are a source of food. Grab a fishing rod, find a quiet spot, and catch fish before the local creatures notice you. Peaceful fishing may be the only chance to rest and fill your stomach after another harsh day in the Zone.

Do not look for easy paths. The best loot is hidden behind boarded windows and locked doors. Break your way inside to find truly valuable gear.

store_data.about_the_game:
〇 Genre

2D Strategy Board Game

〇 Game Mechanics

Two players each select six units (pieces) and operate them on a 6x6 board.

This game does not have a clear turn system; the command order of units is determined by their stats.

The command order can be changed through player actions during the game.

Units level up over time, strengthening their stats and allowing them to select commands such as attack and strengthen.

Each unit has its own stats, arts (attack techniques, support techniques), and skills, so choose units that match your strategy and tactics.

When a unit reaches a certain level, it can evolve into a new unit that can significantly change the course of the battle, and its stats will be greatly enhanced.

Use arts (attack techniques) to attack your opponent's units when selecting commands. When a unit's durability reaches 0, it is destroyed.

Destroying a certain number of your opponent's units wins the game.

〇 Game Modes

MAGISTAL implements Free Duel Mode and Story Mode.

Free Duel Mode allows you to select your favorite units and battle against other players (Player 1 vs. Player 2).

Player 2 can be designated as a CPU, allowing Player 1 to battle alone.

Story Mode allows you to experience the world of MAGISTAL in an episodic format.

You progress through the story by repeatedly selecting episodes, watching character conversations, and engaging in battles.

Clearing certain episodes unlocks more units.

〇Story

As the eldest son of one of the four great noble families ruling the kingdom, you will win territorial disputes against other nobles through duels.

There is an absolute rule that all disputes between nobles must be resolved through duels, and the winner receives the conditions presented by the loser; there is no resistance to this coercive force.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Hidden Camp is an online multiplayer social deduction survival game for 9 players, set in a mysterious forest camp where trust is fragile and every decision matters.

At first, everyone appears to be part of the same group. Players gather around the camp, complete tasks, explore the environment, and try to survive each round. But among them, hidden traitors are waiting for the right moment to create chaos.

The campers must work together, complete their objectives, and identify who cannot be trusted. The traitors must stay hidden, mislead the group, and eliminate the campers before they are exposed.

Every round is shaped by suspicion, strategy, timing, and betrayal.

SOCIAL DEDUCTION IN A MYSTERIOUS CAMP

No one knows who they can fully trust. A helpful player may be protecting the group, or secretly guiding everyone toward danger.

Observe player behavior, question suspicious actions, and make careful decisions before it is too late.

COMPLETE TASKS AND SURVIVE

Campers can progress by completing tasks around the map. Teamwork is important, but moving alone can be dangerous.

Every completed task brings the campers closer to victory, while every mistake gives the traitors more control over the round.

HIDDEN TRAITORS

Traitors must blend in with the group, avoid suspicion, and strike when the moment is right.

Use deception, movement, and timing to confuse the campers and survive long enough to win.

CAMP LEADER SYSTEM

Each round includes a Camp Leader who gains special responsibility during the match. The leader can influence the flow of the game and make important decisions that may change the outcome of the round.

But power does not always mean safety.

PROXIMITY VOICE CHAT

Communication plays a key role in The Hidden Camp. Players can talk through proximity voice chat, making conversations feel more natural and tense.

Who you hear, what you say, and when you speak can all affect whether others trust you.

KEY FEATURES

  • Online multiplayer matches for 9 players

  • Social deduction gameplay with hidden traitors

  • Task-based survival objectives

  • Camp Leader role with special gameplay impact

  • Proximity voice chat

  • Suspicion, betrayal, and teamwork in every round

  • Stylized 3D characters and a mysterious forest camp atmosphere

TRUST NO ONE

In The Hidden Camp, survival is not only about completing tasks.

It is about reading people, hiding your intentions, making the right accusations, and surviving long enough to reveal the truth.

Work together. Stay alert. Find the traitors. Survive the camp.

store_data.about_the_game:
🚂 Doomsday Train: A Mobile Haven on Rails

When the world collapses in the apocalypse and cities lie in ruins, the order of civilization has long ceased to exist. Only the rusted railway tracks still stretch across the barren wasteland, carrying humanity’s last hope. You will take command of an end-of-the-world train, leading a group of survivors to fight for survival from your mobile stronghold.

🔧 Refit Your Train to Build a Mobile Home

Unlike traditional colony survival games, you don’t need to build permanent houses or walls — every carriage of your train is your workshop, storage, medical bay, and living quarters.

  • Rearrange carriage layouts, build facilities, and construct an efficient survival network in limited space.

  • Maintain the train engine, reinforce armor, and keep it moving forward through the dangers of the wasteland.

  • Assign jobs and roles to survivors, ensuring every member of the team contributes to your survival.

☀️ Dynamic Extreme Weather Tests Your Strategy

On the wasteland, danger never follows a pattern:

  • Sandstorms wear down train parts, while radiation clouds force you to seal carriages immediately.

  • Blizzards freeze the tracks, and sweltering heat spoils food — every weather condition requires advance preparation.

  • Threats like zombie hordes and raiders can breach your defenses at any time.

🧠 Deep Survival Management and Tough Choices

Survival is more than just gathering resources:

  • Manage food, water, and fuel carefully to travel farther in the resource-scarce wasteland.

  • Care for survivors’ health, moods, and needs — illness and depression can tear the team apart.

  • Face moral dilemmas: accept strangers or conserve supplies? Risk scavenging or play it safe? Your decisions shape everyone’s fate.

🎮 Immersive Side-Scrolling Perspective

Featuring a 2.5D side view , you’ll witness the struggles of life inside the carriages up close, feeling the tension and despair of the end of the world.

Compete with other angels to invest into the most perspective startups and climb the top of the rankings.

store_data.about_the_game:
Generals at the Line, Banners Sweeping the Realm

Three Kingdoms: Yi (no pretense — really!) is a 2D turn-based roguelite deckbuilder.

You take command as a sovereign in an age of warring lords,

campaigning across 8 provinces and 49 cities,

and with every choice, reshaping your deck, your generals, and your destiny.

▶ Take up the cause of the "Imperial Uncle" and shore up the crumbling Han.

———

Core Features

Deckbuilding × General Cultivation

Four slots on the battlefield are yours to command —

deploy and withdraw any general as the moment demands.

Each general carries unique talents, with thousands of possible combinations.

— Guan Yu's "Saint of War" floods the Seven Armies;

Pang Tong's "Fledgling Phoenix" rises from the ashes.

When a general retires from service, their talents can be inherited

by the next to take up the mantle.

Avatars, generals, troop cards — so long as the bloodline endures,

the story never ends.

8 Provinces, 49 Cities — A Campaign That Never Repeats

The "Nine Provinces" lie scattered like mist, their heroes blazing like stars —

each run, choose any province as your starting ground.

Conquer six cities within your province, and the road to Sili opens —

all the way to Luoyang.

Events, shops, recruitment, rest stops, drills, inheritance —

the choices among them shape the path of your fate.

▶ Set out from Yizhou, with eyes on Luoyang!

Persuasion: Turn Foes Into Allies

Every enemy general can be persuaded — even bosses.

Use Persuasion Decrees of varying quality to attempt the turn,

and with luck, the enemy will change banners and stand with you.

— As recruitment count rises, you unlock the Star Chart and light new talents.

Custom Generals and Awakening

Sculpt your own avatar with your own hands —

choose their nature, attributes, and talents.

Four entirely distinct paths of Awakening shape four different builds.

Let the general of your own creation step into the chaos of the Three Kingdoms,

and through the Awakening system, reshape their power again and again.

Banner System: The Mark of a Faction

Each city you conquer yields the banner of its former lord,

along with a randomly drawn banner motto.

Assemble the full banner, and your entire host gains its blessing —

Shu's righteousness, Wei's dominion, Wu's cunning, Han's legitimacy,

all bent to your will.

———

Find Your Own Answer in the Chaos

Every city is a question to be answered.

Every recruitment may steer your deck into new waters.

Banners, avatars, destiny, the Star Chart —

all your gains are kindling for the next march on Luoyang.

▶ Don't end up like the "Prime Minister," undone by a single wrong choice.

store_data.about_the_game:
This game has a strong right-wing bias.

If you are left-wing, this game may not be for you.

As of now, the game includes 31 debates. The list also features a search function.

All debates are scripted and may have multiple endings.

During a debate, either you or the NPC may start the conversation.

You may be given a single choice or multiple options.

Sometimes the game opens a separate screen where you must select the correct checkboxes in a datasheet. The game will only continue once all the correct checkboxes have been selected.

In most cases, the NPC you are debating with will try to punch you when faced with arguments they cannot refute, similar to many real-life situations. You can choose to punch the NPC back, let yourself be punched, or escape.

Depending on your choices, the ending may change.

For example, you can win by escaping the fight and moving your character to the left side of the screen.

Or lose depending on the conditions — for example, if you knock out the NPC.

In every debate included in this game, knocking out the other NPC does leads to a lose scenario, since the goal of the game is not to promote violence.

However, you can easily create your own debates where this condition results in a win.

This game includes tools for creating mods, along with examples that show how to create your own characters and debates.

Creating a new character is easy. All you need to do is edit a single file, settings.json, where you change the character’s name and ID, and replace the image file Body.png (you will need an image editor that supports transparent backgrounds).

Creating a new debate is also simple. You only need to create a Debate.json file and a settings.json file.

The game also includes tools to check for mistakes in debates, as well as tools to generate files for multilingual debates. It can even generate VS Code settings that automatically load the JSON schema and enable autocomplete.

There are tools that automatically check errors on characters, debates settings and also their translations.

The debate example included with the game will appear in the main menu list once you comment out the following line in the settings.json file:

store_data.detailed_description:
This game has a strong right-wing bias.

If you are left-wing, this game may not be for you.

As of now, the game includes 31 debates. The list also features a search function.

All debates are scripted and may have multiple endings.

During a debate, either you or the NPC may start the conversation.

You may be given a single choice or multiple options.

Sometimes the game opens a separate screen where you must select the correct checkboxes in a datasheet. The game will only continue once all the correct checkboxes have been selected.

In most cases, the NPC you are debating with will try to punch you when faced with arguments they cannot refute, similar to many real-life situations. You can choose to punch the NPC back, let yourself be punched, or escape.

Depending on your choices, the ending may change.

For example, you can win by escaping the fight and moving your character to the left side of the screen.

Or lose depending on the conditions — for example, if you knock out the NPC.

In every debate included in this game, knocking out the other NPC does leads to a lose scenario, since the goal of the game is not to promote violence.

However, you can easily create your own debates where this condition results in a win.

This game includes tools for creating mods, along with examples that show how to create your own characters and debates.

Creating a new character is easy. All you need to do is edit a single file, settings.json, where you change the character’s name and ID, and replace the image file Body.png (you will need an image editor that supports transparent backgrounds).

Creating a new debate is also simple. You only need to create a Debate.json file and a settings.json file.

The game also includes tools to check for mistakes in debates, as well as tools to generate files for multilingual debates. It can even generate VS Code settings that automatically load the JSON schema and enable autocomplete.

There are tools that automatically check errors on characters, debates settings and also their translations.

store_data.about_the_game:
I originally developed this game for release under the holo Indie brand, but it was not approved by CCMC Corporation.

They said I could still release it independently, so here is the game.

Supports DLSS and FSR.

This game features Pekora and Vivi from hololive (and contains some references that only fans will understand).

Using either a baseball bat or a golf club, Pekora launches Vivi — who is inside a ball — downhill.

You can somewhat control the ball using the [W][A][S][D] keys.

But gravity can easily overpower your controls.

The ball has health points, and it takes more or less damage depending on the surface it is rolling over. For example, it takes less damage on sand and more damage on rocks.

When the ball’s HP reaches 0, it breaks open and Vivi flies out and rolls across the ground.

If this happens near some items, an event can happen. I.E. If you land near a chest, Pekora will open it and obtain a new item.

This detection range depends on the baseball bat or golf club equipped.

You can select the new bat or ball from the main menu (press Esc)

There is a menu that lists all missions, with filters to show or hide completed missions. The list is sorted by name.

Whenever you see a gate with a blinking yellow light, it means it is the first gate of a mission.

However, not all missions have a gate with a blinking yellow light. For example, in the bowling missions, you must knock down all the pins.

store_data.about_the_game:
Main gameplay

Click Through Earth is a short, relaxing incremental game. Your job is simple: gather coins and crystals by clicking any grid blocks to destroy them and see what rewards you can find inside.

Be aware, you only have a limited number of clicks per game, so make every click count.

Currencies

Basically, there are two currencies in the game, coins and crystals, and you need both to progress.

To get coins, you must destroy any single grid block. Each block has a chance to drop a coin when broken.

Crystals work differently. On each level, there are connected blocks shaped according to the level’s visual and theme. When you destroy these connected structures, they may contain the crystal you’re looking for.

Upgrade tree

All the currencies you collect can be spent in the upgrade tree, where some upgrades require one type of currency and others require both, so choose the ones that best fit your playstyle.

Build and Customize Your Attacks

Some upgrades give you items that you must place in a stacking room to use. The stacking is physics-based, so arrange items in a way that gives the best outcome. Each slot in the room represents one click, and you decide the order that suits you.

Use your own combination of items to make super powerful attacks.

Grow stronger as you play.

  • A relaxing incremental game where you progress at your own pace.

  • 10 different levels, each with its own uniqueness.

  • Use your own combination of items.

  • Relaxing soundtracks, composed by Loyalty Freak Music.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Stage

The main stage of this work is a space research vessel named "Xiange". Lost in space and out of contact with Earth, the vessel forms an unconventional "stormy mountain villa", making it an ideal setting for a honkaku mystery story...

Story Background

The protagonist, Chen Chou, is invited by a friend to take part in a strange experiment. During the experiment, Chen Chou enters a bizarre container. When he regains consciousness, he finds himself aboard a space research vessel. Stranger still, the crew members—whom Chen Chou has never met—all claim to know him. Could it be that he has traveled to a parallel world? And soon after, murders begin to occur one after another...

A reasoning experience that emphasizes player agency

In typical mystery games, the deduction segments often follow a fixed process: players are only asked to reason at key moments, spending most of their time watching characters discuss rather than deducing on their own. This makes it hard to experience the authentic honkaku mystery thrill of starting from scratch and unraveling the truth step by step.

The deduction system of Parallel Lines Intersection Murder Case aims to stimulate players’ initiative in independent reasoning. The reasoning process is actively controlled by the player—which line of thought or clue to start with is decided by the player, rather than following a fixed in-game sequence.

Reasoning and story influenced by parallel worlds

Depending on whether the player uses parallel-world-related clues during deduction, the reasoning will diverge significantly, potentially leading to completely different murders and methods. At the same time, it will also affect the subsequent direction of the story.

4772190.name: Master of the Ages: Foundations of History

store_data.about_the_game:
Master of the Ages is a historical 4X strategy game focused on the mechanics of empire building. From the Ancient world to the Modern era, you direct the macro-strategy of your civilization across six eras of human history. The visual presentation favors clean, tidy graphics, making it easy to see what is actually happening across your empire at a glance.

CITIES THAT SPECIALIZE

Cities are differentiated through structural infrastructure choices, not just tile output. Starting in the Classical era, several key buildings come in mutually exclusive pairs: build the Market District for trade and growth, and the Artisan Quarter — better suited to cities sitting on hills and mining terrain — is permanently locked out. By the late game, most of your cities will have settled into distinct roles and flavors based on the infrastructure choices you committed to along the way.
  • A single currency & Urban Capacity. No gold, no influence, no parallel economies to juggle. Production Points are the empire's entire economy — upkeep, construction, and research all draw from the same pool. However, growth is strictly bounded by Urban Capacity; a city's population will stall until you commit production to infrastructure that physically expands its urban footprint.
  • Queue-driven production. Allocate Production Points to what you want built — buildings, armies, founding projects. Unspent PP converts to Research Points up to a per-city Scholarly Capacity (raised by Libraries, Universities, and similar). Beyond capacity the conversion drops off sharply, so idle production cannot be silently converted into unlimited research.
  • City Focus. Each city declares its purpose. Growth and Production focuses are available from the start; Military and Science focuses unlock through later civic technologies. An automated governor handles tile-by-tile improvement decisions according to the focus, leaving the bigger picture to you.
  • No settler units. There is no settler to micromanage. Mature cities project new ones through founding projects, with real constraints on distance, supply lines, and food provisioning from the parent city.

COMPOSITE ARMIES, REAL LOGISTICS

Combat is automatic and resolves over several rounds, with the option to retreat between rounds. Each round runs through structured phases — Air, Artillery, Ranged, Cavalry, Melee, Support — and your composite armies engage according to the unit classes they pool together. Type advantages, terrain modifiers, veterancy, and morale all factor into outcomes. Battles play out quickly but the results feel grounded — armies that take heavy damage break morale and rout, and sieges require actual siege weapons — you will not breach a fortified city with cavalry.

The strategic layer is what gets armies into a fight:
  • Supply networks with finite range, chained supply depots, and depot positions enemies can target to disrupt your campaign.
  • Movement types (Foot, Mounted, Wheeled, Tracked, Motorized) that interact with terrain and roads — mountain passes matter, river crossings matter, road infrastructure matters.
  • Zone of Control that turns terrain choke points into real tactical decisions without requiring you to micromanage individual units.
  • Naval and air domains with embarking constrained by your port infrastructure's transport capacity, escort mechanics, coastal bombardment, and submarine stealth. Fleets patrol open water to engage hostile ships and shield vulnerable, embarked armies from interception.
  • Unified urban defense — cities defend with walls, militia, and garrison together. Taking a fortified city means breaking through each layer in turn.

FIVE BRANCHES OF PROGRESS

Technology is structured across five parallel categories — Agriculture, Engineering, Science, Civics, and Military — so your civilization develops as a coherent society rather than a single line on a tree.
  • Boost any category to accelerate research where you most need it.
  • Era advancement requires meaningful breadth across all five categories. You cannot sprint through Ancient by ignoring everything but Military.
  • Cross-category prerequisites create genuine strategic chains across the tree.
Six eras span Ancient through Modern, with technologies grounded in their historical context.

COVERT POWER

Beyond open warfare, you run espionage networks that gather intelligence on rivals, steal technologies, and execute sabotage. Espionage uses a deterministic friction model rather than dice rolls — the outcome of an operation is legible from its inputs, and a rival hiding a tech lead behind closed borders is a problem you can solve with patience and infiltration rather than luck.

THREE PATHS TO VICTORY

The Modern Era drives the world toward a climax. As any nation closes in on a victory condition, a global Doomsday Clock appears — alerting all players to the impending threat. There are no quiet, behind-the-scenes finishes.

Military Victory — Full Spectrum Dominance
Achieve a global Combat Strength (CS) of at least 1.5× the combined total of all surviving rivals to trigger a 10-turn surrender countdown. No tedious, city-by-city mop-up required. However, because CS scales dynamically with current unit HP%, a global coalition can pause or reset your countdown by damaging your forces via artillery, airstrikes, or skirmishes.

Economic Victory — Mars Colonization
Construct both a Spaceport and a Fusion Reactor to unlock the continuous Launch Mars Payload project. Every Production Point allocated across these specialized industrial hubs converts directly into tonnage toward a one-million-ton threshold. To stop you, rival nations must physically bomb your spaceports or capture your launch cities.

Science Victory — AI Singularity
Construct specialized AI Research Labs across your empire and flood them with Research Points. The Doomsday Clock displays the exact turns remaining until the Singularity completes, painting an immediate target on your top science hubs for the rest of the world.

NUCLEAR WEAPONS

The Modern Era introduces nuclear options, permanently reshaping both the map and the user. A strike scorches a seven-hex radius into a lasting wasteland. Crucially, the aggressor accumulates stacking domestic instability — protests, unrest, and lost urban capacity — while retaliatory strikes carry no such domestic penalty. Striking first cripples your own empire; striking back does not.

A NOTE ON DESIGN PHILOSOPHY

Master of the Ages is built for players who value systemic depth and clear feedback. The map favors readability over visual density, and the mechanics reward long-term planning over mechanical busywork.
With a unified economy driven by a single currency and an automated tile-management system, players do not need to manage individual settler movements, route spies across hexes, or handle granular micromanagement. Time spent in menus is focused entirely on making high-level, strategic decisions about the macro-development of your civilization.

store_data.about_the_game:
Between the Lines is a puzzle game centered around the transformation of Chinese characters.

In the game, every block is a Chinese character. You will push character blocks and create new characters through combination, decomposition, and transformation in order to complete each level’s objective. The position of each character, the order of combination, and the timing of triggering mechanisms can all affect the solution to a puzzle. The game also includes a dictionary system that records the characters you unlock along the way.

As you progress, more rules related to Chinese characters will gradually be introduced. Explore the vast world of Chinese writing, and discover new possibilities between the lines.

Features:

- Character-based puzzle mechanics: Change character blocks through combination, decomposition, and transformation, with puzzles closely tied to the shapes and meanings of Chinese characters.

- Multiple ways to solve puzzles: There is often more than one way to clear a level. A different perspective may lead to an unexpected solution.

- Built-in dictionary system: Newly created characters are recorded in the dictionary and can be reviewed at any time. You may even learn a few rare characters by accident.

- Hidden achievements: In certain levels, creating something especially fitting may unlock an achievement. Sometimes, making your own little scene can be just as enjoyable as clearing the level.

store_data.about_the_game:
Astral Dive is a fantasy pixel art RPG that pays homage to the great classics of the genre, reinventing exploration and combat with modern and dynamic mechanics.

Step into the shoes of Atlas, a young and promising mage, as you cross the threshold of astral portals, explore fascinating dimensions, and investigate the mysterious events that shook the academy of magic years ago. Will you uncover the truth and protect your world?

Unique and Strategic Turn-Based Combat

Forget typical turn-based battles. In Astral Dive, combat blends the tactical planning of classic JRPGs with an original system of stellar tiles (magic cards). Collect new spells during your journey, customize your deck, and create lethal synergies to defeat bizarre creatures and colossal bosses.
