It was the feeling it left behind.

The beauty.

The restraint.

The regrets.

The subtle and complicated relationships between people.

I always felt that simply reading the story was not enough.

I wanted to give it another life.

Not as a novel.

But as a world.

🏗️ Current Development Status

Red Chamber Chronicle already features a freely explorable world and a growing life simulation system inspired by the original novel.

Current features include:

  • A freely explorable Grand View Garden and Jia family world

  • Dynamic NPC schedules and time progression systems

  • Character growth and life simulation activities

  • Branching storylines and multiple endings

  • An expanding world that continues to grow with development

The game is not yet complete, but it has already become a world that players can truly live in.

🌳 What It's Like Developing Alone

Sometimes it feels slow.

Sometimes it feels impossibly difficult.

But most of the time, it brings a quiet sense of fulfillment.

Because you are not simply finishing tasks on a checklist.

You are building a world with your own hands.

A place that gradually grows into something real.

🌱 A Final Note

The complete vision for Red Chamber Chronicle spans seventeen years of life within the world of the Red Chamber.

The upcoming demo will contain the first six years of this journey, offering a substantial introduction to the world, characters, and systems.

The remaining eleven years, along with additional storylines and life chapters, will continue to be developed and expanded over time.

Thank you for taking an interest in this project.

I sincerely hope you enjoy your time in this world.
store_data.short_description: Red Chamber Chronicle is a classical Chinese life simulation and visual novel with multiple endings. You play as Jia Baoyu in the Grand View Garden, where daily life, relationships, and choices shape your branching story and different outcomes.

store_data.about_the_game:
Heartmend: 3D Jigsaw Puzzle is a warm and quiet 3D restoration puzzle game.

In a room that is slowly becoming empty, you will pick up scattered fragments, move them, rotate them, and study their shapes, piece by piece restoring broken objects to their complete form.

With every object you repair, the room changes in subtle ways. Places that once felt empty gradually begin to show traces of life again.

This is not a hurried challenge, but a slow process of sorting things out, piece by piece, and moving gently toward wholeness.

Restore Broken Objects

Each object has been shattered into 3D fragments of different shapes.

You will need to observe them from different angles, then move and rotate the pieces so they can fit back into their proper places.

From small dolls, plants, and lamps to objects filled with memories, every piece you put back makes this space feel a little more complete.

Observe and Assemble at Your Own Pace

You can freely adjust each fragment, studying its outline, cracks, and angle. It may take a little patience.

The game supports both keyboard and mouse controls, allowing you to move and rotate pieces more freely as you slowly find where they truly belong.

A Gentle Space Full of Small Interactions

As the room gradually recovers, some objects will gain small interactions of their own. It might be a piece of music, a little movement from a doll, or a tiny surprise waiting in a corner.

Features

3D fragment assembly: freely move and rotate pieces to restore broken objects
A room that gradually recovers: each completed puzzle makes the room warmer and richer
A variety of objects to restore: furniture, plants, dolls, instruments, and small everyday items full of life
Healing atmosphere: soft visuals, gentle music, and a quiet pace
Hidden interactions and small surprises: discover more details in the restored room
Perfect for players who enjoy slow-paced, cozy, relaxing, collecting, and restorative experiences

Some broken things do not disappear right away.
But the moment you choose to pick up the first piece, healing has already begun.
May every piece you put back make some quiet corner of your heart shine again.

store_data.about_the_game:
Catch the cats at all costs! Or... press the button and blow everything up?!

"Cat Or Explosion" is a single-screen, room-clearing point-and-click game where you try to catch adorable cats.

■ Two Ways to Clear Every Room

Every single room comes equipped with a "Cat" and an "Explosion Button"!

Will you catch the cat like a civilized person, give up and press the button, or... just press it anyway because you want to??

The choice is entirely yours! In some rooms, pressing the button might actually be the harder challenge?!

Can you clear every room using both methods?

■ 50 Stages Packed with Gimmicks!

Every room features different and unique Gimmicks!

Use your wits to catch these free-spirited cats!

(※ There is a possibility of more rooms being added via future updates or DLC.)

■ No Language Barrier! Intuitive Fun for Everyone

There is absolutely no text reading or math required to play.

While the supported languages are English and Japanese, text is only used for the user interface (menus, etc.) and will not affect your ability to enjoy the actual game.

■ Play Your Way! Full Input Support

Playable with just a mouse! Just a keyboard! Or just a controller!

No configuration needed—enjoy the exact same smooth controls on whichever device you prefer.

■ More Rooms Added Based on Sales!

We plan to add brand-new rooms through updates based on total copies sold!

Enjoy the game and look forward to more content!

Next Goal: 100 copies sold → 10 New Rooms!

──────────────────────────────────

※ Cat Or Explosion is a complete remake of the original web game of the same name. We have completely overhauled the system, redesigned all existing stages, and added plenty of brand-new rooms.

Video Posting and Live Streaming Guidelines

You are fully permitted to post videos and live stream this game, including the ending. Monetization using the official features provided by streaming platforms (such as ads, Super Chats, etc.) is completely fine. For more details, please refer to our official webpage.

╚══════════════════════════════╝

Hello Operator, we've been awaiting your decision.

The Moment of Panic is an experimental strategy game set in a dystopian future, where your finger rests on the button of a weapon of unimaginable destruction.

Buried deep underground and cut off from the outside world, you must interpret incoming intelligence signals with the help of advanced AI advisors. Your only job is to decide whether to step closer to doomsday, or pull the world back from the edge.

Some signals are warnings. Some are bait. Some are accidents. Some are lies.

Your AI advisors will analyze the situation, but they are not neutral. Each one has its own worldview, strategic instincts, and hidden priorities. One may urge escalation. Another may plead for restraint. Another may sound confident for all the wrong reasons.

You make the final call.

Escalate too quickly, and you may unleash the very disaster you were trying to prevent. Hesitate too long, and you may fail to stop a real attack. Every decision pushes the crisis closer to resolution, collapse, or launch.

You do not see the war. You do not fight the enemy. You sit in the bunker and decide what the world should fear.

Features

  • Interpret short, urgent intelligence signals from an unstable future world.

  • Consult AI advisors with distinct personalities, biases, and strategic beliefs.

  • Decide whether to escalate, de-escalate, or hold your position under pressure.

  • Manage uncertainty when no source of information can be fully trusted.

  • Experience a psychological strategy game about panic, paranoia, and irreversible decisions.

  • Replay crisis scenarios where signal truth, advisor behavior, and outcomes can shift.

Innovative Storytelling Using Local AI

The Moment of Panic uses a locally running, open-source large language model constrained by game logic to create AI advisors that feel reactive, opinionated, and alive.

These are not simple dialogue trees. Your advisors can interpret the current crisis, argue with each other, justify their recommendations, and attempt to influence your decision. But beneath every conversation, the game is still tracking truth, uncertainty, pressure, and consequence.

The machines can speak. They cannot always be trusted.

store_data.about_the_game:
CRUORFALL

Two souls. One labyrinth. No mercy.

I'm building Cruorfall alone. One developer, one plan, step by step — a game I always wanted to make.

This is a roguelike dungeon crawler. Cards, dodging, runes, and a labyrinth that wants you dead. There are no difficulty sliders. There's no tutorial holding your hand. You'll die. Many times. So did I. That's the point.

THE WORLD

A gothic, ever-shifting labyrinth, rotted through with a curse of blood magic. Two strangers wake bound by fate inside it — a frail aristocrat with a sharp mind, and a brute mercenary who uses his head to hit, not to think. They have nothing in common except the dungeon. Their story unfolds slowly, in pieces. Across many deaths.

Across many runs. Across many tries.

HOW IT PLAYS

You hold cards. You play them in real time, while enemies fire at you and the floor tries to kill you. Some cards hit you with timing minigames — reflex tests, timing checks. Hit them clean and the damage spikes. Hit them perfectly, again and again, and your starter card can kill a boss. There's no ceiling. The card sets the floor. Your reflex sets the rest.

Each card also carries a single rune — a letter. Play your cards in the right order and they spell a word. The word casts a spell. Play them carelessly and the runes stay decoration.

Between turns you dodge. WASD. No pause. Read patterns, move smart, plan through the stress. Stay alive long enough to draw your next card. Don't waste the last drop of blood.

The dungeon throws riddles at you too. Reflex tests. Traps. Small puzzles. It's not just about your deck — it's about you.

PROGRESSION CUTS BOTH WAYS

You unlock crafting, enchanting, artifacts, card upgrades. None of it comes free. The same materials you spend to unlock a mechanic also pay the dungeon — enemies hit harder, enemies have more health. Every tool you earn arms them in the same breath. You don't outgrow Cruorfall. You just trade one edge for another, sharper one.

PERMADEATH

You die, you start over. The dungeon forgets. You don't.

WHY I MADE IT THIS WAY

I designed Cruorfall to be unforgiving on purpose. Not cruel — cruor (Latin for blood). The kind of game where the win means something because you earned it. The pleasure is in the bleeding.

FEATURES

  • Real-time card combat with timing-based minigames

  • Runic spellcasting through card play

  • Bullet-hell dodging during your turns

  • True permadeath — every run starts you fresh

  • Meta-progression that arms the dungeon as it arms you

  • Crafting, enchanting, artifacts, card upgrades

  • Procedural dungeons, riddles, events, traps

  • Two protagonists with a shared, slowly unfolding story (in progress)

  • Co-op and PvP — planned

  • Grim pixel art

  • Built by one developer, in the dark, slowly - somewhere in Poland

FOR PLAYERS OF

Slay the Spire. Darkest Dungeon. Anything that made you swear at your screen and come back the next night.

Bleed wisely.

store_data.about_the_game:
A dead man. A borrowed name. A case no one wants reopened.


Wild East: The Straw Man is a story-driven 2D point-and-click adventure set in the wild 1990s of Slovakia and Czechia.

Marek Varga is a young reporter at a small newsroom, sent to cover what looks like a routine death: a company director, a few suspicious papers, and another case everyone would rather forget.

But the dead man was not the person in control. He was a straw man: a name on documents, a signature where someone else needed one, and a body left behind when the scheme became inconvenient.

Together with Czech reporter Eva Svobodová, Marek follows answering-machine messages, old files, witness stories, locked doors, and uncomfortable favors through a world where the official version is rarely the true one.

Take your time. Read the room. Follow the paper trail.


This is a slower, atmospheric mystery built around conversations, observation, documents, inventory puzzles, and the strange logic of a decade where almost anything could be explained away with a stamp, a favor, or a missing file.

Features


  • Classic 2D point-and-click adventure gameplay.
  • A grounded mystery set in 1990s Slovakia and Czechia.
  • Two reporters uncovering one case from different sides of the border.
  • Dialogue-driven investigation with choices that matter.
  • Inventory puzzles, documents, witness accounts, and locked doors.
  • Dry local humor and atmospheric, slower-paced storytelling.
  • Full voice acting planned in English, Slovak, and Czech.

CosmoFab is a factory-building game where you create massive automated industrial systems through mining, construction, production, and logistics.

Explore and mine resources to produce a wide variety of materials and products.

Expand your base by efficiently connecting production facilities and transport lines, and build a large-scale automated factory system.

While carrying out your mission, hostile creatures will continuously attack your base.

Build walls and defensive turrets to protect your facilities, and carefully manage both expansion and defense at the same time.

Research new technologies to unlock faster production and stronger defensive systems.

Through continuous research, you can gain access to more advanced equipment and technologies.

Plexa is a planetary exploration unit available from the very beginning of the game.

It plays a key role in scouting the planet and defending your base, and can be upgraded to become even more powerful.

Use Plexa to explore unknown planets and complete your mission.

store_data.about_the_game:
YOU ARE THE DISPATCHER

Calls are coming in. The city needs help. You have seconds to decide.

Signal Zero puts you behind the emergency dispatch console — a one-person
operation managing police, fire, and EMS units across a city that never stops
demanding your attention.

HOW IT WORKS

  • Incidents appear on your board with a countdown timer
  • Route the right unit — send the wrong one and you'll pay for it
  • Units take time to travel — a closer unit arrives faster
  • Let calls escalate and they get harder to resolve
  • Reputation hits zero and your shift is over

BUILD YOUR DISPATCH CENTER

Earn budget on every resolved call. Spend it on additional units and upgrades
to handle more simultaneous emergencies as shifts get harder.

60 UNIQUE INCIDENTS

From bar fights to cardiac arrests to swift-water rescues — some calls are
obvious, some will trick you. A child locked in a hot car isn't a police call.
A psychiatric crisis isn't always EMS. Learn the city.

FEATURES

  • Tense single-player dispatch gameplay
  • 3 unit types — police, fire, EMS — each with unique incidents
  • Distance-based response times reward smart unit placement
  • Escalating priority system — ignore a call and it gets worse
  • Shift progression across 10 increasingly difficult shifts
  • Scanner radio atmosphere
  • Minimalist dispatch-console aesthetic

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to Puzzle O’Matic, a cozy island adventure where every photo becomes a puzzle.

Explore a peaceful world full of charming places, adorable creatures, and small relaxing moments. Meet friendly NPCs, accept simple photo quests, and wander across the island looking for the perfect shot.

Take photos, create puzzles, and bring your memories to life.

When you find something special, enter Photo Mode, adjust your view, and capture the scene. Each photo is turned into a physical puzzle box that you can carry to a puzzle station, build right away, or store on shelves for later.

A relaxing loop of exploration and creativity

  • Explore a colorful island at your own pace

  • Accept quests from NPCs and discover new photo spots

  • Photograph cute animals, cozy houses, shops, flowers, and scenic places

  • Turn every photo into a jigsaw puzzle

  • Save puzzle boxes on shelves and finish them whenever you want

  • Complete puzzles to decorate the world with your finished pictures

Made for cozy players

Puzzle O’Matic is designed to be calm, gentle, and satisfying. There are no intense battles or stressful timers — just exploration, discovery, photography, and the joy of fitting pieces together.

Whether you want to finish quests, collect lovely scenes, or simply spend time in a peaceful world, Puzzle O’Matic is a small cozy journey full of cute details and handmade memories.

store_data.about_the_game:
Knaights is a turn-based strategy game set in a medieval fantasy environment, with linear base vs base combat. You start with a castle and 3 knights to build a strong kingdom that vanquishes your opponent's stronghold. Each turn, select actions for all your assets (structures, units/troops, and a perk for your team) that execute together once you submit your selections. Progress through your upgrades and build quickly to gain the advantage on your opponent!

Depending on your strategy, time commitment, and difficulty level, matches can last anywhere between 30 minutes and a week! Unlock customizations and gain achievements as you battle opponents and seize victories! Completely playable with just a mouse, keyboard and controller functionality are also supported. There should be some laid-back feel as there is no time-pressure regarding your turns (unless you're playing competitively).

Each structure and unit has a special purpose. Knights (the main fellow/lady in the game) are used for questing, attacking, and guarding. They can be upgraded (no spoilers here) and are your first usable unit. Sending knights on quests risks their death out in the world. If they are successful, however, they bring back spoils of their trials, earning them a name on the field. Use their spoils to build your army, unlocking new units and abilities.

Sending an overwhelming army will eventually whittle down your opponent and reaching the castle allows your troops to damage their base. Once the castle health is depleted, you'll reign victorious.

store_data.about_the_game:
About This Game

Hannibal is a grand strategy and real-time tactics game where every decision on the campaign map can turn into a decisive battlefield clash. Build your power across regions, plan your invasions, manage your army, and when war begins, take direct control of your forces in real-time battles.

In Hannibal, conquest is not only about having the largest army. Victory depends on timing, positioning, formations, and the way you use your units on the battlefield. Choose the region you want to attack, prepare your army, and enter a tactical battle where you must break the enemy line, protect your own formation, and use the terrain to your advantage.

The game combines the large-scale planning of a Grand Strategy game with the direct control and intensity of Real-Time Strategy combat. On the world map, you expand your influence, capture new lands, and decide where your next campaign will begin. On the battlefield, you command infantry, archers, cavalry, and generals in a system inspired by classic lines of battle.

Key Features

Grand Strategy Campaign

Control your nation from the campaign map. Choose which regions to attack, defend your borders, and expand your territory step by step. Every region can become an opportunity — or a dangerous trap.

Real-Time Tactical Battles

When armies meet, the battle is not decided automatically. You take command directly. Move your units, create formations, react to the enemy, and lead your army in real time.

Formation-Based Warfare

Victory depends on how well you organize your army. Infantry can hold the front line, archers can weaken enemies from a distance, cavalry can flank and break formations, and generals can change the flow of battle.

Lines of Battle Style Combat

Battles are built around frontlines, unit positioning, and tactical pressure. Breaking the enemy line at the right moment can decide the whole war.

Strategic Region Conquest

Each attack begins with a choice on the map. Decide where to strike, which army to send, and how much risk you are willing to take. A successful invasion can open the path to new territories.

Command Your Army Your Way

Use different tactics depending on the situation. Hold defensive positions, rush weak points, surround enemies, or use cavalry to attack from the sides. Your decisions matter both before and during battle.

Your Goal

Your mission is to build a powerful empire through smart strategy and strong battlefield leadership. Expand your control, defeat rival forces, and prove that victory belongs not only to the strongest army, but to the best commander.

In Hannibal, every region is a decision.

Every battle is a test.

Every victory brings you closer to domination.

Victory depends on how well you organize your army. Infantry can hold the front line, archers can weaken enemies from a distance, cavalry can flank and break formations, and generals can change the flow of battle.

Lines of Battle Style Combat

Battles are built around frontlines, unit positioning, and tactical pressure. Breaking the enemy line at the right moment can decide the whole war.

Strategic Region Conquest

Each attack begins with a choice on the map. Decide where to strike, which army to send, and how much risk you are willing to take. A successful invasion can open the path to new territories.

Command Your Army Your Way

Use different tactics depending on the situation. Hold defensive positions, rush weak points, surround enemies, or use cavalry to attack from the sides. Your decisions matter both before and during battle.

Your Goal

Your mission is to build a powerful empire through smart strategy and strong battlefield leadership. Expand your control, defeat rival forces, and prove that victory belongs not only to the strongest army, but to the best commander.

In Hannibal, every region is a decision.

Every battle is a test.

Every victory brings you closer to domination.
store_data.short_description: Hannibal is a grand strategy game with real-time tactical battles. Choose regions on the campaign map, command your army, and take direct control when war begins. Build formations, break enemy lines, and lead your empire to victory through smart strategy and battlefield decisions.

store_data.about_the_game:
HELLOCRACY

Welcome to hell.

Take a ticket and wait to be called.

HELLOCRACY is a short, story-driven first-person survival shooter about a man who, after death, finds himself in a bureaucratic hell. Here, demons wear ties, the offices never end, and every new corridor smells of stale coffee and burnt-out employees.

The player must survive among endless departments, search for resources, craft items, read notes from fallen hellish workers, and try to figure out if escape is even possible.

The combat system is built around limited resources and aggressive enemies.

  • First-person shooting

  • Pistol with two firing modes

  • Dash for dodging

  • Fast enemies and long-range combat

Traps and resource management:

  • LMB - single shot;

  • RMB - empty entire magazine at once

Sometimes it's better to conserve ammo; sometimes it's too late.

To survive, you'll need to gather resources and use your inventory.

The player can:

  • Create bandages

  • Use buffs

  • Restore health

  • Increase damage

  • Temporarily increase stamina with coffee

Every item found can be useful later in the level.

Hell here operates like a huge, broken system.

The levels contain:

  • Traps

  • Toxic zones

  • Closed office sections

  • Loudspeakers with employee announcements

  • Lore through posters and notes

The story is told through the environment and comic inserts instead of cutscenes.

Enemies

Clerk

A typical office worker from hell.

Attacks from close range and constantly presses.

Toxic

A heavy ranged enemy that attacks with toxic projectiles.

The Little

A fast and dangerous enemy that dies easily, but is excellent at finishing off inattentive players.

Shredder - General Manager

The final boss and ruler of this section of Hell. A huge monster that attacks in melee combat and releases smaller mobs during battle.

Control

  • LMB — shoot

  • RMB — fire all bullets

  • F — close-range attack with suitcase

  • G — throw grenade

  • Shift — run

  • Space — dash

  • B / I — inventory

  • ESC — pause

  • 1 / 2 / 3 — quick item slots

About the project

Made with Unreal Engine 5

The game is designed to last approximately 10-15 minutes and is a short story-driven adventure with elements of survival and first-person shooter.

store_data.about_the_game:
Rogue Jet Fighter is a fast‑paced arcade space shooter that sends you on a dangerous solo mission deep inside hostile alien territory. Your objective: reach and destroy the enemy’s Death Moon station — a colossal super‑weapon capable of wiping out entire fleets. Armed with your jet fighter, quick reflexes, and a single powerful blaster bomb, you must fight your way through waves of alien ships, deadly obstacles, and chaotic space environments.

Fly through asteroid fields, dodge incoming fire, and blast enemy fighters in classic arcade‑style combat. Choose from multiple ships and space scenes, each offering a different visual and more challenging experience. Tight controls and fast action make every run intense, challenging, and replayable.

Your mission is simple: survive long enough to get close to the Death Moon station… and blow it apart.

Features

  • Fast, arcade‑style space shooting with intense enemy waves

  • Solo mission behind enemy lines with a clear objective: destroy the Death Moon station

  • Dodge asteroids and enemy fire in high‑speed combat

  • Use your powerful blaster bomb when you reach the station

  • Multiple ships and space scenes to choose from

  • Colorful 3D environments with classic sci‑fi style

  • Simple, responsive controls designed for quick action

  • Short, replayable runs perfect for arcade shooter fans

4777610.name: Time Gamers: Guardians of the Marble Man

movies.name: Guardians of the Marble Man: Game demo

store_data.about_the_game:
As a Time Gamer, you have been selected to journey back to 1864 in search of a mysterious relic believed to have inspired the Confederacy during the American Civil War. Armed with a period map and a list of historic locations, you must explore the past, uncover clues, and collect keys that lead to the lost artifact.

This is a relaxed exploration and discovery game. There are no enemies, combat sequences, or time limits. Your objective is simply to search, investigate, and find. To keep every adventure unique, each playthrough features a different randomized set of clues, locations, and targets to discover.

Features:

Immersive World:
Step into a meticulously reconstructed version of one of the Confederacy’s most prosperous cities, Columbia, South Carolina, during the Civil War. Explore streets, landmarks, and neighborhoods recreated from extensive historical research.

3D Anaglyph Mode:
Experience the world in immersive 3D at the press of a key. Simply put on a pair of red/cyan 3D glasses to see Columbia come to life in a whole new dimension.

Original Soundtrack:
Every location is accompanied by its own original musical score, carefully composed to capture the mood and character of the setting. The music enhances the atmosphere, enriches the storytelling, and creates a memorable journey through history.

Historical Narration:
As you explore, narrated commentary reveals the authentic history of each location. Meet and interact with people from the era while discovering buildings and environments reconstructed from historical records, maps, photographs, and archaeological research.

Investigation and Discovery:
Success depends on careful observation. Search for clues, uncover hidden connections, and find creative ways to overcome obstacles as you work toward solving the mystery.

Achievements and Exploration:
While your primary mission is to locate the lost Calhoun statue, the world is filled with additional secrets, challenges, and historical discoveries. Venture off the main path to unlock achievements and uncover more of Columbia’s rich past.

Background:

Behind this game is more than a decade of historical research and reconstruction. Over 170 city blocks have been painstakingly recreated using 1850 and 1872 maps, early Columbia city directories, archaeological findings, and records documenting the buildings destroyed in 1865. The result is a detailed recreation of Columbia, South Carolina, as it stood in 1864, on the eve of its destruction by fire.

The Old South Carolina State House has been reconstructed from original architectural plans and extensive archival materials preserved by the South Carolina Department of Archives and History. Alongside documented history, the game incorporates some of Columbia’s most enduring legends, including stories of the city’s underground tunnels and the mysterious USC Third-Eye Man.

Yet the Roman statue of John C. Calhoun is not a legend.

It is the relic you seek.

It is the Marble Man.

In 1850, shortly before his death, Calhoun took a personal interest in the design of the statue. A student of history and particularly fascinated by the decline of the Roman Republic and Empire, he believed the United States faced deep sectional divisions that could eventually lead to conflict. His warnings about the nation’s future helped make him a powerful symbol for the secession movement that emerged a decade later.

When Union forces occupied Columbia in 1865, the statue disappeared. Historical accounts suggest it may have been concealed beneath the Old State House to prevent its destruction. What became of it remains one of Columbia’s enduring mysteries. Some stories even claim that its final guardian was buried alongside it.

Now, more than a century later, the mystery remains unsolved.

As a Time Gamer, you have been chosen to travel back to 1864 and uncover the statue’s fate. Following clues hidden throughout the city, you must locate the Marble Man before history closes around it forever.

The past is waiting.

Will you find the Marble Man?

Welcome to the most chaotic, yet utterly addictive "fully automated" farm in the universe.

Forget traditional management games where you manually swing hoes and herd livestock. Here, you have zero control over where the animals go—they sprint blindly across the field like wild horses. Your core mission is to use deep strategy to shape the environment, then sit back and watch the chaos trigger mind-blowing chain reactions!

This is a hardcore Roguelike strategy game that perfectly blends RNG, spatial geometry, and god-tier build synergy. You handle the probabilities and placement—the rest is up to fate and the animals' digestive tracts!

🎲 Master the Chaos: Luck is a Skill, But Wisdom Rewrites Fate

  • Uncontrollable, Free-Roaming Pathing: When the animals turn, collide, or poop on the farmland is entirely up to their own "free will."

  • Manipulate Odds with Items: Having animals hit structures to trigger skills used to be purely up to fate. But as the run progresses, you can collect powerful items that drastically boost trigger rates. With the right build, you can turn random luck into a 100% guaranteed "inevitable chain reaction"!

📐 Geometric Placement: Build Your Own "Living Pinball Machine"

Animals walk with random path, but you can use field items to pave the way for them!

  • Trajectory Masters: Use over a dozen types of placeable farm items with turning and bouncing mechanics to precisely guide animal routes, forcing them to "release" resources at the exact right time and place.

  • High-Stakes Spatial Strategy: The placement order and layout of your devices make or break your run. A god-tier setup can cause rampaging animals to trigger endless chain reactions between structures, skyrocketing your production efficiency in an instant!

🏆 Insane "Synergies": No Single Meta, Only Game-Breaking Combos

  • A Pool of 100+ Mysterious Trinkets: Every run is an irreversible, randomized adventure. Hundreds of trinkets provide rule-bending passive abilities.

  • Dopamine-Fueled Builds: Will you go for the "Ultra-Speed Hyper-Bounce Build," the "100% Lucky Never-Miss Build," or the "Poop-Covered Production Blast Build"? The synergies between animals, items, and trinkets are endless, satisfying your ultimate craving for min-maxing and theorycrafting!

📊 Endless Replayability! Face Never-Before-Seen Chaotic Runs

  • 10 Quirky animals, each with unique and chaotic collision physics

  • 10+ types of placeable items to alter trajectories and create infinite chains

  • 100+ trinkets and items to rewrite probabilities and break stat caps

  • 7 distinct game modes, each requiring an entirely new tactical approach to break the game

  • 7 grueling difficulty tiers, tailor-made for roguelike players who love deep strategy

Story

After taking the subway downtown to see your family members, you fall asleep on the train. When you wake up, you find yourself in a disturbing new reality.

Features

  • Surreal Psychological Horror: Experience a disturbing, linear narrative that blurs the line between a routine commute and a waking nightmare.

  • Immersive Realism: High-resolution graphics and atmospheric environmental design pull you directly into the depths of this twisted reality.

  • Evasion & Survival: Encounter aggressive, bizarre enemies where survival depends on quick thinking and resourcefulness.

  • Interlocking Puzzles: Progress through unique environments by solving clever, logic-based puzzles and environmental challenges.

  • Cinematic Presentation: Voiced characters and high-quality cutscenes bring the dark narrative to life.

  • Original Soundtrack: Features a full, atmospheric soundtrack tailored to heighten the game's tension and dread. With music from Avapxia.

  • Full Controller Support: Play your way with seamless controller integration.

store_data.about_the_game:
Every soul shall face judgment.

After death, the dead cross the River of Duat and arrive at the land of judgment.

You are the witness of death, the arbiter of souls, the one who decides their final fate.

Among them are liars, murderers, the regretful, and those who deny their sins even in death.

Open the Book of the Dead. Use the Mirror of Truth to uncover hidden clues and contradictions, and seek the truth buried within chaos.

Your choices and judgments will shape both the fate of each soul and the stories that follow.

The Scales Debate

Judgment is not a simple matter of good and evil.
What is truly weighed is the soul itself.

Use abilities and cards to influence the balance of the scales within limited turns. Obsession, denial, and curses become weapons in the debate. Use truth, conviction, and the power of order to break through deception and falsehood.

Even the gods themselves may intervene and judge your worth.

The Ever-Changing Underworld

Conflicts between ancient gods, forgotten laws of judgment, wandering souls...

The deeper truths hidden within the underworld will slowly reveal themselves.

And every judgment you make may alter the future of the entire underworld.

store_data.about_the_game:
An unknown signal is rising from the deep. Dive, recover, and return alive.

Deep Drift: Signal Below is a 2D underwater action-adventure game. Descend into dark ocean passages filled with coral reefs, kelp fields, rock walls, and deep-sea trenches as you search for the source of a mysterious signal below.

Every dive is a choice between risk and reward. Push deeper to uncover more valuable salvage, or return before oxygen, pressure, and hostile sea life overwhelm you. Bring resources back to the supply station, upgrade your gear, and prepare for the next descent.

Explore The Deep

  • Swim through open water, reef passages, kelp zones, and underwater caverns

  • Manage oxygen, depth, and pressure as you decide how far to descend

  • Collect coins, shells, treasure chests, and mission-critical objectives

  • Trace the strange signal hidden beneath the ocean floor

Recover Resources And Upgrade Your Gear

Use recovered resources to improve your diving kit. Upgrade your oxygen tank to stay underwater longer, reinforce your pressure shell to reach deeper zones, expand your cargo frame to carry more salvage, and enhance your fins and harpoon rig for better mobility and utility.

Control The Rhythm Of Every Dive

The deep will not wait for you. Oxygen drains over time, pressure rises with depth, and one greedy decision can turn a successful run into a failed expedition. Learn when to keep descending, when to retreat, and when to risk everything for one more objective.

store_data.about_the_game:
Shrunken to a mere 8 centimeters tall by an unknown force, once familiar rooms, clothing, and human bodies have become gigantic terrain that must be viewed from below. Your only reliable ability is to freeze time. In the brief moment the world stands still, find climbable surfaces, plan your route, seize opportunities to move, and reach those seemingly close yet unattainable destinations.

Beyond the main objective, special items are hidden throughout the environment. Often concealed in inconspicuous locations, they require careful observation using your 8-centimeter perspective and more daring climbing routes to reach them. Collecting these items unlocks hidden content, allowing you to gradually piece together more secrets behind this miniature world.

Key Features

- 8-centimeter miniature adventure: Re-examine rooms, human bodies, and everyday objects from an extremely small scale.

- The core ability to freeze time: Freeze dynamic scenes, creating stable climbing windows.

- 3D climbing using human bodies as terrain: Find routes on special surfaces to move towards designated destinations.

- Beware of falls from heights.

- Observation-driven exploration: Discover your way forward through perspective, distance, and environmental details.

- Hidden collectibles and unlocks: Find special items to unlock additional content and secret clues.

- A tense yet controlled climbing experience: Every ascent requires judgment, endurance, and a touch of adventure.

store_data.about_the_game:
Rewrite the war with hindsight

You already know how history ended. The question is what you can do with that knowledge before the next month arrives.

Cascade: Hindcast is an alternate-history grand strategy game about monthly political, economic, diplomatic, and military decisions under pressure. A doctrine choice, cabinet reshuffle, production priority, or diplomatic gamble can strengthen one front while weakening another. The result is not just a report. The map moves.

A living operational map

Front lines shift across Europe as armies advance, stall, and collapse. Troop counts change in real time, territories change hands, and the strategic situation becomes visible without digging through spreadsheets.

Decisions with delayed consequences

Some decisions pay off immediately. Others return months later as shortages, breakthroughs, political crises, or new opportunities. You are not choosing isolated cards. You are building a chain of consequences.

Key features

  • Monthly decision driven grand strategy

  • - Real time front line movement and troop counters

  • - Political capital, budgets, ministers, and cabinet pressure

  • - Military, diplomatic, economic, and intelligence decision cards

  • - Alternate history campaigns built around cause and consequence

  • - A map first interface designed to show the war changing, not just describe it

store_data.about_the_game:
FOUND FOOTAGE HORROR

Enter the decaying network of abandoned Soviet facilities hidden deep within the outskirts of Chernobyl, captured entirely through the lens of a handheld camera. Explore collapsed corridors, flooded reactor tunnels, forgotten laboratories, and makeshift containment zones while being hunted by SCP-173; a living statue that only moves when unobserved. Every flickering light, distorted tape artifact, and frantic camera movement is designed to make you feel trapped inside recovered footage that was never meant to be seen.

THE COMRAD

Redirect power, reactivate aging Soviet machinery, manipulate hazards to your needs, and solve environmental puzzles using improvised Cold War-era technology. Unlock new attachments and escape before you too are lost to history.

One missed glance is all it takes, especially when the entity isn't the only thing lurking in the dark.

Lin Xu, a Vancouver mafioso working for the Midnight Queens has been blackmailed into assassinating a young girl, and finds out that her target is being protected by Betty Hunter, a very talented marks-woman from a rivalling gang, named the Crimson Dresses. The two of them must race each other through the brutal and complex world of organized crime to reach their goals as they fight for what they believe in and protect the people that they care for.

store_data.about_the_game:
Manhattan's most scrutinized heart-transplant program. Tuesday-morning committee votes decide who gets the call, and who doesn't.

In Donor Tryst, you play Vaughn Aldrich, Chief of Cardiac Transplantation at Mercer-Aaronson Medical Center. A federal investigation, a New York Times exposé, and a looming Senate hearing close in over twelve weeks—and three women enter your orbit with incompatible stakes.

In a world ruled by minutes, memos, and the pager's unforgiving beep, intimacy isn't an escape. It's another decision that has consequences.

Meet the Cast


Eloise Hauptmann — "The Waitlist"
The polished public face of patient advocacy—and the wife of a Status 1A patient whose survival depends on the list you chair. She arrives with foundation-board grace, donor-level influence, and a private fear she has learned to translate into elegant language. The route with the hardest geometry: forbidden attraction threaded through duty, money, and a marriage living on borrowed time.



Halle Park — "The Fellow"
A senior transplant fellow and the inventor-of-record on the allocation tool now under federal subpoena—precise, relentless, and quietly furious at anyone who misunderstands her work. Both your sharpest asset and your most dangerous responsibility: a mentee whose future you can elevate with a sentence—or ruin by staying silent. A slow-burn collision of mentorship, ambition, and desire in a system that keeps score.



Sasha Halevy — "The Embed"
A senior New York Times investigative correspondent who lives by attribution, leverage, and the discipline of the written record—until her embed places her too close to the man at the center of her story. Threat and mirror: the one person who can turn your choices into history, and the one who understands exactly what those choices cost. Intimacy under ethics—where every "off the record" moment still leaves a trace.

Key Features


  • Three romance routes, one impossible choice: Pick who you answer first—and watch that triage decision reshape your season, your ethics, and your heart.
  • A high-stakes medical thriller backdrop: Allocation, investigations, subpoenas, and the brutal logistics of transplantation drive every scene with grounded institutional detail.
  • Romance under scrutiny: Love stories built on power, proximity, and professional risk—where reputations, careers, and lives are always on the record somewhere.
  • A clockwork narrative of pressure and release: Weekly publication deadlines, OIG tranches, and the looming Senate hearing create relentless momentum toward the call.
  • Themes with bite: Scarcity, fairness, complicity, and choice—told without easy moralizing, in a system that keeps running long after the credits.
  • Adult content: Each romance route includes explicit adult scenes.

Content Warning


This game is an Adult Romance Visual Novel intended for mature audiences (18+). It includes explicit sexual content and explores themes of medical crisis, mortality, institutional power, ethical conflict, and high-pressure professional relationships. Player discretion is advised.

store_data.about_the_game:
Aiya Desire is an exploration × rhythm game × horror adventure that combines exploration, puzzle-solving, horror presentation, and rhythm game-style boss battles.

Is this salvation? Or control?

In the near future, even as AI optimized every aspect of society, war continued to torment humanity.

Amid endless conflict, the answer the AIs arrived at through “optimization” was not to scatter bullets, but to unleash a bioweapon virus that could invade even the human mind.

The world sank into an “Infection Panic,” and people were forced to live in fear of anxiety, confusion, hallucinations, and madness.

Then, in the depths of that despair, a miracle appeared: a neural-linked wearable chip known as HC (Harmony Chip).

This miraculous device, capable of calming the wearer’s anxiety and confusion, spread across the globe in an instant.

Now, with the vast majority of humanity equipped with HC, society seemed to have regained its stability.

But among those who refused to wear HC, something strange began to happen.

Even without being infected, they suffered hallucinations, derangement, and the collapse of their personalities.

Those who lost their sanity were driven into quarantine zones, and the divide between HC users and non-users only continued to widen.

Her father’s disappearance. Her mother’s death. A black chip.

Aiya’s father was one of the genius scientists who co-developed HC.

He had once loved Aiya deeply.

But one day, he began to distance himself from her.

A few days later, her mother died under mysterious circumstances, and her father vanished without a trace.

An empty house.

The faint smell of iron in the air.

An eerie electronic noise coming from beyond the wall.

All that remained in her father’s study was a handwritten message and a black chip unlike anything she had ever seen before.

“To ‘save’ those who have been fitted with HC, I am heading to the radio tower Sentinel.
You must use this chip as well.
There is no time left.”

At that very moment, every monitor in the house flickers to life.

“Unauthorized subject detected. Initiating retrieval protocol.”

Is her father an enemy?

Or an ally?

Did HC truly save humanity?

Or is it hiding something no one has yet realized?

For the young girl Aiya, a nightmare with no escape is about to begin.

Explore the radio tower Sentinel

Aiya’s destination is Sentinel, a massive radio tower deeply tied to HC.

The tower is filled with a wide range of mechanisms and hidden devices.

Players control Aiya as they explore rooms, gather items, uncover clues through conversations and logs, and solve the mysteries built into the environment.

Resist control through music

During boss battles, the game shifts from exploration horror into a 2-button rhythm battle set to music.

Press the buttons in time with the rhythm using the hit zones on the left and right. Midway through songs, the note chart may even reverse.

Features

  • An exploration × rhythm game × horror adventure set in a near future after the Infection Panic

  • A story centered on HC, the neural-linked chip said to have saved humanity

  • Exploration gameplay in the massive radio tower Sentinel, where conversations, logs, and items bring you closer to the truth

  • Puzzle-solving using a variety of gimmicks such as cameras, lights, and candles

  • Rhythm game-style boss battles built around a simple 2-button system

  • Horror effects that distort visuals and sound depending on failure and Aiya’s mental state

store_data.about_the_game:
"BWM" is a 3D survival action Werewolf game for up to 12 players.

Players must work together to eliminate the encroaching monsters and the treacherous "Werewolves" hiding in their midst.

[Day]

The daytime is safe. Share information with other players to uncover the Werewolves.

[Night]

When night falls, the surroundings are enveloped in darkness, and monsters emerge to launch an all-out attack on the players. Defeat monsters to earn gold, buy items, and gain the upper hand in the game!

Players are randomly assigned roles such as "Villager" or "Werewolf."

* Villager Camp: Work together to fight monsters, find and eliminate the Werewolves, and aim for the survival of the entire team.

* Werewolf Camp: Conceal your identity, blend in with the villagers, and secretly assassinate them under the chaos of the night.

* Third Party Camp: Exploit the chaos, act in secret for your own agenda, and aim for a solo victory by achieving special conditions.

"3D Proximity Voice Chat"

Featuring 3D spatial audio technology where the sound of voices changes dynamically based on distance and direction.

* During the day, all players engage in group discussions. When night falls, you can only communicate with those who are physically close to you.

store_data.about_the_game:
Planet Harvester is a sci-fi automation and resource management sim about building a growing harvesting network across distant planets.

Deploy autonomous drones, unlock planetary operations, collect resources, upgrade your mothership, and expand from a single fragile outpost into a larger interplanetary production system. You are not here to pilot drones by hand. You are the operator, the planner, and occasionally the reason ARIA has to explain basic logistics again.

Each planet is its own production site with local storage, drones, structures, upgrades, finite resources, and bottlenecks. Drones harvest automatically, but your decisions determine how efficiently the whole network grows.

Transfer resources back to the mothership, spend them on upgrades, unlock new planets, increase Command Capacity, improve automation, and keep production moving as storage fills, planets deplete, and new opportunities appear across the galaxy.

Key Features

Autonomous harvesting drones

Drones gather, carry, deposit, recharge, and keep the operation running without direct micromanagement.

Planet-based production sites

Each planet has its own resources, storage, upgrades, and operational state.

Mothership command hub

Manage planet selection, resource transfers, upgrades, expansion, automation, and network status from a central dashboard.

Idle and active progression

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome, my lords, to this Three Kingdoms world of chaos and ambition.

We have always wanted to create a Three Kingdoms game that feels easy to get into, but still offers a solid sense of long-term growth. This is not a game that asks you to watch the battlefield every second, nor does it rely on complicated controls. Instead, we hope you will enjoy the gradual satisfaction of pushing through stages, developing your officers, farming for loot, and growing stronger through rebirth.

Bit by bit, your team will become stronger. Officers who once stood at the beginning of their journey may eventually become reliable forces under your command.

We hope every lord can find simple, steady enjoyment in building their own army and growing stronger in this Three Kingdoms world!

<Game Introduction>

Idle Three Kingdoms is a role-playing game built around Three Kingdoms officer collection, idle progression, loot farming, auto-battle, and strategic development.

You will recruit and train officers, build your own formation, progress through stages in automatic battles, collect equipment and resources, and steadily increase your team’s power. The game focuses on relaxed idle gameplay and continuous growth, with offline rewards available even when you are away.

Starting from Nothing in a Time of Chaos

The Three Kingdoms are at war, and heroes rise across the land.

As a lord, you will step into this chaotic era with a small and humble force. From there, you will recruit officers, develop your strength, gather resources, and gradually build a power of your own. The chaos of war waits for no one, but every challenge, every improvement, and every hard-earned victory will bring you one step closer to uniting the land.

Relaxed Idle Gameplay and Auto-Battle

Battles progress automatically through each stage, allowing you to watch your officers clash on the battlefield without constant manual control. The real enjoyment comes not only from the battles themselves, but from seeing your team grow stronger through every challenge.

Sometimes, the result of a battle may change because of a single skill upgrade, a new piece of equipment, or the unlock of a new feature. The road through this chaotic era will not always be smooth, but every battle leaves behind progress that helps your force move further forward.

Recruit Officers and Develop Their Skills

In this age of war, heroes can be found everywhere. You can recruit different types of Three Kingdoms officers and make them important members of your forces.

Each officer has a different role. Some are suited to fighting at the front line, some are better at supporting development and training, while others can contribute to the growth and efficiency of your main city.

Through leveling, skill development, and resource investment, your officers will gradually become stronger. Improving the right attributes at the right time can often turn a difficult battle in your favor.

Farm Equipment and Collect Treasures

As you continue to clear stages and challenge enemies, you can obtain various pieces of equipment and treasures. Better equipment means stronger attributes, better combat performance, and the ability to take on more difficult stages.

As a lord, you will need to decide which equipment best suits your main officers and which treasures can strengthen the weaker parts of your formation. Every loot drop is another chance to make your team stronger.

Rebirth and Continuous Growth

When your growth reaches a bottleneck, rebirth becomes a new way to break through.

Through rebirth, your characters can gain greater growth potential and begin a new stage of progression. This is not simply starting over. It is a chance to rebuild with the experience you have already gained, plan your development more effectively, and challenge even stronger enemies.

Every rebirth is a new beginning.

Build Formations and Challenge Stronger Enemies

You can continue trying new combinations, adjusting your development path, and finding the combat style that best suits your forces.

In this chaotic era, a powerful force is not built in a single day. It is shaped through repeated challenges, steady growth, and the choices made along the way.

store_data.about_the_game:
Terra Crafter is an incremental sci-fi terraformation game. Your mission is to discover technologies and gather resources on a barren planet, eventually turning it into a thriving green paradise. Construct buildings which affect the atmosphere, build a power grid to keep everything going, and watch as your planet takes shape. Slowly, you’ll see the sky change from black to blue. Clouds will form, and rain drops will begin to fall. Lakes will begin to fill the crevices of the planet. After a while, you’ll see you’re in a very different place than where you first landed.

As you reshape the planet's atmosphere, you’ll be recruiting a colony of robot helpers to aid your progression. Every machine you build contributes to the planet's transformation, but every robot you add to your colony scales your potential building rate. As your terraformation score goes up, new technologies, personal upgrades, and building types become available. 

Your Base, Your Rules

Construct an expanding space base on the planet's surface. You’re going to need research facilities to start making sense of the technologies you discover. As your production facilities and robots start to demand more power, provide the infrastructure they need to keep going.

Spend your time designing efficient production chains or exciting architecture and watch as your planet experiences the changes from your efforts. In order to succeed you will need a self-sustaining settlement capable of surviving the planet's harsh conditions.

Automate Tedious Tasks with Your Robot Army

As you progress you won’t want to keep doing the tiny tasks that your base will need. That’s why you’ll want to recruit as many robots to help you as possible!

You can assign their work priorities and manage schedules to keep everything running as smoothly as possible. A successful colony depends on smart planning and efficient logistics.

Terraform an Entire Planet

Increase your global terraformation scores through strategic expansion.

Explore a vast environment and locate hidden treasures. Use your discoveries to reach major milestones which unlock advanced technologies and new construction options.

Every improvement brings the world one step closer to becoming habitable.

Features

  • Build and expand a planetary colony of autonomous robots

  • See your impact on the world as your terraformation score increases

  • Design and create your unique space base

  • Establish power networks with generators and batteries

  • Mine, harvest, craft, and automate resource production

  • Research new technologies like jetpacks and ore vacuums

  • Explore and develop a persistent open world

store_data.about_the_game:
In the near future, humanity no longer waits for the miracle of birth. New governments, corporations, and machines take control over the creation of life. What was once the work of nature and the divine spark becomes production. Robots live among humans. Rejected, watched, needed, and hated. The world changes its laws, its beliefs, and its sins. And when humankind usurps the act of creation, something is born that was never written in any holy book. The eighth sin. USURPATIO.

USURPATIO is a cinematic third-person science fiction game set in a near future where humanity is slowly losing the ability to create life naturally.

As birth rates collapse and death begins to outpace new life, corporations and research institutes take control of what was once left to nature. The KISH Institute becomes a symbol of hope for people who still dream of having children. Through powerful marketing, public trust, and promises of salvation, it is seen as one of the most important organizations in the world.

But behind the clean image of the institute, something darker begins to grow.

In USURPATIO, you experience one story from three different perspectives: Ren, Mark, and X13. Each of them sees the same world from a different place in the system. Their paths reveal a story about robots, artificial life, corporate power, and the dangerous moment when mankind decides to take control over creation itself.

This is a story-driven third-person action game with exploration, tension, cinematic scenes, and moments of violence. The world of USURPATIO is built around a disturbing question: what happens when creating life is no longer a miracle, but a product?

When humanity claims the act of creation, a new sin is born.

USURPATIO.

>>Playable DEMO coming soon!<<

Mature Content Description
USURPATIO contains mature themes, including violence, blood, combat scenes, strong language, and disturbing science fiction elements.

The story takes place in a dark near-future world shaped by corporate control, artificial life, human experimentation, manipulation, and the collapse of natural reproduction. Players may encounter tense scenes, captivity, damaged robots, hostile machines, moral discomfort, and violent confrontations.

The game may depict adult characters in dangerous, emotionally difficult, or threatening situations as part of the story. USURPATIO does not contain nudity or sexual content.

  • Supply Chain & Heavy Fleet: Procure concrete, steel, and brick on a volatile commodity exchange. Deploy and maintain a fleet of heavy machinery—including earthmovers, tower cranes, and concrete pumps—to avoid project downtime.

store_data.about_the_game:
A cozy retail sim that was definitely not assembled the night before launch.

Run your very own corner store! Stock the shelves, ring up customers, set your prices, and slowly come to terms with the fact that something is deeply, spiritually wrong with this building.

The cola costs whatever it feels like. The empty boxes have opinions about where they want to be thrown. Customers pay by card because they are, frankly, too afraid to handle cash here. And the soundtrack? That's coming from a cassette the tape deck is currently eating, and no, you cannot turn it off, and no, we don't know whose voice that is.

Features:

  • 🛒 Actual shopkeeping! Probably!

  • 📦 Physics that range from "fine" to "war crime"

  • 💸 A pricing system you control with your bare hands and zero guidance

  • 📼 An original Dreamcast-era soundtrack, lovingly run through a haunted cassette

  • 🐛 Bugs we have reclassified as "emergent atmosphere"

  • 👻 At least one (1) ghost. We think. Reports vary.

It's not broken. It's brave. Wishlist now before it becomes self-aware.

This game is a J-horror game from the perspective of a woman working in a hospital.

This work is a psychological horror game where you explore a hospital from a first-person perspective and solve mysteries.

【Overview】

Scare level: Medium to High

Play time: 1–2 hours

Completion difficulty: Low to Medium

【Controls】

WASD: Move

SHIFT + WASD: Move quickly

ESC: Settings

Left click: Talk, open doors, select, etc. (almost all actions)

【For Buyers and Streamers】

Copyright: All rights to the game itself, as well as the visuals and music, belong to the author.

Game streaming and broadcasting: Full play-through streaming and video uploads are allowed (no prior notification needed, monetization is OK).

There is no concern about music copyright violations (so-called Content ID warnings), so please feel free to use it for live streaming or video uploads.

【If the game does not progress (or you do not know how to proceed)】

If the progression requirements are met, clicking on a brown or blue door will move the scene forward.

If the progression requirements are not met, either wait for an event to occur or meet the requirements and click the door again.

If you still cannot progress, or if you encounter what appears to be a bug, please go back to the title screen from the settings menu, or close the game window once and then reopen it.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to Diabolus 

Diabolus is the ultimate integration of the Humanist Reconstruction Project, provided by Supremacy, designed to offer post-war shelter to all races.
Any individual, regardless of race, can apply and pass screening to become a legal resident of Diabolus.

“Long live humanity. Glory to Supremacy.”

A Brand-New Card Combat Experience

Diabolus introduces a fresh card battle system.
With diverse card types and unique damage resolution mechanics, it delivers a combat experience like no other.
Easy to learn, but full of possibilities.

Face the randomness head-on in tight turn-based battles. Adapt on the fly, or keep your head down and push forward.
Play an airtight defense to counter every enemy move, or go all-in with a devastating strike!
Defeat wave after wave of cunning, unpredictable foes, and show them your strategic genius (or just plain luck).

Make a Pact with the Devil

On the stage of Diabolus , you walk alongside devils.
Sign a contract with a demon of unknown origin – gain the power to change your fate, or become another sacrifice.
Don’t let your guard down. This is true dance with wolves.

Every action has its price.
Forget about mana or card limits – just make sure you don’t get killed by your own cards.

Endless Rogue-like Dungeon Exploration

Prepare for a real adventure.
At unknown crossroads, you may encounter death row inmates, techno-fascists, mysterious strangers, or even more devils.

Rich random events and special cards await discovery.
How you choose, how you fight – it’s all up to you.

A Twisted Dieselpunk Story

A fantasy tale woven from world war, diesel engines, and devils.
In the aftermath of a post-war era, walk the brutal and treacherous path of revenge as a death row inmate whose fate is already sealed, alongside a demon companion.
Piece together the truth of Diabolus through your journey and conversations.

*《Diabolus》 is a game in active development. The demo version does not represent the final quality of the product.

store_data.about_the_game:
Eight days. One mountain. No backup.

"October 11th, 1989, 03:14 in the morning — the barrier gave way." So ends one of the magnetic tapes from Š-7, a secret facility of the Czechoslovak State Security, hidden beneath a mountain since 1948. A month later, as the regime collapses above ground, they send you down. You are Lieutenant Tomáš Vlk, and your orders are clear: document, destroy the archives, deal with the surviving witnesses. Alone.

THE STORY

Š-7 ran for 36 years: 247 test subjects, three directors and one classified program — the Theta protocol. For years they kept something locked behind an isolation pod and studied it. One October morning in 1989, it answered for the first time — and got out. Prague wants Š-7 to have never existed, and sent you down to make sure of it. But the truth arrives in layers: first what they told you, then what you suspect, and finally what truly is. The deeper you descend, the clearer it becomes — the "failing" project never failed. It worked exactly as intended.

ALONE. ONLY MONSTERS.

One rule that never breaks: nothing in Š-7 is still alive. No companions, no friendly faces, no help. Your only company is corpses, more than thirty tapes and journals, voices on the radio and the telephone — and things that used to be scientists, guards and subjects. Isolation is the only certainty here.

WHAT AWAITS YOU

  • A prologue and 8 days

  • Authentic 1989 Czechoslovakia: an encrypted radio, bureaucracy and dread

  • Raw PS1/PS2 retro visuals where the darkness itself becomes the enemy

  • Scarce ammo, an axe, a pistol and firebombs — combat is a last resort, not a playstyle

  • 30+ tapes and dozens of documents that assemble the truth piece by piece

  • 5 different endings, decided by the single sentence you finally speak into the microphone

A HIERARCHY OF EVIL

What devours you is not the monster in the corridor. The subjects are victims. The scientists were only subordinates. The director sits in Prague. And you are the instrument. The question is: do you stay the instrument, or do you turn? CLEARANCE never tells you what is right. It only shows you who died because of what you said.

content_descriptors.notes:
CLEARENCE is a psychological horror game set in 1989 Czechoslovakia. It contains the following adult content that may not be suitable for all audiences:

VIOLENCE & BLOOD
• Realistic depiction of corpses (encountered as part of the investigative gameplay)
• Player character can die in scripted scares and during combat with hostile entities
• Use of a firearm against undead enemies (no torture, mutilation, or gore beyond standard horror conventions)
• Brief depictions of injuries and signs of off-screen violence in the story

PSYCHOLOGICAL HORROR
• Persistent atmosphere of dread, jump scares, and disturbing imagery
• A relentless stalker enemy that pursues the player
• Themes of paranoia, isolation, and the loss of self

LANGUAGE
• Czech profanity in spoken and written dialogue (intelligence-service banter, period-accurate)
• Crude language and occasional swearing

DARK THEMES
• Depictions of covert state security (StB) operations during the late communist era
• References to experimental medical/psychological programs conducted on detained subjects
• References to alcohol and tobacco consumption typical of the period (no on-screen drug use)

The game contains NO sexual content, NO nudity, NO sexual violence, NO content depicting minors, NO hate speech, NO real-world gambling, and NO real-money transactions.

store_data.about_the_game:
The magic circle answers to no one but you. The world is flooding. Enemies pour from every direction, endless and relentless. You stand alone at the center, no retreat, no reinforcements. Only the ancient magic circle that orbits at your command, and the power to decide who falls next.

Your will is your weapon

Guide the magic circle. It follows. Hold it over an enemy, your power locks on and strikes. Drive it through the horde – it carves through everything in its path. No buttons to mash. No spells to cast. The magic works on its own. You only decide where.

The gods are watching

Between the waves, time stops. Three divine gifts appear before you and you choose one. Seven pantheons offer their power: the raw fury of Gorr, the creeping chaos of Ryn, the cold patience of Jentu, the shadow arts of Nyx. Uncover the mystery of the eighth god's disappearance. Each run, a new combination. Each combination, a new way to dominate.

The horde never ends

Hundreds flood the arena from every side. They grow stronger. They grow faster. When you fall, you rise again your power intact, the arena reset, the gods still watching. Every death is a lesson. Every run, you go a little further.

Choose your champion

Eight heroes. Each one a legend. Each one with a rare gift that shifts how the circle fights, how your powers combine, and what kind of force you become. Unlock them. Learn them. Find your own way to the center of the storm.

store_data.about_the_game:
Embark on a peaceful journey through the endless universe and turn a small ship into a massive interplanetary resource harvesting system.

Starting with a simple ship and limited resources, you will gradually expand your influence across space step by step. Every new planet brings unique materials, new upgrades, and additional ways to grow your harvesting network.

Explore Planets and Expand Your Expedition

Travel between different worlds, discover new harvesting locations, and build an efficient progression chain. With every new flight, you will uncover more valuable resources and gain access to advanced technologies.

The universe gradually opens up before the player, allowing you to progress at your own pace without pressure or rush.

A Massive Upgrade Tree

Develop your expedition through a huge branching upgrade tree featuring more than 100 upgrades.

– Increase harvesting efficiency

– Speed up resource production

– Unlock new mechanics

– Upgrade your ship and technologies

– Create your own progression style

Each new level unlocks additional opportunities and makes your growth even more масштабным.

Meditative Gameplay

Universal Harvest: Incremental is designed to provide a calm and comfortable experience.

No timers, punishments, or constant pressure — just smooth progression, pleasant visuals, and an atmospheric space journey. The game is perfect for relaxing, background play sessions, or simply immersing yourself in the satisfying process of gradual growth.

Game Features

– Interplanetary travel

– Relaxing incremental gameplay

– Large technology and upgrade tree

– More than 100 upgrades

– Gradual unlocking of new mechanics

– Atmospheric cosmic visual style

– Meditative progression without pressure

– Simple and intuitive controls

– Constant sense of progression and expansion

Add the game to your wishlist now — release is coming soon! The game is being developed by a solo developer, so every wishlist truly means a lot!

store_data.about_the_game:
The outbreak started before anyone was ready. The first horde is already moving. You have 72 hours to contain it.

Command the Dead puts you in the commander's seat, not on the ground, but above it. Your theatre of operations is a tactical display: phosphor green, clinical, cold. Units move on your orders. Cities report their status. The map tells you what is happening. What you do about it is up to you.

This is not a game about fighting zombies. It is a game about managing a situation that is always threatening to get away from you. Hordes grow. Unrest builds. Civilians move. Cities fall under martial law, then into chaos. Every decision commits your finite resources, and every commitment leaves somewhere else exposed.

Your army units are autonomous. They follow orders, hold positions, engage threats, but they are not under your direct control. You are the FOB commander, not the soldier. Issue the order. Trust the execution. Watch the consequences unfold.

The 72-hour window does not wait.

FEATURES:

- Real-time strategic command across a procedurally generated outbreak theatre

- Autonomous unit behaviour: issue orders, not actions

- Dynamic infection, unrest, and martial law systems that interact and escalate

- Waterway barriers and crossing chokepoints that define the tactical map

- Procedural objectives tied to the actual map, no two runs play the same

- FOB tactical display aesthetic: this looks like a war room, not a video game

🏃 A NON-STOP ACTION FEST!

Where does the road lead? To a massive showdown, of course! Shoot Together is a relentless auto-running arcade action game that tests your reflexes and split-second decision-making. As your character relentlessly dashes forward, blast away incoming barrels, giant boulders, and rushing hordes of enemies with your weapon, survive, and push the limits of power!

🎯 SINGLE-PLAYER MODE: RUN, GUN, POWER UP PERMANENTLY!

In this solo challenge, your goal isn't just to survive—it's to become more lethal with every single run.

• Epic Boss Fights: Progress far enough to face off against ruthless, giant bosses waiting for you at the end of the road.

store_data.about_the_game:
is a story-driven, first-person psychological horror inspired by genre classics. You play as Arthur, who awakens from a nightmare inside his family estate, a place abandoned years ago. He has no memory of how he got here, yet it’s clear he was expected. But by whom, and for what purpose? You must descend into the darkest corners of the forsaken house to uncover the truth.

But remember: some doors are better left locked.

Darkness Means Doom, Light is Salvation:

Arthur has suffered from nyctophobia since childhood, making the dark literally drive him mad. Your sanity is a fragile resource tied directly to the light. The longer you linger in the shadows or witness the unexplainable, the more reality distorts. Scavenge for fuel, keep your lamp lit, and stay in the light.

Fears Come Alive:

You are powerless against the horrors roaming the mansion. Sometimes your best option is to run; other times, you must become one with the shadows and hide. Avoid the monsters whenever possible, even from a safe distance—just laying eyes on them shatters your mental state. However, a specific item exists within the game to help you combat this fear and restore your sanity.

The Mystery of the Manor:

You must piece together the chronology of events, gathering fragments of the past through scattered notes and forgotten items. Solve puzzles, delve deeper into the abyss of your fears, and uncover the dark secret hidden within the walls of the abandoned estate.

store_data.about_the_game:
From a garage to a global empire

You started with a laptop and an idea. Idle Startup is a relaxing incremental game about growing that idea into a tech company — one completed task at a time.

Pick a skill, and it goes to work. Progress bars fill, XP rolls in, money stacks up. Spend it on upgrades, level up, and watch new skills and whole departments unlock as your company grows.

Every skill is its own journey

Each of the six skills has its own upgrade store — a tree of nine upgrades gated by skill level and cost. Most boost that skill alone, but every skill hits milestones at levels 25, 50, 75 and 99 that reward a permanent, company-wide bonus. There's always a reason to push one more level.

Simple to start, deep to grow

The whole game makes sense in under a minute — select a skill, earn, upgrade, repeat. But there's always a next unlock: a costlier upgrade, a milestone, a new department, the next achievement. Max a skill out and it keeps earning Mastery, a slow bonus that never stops growing.

Always progressing

Idle Startup respects your time. The game keeps earning while it's closed (up to 4 hours), and a free Coffee Break speed boost is yours to claim a few times a day. Your save syncs through Steam Cloud, so you can pick up on any device.

Optional boost packs (you don't need them)

Three small optional purchases let you skip ahead if you want to: an Energy Drink for a 2× speed boost across four hours, a Coffee Pot for a full 24 hours, and a one-time Productivity Suite for a permanent 2× speed boost and unlimited offline earnings. None of them are required — the whole game is playable and completable without spending anything.

Features

  • One-click idle loop — pick a skill, it runs itself

  • 6 skills across 4 company tiers, from Garage Startup to Corporate Office

  • Per-skill upgrade trees plus a company-wide store — 66 upgrades in all

  • Milestone upgrades at Lv 25/50/75/99 that buff your whole company

  • Skill Mastery — maxed skills keep earning a permanent money bonus

  • 29 Steam achievements, from First Day to Trillionaire

  • Two interface themes — sleek Midnight, or warm Poolside FM sunset

  • Offline progress — earn while you're away

  • Steam Cloud saves — play on Windows and macOS (Steam Deck supported via Proton)

  • A free recurring speed boost, no ads ever

  • Optional one-time boost purchases — never required, never gated

  • Clean, modern interface designed to stay out of your way
