store_data.about_the_game:
The world where the story unfolds is the mysterious Heroes Valley - a land named after the adventurers who travel there to battle strange monsters that emerged from an unknown world. The appearance of these creatures sparked a massive frenzy around hunting them and collecting the valuable resources that can be extracted from their remains. Only the bravest dare to come to this valley - or those desperate to make a fortune.

One day, a mysterious stranger approached the protagonist with an offer: a plot of land containing an abandoned tavern and a small cabin for an unbelievably low price. Without hesitation, he sold everything he owned and bought a ticket to this mystical place - Heroes Valley.

The protagonist did not come here as a noble knight or fearless warrior, but as a businessman determined to profit from the chaos. He understands that the true value lies not in the monsters or their resources, but in the heroes who hunt them.

Will our hero be able to build a thriving tavern and turn this age of monster fever into opportunity? And what other secrets lie hidden within Heroes Valley?

Build Your Dream Tavern

Transform a small abandoned tavern into the most popular destination in Heroes Valley. Design and expand your establishment, decorate it with crafted furniture, and create a cozy atmosphere that keeps visitors coming back.

Grow, Cook, and Brew

Cultivate crops on your farm, prepare delicious meals, and brew a variety of drinks. Serve hungry adventurers and become known for the finest food and beverages in the valley.

Craft Equipment for Heroes

Forge and craft a wide range of equipment, including swords, clubs, hammers, scepters, and other useful gear. Supply adventurers with the tools they need to survive their dangerous journeys.

Explore and Gather Resources

Venture into mines and dangerous locations to collect valuable resources. Mine ore, gather materials, discover rare treasures, and face the creatures lurking beneath the surface.

Fishing and Relaxation

Take a break from tavern life and enjoy fishing across various locations throughout the valley. Catch different species of fish and use them in cooking recipes or sell them for profit.

Complete Quests and Meet Unique Characters

Interact with villagers, heroes, and merchants. Complete quests, unlock new opportunities, and discover the stories hidden within Heroes Valley.

Manage Your Tavern

Serve customers, clean tables, maintain your establishment, and keep visitors satisfied. The better your service, the more famous your tavern becomes.

Features

  • Build, expand, and customize your tavern

  • Farm crops and harvest valuable ingredients

  • Cook meals and brew drinks

  • Craft furniture and decorate your establishment

  • Forge weapons and equipment for heroes

  • Explore mines and gather rare resources

  • Fight monsters and discover hidden treasures

  • Fish in multiple locations

  • Complete quests and special requests

  • Serve unique guests and travelers

  • Manage your business and grow your reputation

  • Uncover the secrets of Heroes Valley

store_data.about_the_game:
Wild West Miner Simulator: First Gun
On the Wild West frontier, the nights are long and people’s memories are short. After a brutal wild animal attack, you wake up on the edge of town bruised, stripped of everything, and forgotten. The place you once called home now looks at you like a stranger. If you want your life back, you’ll have to dig it out of the dirt, the blood, and the dust.

In Wild West Miner Simulator: First Gun, you claw your way back into existence one step at a time. You start with an empty stomach and a small patch of land where the soil hides more secrets than the folks in the saloon. You dig for coal and iron, sell them to the few townspeople still willing to deal with you, and slowly rebuild your standing in a town that trusts no one for free.

The town lives, breathes, and watches:

  • Buy food to keep yourself standing.

  • Dig up coal and iron, selling them to the railroad and the blacksmith who counts every cent.

  • Build a furnace, smelt your ore, and learn that metal only has value if you can protect it. Raise a bank, a machine factory, and help craftsmen whose smiles hide their own secrets.

  • Discover oil on your land, black gold that can change your life or ruin it.

  • Hire workers, set up pumps, build homes and workshops as the town grows with you, though not always toward the light.

But the bigger the town becomes, the longer the shadows stretch. You face a gunslinger duel, build a wagon workshop, buy a handcart, and raise a stable. That’s where the prologue ends, the moment the town finally notices you and judges you.

Creovia is a 2D sandbox MMO with RPG elements. Build your own worlds, craft powerful gear, trade with other players, and carve out your place in a persistent, player-driven universe.

BUILD & CRAFT

Claim a world and shape it tile by tile. Upgrade your crafting benches,

smelt materials, and unlock better gear as you progress through equipment

tiers - Stone, Iron, Gold, and beyond.

PROGRESS THROUGH THE TECH TREE

Earn Tech Trash through daily play and spend it to unlock craftables,

cosmetics, and utility upgrades.

EXPLORE SUBWORLDS

Venture into procedurally generated caves, deserts, and volcanic zones

to gather rare resources. Take on hand-crafted PvE arenas across

Grasslands, Darklands, Hell, and Ice Caverns - solo or with a squad.

TRADE & ECONOMY

Only cosmetic items & resources are tradeable, keeping the game fair for everyone.

Buy, sell, and negotiate directly in player-owned worlds.

GUILDS & SOCIAL

Form guilds, climb monthly leaderboards, and complete daily and weekly

quests. Rotating weekly events keep the world alive and rewarding.

Fair play enforced.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to Stepwell Step into a microscopic dimension where up and down are merely suggestions. In Stepwell, you are the architect of impossible structures. You are tasked with building pathways for your Quarks—quirky, geometric creatures driven by a singular goal: harvesting energy-rich Joules.

Because Quarks experience reality relative to the color of the surfaces they walk on, you will need to shift your perspective and think from every angle.

Build Paradoxical Architecture

  • Mind-Bending Mechanics: Place ambiguous cubes, stairways, and mind-bending curves onto a dense hexagonal grid. Overlap tiles to create twisting, multi-layered pathways.

  • A Hypnotic Ant Farm: There is no rush. Take your time in a zen-like puzzle game. Watch as your overlapping structures evolve into a bustling, living colony teeming with color and personality.

  • Quirky Interactions: Your Quarks aren't just mindless drones. Watch them bump into one another, celebrate when they reach their Joules, and even interact with you!

  • Master Multiple Dimensions: As the game progresses, you will unlock new building blocks that will be challenging to wrap your mind around.

store_data.about_the_game:
Four sisters. Four memories. One impossible truth.

This is a gothic point-and-click puzzle adventure set in a Salem-inspired village of witchcraft, fear, and family secrets. Explore strange rooms, collect objects, solve surreal puzzles, and uncover the truth behind a death that each sister remembers differently.

The Nightmare Begins

The story starts with a ritual of divination. The four Whitlock sisters — Priscilla, Esther, Susanna, and Grace — gather to glimpse the future by dropping egg whites into water. But the omen they receive is unmistakable: the fluid twists into the shape of a coffin.

Before the night ends, the youngest sister lies dead.

As rumours of witchcraft spread through the village, the townspeople’s fear quickly turns into accusation. To escape the shadow of the gallows, the surviving sisters must return to their memories, confront their secrets, and piece together what really happened that night.

Point-and-Click Mystery Puzzle Gameplay

Gameplay focuses on atmospheric exploration and puzzle-solving. Players investigate rooms, examine objects, collect items, and use them in the right places to unlock new clues, hidden scenes, and fragments of memory.

You will solve logic puzzles, object-based puzzles, symbolic riddles, and strange ritual puzzles connected to witchcraft, family history, and the sisters’ conflicting memories.

The game includes:

  • Point-and-click exploration

  • Item collection and object interaction

  • Escape-room-style puzzle solving

  • Surreal symbolic puzzles

  • Clue finding and deduction

  • Story fragments hidden behind puzzles

  • Multiple playable perspectives

Four Sisters, Four Versions of the Truth

Play through the memories of the four Whitlock sisters. Each sister sees the same tragedy from a different angle, and each memory reveals new details, contradictions, and secrets.

What one sister remembers as grief, another may remember as guilt. What one calls an accident, another may remember as a crime.

By switching between perspectives, you will compare their memories, uncover missing pieces, and slowly reconstruct the truth behind the youngest sister’s death.

A Dark, Surreal Witch-Trial Mystery

Expect an intimate narrative mystery with a dark fairytale atmosphere, witchcraft-inspired symbolism.

In Salem, anyone can be a witch.

store_data.about_the_game:
【Synopsis】

100,000 Trees to Go is a relaxing logging sim about building a one-axe operation into something that can clear an entire forest. Every tree on the map is real. Every one falls.

【Gameplay: Logging Operation Simulator】

  • Chop grab an axe and get started. Every tree has physics, every hit counts, every stump stays.

  • Hire workers each one has their own stats — speed, stamina, carry capacity. Put the right person in the right zone and the operation moves. Put the wrong one anywhere and you'll feel it.

  • Deploy bots automated collectors that run routes while you focus elsewhere. Set them up, optimize later.

  • Find gear in the field better axes and tools drop as you explore. One good find can change how fast the whole operation runs.

  • Build your camp zone by zone, your base grows alongside the crew.

  • Unlock new zones denser forest, different terrain, better prices. The map opens up as the counter goes down.

【Key Features】

  • 100,000 individual trees — every single one is on the map and every single one can be chopped

  • Real worker stats — speed, stamina, carry capacity matter; wrong hire, wrong zone, you'll notice

  • Bot automation — set up collection routes and let them run

  • Field gear drops — equipment found while exploring can shift your whole strategy

  • Open map progression — unlock zones, expand camp, watch the number drop faster

  • Challenges: Milestone objectives that mark your progress — from hiring your first worker to becoming a legitimate terror of the woods.

Just the forest, an axe, and 100,000 trees to go.

store_data.about_the_game:
Ornament Tower is an action-adventure & puzzle game for up to two players. The couple of explorers Azulin and Guaraná were climbing the dangerous canyons that surround the abandoned Ornament Tower when they fell and woke up in its vicinity. Because they got too close to the tower, they were cursed and their bodies transformed into those of animals.

Created by Lotovik, former Lead Pixel Artist of Fields of Mistria.

Explore over 120 floors across 5 distinct towers, each with different environments full of challenges, monsters, and puzzles.

Get ready for this adventure playing with one or two players. Cooperation is the key to reaching the top of the tower… and also to each other's hearts.

Defeat monsters together using elements of the environment, or use them to your advantage to solve puzzles!

Rack your brain solving puzzles involving boxes, keys, gates, time, thorns, and all sorts of dangers!

Help Azulin and Guaraná recover their original bodies by collecting the strange and mysterious spheres of living matter…

  • Created by Lotovik, former Lead Pixel Artist of Fields of Mistria

  • Highly detailed 2D pixel art with dynamic lighting

  • Low-poly 3D scenes with extremely detailed textures

  • Pixelated and high-resolution 3D modes

  • Monsters with challenging behavior patterns

  • Intriguing puzzles with eureka moments

  • A mysterious, captivating, romantic story

store_data.about_the_game:
Investigate a deceptive, unclassified threat in this atmospheric first-person survival horror thriller, featuring a dark and isolated SCP universe setting.

You are an SCP Foundation field agent deployed to an isolated sector in post-Soviet territory. The Foundation's Analytics Department has no data regarding the nature of the entity. Your objective is to go into the epicenter of the anomaly, determine its life cycle, identify vulnerabilities, and find a way to survive.

ACCESS LEVEL: 3

OBJECT STATUS: Unclassified

INCIDENT CLASS: Active. Pending data collection.

DIRECTIVE: Conduct a threat assessment.

OPERATION PROTOCOLS

Primary environmental analysis indicates that the entity is likely blind and hunts via echolocation. Your safety directly depends on the level of noise you produce. Control the weight of your footsteps, mind the surface types, and carefully manage your physical interactions with the environment.

The game completely lacks a classic user interface (HUD). Document handling, evidence analysis, navigation, and inventory management are all conducted through the agent's physical field equipment in real time. Every attempt to access data requires you to divert attention from your surroundings, leaving you completely vulnerable.

Anomalous acoustic phenomena have been recorded: exact vocal reproductions of individuals listed as missing are being detected in the incident zone. It is unknown whether this is residual background noise from the incident or a deliberate baiting tactic. Exercise extreme caution when investigating sound sources.

Time is a critical factor. The longer you hesitate, the more the sector degrades: the disappearance of the local population, the blocking of safe routes, and the rapid escalation of the threat.

You are entering unknown territory. Study archival records, question the residents, analyze disappearance locations, and deduce the entity's behavioral patterns on your own. Your tactical advantage during the inevitable direct contact depends heavily on the quality of the information gathered.

store_data.about_the_game:
You and your friend share a passion for exploring mysterious and abandoned places. One day, your friend sends you a message about an old mansion where a brutal murder took place years ago. Intrigued by the story, the two of you agree to investigate the mansion on a specific day.

On the night before your trip, while you were at home, you heard a strange knock on your door. When you opened it, something happened that you never could have expected...

The next morning, you find yourself heading to the mansion alone. As you venture deeper into its dark halls, terrifying secrets begin to surface, and the truth behind the long-forgotten murder slowly starts to reveal itself.

Gameplay & Mechanics

To survive the nightmare and uncover the dark secrets of the mansion, players will engage in:

  • First-Person Exploration: Navigate through pitch-black corridors, relying on limited light sources to investigate the eerie, abandoned mansion.

  • Interactive Investigation: Search rooms thoroughly, interact with environmental objects using a raycast inspection system, gather crucial clues, and read hidden notes to piece together the tragic history.

  • Environmental Puzzles: Challenge your mind by solving complex puzzles embedded within the mansion’s architecture and lore to unlock new areas.

  • Resource & Sanity Management: Manage your survival while enduring intense psychological horror, disturbing hallucinations, and a tense atmosphere where danger could be around any corner.

Key Features

  • First-person psychological horror experience.

  • Atmospheric exploration inside a detailed, mysterious mansion.

  • Story-driven narrative filled with dark secrets and unexpected twists.

  • Immersive sound design and highly tense, suspenseful gameplay.

Killing Slime is a roguelite tower defense game where time, strategy, and strange allies collide.

Build your defense on a grid, draft new units from the shop, and survive wave after wave of enemies pouring through unstable portals. Every run starts small, but each cleared wave gives you more gold, more choices, and more ways to turn your board into a ridiculous engine of destruction.

Recruit an unpredictable roster of units from across eras and genres: archers, minotaurs, foot troopers, laser soldiers, wizards, unicorns, mechs, orbital lasers, and more. Place them carefully, combine their strengths, and adapt as enemies grow faster, tougher, and more numerous.

Between combat cycles, choose powerful augments that reshape your strategy for the rest of the run. Temporary round modifiers keep each cycle dangerous, forcing you to rethink your setup when enemies speed up, towers slow down, interest disappears, or the rules bend against you.

Features

  • Grid-based tower defense with wave survival

  • A shop-driven unit drafting system with rerolls and rarity odds

  • Unlockable units across fantasy, modern, prehistoric, mystic, and futuristic themes

  • Roguelite augments that stack into powerful builds

  • Temporary round modifiers that change the rules every few waves

  • Gold economy with income, interest, and strategic spending

  • Escalating enemy waves, limited lives, and run-based progression

Defend the gate. Draft the weirdest army possible. Survive long enough to see what breaks first: the enemies, the timeline, or your build.

store_data.about_the_game:
Is it a place you live in… or a rule you obey to survive?

After 9:59 is a short (~30-minutes) indie horror walking simulator with a simple, clear story and uncluttered gameplay.

You play as Clara, moving into a new apartment building. Before leaving, the landlord gives you a list of strange rules. Most seem unusual. But one stands out above all the others: “Do not open your door after 9:59 PM.”

Clara, who used to live in a village. After a painful accident, she decides to start a new life, so she moves to the city and begins living in an apartment building.

Rules You Must Follow:

  • Do not open your door after 9:59 PM.

    No matter who is knocking.

  • Do not respond to voices from the hallway.

    Even if they sound familiar.

  • Do not look through the peephole after 9:59 PM.

    Some things are better left unseen.

  • If someone claims to be the landlord, stay inside.

    The landlord never returns at night.

Designed to be played in one sitting (~30 minutes), with a tense atmosphere.

Game Features:

  • Atmospheric indie horror experience

  • Immersive, tense sound design

  • Simple, story-driven walking gameplay

  • Short and focused (~30 minutes) experience

  • Minimalist gameplay with psychological tension

store_data.about_the_game:
A first-person simulation game, where you create and sell small pieces of art with fuse beads to pay off a massive debt.

Combine beads of different colors to create various shapes and designs.

Display your creations in a showcase for customers to see. If they like them, they'll buy them.

You need to earn enough to cover your daily expenses for food and debt.

You can buy necessary items and access various information from your computer.

Your employer will visit you every two or three days to check on you and offer support. It's best to maintain a good relationship. (You can choose between two appearances.)

As your popularity increases, you'll be able to buy useful gadgets, more bead colors, or more expensive beads.

store_data.about_the_game:
You begin the descent again... How many times have you attempted to reach the bottom? 20 floors... only 20 floors.

You lost your life years ago, but instead of entering the afterlife, you were forced into a dungeon of endless horrors. Under the watchful eye of The Voice and The Masters, the torment will not end until you reach the bottom. Every brutal death is remembered. The dungeon is always changing. The torment never stops.

20 Floors Down is a top-down horror roguelite where survival depends on resource management, careful exploration, and the weapons you carry into the dark. The dungeons are unforgiving, the monsters are relentless, and the only light you have is the one in your hand; and you DO NOT want to let that light run out.

Features:

  • Procedurally generated floors that grow larger and more dangerous as you descend.

  • Full controller and keyboard/mouse support

  • Beat the game and unlock an unlimited mode that let's you go as deep as your skill allows.

  • A cast of horrifying enemies including giant spiders, skeleton armies, and many more. Each enemy has a unique AI that challenges you differently.

  • Dungeon crawling roguelike system. Items exponentially increase in value as you delve deeper.

  • A deep inventory, upgrade, and loadout system. Choose your weapons and items wisely before each descent.

  • A unique dynamic lighting system that enemies will use against you.

  • A dark, evolving narrative told through notes that you left on previous descents.

Shape the Dungeon:
With full Steam Workshop integration and a robust modding API, you can alter the dungeon yourself. Code new items, design custom enemies, or download community-made creations to completely change your descent.

The Voice says reaching the bottom will end the suffering. But what awaits you at the bottom?

What awaits you 20 floors down?

content_descriptors.notes:
Contains frequent combat violence including weapon-based combat, enemy death animations, and player death sequences that include dismemberment and blood. The game features horror themes throughout including psychological torment, themes of eternal damnation and suffering, and depictions of anguish and hopelessness. The narrative deals with themes of condemnation, loss of free will, and an inescapable cycle of death that some players may find distressing.

This game does not contain sexual content, drug or alcohol use, or depictions of self-harm.

The Age of Hunger Has Begun

A terrible curse has fallen. The entire world suffer from famine. To survive, humanity has been forced to take part in a deadly card game called "The ritual."

Famine is a horror roguelike deckbuilder. Each day, you embody a new candidate for the Ritual. If you succeed, you keep humanity from dying for a few more days. If you fail, you die.

In addition to being a card game, Famine is a narrative-driven game. Your different runs will be interspersed with cutscenes that allow you to discover a dark and mysterious world blending political intrigue, investigations, cursed temples, and plot twists.

store_data.about_the_game:
Somewhere underground in the modern era, the most popular "game" has never been about fair competition, but about who dares to lie more, and who can flip the table at the last second. Forced to sit at the card table for survival and prestige — every round is a life-or-death battle of deception.

Truth, lies, and that split second of doubt.

Core loop: Here's the English translation of the game sequence:

Announce the number both sides will play → Play cards face down → Challenge the truth → Play again, until one player runs out of cards and deals final damage. You can play truthfully with real cards, or bluff with fake ones — but if your opponent challenges, the card is revealed, and the liar pays the price.

Roguelike: Win a round, live a few more days.

The cost of defeat is fatal, while victory grants you enhancements — whether skills, card upgrades, or other interesting boons. Each win gives you a brief respite, during which you can visit shops, enter taverns, encounter random events, or even explore some unknown underground place... but time slips away quickly, and soon you must face the next battle.

Enemies lie, have their own playing habits, and their own stories.

As the game progresses, you'll encounter increasingly stronger enemies with distinct mechanics:

You'll meet a wizard's apprentice who can see through cards, a blood-wasting patient who self-destructs after death; a suspicious little cheater, and a cautious seared‑mark emissary. Face different enemies, experience different psychological games, and try to defeat them.

As you play, you'll uncover the stories behind these enemies — and, if possible, your own story.

Perfect for you if:

- You enjoy bluffing / poker‑style psychological gameplay.

- You want short, high‑density decision‑making rounds combined with roguelike progression.

- You're a technical player willing to iterate through information, challenge, and deck‑building.

store_data.about_the_game:
Friction is a fast-paced arcade style game of tag.

In the game, the goal is to have the most amount of points before the round ends. Each round lasts 2 minutes. Players who pick up the star, that randomly spawn around the map, becomes the tagger. The taggers goal is to chase down other players in order to gain points. Players who are tagged lose a small portion of their points. Green orbs will spawn throughout the map that only non-taggers can pick up to keep the advantage over the tagger.

Features

  • Online Multiplayer PVP

    Compete against friends or other players online in lobbies of up to 16 players for maximum tag intensity.

  • Creative Take on Tag

    Features such as the star and green orbs add a twist onto tag's classic game loop that makes it more competitive          and interesting to play.

  • Leaderboards

    Fight to earn the #1 spot in the lobby leaderboard before the timer ends!

  • Customization

    There are loads of ways to customize your character to set yourself apart from other players.

  • Skill based movement

    Train your skills over time to become a pro at dodging and weaving between players. Hone your dash timing and            movement skills to become untouchable as you zip around corners.

store_data.about_the_game:
If out of bed on summer’s night

You hear the crack of lightning bright,

And spying there a shadowed shape, 

Fear not, my girl, nor flee in fright

The scarecrow’s on his watch tonight.

Your father said he'd be back before Christmas. That was two years ago.

Now your mother's moving to work at a radar station in the rural edges of New Zealand, and unfortunately for you, she's taking you with her. To make matters worse, there's something rotten lurking in the bush beyond your grandfather's house... and it's coming for the two of you.

Oh, and don't think the scarecrow will help you. He's useless.

Girl & Scarecrow is a fantasy visual novel game with a moderate amount of choice, eight or so characters, a couple endings and a big rat.

store_data.about_the_game:
Mine into the depths of mount Olympus.

Echoes of the Deep is an incremental endless idle game where you mine rocks, collect rare Lefkadium crystals, and unlock powerful upgrades to grow your production.

DEEP DESCENT

You can sacrifice your progress to descend deeper into the mountain. Each descent permanently multiplies your Rock and Lefkadium gains. Stack your multipliers across dozens of descents and see your numbers climb!

ORE VEINS

Unlock 16 tiers of Ore Veins through an expansive upgrade tree with over 300 nodes. Each tier boosts your production , from humble beginnings to numbers that need scientific notation to display.

ECHOES

After each Deep Descent, choose a powerful Echo that shapes your run. Echoes can transform your run from good to Legendary and no two runs feel quite the same. Chase Legendary Echoes for the biggest rewards.

MILESTONES / ACHIEVMENTS

Over 200 milestones that tracks everything you do . Blocks mined, peaks destroyed, descents completed, time played, and more.

QUESTS

Daily and weekly quests give you permanent bonuses that accumulate over time. The longer you play, the stronger your endgame becomes.

ROCK TREE

Spend your Rock to unlock a spiral of 24 permanent nodes that multiply your income, boost your Anomalies, and make every block count.

ROCK RARITIES

Unlock 4 ore rarities that provide extra multipliers and bonuses. Their glow is very profitable.

THE DRILL

Constantine channels his inner strength and conjures a massive Drill in front of him . Mining huge amount of rocks and other resources . Upgrade it through its own talent tree.

THE RESONANCE FIELD

A curved energy field that extends from your drill tip and boosts every block and peak it touches. Upgrade it through its own talent tree.

PATH OF OLYMPUS

The mountain has a name. It is Mount Olympus. The Path of Olympus reveals the journey ahead where you are now and where you are going. with more locations to be added.

OFFLINE PROGRESS

Your miner keeps running while you're away. Come back to a full haul ready to spend .

ANOMALIES

Two rare Anomaly types can appear in the world at any time.

Anomaly: Lefkadium : teleports you to a 25-second farming burst.

Anomaly: Vein Extraction : puts your Ore Vein branches against each other , the winning branch gets buffed for 25 minutes.

Chain them for massive gains.

THE DARK MARKET

Mine a black rock and meet the Dark Wanderer. Choose one powerful buff from a pool of 100.

Simple to pick up. Impossible to put down.

Disclaimer : 
AI tools where not used during development of the game

Visual assets, music, and sprites werecreated by artists and licensed musicians.

All of the above are also listed in the credits of the game .

Thank you

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to Green Market, a cozy dispensary management simulator set in a charming low‑poly voxel world.

You’re the proud owner of a small shop with big dreams. Customers walk through your door with specific needs – exact strains, exact weights. It’s up to you to keep your shelves stocked, your scales calibrated, and your register ringing. Every sale you complete adds money to your pocket, which you can reinvest into your business to make it grow.

How It Works

Order fresh product from the wholesale market using your shop laptop. After a short delivery time, wooden pallets appear outside your door, loaded with jars of premium flower. Carry the jars inside, place them on your shelves, and get ready for business.

Customers arrive, form a line, and place orders. They want a specific strain and a specific weight—no substitutions, no “close enough.” Use the scale to weigh out the exact amount, bag it up, and complete the sale at the register. Happy customers leave you with a tip, and your reputation grows. Frustrated customers walk out, and you lose the sale.

Build Your Dream Dispensary

As you earn money, you can unlock new strains, upgrade your storage shelves to hold more jars, increase your queue capacity to serve more customers, and boost your marketing to bring in foot traffic faster. You can also improve your delivery speed and pallet capacity so you always have the product you need on hand.

Your shop is your canvas. Decorate with glowing neon signs, potted plants, and cozy couches. Every decoration adds a permanent tip multiplier, so making your dispensary feel like home pays off.

Realistic, Relaxed, Rewarding

Green Market is a single‑player experience with no time pressure, no fail‑state, and no stress. You control the pace. It’s a game about attention to detail, efficiency, and the satisfaction of watching your small shop turn into a thriving business.

Key Features

  • Authentic Dispensary Management – Greet customers, fill precise orders, and run every detail of your shop.

  • Physical Order Fulfillment – Weigh product on a working scale, bag it up, and complete the sale at the register.

  • Wholesale Delivery System – Buy product online and wait for it to arrive on pallets outside. Carry jars inside and place them wherever you like.

  • Dynamic Customer Queue – Customers line up with unique requests. A visible patience bar tells you exactly how much time you have.

  • Deep Progression – Unlock new strains, upgrade shelves, queue capacity, marketing, pallets, and delivery speed.

  • Decorations That Matter – Neon signs, plants, and couches boost your tip multiplier, encouraging you to make your shop your own.

  • Full Save System – Three save slots, persistent world state, and even the jar you’re carrying is saved.

  • No Pressure – Play at your own pace. No timers, no fail‑states, just the joy of building a business.

So grab your keys, unlock the door, and welcome to Green Market – where every gram counts.

store_data.about_the_game:
you are the operator of a system that is learning to run itself.

it starts small: you click, you build, you watch a number climb. then you automate the clicking. then you automate the thing that automates the clicking. layer by layer the machine takes over - and one by one, your own controls deactivate. the buttons go dark not because you failed, but because you succeeded. you are automating yourself out of a job, and the job is you.

when the machine finally no longer needs you, there is one control left.

BREAK THE CYCLE.

you wake up one layer higher. doing it again. faster, this time, because you remember - and so, quietly, does the machine.

cold terminal calm.

the whole game is a monochrome-green console with the hum of a system running itself. lowercase prose, no carnival, no nags, no dark-pattern timers. the ui is the machine.

an idle game that respects your time.

meaningful offline progress, instant readability, honest math. leave it running for days or sit with it for an hour - both are intended.

depth that compounds.

a branching tree of upgrades each run, ten workers who grow a second skill as you go, and a small web of echo choices that bend every repeat. achievements double as a checklist of everything to see.

a loop that knows it's a loop.

the narration remembers. each cycle it gets a little more knowing. there is something on the other side of enough repetitions - not a door out, but a thing to understand. we won't say more than that.

built for the people who finished universal paperclips and wanted the feeling again.

Outage is a first-person co-op survival horror game set on a dark estate.

A strange animal causes your car to crash at night during a storm. To find shelter, you break in to what seems to be an abandoned, old mansion. But the house is not empty. Its owner captures you, and the estate becomes your prison.

Explore the mansion, loot supplies, craft useful items and weapons, hide from the evil man and try to find a way out to escape.

Survive the Owner, Alone or Together

Face the estate on your own, or bring friends into the nightmare. Work together to explore the mansion, loot supplies, distract the old man, and fight your way deeper into the estate. But watch out for his traps, he is a skilled trapper with decades of hunting experience. 

Fight the creatures

At first, the mansion seems empty - but something is wrong. You hear strange noises, see weird shadows move in the dark, and the estate slowly reveals the creatures bred by its owner. Fight them with what you found or crafted.

Use the Generator

The generator changes how you explore. Turn it on to light the mansion, power machines, use devices, and force the light-sensitive creatures back into hiding.

  • Explore a dark estate

  • Loot supplies and craft useful items

  • Use the generator to change the mansion around you

  • Hide from the old man or fight back

  • Discover eerie creatures

  • Fight stronger boss creatures that act as milestones and reward you with special items

  • Find a way out before the estate becomes your last destination

  • Explore procedurally generated areas that change with each playthrough

store_data.about_the_game:
You cannot see four dimensions. But you can see what a four-dimensional object looks like from inside three-dimensional space.

A 4D chess piece passing through your world doesn't appear all at once. You see a cross-section of it — a slice. Depending on where along the fourth axis the slice falls, the same piece can appear small, regular, or large. Move along the fourth dimension and the cross-section changes. The piece shifts. Its apparent form in your space is not its true form. It is a shadow of something bigger.

That is Vektor Chess.

The board extends across three spatial dimensions — eight files, eight ranks, eight layers deep. Pieces move through all of it: rooks sweep full columns, bishops cut diagonally through the stack, pawns climb upward layer by layer. But the board is not the whole picture. Every piece also exists along a fourth axis, invisible to you, expressing itself in three-dimensional space as a phase — Small, Regular, or Large.

Phase is not a status effect. It is geometry. It is the piece's true position rendered in a dimension you can only glimpse.

To capture, you must meet the piece where it actually is — not just in space, but in state. Position is necessary. Phase is also necessary. A piece can stand directly beside its enemy and remain completely harmless, because in the fourth dimension, they are not in the same place at all.

Pieces move through all of it: rooks sweep full columns, bishops cut diagonally through the stack, pawns climb upward layer by layer. But the board is not the whole picture. Every piece also exists along a fourth axis, invisible to you, expressing itself in three-dimensional space as a phase — Small, Regular, or Large.

Phase is not a status effect. It is geometry. It is the piece's true position rendered in a dimension you can only glimpse.

To capture, you must meet the piece where it actually is — not just in space, but in state. Position is necessary. Phase is also necessary. A piece can stand directly beside its enemy and remain completely harmless, because in the fourth dimension, they are not in the same place at all.
store_data.short_description: Four-dimensional chess, rendered in three-dimensional space. Move pieces across a board eight layers deep, shift their phase between Small, Regular, and Large along a hidden fourth axis, and capture only when position and state align. Play solo, locally, or online.

store_data.about_the_game:
Gambillion is a neon-drenched roulette game built around one simple question: how far are you willing to go?

Spin the wheel, place your bets, and chase an ever-growing bankroll target through a haze of bad decisions and worse odds. The core loop is a simple system of drinks, modifiers, and increasingly desperate financial choices that keeps every run feeling different. Hit your goal and you'll prestige, choosing a permanent perk before resetting and pushing further. Go broke and, well... you still have options. You just might not want to think too hard about them.

Key Features

  • Roulette with a twist. Classic roulette bets with a roguelite progression layer. Each run builds toward a target bankroll, and hitting it unlocks a prestige perk that carries into the next run.

  • The Drink Shop. Browse a rotating selection of cocktails that bend the rules of probability. Martingale safety nets, double-or-nothing gambles, sector biases, loss caps, and more. Buy smart or buy reckless.

  • Inventory System. Save drinks for the right moment and consume them on your terms. Timing is everything.

  • Sell Anything. Unload unwanted drinks for quick cash. And when the cash runs out... your body is also an asset.

  • Body Parts as Currency. Go bust and the game doesn't end — it negotiates. Sell what you've got left and spin again. Run out of parts, and you go die in the street.

  • Prestige Upgrades. Hit your bankroll goal to unlock a permanent perk, then reset and push further than before.

  • Achievements & Milestones. — Track your progress and unlock bragging rights across every run.

store_data.about_the_game:
Altarnode is a dark 2D top-down survival colony-defense roguelite where you play as an evil god protecting a desperate cult from endless waves of critters. Offer sacrifices through the Altar Node, expand your colony, and survive as long as your followers can sustain its growing ritual demand.

Keep Feeding the Altar

Kill roaming critters, let your cultists process their bodies into meat, and offer sacrifices at the Altar to keep your cult alive.

Build and Expand

Place new Nodes including pits, butcheries, storage, and defensive structures. Placement matters, efficient layouts improve logistics, while strong defensive positioning can decide how long your colony survives.

Your Divine Power

Strike enemies with mouse-driven attacks while your cultists focus on their ritual work. Every sacrifice empowers the altar and grants you greater divine strength.

Survive

Critters grow more dangerous over time while the altar demands larger and larger offerings. The moment sacrifices stop, the countdown start and Altar collapse begins.

Unlock Upgrades and Power

Earn Tithe at the end of each run based on total meat sacrificed. Spend it to unlock upgrades, improve efficiency, strengthen future starts, and discover new ways to survive longer.

Altarnode is a fast, replayable roguelite about momentum, pressure, and sacrifice. Build carefully, feed the altar, and push your cult a little further with every run.

store_data.about_the_game:
Bust a Nut! A Game About Raising Cocks

Inheriting your late uncle's estate, The Nut House, wasn't exactly what you had planned for your weekend... but it's time to roll up your sleeves and get to work. Do you have the stamina to handle the world's fifth-largest nut empire?

Grab Your Nuts and Get Pulling!

Start from the bottom and work your way up. Use your own two hands to Bust a Nut! manually, or hire a massive flock of Cocks and other trusty farm animals to handle the heavy stroking for you. The more you pump into your farm, the bigger your yield becomes!

Experience Massive Growth Spurts

  • The Nut Tree: Climb the branch of success! Spend your nuts on the Nut Tree to unlock permanent perks that keep your wood hard and your production flowing.

  • Deep Prestige: When your bush is tapped out, it's time to release! Reset your progress to spread your Seed. Use those Seed Points to ensure your next growth spurt is even harder and faster.

  • The Blue Ball Bonus: Keep an eye out for a sudden Blue Ball... clicking it gives you a temporary, throbbing seed bonus that really hits the spot.

Play the Market with Your Nut Sack

Is your Nut Sack feeling heavy? Take it to Wall-Nut Street!

  • Invest in blue-chip giants like Deez & Co.

  • Short or long your positions to earn Gacha Tokens. Just make sure you don't get caught with an empty sack when the market goes limp!

The Nut Grab & The Creature Arena

Ready for some furry fun? Reach into the Nut Grab to spend your hard-earned nuts on a new companion. You might pull out a Dirty Pussy, a Smelly Beaver, or even a Big Ass.

  • Train Your Unit: Every creature comes with four signature moves, like Small Squeeze, Heavy Pant, or Huge Load.

  • The Nut Cracker: Take your prize Cock to the arena and beat off the competition! Defeat the four legendary trainers to earn the ultimate prize: a Pearl Necklace for your sweetheart.

A Twist You Won't See Coming!

Travel the land to defeat the four elite Gym Leaders:

  • Ben Dover

  • Phil McCracken

  • Mike Oxmal

  • Anita Hanjaub



Bust a Nut! is a game of girth, grit, and high-frequency friction.

Wishlist now... it's going to be a long night in the barn!

store_data.about_the_game:
AENAI

The sea remembers everything.

In the kingdom of Fluvia, people begin disappearing without a trace, rivers change their course, and ancient chronicles speak of a name that once gave life to the world.

Play as Nerielle Lysarane, the last heir of a bloodline bound to the ancient elements. Discover the secrets of sunken temples, make choices that shape the fate of the kingdom, and uncover the truth hidden within forgotten myths.

Unite with the elemental forces and uncover their ancient power.

AENAI is a melancholic fantasy game focused on narrative, atmosphere, and the consequences of choice. The world is inspired by ancient chronicles, forgotten legends, and the raw power of nature’s elements — especially water, which in this world possesses a memory of its own.

Key Features

🌊 Explore a world shaped by ancient chronicles

Travel through ruins, temples, and cities hidden among water, fog, and the remains of lost civilizations.

⚖️ Make difficult choices

Your decisions influence the people of Fluvia, the relationships between characters, and the awakening of the elements.

👑 Discover Nerielle’s story

Follow the journey of a young heir connected to the legend of the goddess Aenai.

✨ Immerse yourself in atmospheric fantasy

A blend of pixel art, painterly landscapes, and a calm, melancholic atmosphere.

📖 Uncover the secrets of the elements

Water, fire, earth, and air hold stories older than the kingdom itself.

Additional Information

Genre: Narrative Fantasy / RPG / Choices Matter

Game Mode: Single-player

Languages: Polish, English

Created by a solo indie developer

The visuals shown are concept art and are subject to change during development.

store_data.about_the_game:
Ash and Velvet is a dark fantasy adult visual novel about pride, power, political manipulation, and the cost of making yourself useful to the wrong people.

A proud dark elf in a human court

Serith, a proud dark elf envoy of House Vaereth, is sent to the human surface with a simple purpose: turn men and dwarves against each other for the benefit of her house. She arrives cold, disciplined, and certain of her own superiority — but the human court does not meet her on clean political ground.

It watches her. Judges her. Desires her. Tests what she is willing to trade.

As Serith moves through hostile halls, private rooms, dangerous negotiations, and morally ugly bargains, every compromise changes how others see her — and how she learns to use them in return.

What to expect

- A dark fantasy story focused on court politics, reputation, manipulation, and corruption

- A proud female dark elf protagonist with her own goals, contempt, and ambition

- Adult scenes tied to power, status, leverage, and consequence

- Choices that shape tone, relationships, memories, and how Serith is read by others

- A cinematic visual novel style with character sprites, painted backgrounds, inserts, voice acting, and music

- A morally gray story where progress often comes with a price

Current release

The current release contains the opening chapters of an ongoing story. Future updates will continue Serith’s political and personal descent through the human court, the growing conflict with the dwarves, and the increasingly dangerous attention of the men who find her useful.

store_data.about_the_game:
⏰ FIVE AM. ALARM CLOCK.

Kolya is an engineer. He needs to get to work. Sounds simple. It's not. The office is far away. Very far away. And Kolya's body doesn't want to move. Kolya's body doesn't want anything.

🛌 A BODY THAT WON'T COOPERATE

Controlling Kolya is simple: four keys for four limbs, mouse pulls, click grips. Controlling Kolya is impossible: the body won't listen, arms miss, legs slip. Somewhere between "simple" and "impossible," progress is born.

🚆 AN ORDINARY COMMUTE

From the blanket to the porch — a feat. From the porch to the platform — an ordeal. From the platform to the station — an adventure. What's next? Best not to think about it. The route is longer than it seems. Much longer.

🎙 THE NARRATOR

Kolya is accompanied by a narrator — admiring, ironic, omniscient. He describes every situation as if filming a documentary about a great endeavor. In a way, he is.

🤖 POST-SOVIET RETROFUTURISM

Technology was implemented. Instructions were lost. Holograms glitch, robots get stuck, smart things act dumb. A familiar world with a thin layer of absurd future on top.

🧩 PHYSICS AS PUZZLE

There's no right solution. There's physics, four limbs, and whatever happens. Sometimes it's graceful. More often — hilarious.

Kolya doesn't complain. Kolya doesn't quit. Kolya just does what needs to be done.

Wishlist to find out why.

store_data.about_the_game:
Plot

The story follows an eccentric scientist (the protagonist) and his companion, who have been abducted by agents acting on behalf of the state and are being pressured to defect to the country that kidnapped them. Depending on the choices made, the pace and direction of the plot will unfold in different ways.

The backstory and other plot elements are revealed in small doses, leaving room for theories and providing motivation to keep playing in order to unravel all the mysteries.

The visual novel is divided into three playthrough styles, each with its own ending.

Negative – the pace is very fast, bloody, with a large number of scenes of violence and swearing, and also reveals secondary characters.

Neutral – the pace is measured and calm, with a low or moderate (depending on the player’s choices) amount of violence and swearing, and it answers the main plot questions whilst focusing on the protagonist.

Positive – the pace is faster than in the neutral mode, yet still more measured than in the negative mode. A minimal amount of violence and swearing. Over time, the story will increasingly focus on one of the secondary characters.

The game’s plot is spread across multiple paths, meaning that to fully understand the story, it is not enough to play through just one ending. On the contrary – to do so, you must play through the game in its entirety to see all the endings.

Visuals

The backgrounds and characters are hand-drawn, in a style that occasionally exaggerates proportions and presents the scene from a different angle.

The selection buttons are stylised to match the scene.

Animations are rarely present.

Soundtrack

For most of the game, you’ll be accompanied by ambient music that captures the game’s cosmic atmosphere, but there are also other tracks that will accompany events ranging from brutal confrontations to everyday tasks.

Most in-game events also feature sound effects, such as the sound of a door opening or the protagonist’s footsteps.

Gameplay

For most of the game, you will be reading dialogue, periodically choosing from the options presented by the game

store_data.about_the_game: Trace Ukraine’s journey from the early 1990s to the 2040s. Guide your country through geopolitical turbulence, hybrid aggression, and the complex process of nation-building. You’ll delve deep into complex systems: waging hybrid wars, navigating shifting geopolitical dynamics, developing a political leader, and shaping a regime. The game offers an innovative wargame experience—right up to the use of nuclear weapons. You choose the direction of development yourself: from building a stable democracy to establishing a harsh dictatorship. All game mechanics, as well as dozens of historical events and simulated crises (civil wars, invasions, and other global challenges), were developed by a professional political scientist, so they correspond as closely as possible to harsh political realities. What if Ukraine hadn’t signed the Budapest Memorandum, and Russia had split into three separate entities—all while you were in power!

store_data.about_the_game:
Break into the system. Clear every room. Go deeper.


Nullbreak Protocol is a sci-fi arcade roguelite built on one escalating loop: launch your core, shatter every block in the room, survive what the room fires back. Every run drives you deeper into the system - and the system never stays the same.

Run the protocol

Every run is a descent. Rooms tighten in density, hazard, and pressure the further you push. There's no victory screen down here - only how deep you got, and whether the next run goes deeper.

Build your run

Between rooms you draw protocols - modular upgrades that rewrite how your run plays. Stack them, chain them, specialize. With 20+ protocols and stacking effects, no two runs ever resolve the same. Side cannons, pulse lasers, shockwave radius, overclocked speed - the build is yours to assemble.

Read the room

The system fights back. Turrets track and fire. Laser nodes sweep the arena. Explosive blocks chain. Shields refuse to break. Regenerators heal their neighbors, phase blocks flicker out of reach, mirrors and accelerators bend your core's path. Fourteen block types - each one a different problem to solve under pressure.

Push the depth

Clear rooms, bank fragments, unlock new protocols and run-start bonuses. Persistent meta-progression means every run feeds the next. Your record is depth - beat it.

Make it yours

Done with the built-in challenges? Build your own rooms with the in-game editor and drop straight into them. Your layouts, your rules.

Features

  • Fast-paced sci-fi arcade roguelite - easy to start, hard to master
  • 20+ stackable protocols for deep, run-defining builds
  • 14 distinct block types, from turrets and laser nodes to phase and mirror blocks
  • Endless descent with escalating difficulty and depth-based scoring
  • Persistent meta-progression - unlock protocols and bonuses across runs
  • Build and play your own custom rooms with the in-game editor
  • Full English and German language support

store_data.about_the_game:
Cozy Radiation Cleaner

Cozy Radiation Cleaner is a dark post-apocalyptic exploration and cleanup experience where players step into the role of a lone radiation cleaner sent into the remains of a fallen world. Armed with a radiation detector, protective equipment, and specialized cleanup tools, players must travel through contaminated zones, locate hazardous radioactive objects, and restore abandoned areas once considered impossible to survive in.

Built entirely in Unreal Engine 5, the game focuses on atmosphere, immersion, environmental storytelling, and satisfying cleanup gameplay. Every location tells the story of a civilization destroyed by catastrophic radiation events, where nature, decay, and danger have consumed the world left behind.

Players will explore multiple large-scale maps, each featuring unique environments, hazards, visual styles, and gameplay challenges. From destroyed cities and abandoned industrial facilities to underground laboratories, ruined suburbs, military zones, forests, and contaminated research stations, every map introduces new objectives and increasingly dangerous radiation levels.

Using a handheld radiation detector, players must scan their surroundings to locate hidden radioactive materials scattered throughout the environment. Some contaminated objects are easy to detect, while others are buried beneath debris, hidden inside buildings, or protected by unstable environments. Players must carefully search each area, manage exposure levels, and clean or extract dangerous materials before the contamination spreads further.

The gameplay combines:

  • Exploration

  • Radiation scanning

  • Environmental cleanup

  • Resource management

  • Hazard survival

  • Objective-based progression

  • Atmospheric world discovery

As players progress, they will unlock better cleanup equipment, advanced radiation scanners, improved protective suits, and upgraded tools that allow access to higher-risk areas with stronger contamination. Dangerous zones may contain collapsing structures, toxic air pockets, unstable reactors, electrical hazards, or heavily irradiated objects requiring specialized handling.

Each map is designed with replayability in mind, encouraging players to fully explore environments, discover hidden contaminated areas, and improve cleanup efficiency. Dynamic lighting, volumetric fog, detailed environments, and realistic post-processing effects powered by Unreal Engine 5 create a tense and immersive atmosphere throughout the experience.

The world of Radiation Cleaner is intentionally lonely and oppressive. Players are not heroes fighting monsters — they are survivors performing one of the most dangerous jobs left in humanity’s final days. Every cleaned area represents hope, recovery, and a small step toward rebuilding civilization.

Key Features:

  • Multiple large post-apocalyptic maps

  • Radiation detection and cleanup mechanics

  • Immersive atmospheric exploration

  • Unreal Engine 5 visuals and lighting

  • Dynamic environmental storytelling

  • Progressive equipment upgrades

  • Hazardous contaminated zones

  • Realistic radiation scanning gameplay

  • Dark cinematic presentation

  • Detailed ruined environments

  • Survival-focused gameplay systems

  • Hidden radioactive object searching

  • Satisfying cleanup progression loop

Radiation Cleaner aims to deliver a unique combination of exploration, tension, and environmental restoration within a haunting post-nuclear world where every signal from your detector could lead to danger — or salvation.

store_data.about_the_game:
The ocean isn't big enough for all of you.

Jump into chaotic multiplayer battles where every player sails inside their own barrel. Armed with nothing but an oar at the start, you'll have to fight, dodge, and outsmart your opponents to stay afloat. Every match quickly turns into a frantic struggle for survival as players clash across the waves, searching for better gear and the perfect opportunity to strike.

Whether you're playing in a free-for-all where everyone is an enemy or teaming up in 2v2 battles, no fight ever unfolds the same way. One moment you're escaping an attack, the next you're chasing down a weakened rival. The last barrel floating wins.

The ocean is filled with opportunity for those brave enough to claim it.

Crates drift across the water carrying weapons, resources, and valuable treasures that can completely change the outcome of a battle. Chasing loot is often worth the risk, but every crate becomes a hotspot that attracts nearby players looking for the same reward.

A lucky find can turn an underdog into the most dangerous player on the map. But the longer you spend looting, the more exposed you become to enemies waiting for the perfect moment to attack.

Survival isn't just about fighting, it's about becoming stronger than everyone else.

As matches progress, you'll discover shops scattered throughout the ocean where you can spend your hard-earned resources. Improve your barrel, increase your chances of survival, and gain advantages that help you stay ahead of the competition.

Every decision matters. Spend your resources too early and you may miss a better opportunity later. Save them for too long and you might not survive long enough to use them. Finding the right balance between combat, looting, and upgrading is often the difference between victory and defeat.

The sea itself is one of your greatest enemies.

While players battle for dominance, dangerous threats roam the waters. Pirates and mysterious sea creatures attack anyone they encounter, turning the battlefield into a constant struggle for survival. These encounters can force rival players to put their differences aside and work together against a common threat.

Of course, cooperation rarely lasts for long.

The player fighting beside you against a sea monster may decide you're the easier target once the danger is gone. In the middle of the ocean, trust is fragile, alliances are temporary, and betrayal is always just around the corner.

One match might end with an epic duel between two fully upgraded survivors. Another might see players reluctantly joining forces to defeat a giant creature before immediately turning on each other. Sometimes you'll dominate the ocean, and sometimes you'll be knocked overboard by the friend you thought was helping you.

Loot drifting crates, discover powerful weapons, upgrade your barrel, survive the dangers of the sea, and prove that you're the last one standing in a world where everyone is both a potential ally and a potential enemy.

Welcome to the ocean. Trust nobody.

store_data.about_the_game:
Club Architect

Build, manage, and improve your own nightclub in a cozy isometric tycoon game.

In Club Architect, you take over small, unfinished club spaces and turn them into working venues. Design the floor plan, place rooms and objects, hire staff, open for the night, watch guests move through your layout, and use the results to make your club better.

Every night is a test of your design. Are the toilets too far away? Is the bar queue too long? Do guests have enough room to dance? A bad layout is not a failure. It is your next renovation plan.

Build Your Club

Create the foundation of your venue, place walls and doors, assign functional zones, and add the objects your club needs to operate.

Rooms and features include:

  • Dance floors

  • Bar areas

  • Restrooms

  • DJ areas

  • Staff rooms

  • Cloakrooms

  • Much more

Manage The Night

Once your club is ready, open the doors and watch the night unfold.

Guests will:

  • Enter through your doors

  • Move through your layout

  • Visit the bar, dance floor, and restroom

  • Queue when capacity is too low

  • Spend money on entry and drinks

  • Become happy or frustrated depending on your design

Hire Staff

A club does not run itself. Hire basic staff such as bartenders and cleaners, and make sure your venue has the rooms and objects needed to support them.

Learn, Improve, Repeat

After each night, review what worked and what went wrong. Expand the club, adjust the layout, improve capacity, and prepare for the next opening.

Career Mode

Start in Cologne, your first small venue and tutorial location. Learn the basics of building, zoning, staffing, and opening your first club night before growing into more complex locations in the future.

store_data.about_the_game:
Build Your Academy

Start a gym from scratch or take over an existing academy. Sign fighters from a worldwide free agent pool, develop their game on the mats, and compete in tournaments from local opens all the way to world championships. Every decision is yours.

A Living World

Every save generates a unique world. 80 gyms across multiple countries, each with their own roster, reputation, and trajectory. Over 1,500 fighters compete across men's and women's divisions. Gyms rise and fall. Fighters age, develop rivalries, pick up injuries, and retire. The fighter who wins gold at worlds in one save might never exist in the next.

A Deep Match Engine

Fights resolve through a tick-based simulation with 41 grappling positions, 34 submissions, and over 130 unique transitions. Watch every moment unfold with live commentary and positional illustrations, or skip straight to the result. Set tactical instructions before each bout. Your choices shape how the fight plays out without removing the unpredictability.

Gi and No-Gi

The full tournament calendar runs both gi and no-gi events with proper rulesets. Gi-only positions and submissions are locked out of no-gi matches. Belt legality for leg locks differs between formats. Over 400 events per year across six tiers from local opens to invitation-only pro championships.

Develop Your Fighters

Each fighter has 15 attributes, a unique fighting style, a personality, a signature submission, and a career driven entirely by your coaching decisions. Train them with customisable focus allocation. Hire coaches to accelerate development. Open a youth academy and develop the next generation from age 7 through to graduation at 16.

Manage Everything

Finances, facilities, coaches, contracts, injuries, satellite training camps, in-house training matches, scouting, and a world map spanning 20 countries. Go broke and face the consequences. Build a dynasty and enter the Hall of Fame.

Diary: White is a 2D point-and-click psychological horror adventure game that plunges you into an inescapable nightmare, blurring the lines between safety and terror.

A suffocating home or a prison of the mind? You play as Khoa, a high school student crumbling under crushing academic pressure and the "perfect," extreme care of his mother. Locked within the walls of his own home, Khoa is forced to drink a cup of "calming tea" every night.

But as the effects of the tea wear off, reality begins to distort. Collapsing school hallways, blood-stained desks, and a colossal shadow lurking in the dark. Something is deeply wrong in this house. What sinister secret lies behind the red glow of his mother's always-locked door?

WHAT IF THE MONSTER YOU'RE RUNNING FROM... IS YOU?

You play as a disgraced police officer, once a loyal servant of a powerful secret cult that manipulates justice, medicine, and the truth itself. Protected by your badge and the influence of your brothers in the shadows, you committed acts no one was supposed to survive... until they turned on you.

Now you’re on the run. Framed. Hunted by the very system you helped build, and haunted by the crimes you tried to bury.

Your only hope lies deep within an abandoned monastery, where the cult hid its most damning secrets: forbidden experiments, missing documents… and your last chance to erase the past.

EVERY DOCUMENT TELLS A PART OF THE TRUTH.

Explore decaying tunnels, hidden chambers, and ritual sites buried beneath stone and silence. Use light, mirrors, and logic to solve carefully crafted puzzles that reveal the cult’s grotesque history, and your role in it.

KEY FEATURES

Logical Puzzles

Manipulate mirrors, and ancient mechanisms to open paths and unlock buried truths.

Tactile Lockpick System

Unlock doors and hidden compartments with a fully interactive lockpicking mechanic.

Survive Deadly Encounters

Enemies don’t just stalk you, hey kill you. Use your pistol wisely or become one of the lost.

Inventory & Resource Management

Collect, inspect, and manage limited resources as you dig deeper into forbidden places.

Retro VHS Horror Aesthetic

Experience psychological horror through a decaying lens of analog static, distortion, and tape-era unease.

Mature Psychological Narrative

Themes of guilt, abuse, corruption and memory are explored in a deeply personal, disturbing storyline.

store_data.about_the_game:
One Star Hotel is a 2-4 player co-op game about running a terrible hotel where the kitchen has standards, but not morals.

By day, cook meals, serve guests, clean up the mess, and keep customer satisfaction from hitting zero. By night, sneak through the hotel, gather tomorrow's ingredients, and make it back before morning.

RUN THE WORST HOTEL IN TOWN

Take orders. Cook fast. Serve faster. Drop a plate, burn dinner, slip on the floor, recover somehow, and pretend this is normal hospitality.

EXPLORE SIX QUESTIONABLE FLOORS

Climb through six different floors at the night shift, each with its own theme, dangers, and secrets. The building keeps changing. Nobody knows why.

NIGHT SHIFT GETS WEIRD

When the restaurant closes, the hotel opens up. Explore deeper floors, hunt for ingredients, drag supplies back, and survive long enough to make tomorrow's menu.

CHAOS IS BETTER WITH FRIENDS

Split jobs with your team, yell across the kitchen, rescue each other when things go wrong, and survive seven days together. Fail the day shift or lose everyone at night, and the run starts again.

FEATURES

  • 2-4 player online co-op

  • Chaotic restaurant service with cooking, serving, dirty plates, cleanup, and angry customers

  • Darkly comedic night exploration where tomorrow's meat supply becomes everybody's problem

  • A 7-day run structure with deeper hotel floors unlocking each night

  • Cute bean characters doing extremely questionable hospitality

  • A one-star hotel that can become a two-star hotel if your team survives

store_data.about_the_game:
A Bite-Sized Hide-and-Seek Adventure

Welcome to Costa Rica! Slip into a stress-free, hand-drawn tropical paradise designed for puzzle lovers, animal enthusiasts, and anyone looking to unwind.

Your goal is beautifully simple: Find 50 charming sloths taking a nap across a massive, custom-illustrated jungle map. There are no timers, no penalties, and absolutely no rush. Just you, some relaxing ambient sounds, and a bunch of masterfully camouflaged little friends.

Key Features

  • Lovingly Hand-Drawn Map: Explore a vibrant, custom illustration of Costa Rica teeming with rich environmental details, hidden quirky moments, and lush tropical greenery.

  • Juicy, Satisfying Clicks: Feel the instant satisfaction of rescuing a sloth with playful visual "pop" animations and crisp sound effects.

  • Seamless Navigation: Built with responsive mouse-wheel scrolling and a dedicated physical UI slider so trackpad and handheld players can pan and zoom into details with ease.

  • Play Anywhere: Full Steam Deck support means you can take your cozy sloth hunt on the go, utilizing precise trackpad controls.

store_data.about_the_game:
Do you remember when managing a football team was all about pure strategy, matches, and quick decisions? Retro Football brings back that experience with the authenticity of 90s classics and today’s technology.

Choose your club in editable retro seasons. The 1995-96 season includes more than 400 teams, almost 10,000 players, and 20 leagues from Europe and South America. Experience the golden era of football from the dugout and build your own path to glory.

The game you remember, the way you remember it

The pace is the same as ever: match by match, fixture by fixture. Check the condition of your squad, make decisions, move forward, and face the consequences. No filler, no complications. Just management.

Manage every detail of your club

Squad and lineup
Choose your starting eleven, manage substitutes and call-ups, and keep an eye on injuries, suspensions, morale, and fitness.

Tactics
Select classic formations, adjust your playing style, and assign free-kick, penalty, and corner takers.

Transfers
Negotiate transfers with an AI that evaluates each offer based on the player’s value, the selling club’s financial situation, and the player’s own interest. Receive counteroffers, sign free agents, invest in young prospects, and renew contracts before they expire.

Finances
Control your cash flow, manage the wage bill, set ticket prices, and maximize stadium income.

Technical staff
Hire specialized coaches, physiotherapists, scouts, and other key staff members. Each role has a real impact on the club’s weekly performance.

Stadium
Expand capacity, manage advertising boards, catering, and ticket pricing for each match.

Training
Assign skills to each player based on the coaches you have hired. Young players grow, veterans decline, and every season leaves its mark on your squad.

Match simulation with full match reports

Each match is resolved in two phases: half-time and full-time. The simulation generates a match report with goals, cards, player of the match, and stadium data.

The consequences continue after the final whistle: injuries, suspensions, morale changes, and fitness variations will affect the following fixtures.

Full seasons with promotions, relegations, and awards

At the end of each season, the league closes with its final standings, promotions, relegations, and awards such as Top Scorer, Best Player, and Manager of the Year.

Then a new campaign begins, with older players, developing youngsters, and contracts renewed or expired depending on your decisions.

Built to last

Mod support
Create your own seasons, upload emblems, player photos, and custom databases.

Hot-seat multiplayer
Up to 8 human managers can compete in the same league, each managing their team in turns.

Languages
Available in Spanish, English, French, German, Italian, and Portuguese.

Steam integration
Compatible with achievements, cloud saves, and Remote Play Together.

Key features

  • Editable retro seasons with hundreds of teams, thousands of players, and multiple European and South American competitions.

  • Simulation engine based on statistics, tactics, morale, fitness, and team condition.

  • Transfer system with probabilistic AI, counteroffers, and contract negotiation.

  • Full management of squad, staff, stadium, and finances.

  • Multi-season progression with player development, promotions, and relegations.

  • Integrated modding system for custom seasons and assets.

  • Local hot-seat multiplayer for up to 8 managers.

  • Available in 6 languages.

store_data.about_the_game:
Four employees, one RV, and one absurd night-shift mission: sneak into the wheat fields and carve the perfect "alien message" to make the whole world believe the aliens have landed.

Mowers cut wheat — and shred monsters too. Just hit the gas, and the problem solves itself.

  • Handheld Mower — Carve precise circles, and slice any monster that gets in your face clean in half

  • Arc Suction Gun — Drop a beacon, walk a circle around it, and let the arc line carve a perfect ring. Or use it to grab monsters and fling them away — or latch onto a teammate and drag them off

  • Plasma Gun — Blast searing plasma to burn scorched crop-circle lines into the field, and roast any monster that gets too close

  • Mower Rig — A wheat-shredding beast. Hop on solo and plow your front-mounted blades straight through the crops (and any monster in the way) to carve the boldest circles

  • Bombs, Matches, Seeds, Megaphone — All sorts of "solutions" you can buy at the shop (and brand-new ways to make trouble)

The monsters here aren't out to scare you — they're out to annoy you:

  • Little Pumpkin Fiends — Swarm at you with cleavers, then tumble like bowling pins when your vehicle sends them flying

  • Scarecrow — Can't move while you're looking at it; turn away for a second and it's right in your face

  • Broken Toy Gardener — Doesn't attack you. It just quietly regrows every patch of wheat you worked so hard to cut

  • Grey Aliens, Cultists, Giant Ant Swarms, Chainsaw Maniacs — Each map has its own special troublemaker

How to deal with them? Shout "Monster on the left!" and just run them over.

But it's not just monsters out there. Under the night sky, the field is littered with things that… really shouldn't be on a farm.

  • Glowing Potion Bottle — What happens if you drink it? Nobody knows — so just drink it first and ask questions later

  • Blinking Chest — Full of good stuff… as long as it feels like sharing

  • Mystery Vending Machine — Pop in a coin and roll the dice: treasure or prank, it's all down to luck

  • Brass Cannon — Load yourself (or a teammate) inside and launch across half the field

  • Carousel Music Box — Give it a spin, and strange things start to happen

Grab what you find and use it — the weird stuff in the field is often exactly what turns the game around.

Features:

  • Online co-op physics game for up to 4 players

  • Tons of crop circles waiting to be completed

  • A wild arsenal of mowing gear, from plasma guns to mower rigs to wreck the field with

  • Mysterious otherworldly objects scattered across the field — every one a surprise (or a scare)

  • Team up with friends to turn something simple into total chaos

  • A satisfying mowing feel paired with the co-op joy of working precisely while screaming at each other

Grab your friends, hop on voice chat, and head into the wheat. The more perfect the plan, the funnier the meltdown.

But seriously… there might actually be something out there in the field.

store_data.about_the_game:
Ashentia Hauntings 2 is a 2D top-down survival horror game based on the story of a paranormal enthusiast called Noah, who decided to investigate the various haunted locations of Ashentia, a place that is surrounded by hills and forests.

In the 1950s, the house was built on the land surrounded by trees, located almost an hour away from the Ashentia shopping district. In the beginning, a family used to live there for a few decades. During the 1990s, 2 members of the family died in a brutal car accident while returning home, which happened in Ashentia Highway Block E, where a truck driver was at fault. A few days following the incident, the owner sold the house to a popular businessman of the city. The house was then rented out to a family who are said to have been complaining about weird paranormal activities happening inside the house for the past few months.

The family living there has experienced a lot of paranormal activities, which included unexplained noises coming from the basement, a woman's disembodied laughing sounds, and stick-thumping noises heard during the nighttime. Also, there are car horn sounds coming from the garage area of the house out of nowhere almost at 3 AM every night. There was no explanation of how that happened.

So, the paranormal enthusiast, Noah, got a call from the current owner of the house to check it out to provide them with answers.

You play as Noah, the paranormal enthusiast, and your mission is to investigate the haunted house for proof of the paranormal. Will you be able to assist your client?

Key Features:

  • Explore the entire haunted house!
  • The various kinds of evil spirits lurking in the shadows!
  • Avoid dangerous traps like spikes, fire, etc.
  • Collect various items like keys, Brown box etc.
  • Explore spirit world carefully.
  • Nearly half an hour of paranormal investigation.

Warning:

This game contains flashing lights which may not be suitable for people with epilepsy or other photosensitive conditions. Player discretion is advised.
