store_data.about_the_game:
A cribbage roguelite deckbuilder. One peg, one board, one tournament tour at a time.


You're a traveling cribbage player working your way up the Long Tally, a tour that starts at regional clubs and ends at the national championship. Every match is a real cribbage match. Deal six. Drop two to the crib. Peg the round. Count the four cards in your hand against the cut.

Between matches, you build the player who shows up to the next one. Between tours, you build the player who walks back into the next tour.

Three ways to play


  • Campaign: the full Long Tally tour, with persistent unlocks, peg selection, and the campaign-layer build that carries between runs.
  • vs AI: one-off matches against AI opponents at three skill tiers and three personalities. No campaign, no progression. Just cribbage.
  • Online Multiplayer: head-to-head cribbage against another human, outside the campaign. Matchmaking and direct lobbies.

The run and the campaign


A run is one tournament tour from a regional club through nationals, with different opponents in every zone. Within a run, you build a temporary loadout: powerups that change how your hands score, consumables you spend between matches, crayons that mark specific cards for the duration of a single tour. When the run ends, the build resets.

The campaign sits above the runs. Across many tours, you earn permanent markers on specific cards, unlock different pegs to play as, and climb a tree of milestones that persists win or lose. The run's build is loud. The campaign's build is patient.

How the count builds


Cribbage already stacks small scores into bigger ones. The four cards you keep plus the cut combine into fifteens, pairs, runs, and flushes. A run of three with two fifteens is eight points. A run of four in a flushed hand can clear twenty before any modifiers fire.

The roguelite layer takes the count past where a kitchen-table game would stop. A powerup that triggers on every fifteen pushes a fifteens-heavy hand into the thirties and forties. A crayon on your favorite card doubles whatever it touches. Two or three good builds in a run and the counts grow into territory regular cribbage doesn't reach.

Powerups, consumables, and marks


Three systems shape your build.

  • Powerups: modifiers that fire on specific scoring events. Some trigger on fifteens. Some trigger on pairs. Some trigger on the run-ending Go. Stack them and the synergies stack with them.
  • Consumables: one-use items you spend during a match for a specific effect. One use, one decision.
  • Marks: enhancements applied to specific cards. Crayons last for one tour. Markers carry across the entire campaign. A doubled Five. A penalized Jack. A card that scores twice when it shows up.

Cribbage, if you've never played


Cribbage is a 350-year-old card game played to 121 points. Two players take six cards, drop two each into a side pile called the crib, then take turns laying cards down to a running count that resets at 31. The pegging round is a tactical poke and parry. Then both players reveal their four-card hands and count the score against a randomly cut fifth card: every fifteen, every pair, every run, every flush, every nob.

We kept all the rules. The roguelite layer is the wrapper, not the replacement. If you have played cribbage at a kitchen table, the math is the same from minute one.

What's in the box


  • Three game modes: Campaign, vs AI, and Online Multiplayer.
  • A campaign of tournament tours from regional clubs through the national championship.
  • Different opponents in every zone, each with their own personality and skill tier.
  • Multiple pegs to play as, each with their own play personality.
  • A growing roster of powerups, consumables, crayons, and campaign markers.

Early Access


Double Skunk is launching in Early Access while the campaign content and balance fill in. The core systems are stable: the scoring engine, the pegging round, the powerups, the marks, the campaign layer, all three game modes. The content is still growing: more opponents per zone, more rings on the campaign tree, more tuning passes against real player runs.

We're aiming for a content update every six to eight weeks during Early Access, and a 1.0 release once the full ring of opponents is in and the tuning has had time to settle against the EA cohort's runs.

If that sounds like a game you want to help shape, wishlist now and the page will notify you the day the demo lands.

store_data.about_the_game:
Story

Burrow is a beautiful world, lush and full of life. It is home to all variety of wildlife and plantlife.  Unknown to the denizens of Burrow, however, the cruel and evil Selenites (hideous robot moon wizards) watch from a distant moon, jealous of Burrow's life.

The Selenites, in a moment of particular cruelty, decide to take Burrow! They unleash a swarm of void meteors on Burrow. The void meteors shatter and from their remains grow huge, twisted briars, corrupting the very life force of Burrow. The briars drove the animals mad, filling them with evil void energy. The Selenites' plan seems almost complete...

Enter Calla and CLOVER - premier members of Burrow's V Mech Corps.  The  V Mech Corps is Burrow's elite fighting force, the first and last line of defense against the briar corruption.  It's up to Calla and CLOVER to save Burrow!  Can they do it?  That's up to you!

Features

  • Calla is a nimble rabbit! She can double jump, dodge, dash, sprint, and slide her way to victory. But she's still just a bunny. For added power and durability, Calla can jump (not hop, we're not doing that here) into CLOVER, her purpose-built combat mech!

  • Join Calla and CLOVER's battle across five unique levels, including the meadows, the wetlands, the desert, the alpines, and the spooky and mysterious ANOMALOUS CRATER. Find the cause of the briar infestation and stop the Selenites!

  • Enjoy a relaxing Lo-Fi soundtrack as you crush your enemies!

  • Exciting gunplay! Shoot on foot!  Shoot from a mech!  Shoot chickens! Shoot your own mech! (Not recommended)

  • Hub world! Chat with Burrow's colorful residents to learn more about the void meteors, the Selenites, and life in Burrow!

  • Intense Boss Battle!  So intense, there's just the one!

  • Collectibles!  Carrots!  Survivors!  {Spoiler}!

  • Speedrun mode!

  • 16 handmade achievements

  • Seriously, no rabbit puns.  Or at least not many.

Excuses

  • Made by one guy!

store_data.about_the_game:
Oh, My Doug! is an irreverent hand-drawn Metroidvania where two mismatched heroes are forced to work together inside the body of a very unhealthy man. Explore bizarre, interconnected biomes, uncover strange powers, wield outrageous weapons, and survive an apocalypse caused by Doug’s attempt to get healthy.

Game Features

  • A Metroidvania inside a human body.

Explore interconnected regions inspired by organs and bodily functions. Anatomy shapes navigation naturally, transforming Doug’s unhealthy body into a strange world of exploration, danger, and grotesque comedy.

  • A Single-Payer Co-Op.

Control two unlikely heroes forced to stick together. Their wildly different abilities combine into a complete toolkit for exploration and combat; their personalities, however… don’t mix nearly as well.

  • Hand-drawn to a fault.

A huge cast of bizarre creatures and memorable oddballs comes to life through traditional hand-drawn animation. An afternoon cartoon with razor-sharp controls.

  • Outlandish Arsenal.

Ride an Acme rocket, throw a portable hole, or blast flames from a squid’s butt. Every weapon and tool runs on cartoon logic, making it wildly different from anything in a typical shooter.

  • Irreverent 90s Cartoon Energy.

Chat with a sperm cell, spend the night in a tooth cavity… or explore a cemetery deep in the bowels. Every grotesque idea is delivered in glorious, high-detail gross-ups.

store_data.about_the_game:
Features

-Manage your fear

-monitor your heart rate

-survive the depths from both inside and outside

Gameplay

Each depth introduces new threats, and objectives. You will need to repair failing systems, check security cameras, use the periscope, decide when to sleep, and learn how each creature behaves before panic makes the decision for you. The deeper you go, the more the ocean starts to feel less empty.

Built around tension, resource management, and close-quarters horror, the game is designed to make simple actions feel risky. Looking through the periscope, checking a note, or waiting too long can change the night completely. The submarine is your shelter and your prison treat it well.


Story

The world did not end in fire... It rose,

The oceans didn't rise instantly. There was no single impact. There was no warning from the sky. Most importantly there was never a miracle technology to escape into the stars. Humanity had spent centuries reaching upward, only to find their limits. with the nearest habitable worlds farther away than any lifetime could cross, there is nowhere else to go.

Now the last record of the old world lies beneath impossible pressure. You pilot a small submarine into the depths, searching for answers in places mankind was never meant to return to. Every descent has brought you closer to what may be answers.

The ocean is not just empty space between ruins. Something has changed down there. Shapes move beyond the glass. Voices echo through equipment that should be dead.

With escape to the stars impossible and the surface nearly gone, the only direction left is down. Reach each the depths complete your objectives, and uncover what humanity buried beneath its own drowned world. You need to go deeper.

store_data.about_the_game:
Your father's house is a ruin. The name he left is so worthless, the King has given you a new one. All you have now is an empty manor, a single horse, and a training lance.

JoustVille is a singleplayer, open-world, Arthurian-inspired medieval RPG about making your name in a world that watches what you do and remembers. Ride from tournament to tournament, train the horse that carries you, forge alliances and rivalries, and build a reputation entirely your own.

The Joust

Every pass is a duel of timing and nerve. Skill-based combat rewards understanding your opponent before you ever step into the Arena. Line up your charge, commit your lance, and read your opponent in the instant before impact. There's no single "best" loadout; a heavy lance that unhorses one rival glances off the next, and every horse, shield, and suit of armor changes how a pass feels. You win by knowing who you're facing and what you've got in your hands.

Your Horse, Your Companion

Each horse is a unique companion, with their own personality and history. Build a bond that shows in the moments that matter, and feel the difference between a new horse and a trained, seasoned companion. The finest knights in JoustVille aren't the ones with the best gear. They're the ones who ride as one with their horse. From the heavy Percheron to the swift Arabian to the noble Friesian, you can unlock different breeds, train them in authentic dressage moves, and even send them on HorseQuests of their own.

A World That Remembers

Your choices matter. The people of JoustVille watch and remember what you do. The world sees what kind of knight you are becoming, and acts accordingly. Are you just and lawful, but without mercy? The Sheriff might think highly of you; the Priest might not. There is no right or wrong answer, but the people have their own opinions, and the world will change based on your actions.

Make Your Mark

Deep character customization runs through every system. Design your own coat of arms and carry your colors into every tournament. As you earn the respect of the people around you, the heraldry you fly and the equipment you bring into the lists become a living record of everything you won, who helped, and who hindered. Anyone can buy equipment, but alliances are earned.

Forge Your Own Path

There are no game-overs, and no single ending. Lose a tournament, make an enemy, fall into debt? The world doesn't end. It simply turns, and your story bends with it. A defeated knight rebuilds. An outlaw finds new roads. A bankrupt heir takes the long way back. Be merciful or be just. Be feared or be honored. There's no good or bad. Some people will applaud your decisions, others will never understand. JoustVille is a story-rich RPG with multiple endings and high replay value. It never tells you the right way to be a knight. It only asks what kind you'll choose to become.

A World Still Being Built

JoustVille is in active development, and I can't wait to share it with players. The opening towns are playable today, with the joust, horse training, HorseQuests, and heraldry systems live and evolving. Coming in Early Access: more towns, deeper systems, your camp growing into a staffed retinue, and the rebuilding of your family estate.

All pixel art is captured from live gameplay. The most likely thing to change is the art, but the Joust itself and the dynamic, reactive world that remembers your choices are already built and working.

As a wishlister, you'll be there to see the world grow with every update. Add JoustVille to your wishlist and follow the road from a ruined name to a legend.

Create a city one Page at a time in this rogue-like deckbuilding city builder. Each run begins with a small collection of cards and an empty Page. Princess Waifu is a princess-themed adult puzzle game built around image-based tile swapping, gradually increasing grid sizes, stage progression, hints, and unlockable artwork.

The current Early Access version includes 10 playable puzzle levels. In each level, the image is split into shuffled blocks. Your goal is to rebuild the image by placing the blocks into their correct positions.

The puzzle mechanic is based on direct selection rather than dragging or sliding. You first select one shuffled block, then select any other block you want to swap it with. The two selected blocks instantly exchange positions. You are free to choose any two blocks on the grid; they do not need to be next to each other.

As you progress, the grid size increases and the puzzles become more demanding. Larger grids require closer observation, memory, and planning as you compare image details, identify misplaced blocks, and decide which swaps will solve the puzzle efficiently.

The game includes a hint system to help when you get stuck. Hints support the puzzle flow without turning the game into a speed challenge. The focus is on relaxed puzzle solving, gradual progression, and completing each image at your own pace.

By completing stages, you progress through the level list and unlock more artwork. The planned full version will expand the game from 10 puzzle levels to 20 puzzle levels, with the remaining levels shaped around puzzle difficulty, grid progression, and player feedback during Early Access.

Humanity is no longer born. It is authorized.

You awaken to an unfamiliar world and a body the system refuses to explain. Under the rule of CORE, society has been rebuilt around the GENESIS Protocol — a mandate that controls reproduction, identity, and human existence itself.

Uncover who you truly are, what happened in the past, and why the truth seems to elude you at every turn.

No Health. Only Heart.

A unique heart-rate health system replaces traditional life bars. Taking damage sends your pulse climbing, pushing you closer to 'catastrophic cardiac disassembly'.

Classic Turns. Modern Violence.

A hybrid AATB battle system blends classic turn-based strategy with dynamic action timing. Plan your moves, watch the action bar, and unleash cinematic attacks with brutal cyberpunk impact.

Looting is Life

Scavenge lockers, crates, and even enemy corpses for valuable resources, cybernetic upgrades, medical supplies, weapons, and random junk that might just keep you alive.

Aim to Kill

Some skills demand more than a menu click. Time your strikes, execute input combinations, mash through pressure, or directly target enemies to land stronger hits.

『ContrailBlazer（コントレイルブレイザー）』は、美しい大空を舞台にした、のんびり楽しめるフライトアドベンチャーゲームです。

◆ 【簡単なシステム】飛行機雲で囲む、新感覚トレイルアクション
本作の最大の特徴は、自機が引き連れる「飛行機雲（トレイル）」です。
空に浮かぶアイテムや、迫りくる敵の攻撃を、あなたの飛行機雲でぐるっと「円」を描くように囲んでみましょう。囲まれたものはすべてあなたの力へと変わります！少ないボタン操作で楽しめます。

◆【物語】２人の主人公
本作には2人の主人公が存在し、作中で起きる「ある事件」をそれぞれの視点、まったく別の角度から描き出します。
プレイヤーの心に深く残るストーリーもお楽しみください。

◆【世界観】凍てついた廃墟
物語の舞台は、ミランコビッチ・サイクルの影響で過酷な寒冷期を迎え、静かに滅びゆこうとしている孤独な惑星です。美しい大空の下には、文明が途絶え、剥き出しの鉄骨や赤い錆びついたタンクだけが遺された静かな廃墟が広がっています。このどこか懐かしくも物悲しいディストピアな景色の中を旅しましょう。

store_data.about_the_game:
Night fell over Paintra.

A dark figure arrived with a stolen paintbrush and shattered the legendary Color Palette, the artifact that sustains the entire land. Paint Gems scattered across every corner of the world, and the townsfolk were taken.

Now Tomataro must recover the lost colors, rescue the townsfolk, and bring life back to Paintra.

Momentum-Based Precision Platforming.

Every move in Paintra flows into the next. Build speed on slopes, travel through pipe tunnels, wall-jump between cliffs, air-dash across gaps, and bounce off trampolines to reach hidden areas.

Paintra is built around movement with weight. Slopes, jumps, dashes, bounces, and landings all affect your speed and control. Mastering that movement is the core of the game.

The Boomerang.

Tomataro's boomerang is more than a weapon. Use it to defeat enemies, collect certain items, trigger objects, and interact with the world around you.

  • Dual-Hit Combat

    Hit enemies on the way out and on the way back. Aim carefully, and you can strike the same enemy twice with one throw.

  • Swing Orb Grappling

    Throw your boomerang at glowing Swing Orbs to latch on, build momentum, and launch yourself across wide gaps. Release at the right moment for extra distance.

  • Charged Throws

    Hold the throw button for a longer, wider arc that can reach farther enemies, items, and Swing Orbs.

Chain Moves. Earn More.

Keep your feet off the ground and keep the chain alive. Bounce off enemies, pop balloon creatures, and swing from orbs without landing to build your combo multiplier.

The longer the chain, the more Paint Coins you earn. Mix different move types in one chain for an extra bonus.

A Hand-Painted World

Explore more than 20 handcrafted levels across painted forests, caves, towns, ruins, and other strange corners of Paintra.

Each zone has its own hazards, enemies, secrets, and movement challenges built around Tomataro's abilities.

Boss Fights

Face multi-phase bosses that test the skills you have learned. The King Slime will not go down without a fight, and he is not the only one waiting deeper in the canvas.

Customize Tomataro

Spend Paint Coins at the prize capsule machine to unlock randomized cosmetic hats and character skins.

Hats are purely for style. Collect them all and show off your rarest pulls.

Meet the Inhabitants of Paintra

Not everyone has vanished. Talk to strange characters, find hidden villagers, and uncover more about the world you are trying to save.

  • Inspired by classic Sunsoft platformers like Mr. Gimmick and Trip World

store_data.about_the_game:
The Missing Rune is a psychological horror simulation.
[“The Missing Rune” executable may also be designated as OBJ-SP-611. The following is an instructional guide.]


You will simulate a low level researcher in the O.B.J. foundation who has been given the task of banishing demonic entities back to where they came. As of now these entities are not fully manifested into the real world; they will appear to fade in and out of reality. However, if you look directly at the entity it will tunnel into your mind and possess you completing the manifestation process. The same is also true if you look away, however this time it will sneak into your body, turning you into more of a vessel than human. To keep the entity at bay you must keep it in your peripheral vision. To banish the entity you will be placed at a control panel with several rune labeled buttons, you will use a “Rune Operation Manual” to solve which runes to input to properly banish the entity. Dr. █████████, a head researcher and expert on this topic, will be your guide and assist you along the way. In order to secure the safety of you and our staff, if you get possessed, the foundation staff is instructed to neutralize you.

[Incident Report | 001]:

C. 1971, the O.B.J. foundation, an organization dedicated to studying unexplained, unearthed an ancient church yard called “The Church of the Missing Rune”. Taking the necessary precautions they constructed a facility around the consecrated grounds. Among the ruins were fragments of a book titled “The Grimoire of Runes”. Inside the pieced-together book were detailed instructions on how to begin the second coming. 

The foundation has always renounced religion, a higher being was far too simple of an explanation for what they have seen. However there was something about this book, this Grimoire, that made them reconsider. Inside the book were writings from other foundation members who have never seen it before, or members that don’t even exist. Highlights and notes that were already on pages before the pages were found. They were professional, and annotated exactly in the way the O.B.J. instructs researchers to do so. There must be some reason.

According to the book, to begin revelation the researchers must cast a rune sequence. To do this they had to rotate the rune labeled pillars into alignment. Then they must chant the runes aloud. Upon doing so, a rift opened, from the blinding white glow was the sound of trumpets, but soon that sound shifted into bellowing screams and the rift turned to blood. Several non-human entities flowed through the portal. Researcher ████ ██████ was engulfed into the crimson vortex. 

Following the accident, the foundation has so far captured all known entities that escaped, and now they are trying to send them back, and that is up to you, and the several predecessors that failed before.


[Field Notes]:

- Researcher names may be redacted to prevent Cognito-transmission. It's unknown if Cognito-transmission is possible or if possession is contagious. However the board recognizes it as a serious threat so it will be taken as such.

[END]

store_data.about_the_game:
"Only those who save themselves can reach salvation."

Take command of the enigmatic starship Nightwatch as its young captain, and plunge with a crew of clashing temperaments and tangled pasts into the strife consuming the galaxy.

To hunt the enemy who destroyed your homeland, you'll set foot in the Crossroads — a civilization sphere mired in civil war, a fading, rotting sector where opportunity and peril go hand in hand — and dig for the truth.

This is the narrow seam between contending great powers, and the place where the conspiracies that steer humanity's fate spread their reach.

Turn every resource to your advantage. Build trust; guard against betrayal.

Hold your crew together, take on ever-stronger foes, and earn your glimpse of the truth — and the power to take your revenge.

In a far future fraught with danger, end the curse, and write a story of your own.

【A Narrative-Driven RPG】 A wealth of story events and writing, and a choice system that branches into widely different outcomes. Dice rolls resolved against your character's attributes, optional growth paths, and attribute points shared across both combat and story. Weigh every choice with care — what looks like a reward may be a fatal danger. You won't always need force to settle a conflict; and the truth is rarely simple, or harmless.

【Rich Environments — a Magnificent, Uncanny Interstellar Stage】 Rendered in hand-painted 2D art, the game spans several worlds and more than twenty regional maps — from tranquil frontier worlds, to super-civilizations gilded on the surface, to artificial planets where wonder and desolation sit side by side. Every stage is dense with events, characters, and a distinct weight of history.

【Challenging Turn-Based Tactical Combat】 Battles use a turn-based tactics system built on radius-based resolution, compressing each engagement's footprint to heighten its pace and intensity. You'll face dangerous enemies, and the key to victory is using the terrain and the mechanics to choke off their chances to act. The Nightwatch backs you with supporting fire and a powerful special ability — Convergence — letting you press the attack to build toward a single, game-turning blow. Wield a wide array of "meme" skills to disrupt your enemies' actions, defuse danger, and overcome the strong.

【Companions & the Journey】 Meet seven companions who join the adventure, unlock their unique abilities, forge bonds, and explore their tangled pasts and inner worlds.

【Build Your Warship】 The Nightwatch has eight upgradeable sections, along with a host of functions and support skills. Gather resources through exploration and trade to upgrade your "combat platform," making this legendary ship your solid backing — and a haven to come home to.

【An Interstellar Saga Beneath the Evernight】 Through the stories of Qiu Wu, Midori, and Marsille, delve into a vast and ancient interstellar society. This is a cruel, mottled universe where history does not climb in a straight line, and where humanity — like all intelligent life — acts out of interest, not righteousness. To see your convictions through, you must hold the power to survive and to contend. Break a curse a thousand years in the making, or become its footnote — it all comes down to your choices.

store_data.about_the_game:
(Demo releasing June, 2026)

Blightsilver is a story-rich deckbuilder card game featuring supernatural dark urban fantasy interactive visual novel that allow exploring liminal spaces throughout the city. The story follows ordinary university students who get dragged into the hidden supernatural layer beneath normal life, where they must fight using mysterious cards.

:::::::::::::: CHARACTERS ::::::::::::::

Nex Crowmont

  • A 20-year-old, perpetually exhausted university student who coasts through classes on heavy sighs and zero effort. He’d rather spend his days napping and avoiding any thoughts about his future. Despite being good-for-nothing, he is a fair person and always has empathy for other people. He can become intolerant if someone (or something) disrupts his perfect bubble of peace and balance.

    Like : Potato Chips, Taking a nap, Skipping lectures

    Dislike : Chili, Loud chewing

Mayu Kokawa

  • A 20-year-old, brilliant university student. She is fiercely loyal once she considers you a friend, albeit a little clingy. She keeps her friends from failing by generously lending out her flawless study notes. Don't make her mad, or she will start pouting out of the blue. She relies heavily on her instincts, which are almost always correct.

    Like : Rain smell, Cappuccino, Attentions

    Dislike : Sushi, Someone is being phone-snubbed

Kelly Lastochkina

  • A 22-year-old, reckless, sharp-tongued, no-nonsense supernatural expert who lives like she has absolutely nothing to lose. She is highly devoted to her job and refuses to talk about her past. Never fear a dead silence when you're with her; she will gladly fill it with her Dad jokes—which are, of course, never funny.

    Like : Junk food, Soft drinks, Road trips

    Dislike : Vegetables

:::::::::::::: LIMINAL SPACES ::::::::::::::

  • Step into the role of a supernatural investigator in Blightsilver. Through the unique Exploration system, you can freely navigate eerie, abandoned locations — from desolate houses and liminal hospitals where everyone has gone missing, to vacant parking lots and strangely empty subway stations. Uncover hidden events, solve puzzles, and piece together fragments of lore as you progress through a dark urban fantasy story

:::::::::::::: CARD GAME RULES ::::::::::::::

Overview

  • The card battle system of Blightsilver is a unique guess-and-hit opponent's hidden cell. The offensive player will have to choose their attacker wisely because once their ace-card is exposed, it will also be a stationary target for opponent. So they need to play a little mind game not to reveal all the tricks up their sleeve at once. The defensive player can also bluff the attacker to fall into surprises they've crafted. Under a tension of battle, each player can also 'Union summon' a powerful card exchanging for high crystal cost and exposing more information to opponent, which gamble their last stand.

Objective

  • Both players have 25 face-down cards on 5x5 grids. Each player must command their Unit cards to guess and hit opponent's face down card. Up to two units can be commanded per turn.

  • Once a unit card is hit and destroyed, the owner of the card pay crystal cost. The stronger the unit is, the higher the cost they have to pay.

  • Win the battle by reducing your opponent’s crystals to 0, or by destroying all of their Unit cards or Union cards.

Card Types

  • Unit Cards – Your attacking units. Each unit has 'Cost'. You have to pay cost if one of them get destroyed.

    There are 7 affinities : Divine / Chaos / Arcane / Nature / Bio / Cosmic / Anima

  • Trap Cards – Defensive cards that activate upon getting hit.

  • Tech Cards – These cards will not be on the grid, but they will be on your hand as a 'trick up the sleeves'. You can use only one tech per turn. 3 of them is allowed

  • Union Cards – Powerful "fusion" units. You can union summon once per duel. You have to know 'formula' to summon them. Some of the formula requires unit to stand in correct formation.

Before battle (Setup Phase)

  • They place cards into any cell and in any order they like on their personal 5x5 grid

  • There shall be 8-12 Unit cards and 4-6 Trap cards

  • The unoccupied cell will be populated with 'dead end' cell that does nothing if opponent hit it.

  • If you want to Union Summon, you might have to carefully place card in correct formations

  • After all players finished setting up their grid, all card will be flipped face-down.

  • You opponent will never know what's underneath.

  • Enters the battle phase

Battle phase

  • On your turn, if you are an active player, you can do any of these actions

    - Command up to two units to attack

    - Use a Tech card once per turn. Some Tech cards can the tide of battle, such as 'scanning opponent's cell' or 'increasing ATK of all units'. Be careful, some tech required crystal cost.

    - Place a 'bluff' icon on your grid to mess with your opponent. Cool face, sobbing face, intimidating skull, etc.

    - Union summon (you have to place correct units on correct formation according to the formula)

Reckoning

  • Once a unit attacked a target, a 'battle calculation overlay' will show up. This is called 'Reckoning'. It will determine attack power (ATK) or defense power (DEF) of units from both side

  • Attacker use ATK. Defender use DEF

  • Attacker with more ATK wins against defender with less DEF. Defender will get destroyed

  • Attacker with less ATK loses against defender with more DEF. Attacker will get destroyed.

  • If the Attacker has ATK equals to the defender's DEF, both unit get destroyed.

  • Some buff/debuff will also take place in Reckoning (unit's ability)

Defending

  • The inactive player is called 'Defender'

  • Once your unit card get hit, it will be flipped face-up permanently (if it survived the hit, of course)

  • You can't turn card face-down ever again

  • A face-up card is called 'Exposed' card. The exposed card will be seen by opponent.

Traps

  • Hitting a trap card will trigger various effects such as decreasing ATK or freezing that unit from attacking or destroy that unit

  • Be careful, some trap required crystal cost (the owner of the trap pay the cost upon triggered.

  • Once a trap get triggered, it will be gone. So it can only be triggered once.

End Turn

  • If you end the turn without doing anything, the game will considered you 'skipping the turn'

  • Skipping the turn will cost you some crystal tax

  • The tax will increase every time you skipped the turn

  • So please do not skip a turn.

Crystals

  • Each player will start with 5,000 crystals

  • The crystals will be used for various mean such as paying for tech, paying for trap, paying when a unit is destroyed

  • Once the crystals reach 0, that player lose the game

store_data.about_the_game:
The Convergence is a dark fantasy squad auto-battler where heroes from different eras are pulled into the same Arena as time begins to collapse.

Recruit units from across the timeline, build a five-unit squad, and equip chips that shape how your team targets, moves, survives, and fights. Between enemy waves, adapt your strategy by recruiting new units, upgrading your build, and preparing for the next threat. In battle, your decisions play out in real time as enemy factions from different ages and worlds test your squad in different ways.

Play through two modes:

Campaign Mode
Fight through four distinct era-chapters and a final Convergence chapter as the Arena shifts from one world to another. Each chapter introduces its own enemies, battlefield identity, and boss encounter, building toward a final clash where every era collides at once.

Infinite Run Mode
Push your squad as far as it can go in an infinite run built around escalating waves, unlocks, and long-term progression. Experiment with new team combinations, survive deeper into the run, and strengthen future attempts through an expanding talent system.

Whether you are pushing through the campaign or chasing your best endless run, success depends on building the right squad, adapting between waves, and preparing for whatever history throws at you next.

Features

  • Build a five-unit squad from heroes drawn from multiple eras

  • Shape unit behavior with chips that change targeting, movement, defense, and combat effects

  • Battle through a campaign of four era-chapters and a final Convergence showdown

  • Take on an endless run mode with scaling waves, unlocks, and talent-based progression

  • Recruit, upgrade, reroll, and adapt between waves

  • Face distinct enemy factions, bosses, and battlefield identities across multiple worlds

store_data.about_the_game:
Dual-Faced Demon Lord: Immortal of the Heart is an AI-powered interactive fantasy visual novel set in a world of Eastern cultivation and mysticism.

You will play as Chu Qianyin, the princess of the Kingdom of Li, burdened by the tragedy of her family's destruction. Seeking vengeance against Mo Yinfeng, the "traitor" believed to have destroyed the Immortal Sect five hundred years ago, you imprison him—the enemy kingdom's general—by your side. Determined to force him back onto the demonic path through ruthless means, you seek to gather the scattered Demon Crystal fragments and ultimately annihilate his divine soul.

Yet as lost memories awaken and long-buried truths come to light, you begin to realize that the man you have hated for five centuries may not be the true culprit after all.

■ A Dark Fantasy Romance of Revenge and Destiny

  • Experience a love-and-hatred saga spanning five hundred years, where the truth behind an ancient betrayal is revealed through countless twists and revelations.

  • Explore branching storylines where your choices reshape both vengeance and romance.

  • Immerse yourself in a fully dynamic visual experience that brings a heart-wrenching cultivation fantasy to life.

■ High-Freedom Interactive Character Development

  • Multiple endings ensure that every decision leads to a dramatically different narrative path.

  • Engage with lifelike AI-driven characters in fully dynamic interactions, delivering a cinematic level of immersion and allowing you to truly live out your own fantasy romance.

  • Enjoy a traditional Chinese-inspired soundtrack crafted to enhance the emotional tension between love, fate, and betrayal.

■ Key Features

  • Dozens of unique endings, including paths of revenge, redemption, reconciliation, and eternal companionship.

  • Gradually unlock fragments of past-life memories to uncover the complete truth behind the Immortal Sect's downfall.

  • Shape the story through meaningful choices in a world where there is no absolute good or evil—only the consequences of your decisions.

  • Fully localized for multiple languages, bringing this epic tale of Eastern fantasy, romance, and destiny to players around the world.

store_data.about_the_game:
About This Game

"Credit card bills are sky-high, but the hellish subway always blocks my way. And so... I drag my floppy limbs to work."

[SeongsuStation] is a bizarre, hardcore, side-scrolling physics-based platformer set in a realistic subway station. Always on the verge of being late, you must control a ragdoll character at the mercy of physics, pushing through all kinds of obstacles to clock in on time!

Key Features:

  • Simple but Infuriating Controls: Roll clockwise or counter-clockwise with the left/right arrow keys, and jump with the Spacebar. That's it! But your body will never move the way you want it to.

  • Endless Hellish Subway and Station Mazes: On odd-numbered days, you must push through narrow, packed 'train cars'. On even-numbered days, you must navigate through 'station corridors' with unpredictable, complex layouts.

  • 200% Hyper-Realistic Villains: Around 10 types of maddening villains will desperately block your way to work, including the upside-down hanging 'Dark Lord', the threatening 'Backpack Attacker', the 'Back Striker', the 'Danso Killer' (Flute maniac), and the 'Subway Gymnast'.

  • Peddler Shop System: Strategically push through by getting buffs from peddlers you meet on your way to work, like jump cooldown reduction, defense boosts, and health recovery. However, there are no items to give you more time! Be careful not to upset the peddlers, or you'll only waste precious time.

  • 100% Bizarre Graphics and Sounds: The chaotic hellish subway filled with dynamic villains, combined with realistic sounds that capture the deep rage of an office worker, provide extreme immersion (and stress).

Will you be able to bypass the ruthless villains of Seongsu Station and arrive at the office on time?

4786470.name: 核心防线 core defense line

store_data.about_the_game:
Background Story

You are a cloud operations engineer. In 'Core Defense Line,' the work you have been responsible for over the years has always involved intrusion defense. Now, a large-scale virus invasion is brewing. Please take over your defensive line, protect the core, resist continuous virus invasions, customize and build your defenses, construct cards, install various creatively designed plugins, giving you multiple ways to attack, repair outer nodes, while also providing more convenient defense.

What kind of game is this?

This is a minimalist geometric game that combines card building, tower defense, and Roguelite elements. Beyond the set levels, you can also continue to challenge an endless mode.

Who is this game for?

Tired of traditional tower defense games? While other tower defense games have a variety of towers, this game has only one attack tower. However, you can attach various modules in front of the tower to change its attack methods. The combination of multiple styles allows you to enjoy killing enemies efficiently.

Gameplay

This game features dual construction mechanics (cards and defensive lines). After each daily battle, you will randomly receive different modules, devices, and cards, and you can freely choose your path. You can go to the shop to buy modules, devices, or cards. You need to properly arrange the sequence of different modules to achieve the highest attack efficiency, and various modules also have interactions.

For example:

  • Range Burn with Tracking (the flame area you launch is not just fixed burning on the ground, but a flame area that can follow enemies and burn them continuously, incinerating nearby enemies)

  • Reflection with Laser (the laser you launch will reflect at the same angle when it hits the edge of the map)

  • Burning with Poison (effects that can both burn and poison)

  • Laser with Duplication (a single launch can fire multiple lasers)

  • More build combinations are waiting for you to discover

Content Display

Various plugins and devices change your way of attacking

Laser: Fires a laser to strike enemies in a straight line

Summon: Summon a continuous stream of your own enemies from afar, forming a 'human' wall, allowing your minions to attack the enemies.

Mind Power: The coolest attack method, does not fire any bullets, the attack method is mind-killing, allowing enemies to be killed by your mind from a distance.

Ice: crowd control, slow, increase damage, lays the foundation for other attack methods

Thunder and Lightning: precise, high damage, critical hit, defeats enemies in seconds

Flame: Area damage, damage over time, let large waves of enemies die in your flames

Basics: Various bullet hell attacks, the most abundant basic attack method is bullet hell, and it includes various general plugins that can be used across different styles.

Minimalist geometric style, you can clearly see the operation of each plugin, the visual aesthetics of the signal being sent, passing through all the plugins, reaching the attack core, and carrying out the attack.

Customize the arrangement of your plugins to maximize their effectiveness, paying attention to the order.

Game Features

🔌 Signal Network Construction — 50+ types of plugins that can be freely combined to build your own attack circuit

🎨 Multi-Style Gameplay — Basic / Fire / Lightning / Ice / Laser, the color of the signal determines the type of attack

🃏 Card Rhythm — 18 types of cards to control the timing and intensity of signal emission on the spot

⚙️ Device Enhancement — Global passive devices to deeply customize your build style

👾 Mechanic Bosses — 5 bosses, each with their unique mechanics

🗺️ Roguelike Progress — Plan your route on the chapter map, each run is different

About the developers

I am an independent game developer. Yes, coding, art, planning, development—all these are completed by myself. I am passionate about tower defense games, and I believe you will experience fun that other tower defense games cannot offer

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to Voxenvale, a cozy online world where players build, jump, explore, and hang out in small cubic realms.

Create your account, enter the lobby, search for realms, and start shaping your own space with detailed cartoon-style blocks. Place grass, dirt, stone, and cobblestone, visit other players, chat above your character, and move around with playful third-person controls like double jumping and slam landing.

Voxenvale is in early development. The current version focuses on the core online loop: login, lobby, realm travel, block placement, mining, inventory, and shared player presence.

Features:

- Online lobby and player realms

- Block placement, mining, and inventory

- Detailed cartoon-style voxel textures

- Third-person movement with double jump and slam

- Player name tags, flags, and chat bubbles

- Server-saved accounts, realms, inventory, and blocks

An internet connection and Voxenvale account are required to play.

store_data.about_the_game:
Harmonic Catastrophe is a story-rich action RPG where you rescue sacred creatures called Astras. You will forge unbreakable bonds, unleash devastating combat skills and will be joined by different Oathbound through a world where the last light of creation is dying. You are its only chance.

Before the first kingdom fell, the angels hid the light of creation inside living creatures. These creatures - breathing, feeling, sacred beings - came to be known Astras. Because they knew Astras were pure and couldn't be corrupted. 

The Crimson Rite has found a way to harvest the light - ripping it from the living Astras and using it to rewrite reality. The only ones standing between them and the death of every possible timeline are the Oathbound - warriors who rescue, nurture and earn the trust of Astras rather than control them. You are one of them.

FORGE YOUR BOND

Each Astra you save doesn't just add a move to your kit - it changes your combat style, your movement, your abilities entirely. Chain fast attacks, frame-perfect dodges, and celestial abilities through battles that erupt into manga-panel impact moments.

UNLEASH EXTREME COMBAT

Engage in smooth, fast-paced combat where you and your Astra are a team. Apply Extreme Evasion, perfect dodge counters, and unleash awakened forms that detonate when everything is on the line. Every hit is designed to make you feel the full weight of the clash.

IMMERSE IN THE WORLD AND CINEMATIC STORYTELLING

The world of Harmonic Catastrophe is filled with rich storytelling and music - where every character carries their own lore and backstory. A world that feels alive, deep, and worth fighting for - built to give you an experience of a lifetime.

ENCOUNTER THE OATHBOUND

Harmonic Catastrophe launches with a founding cast of Oathbound, each with their own combat style, backstory, and reason for standing against the Crimson Rite. As the world expands, new Oathbound will join the fight — each one adding new abilities, new stories, and new depth to the world you're already invested in.

store_data.about_the_game:
The local speakeasy has been closed down for quite some time due to an undisclosed incident involving the local mob. You've been given the job of finding your way inside, locating, and destroying any and all incriminating evidence that you can get your hands on before it can be used against you.

Silas is a ten foot tall automaton built to entertain guests at the speakeasy and deal with anyone who causes any trouble, and despite the state of the speakeasy, Silas never was shut down. Make your way through the halls while he patrols, listening for footsteps and watching for lights that aren't supposed to be there. Your flashlight is your only way to see in the dark and keep your sanity intact, but every second you have your light on, you risk drawing in unwanted attention.

Silas' Speakeasy is a first person survival horror game set in a 1920s speakeasy. To survive, you'll need to master the tools at your disposal and understand the threats around you.

 Lights: Your flashlight is your only way to see in the dark and keep your sanity intact, but every second it's on, you risk being spotted.

Sounds: Silas can hear you. Running, knocking over objects, or making noise will alert him to your location. Sometimes the safest move is to do nothing.

Hide: Safe rooms and hiding spots offer temporary refuge, but they won't protect you forever. Learn the layout, find keys, and stay out of sight.

The Living Threat: Silas patrols the speakeasy with his own deliberate behavior. He reacts to light, sound, and will chase you through the halls if he detects you nearby. He cannot be fought, only avoided.

store_data.about_the_game:
The night shift at the distribution center was supposed to be just another routine job.
Check the packages, sort them, and don’t make mistakes: send the ordinary ones forward, and move the strange ones to reject.

But before long, the boxes begin to contain things that should never be there.


Each new discovery builds tension, and the familiar routine slowly turns into something far more disturbing.

You have to keep working, make decisions, and avoid confusing the ordinary with the things that should never be sent any further.
Every choice affects how the night unfolds, while random discoveries and different outcomes make each playthrough feel unique.

No Return Address is a psychological horror game where fear grows out of simple work, human error, and the feeling that something extra has found its way into the center tonight.

Features

  • Simple and intuitive sorting mechanics

  • Tension that grows with every new box

  • Different events and outcomes based on your decisions

  • Random elements that change each playthrough

  • A short atmospheric horror experience with a strong sense of unease

store_data.about_the_game:
"The Legend of Mala Tokmachka" is a 2D tower defense and fortress-building game about holding out against an endless siege.

Build your base block by block, turn a small outpost into a towering defensive machine, and survive as long as you can against escalating waves of attackers. Every day brings new pressure: aircraft, armored vehicles, artillery, drones, missiles, and assault groups will test the weak points of your fortress.

Your stronghold is not a static tower. It is a growing structure made of walls, weapons, support modules, power systems, radar equipment, repair blocks, and defensive platforms. Expand upward, reinforce damaged sections, reposition your firepower, and decide which parts of the base are worth saving when the attack becomes overwhelming.

The battlefield is a nameless frontier village where the siege has gone on for so long that nobody remembers how many times it was supposed to be over. What began as a small defensive position has become a legend: a fortress that keeps standing, day after day, against impossible odds.

Build Your Fortress


Construct your base from individual blocks and modules. Shape the fortress your own way: compact and armored, tall and layered, wide and heavily armed, or chaotic and improvised. Every block matters, because every hit can expose a weakness.

Arm Every Level


Install weapons to counter different threats. Machine guns, cannons, anti-air systems, lasers, missile platforms, and specialized modules all have their role. A good fortress is not just bigger — it is smarter, with overlapping fire zones and the right weapons in the right places.

Survive Escalating Attacks


The enemy does not stop. Waves become larger, faster, and more dangerous over time. Ground forces pressure the base from below, aircraft strike from above, and long-range attacks force you to repair, rebuild, and adapt under fire.

Repair, Upgrade, Adapt


Between attacks, spend your resources carefully. Reinforce damaged walls, upgrade key weapons, add new layers of defense, or expand the base to unlock more firepower. Every decision is a trade-off between immediate survival and long-term strength.

A Siege That Became a Legend


The setting is grim, industrial, and absurd: a tiny place on the map transformed into a mythical fortress by years of failed assaults, rumors, propaganda, and dark humor. The game does not tell you who is right or who is wrong. It is about the strange mythology of endurance — how a small defensive point can become larger than life.

Key Features

  • Build a vertical 2D fortress block by block
  • Defend against waves of ground and air attacks
  • Combine walls, weapons, power systems and support modules
  • Upgrade your base and adapt to increasingly dangerous enemies
  • Manage money, experience, repairs, and expansion
  • Create ridiculous defensive structures that somehow keep standing
  • Experience a grim siege atmosphere with a touch of dark humor

store_data.about_the_game:
Pilot the void. Stake your claim. The galaxy is open.

Zerion: Infinite Space is a free-to-play MMO set in an infinite procedural galaxy. Your starship, your sector, your rules — in a persistent universe shared with every other pilot on the server.

Infinite Procedural Galaxy

Every sector is generated on demand across an infinite grid. Warp deeper to find rarer resources, deadlier NPCs, and civilizations you've never seen. Nothing resets — your discoveries persist for everyone.

15 Playable Civilizations

From the disciplined Terran Commonwealth to the silicate Tharix Cabal to the time-weaving Chronos Seers. Each race ships with its own hull silhouette, faction palette, and lore. Choose your home, then trade or feud with the rest.

Real-Time Fleet PvP

Coordinate with friends, run garrison operations, and siege rival claims on a shared live server. Server-authoritative combat — every hit, every dodge, every warp is computed on the backend. No aim-bot survives a wing of human pilots.

Sector Claims & Sieges

Plant your flag on a sector you can defend. Take a cut of every shop transaction and run the local economy. Rivals can siege you back — earn what you keep.

52+ Weapons · 36+ Shields · 22+ Engines

Mix and match a build that fits your playstyle across 7 ship classes, from light Scouts to capital Motherships. Every loadout has counters; nothing is meta-locked forever.

Play Anywhere

Native Windows and macOS desktop builds via Steam. Also available in your browser at with no download, plus native iOS and Android apps. Cross-progression keeps your pilot identical across every device.

Free, Fair, and Yours

No pay-to-win combat upgrades — ever. Premium unlocks cosmetic ship patterns and quality-of-life perks only. Every gameplay edge has to be earned in-sector.

store_data.about_the_game:
Sign-Off Affair


In the final six weeks of a top-rated late-night show, every choice is a countdown—and every kiss risks getting cut for time.

You play as Miles Hale, the showrunner and executive producer of Past Eleven, a #1-rated 11:35 comedy institution—canceled not for failure, but as leverage in a corporate merger that wants one thing above all: silence. With six tapings left and the finale under legal siege, Miles must keep forty people employed, protect severance on a knife-edge deadline, and decide what truth is worth saying before the mic goes dead.

Between the writers' room gallows humor, the studio's cold fluorescent nights, and the hum of a building that never stops, three women pull him in three different directions—toward love, toward loyalty, and toward a sign-off he may not get to control.

Meet the Cast




Priya Anand — The Integration
Priya is Brightwater's integration executive: the poised, clinical face of the faction dismantling Past Eleven—and, inconveniently, the one fighting hardest to protect the staff from the fallout. She speaks in timelines, severance pools, and decisions "made eleven floors up," but she never lies about the cost. Her route is desire across enemy lines, where intimacy means risk, and love doesn't stop the machine—it only asks whether you can step away from it.



Camille Vega — The Returning Star
Camille is the breakout talent who left for a massive streaming empire—and now returns as the finale's marquee guest, polished enough to turn any room into a set. She and Miles share two years of unsaid history, the kind that doesn't fade just because the credits rolled. Her route is a second chance with teeth: she's the future that won, and loving her means deciding whether you'll follow… or stay loyal to the world that made you.



Sidney Calloway — The Head Writer
Sidney is the mind behind the monologue—sharp, fast, and brave enough to aim jokes at the very people trying to bury the show. She's Miles's creative other half, the person who's kept the room funny while everything falls apart, and the one he's spent years pretending he doesn't need. Her route is a slow-burn built from late nights, hard truths, and the question neither of you can dodge forever: when the show ends, what are you without it?

Key Features

  • Single-choice branching romance: one night, three competing asks—choose who gets the evening and commit to a route shaped by real stakes.
  • A procedural late-night setting: pitch meetings, table reads, network notes, severance grids, and live-to-tape countdowns—where romance unfolds inside the work that's breaking everyone's heart.
  • Three distinct romance routes, each with its own ending to the same ending: slow-burn coworkers, second-chance stardom, and forbidden-by-faction desire.
  • Themes of truth vs. survival: fight for a finale that says what happened, or protect the people who'll pay the price for speaking too loudly.
  • A story that doesn't flinch: the merger clears, the industry moves on, the 11:35 slot gets refilled—because the point isn't a fair world, it's what you choose inside an unfair one.
  • Contains explicit adult content across all three romance routes.

Content Warning

Sign-Off Affair is an Adult Romance Visual Novel intended for mature audiences (18+). It contains explicit sexual content, strong language, and themes involving workplace pressure, corporate maneuvering, career instability/layoffs, and emotionally intense relationship dynamics.

store_data.about_the_game:
ASYLUM is an atmospheric survival horror game that will test your nerves. Trapped in a sinister and abandoned place, you will learn the cost of every mistake. There is no room for heroism here: your main objective is to survive at all costs.

Played from a first-person perspective, every rustle and every shadow feels genuinely terrifying. The environment is fraught with danger, and open confrontation with the local inhabitants almost always leads to death. To escape, you must remain unseen. Study enemy patrol routes, use hiding spots, and hold your breath when danger passes just a few steps away.

Key Features:

  • Tense Stealth and Survival: Hide in the shadows, avoid eye contact with enemies, and run for your life if spotted.

  • Puzzle Solving: Interact with your environment, find keys, and discover hidden mechanisms to unlock doors and progress through the story.

  • Oppressive Atmosphere: Realistic graphics and bone-chilling sound design create a constant feeling of dread and anxiety.

  • Deadly Threat: The game features brutal murder scenes—the grim consequences of failing to evade the creatures lurking in the dark.

  • Dark Mysteries: Piece together the horrific events that took place here and desperately search for a way out of this nightmare.

store_data.about_the_game:
MiliChess is a tactical board game where toy-like commanders lead tiny armies across a strange battlefield of soldiers, tanks, aircraft, radar, fog, and improvised war-table chaos.

Choose your commander, read the board, and outmaneuver your opponent through positioning, terrain, unit abilities, and timing. Every piece has a purpose: soldiers hold ground, tanks pressure lanes, engineers build bridges, tunnels, and airfields, radar reveals hidden threats, SAM sites punish careless flights, and jets can strike across the board if they have the range to make it home.

Play classic MiliChess, a Required Ammo variant with supply pressure, or traditional Chess using the MiliChess battlefield style. Matches can be played against AI, locally, online through multiplayer setup, or watched as AI commanders test their plans against each other.

MiliChess is built around readable tactical choices, dramatic board presence, and the feeling of a tabletop battle coming alive.

Features

  • Tactical board combat with soldiers, vehicles, aircraft, radar, engineers, and commanders

  •  MiliChess Standard: the core tactical rule-set built around hidden information, unit roles, and battlefield positioning.

  •  MiliChess + Resources: an expanded mode that adds resource-driven strategy and longer-term planning.

  •  Classic Chess: a familiar rule-set for players who want a traditional board-game experience.

  •  Fog of war, terrain, weather, supply pressure, and air missions

  • Play against AI & local opponents

  • AI vs AI spectator mode

  • Character commanders with distinct table personality

  • Toy-board visual style with animated battlefield setup

  • Six Player Compatible: On PC and NES

store_data.about_the_game:
ZERO GRAVITY, MAXIMUM RISK

Transporting cargo in space isn't just about getting from point A to B. "Space Cargo Simulator" makes you feel the sharp transition between atmospheric flight and the zero-gravity void of space in your bones. Don't fight the physics; adapt to the changing friction rules and gravity fluctuations to deliver your cargo to its destination.

Defy the Weight of the Atmosphere

When you enter the dense atmosphere of planets, all flight dynamics change. Fire your thrusters against severe friction and gravitational pull; perfectly balance your thrust to avoid crashing into the surface with your cargo.

Glide Through the Vacuum of Space

Once you break through the atmosphere and reach the silence of the void, gravity disappears. Perform instantaneous maneuvers in zero gravity, keep your ship's inertia in check, and manage your fuel wisely for long-distance deliveries.

Dynamic Hazards and Your Co-Pilot

You are not alone in the pitch black. Listen to the warning systems of your loyal co-pilot; your radar can fill up with massive meteor showers at any moment.   • Smart & Combative AI: Dangerous enemies that hunt you down, engage in tactical firefights with one another, and chase you across platforms.

  • Unforgiving Pacing: An adrenaline-fueled death line mechanic that forces you to keep moving upward, no matter what.

store_data.about_the_game:
About This Game

Mendel Simulator is a relaxing, cozy, yet mildly brain-teasing plant genetics simulation game. Step into the shoes of a scientifically-minded florist, leverage classic Mendelian inheritance laws, and unlock nature’s most beautiful genetic codes through selective breeding and cross-pollination.

Your ultimate goal: Unlock 8 dream colors and 12 unique shapes to collect all 96 exquisite flower varieties!

Core Gameplay

  • Plant & Nurture: Start from a humble seed, water it, and watch it bloom. Experience the deeply therapeutic process of life flourishing at your fingertips.

  • Market & Earn Points: Sell your newly bred floral creations to earn valuable game points.

  • The Thrill of Mystery Seed Boxes: Spend your hard-earned points on high-tier Seed Mystery Boxes! Every unboxing is a thrill, as they might contain rare parental strains carrying complex recessive genes.

Unique Genetic Mechanics

This isn't just another simple gardening game—it is a strategic interplay between dominant and recessive traits!

Behind every blossom lies a hidden sequence of genetic code. Want to brew that elusive shade of purple? Looking to cultivate a legendary petal shape? You must think like a real geneticist: use scientific hybridizing methods to awaken those dormant recessive genes!

Game Features

  • The Ultimate Collection Challenge: 8 Colors 12 Shapes = 96 distinct entries to complete your field guide. A dream come true for completionists!

  • Bite-Sized, Stress-Free Experience: A perfectly paced game with a total playtime of under 10 hours. No endless grinding—just pure, casual satisfaction perfect for a cozy afternoon or a relaxing bedtime session.

  • The Perfect Background Game: With its minimalist sound design and relaxing pace, this is the ultimate "second-screen game." It is incredibly background-friendly, letting you chill, multi-task, or listen to your own favorite music/podcasts while breeding flowers.

A Message from the Developer:

Science can be incredibly fun! Whether you are a biology enthusiast or a casual player who loves collecting and management sims, Mendel Simulator offers a perfect blend of brain-teasing logic and stress-free relaxation. Grab your copy today and start your very own genetic breeding workshop!

store_data.about_the_game:
Build a Track & Field Dynasty

Take control of a high school track program and build it into a statewide powerhouse across multiple seasons.

Recruit hidden talent, develop athletes through specialized training programs, manage fatigue and morale, and make the critical decisions that define championship teams.

Every athlete has strengths, weaknesses, hidden potential, and their own path to greatness.

Will you create a sprint dynasty?
A distance powerhouse?
Or a balanced team capable of competing for state titles in every event?

A Living Competitive World

Compete in a fully simulated world featuring:

  • 320 schools

  • 64 leagues

  • 16 districts

  • Thousands of athletes progressing every season

Track rankings, scout rivals, watch athletes rise and fall, and build your reputation from Unknown Coach to Dynasty status.

Develop Athletes Over Time

Assign athletes to specialized training groups and build weekly training plans to improve:

  • speed

  • endurance

  • technique

  • power

  • race psychology

Push too hard and your athletes may burn out before championships.
Manage recovery carefully and your team may peak at exactly the right moment.

Every decision matters.

Recruit the Next Generation

At the end of every season, scout incoming freshmen with:

  • graded scouting reports

  • hidden potential

  • breakout upside

  • unpredictable development paths

Some prospects become legends.
Others never reach expectations.

Finding overlooked talent is part of building a great program.

Championship Strategy

Set event lineups, manage relay teams, and choose race strategies for every meet.

Play it safe with conservative tactics or gamble everything with aggressive all-out performances in championship moments.

Use your limited “Peak Now” boosts strategically to give athletes their best shot at breaking records and winning titles.

Create Program History

Over multiple seasons:

  • break school records

  • win championships

  • develop rivalries

  • climb statewide rankings

  • build your coaching legacy

Every season creates new stories.

Features

  • Deep single-player track & field management simulation

  • Multi-season dynasty progression

  • Full athlete development and fatigue systems

  • Recruiting with hidden potential and scouting uncertainty

  • Meet strategy and event management

  • Dynamic rankings across leagues, districts, regions, and state

  • Program prestige and coach progression perks

  • Persistent program records and historical almanac

  • Simulated world with thousands of athletes

store_data.about_the_game:
Run! Jump! Fight! Help the alien Doe and the psychic cat Dot escape the sentient space station they they are being held captive on! 

Doe has been held prisoner on this space station for some time, never quite knowing why she was taken from her planet. All too suddenly, all the caged cells spring open at once, and every alien makes a break for it! A bizarrely dapper feline with psychic powers appears before Doe, and offers to help her escape. Together, and with the help of other escapees, they need to make their way through the giant space station in hopes of finding a path to freedom. 

Doe and Dot is a high speed 2D platformer focused on the joy of movement. It's split into two styles, the linear action style, and the nonlinear exploration style. Action has you running through a level from point A to point B with a ranking system based on how well you did. Exploration puts you in a non linear interconnected zones where you gather upgrades and meet creatures. Action style levels will be accessible from the exploration style zones.

  • Gain momentum by running down slopes or using Doe's ferocious spike to grapple things

  • Slash and claw at your enemies using Dot's mysterious psychic abilities

  • Pick up and throw objects with Dot, which can be then grappled by Doe

  • Race through engaging levels and get the best score

  • Explore zones to find upgrades

  • Meet strange and silly characters who are also stuck on the station

store_data.about_the_game:
About This Game

Gosh Jam It is a wacky western PVP shooter built around one simple question... "What if your gun jammed like 80% of the time?" Step into the boots of a gunslinger and face off against friends in a frantic western-style duel where every shot could be your last! or your first. In a world where every weapon is unreliable, victory isn't determined by who has the best aim, it's determined by who can keep their gun working the longest.

Jamming Mechanic

When you fire the gun there's a high chance your weapon will jam and you'll be thrown into a fast-paced minigame that MUST be completed before you can fire again. Stay calm under pressure, solve the challenge, and get back into the fight before your opponent does and maybe you'll come out on top!

One Shot. One Kill.

It only takes one bullet. Every weapon in the game can eliminate a player in a single shot, turning every encounter into a high-stakes gamble. Will your gun fire when you need it most, or will it jam on you at the worst possible moment?

Play With Friends

Whether you're settling a score in a one-on-one duel or jumping into a chaotic Free-For-All match, Gosh Jam It is built around fast matches, big laughs, and unforgettable moments. Challenge a friend in local split-screen duels or take your skills online and battle players from around the world.

The Wild West

Fight across a variety of ridiculous western arenas. Battle through a dusty frontier town, survive atop a speeding train, dodge explosions in a dynamite factory, or duel at a mysterious UFO crash site. Every map brings its own brand of chaos!

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to the busiest kitchen in town.


In Chopex, you're the chef — but your kitchen runs on cards. Draw ingredients from the supply,

combine them with tools, and serve up dishes before hungry customers lose patience.

Chop. Combine. Serve.


Drag a knife onto a tomato to slice it. Toss raw meat into a pan and oven to grill it. Stack a bun,

grilled meat, sliced tomato, and lettuce to build a burger. Every dish is a puzzle made of cards — and

the clock is always ticking.

Race the clock


Orders pile up with countdown timers. Serve them on time for bonus seconds. Let them expire and you'll

lose precious time. Miss too many and it's game over.

Expect the unexpected


Things don't always go smoothly in a kitchen. Random events will throw a wrench in your plans — adapt

fast or watch your orders slip away.

Two ways to play


  • Challenge Mode — Progress through different kitchens, each with new recipes, ingredients, and

    surprises. Start with simple salads and work your way up to complex multi-step dishes.

  • Casual Mode — Fully customizable sessions: pick your recipes, set the pace, choose your chaos

    level, and cook at your own speed.


Chase the stars


Every level awards up to 3 stars based on how many orders you fill. Meet the quota for one star, push

past it for three. Collect stars to unlock new stages.

Features


  • Intuitive drag-and-drop card gameplay

  • Pixel art visuals with a cozy retro vibe

  • Gamepad, keyboard, and mouse support

  • Quick sessions (2-5 minutes per level)

  • In-game cookbook for recipe reference

  • Optional CRT scanline filter for maximum retro feels

Punk Vampires is a prequel to the novel of the same name by Jacob Cabrera.

The game puts you in the role of Chloe Wade, a young woman from New York who is bitten in 1899 by a master vampire. In this universe, when a victim is bitten, their soul leaves the body, and a creature from the Shadow Realm takes over the empty vessel.

But something unusual happens to Chloe... When the creature awakens inside her body, it carries memories, emotions, and fragments of the young woman she once was. Chloe’s soul has not crossed the threshold: for some inexplicable reason, it remains bound to the mind of the beast, coexisting with it.

At first, the creature rejects this human presence. It feels tormented by it and refuses to listen to that irritating voice inside its mind, a voice that denies it the pleasures of vampiric existence. But little by little, Chloe’s memories begin to influence its instincts, forcing the beast to confront human morality.

Can a human soul change a monster?

Punk Vampires is not just a story about punk aesthetics. The title comes from Chloe’s main conflict, tied to the noise, chaos, and rebellion of the punk movement: the perfect cover for vampires to hide their plans in the shadows.

Explore different eras, fight supernatural enemies, make decisions, overcome skill-based minigames, and discover the origin of a vampire divided between the humanity she lost and the creature that awakened in her place.

Play as exclusive characters such as Aiden Brennan in 10th-century Ireland, Missy, the hunter from London, and other protagonists within this dark, violent, and emotional story.

store_data.about_the_game:
Whisker & The Lost Sun is a cozy storybook adventure about a brave little courier cat, his loyal dog companion, and a golden world slowly fading into shadow.

When the Great Sun shatters above the land of Ambervale, warmth, color, and music begin to disappear. Play as Whisker, a small but determined cat with a red cap, a trusty satchel, and a big heart, as he sets out to recover the missing Sun Fragments and restore light to the world.

But Whisker is not alone. By his side is Mallow, a gentle but powerful dog companion who helps him push heavy objects, dig up secrets, break obstacles, protect him from danger, and solve puzzles that one hero could never complete alone.

Explore forests, rooftops, clockwork towns, crystal mines, forgotten toy kingdoms, lantern-lit lakes, mountain trails, and moonlit dreamlands. Along the way, you will help villagers, deliver lost letters, collect Sun-Sparks, uncover hidden Moon Charms, and follow the mysterious trail left behind by Whisker’s grandfather.

What begins as a journey to restore the sun soon becomes something deeper. The darkness spreading across Ambervale may not be evil at all — only forgotten. To save the world, Whisker and Mallow must learn the truth behind the lost sun, the forgotten moon, and the balance between light and shadow.

A LITTLE CAT, A BIG ADVENTURE

Whisker may be small, but his courage carries him far beyond home. Run, jump, climb, explore, and discover secrets across a handcrafted storybook world filled with charm, mystery, and danger.

YOUR LOYAL COMPANION, MALLOW

Mallow is more than a companion — he is your partner. Use his strength, senses, and loyalty to overcome obstacles, uncover hidden paths, and protect Whisker throughout the adventure.

RESTORE AMBERVALE

Collect Sun-Sparks and recover lost Sun Fragments to bring life back to each area. As you progress, the world begins to change: flowers bloom, lanterns glow, clocks tick again, music returns, and the sky slowly remembers its color.

UNCOVER THE FORGOTTEN TRUTH

Follow clues left behind by Whisker’s grandfather and discover the story of Noctilune, the forgotten Moon-Mender. Restore the sun, remember the moon, and bring balance back to the sky.

KEY FEATURES

  • Play as Whisker, a brave courier cat on a heartfelt adventure

  • Travel with Mallow, a loyal big dog companion with unique abilities

  • Explore a cozy storybook world filled with secrets, puzzles, and collectibles

  • Run, jump, climb, solve puzzles, and help villagers across Ambervale

  • Use teamwork to overcome obstacles with Whisker’s agility and Mallow’s strength

  • Collect Sun-Sparks, Sun Fragments, Lost Letters, Moon Charms, hat pins, and cosmetics

  • Restore each area and watch the world return to life

  • Discover an emotional story about friendship, courage, memory, light, and shadow

The sun is broken. The world is fading. But hope still walks forward — on four small paws, with four big ones beside them.

store_data.about_the_game:
Ayuwoki Army is a first-person shooter with retro-style mechanics.

You are a soldier who must defend the region from an army of animatronics from Ayuwokiland.

In 12 missions, you must defend each zone with your machine gun and your powerful electromagnetic pulse spheres.

  • This game combines the fun of a shooter with the suspense of a horror game, featuring 12 levels with 360 enemies.

  • By carefully managing your ammunition and electromagnetic pulse spheres, you can overcome the threat.

  • Very easy to play, intuitive interface, simple mouse and common keyboard.

store_data.about_the_game:
Zombie Fodder is a tongue in cheek, tactical strategy / zombie survival game where you guide your squad across a post-apocalyptic world while fighting your way through hordes of zombies. Recruit specialists and rescue survivors along the way to keep your population up as you uncover a dark story of government corruption [duh] as you engage the military in a battle of good and evil.

Zombie Fodder has 3 save slots (aka Bases). Survivors are lives. Rescue survivors to gain lives. If you run out of lives, it's game over.  Loot buildings to find supplies which are used to recruit mercenaries to give you a hand in each level. Each level has missions like "Clear a path to town", "Destroy all zombies", "Rescue the doctor", etc in environments like the town, the forest, cemeteries, mall, and so on.

store_data.about_the_game:
"Bentinho wrote his book as though his memories were facts. Allow me, then, to tell my side."

You think you know this story.

The boy and the girl on Rua de Matacavalos, separated by a wall. For over a century, only one version existed — the one written by Dom Casmurro, a bitter, self-made recluse who called his own obsessions the truth.

Now it's Capitu's turn.

Eyes like the Tide is a visual novel based on Dom Casmurro, the 1899 masterpiece by Joaquim Machado de Assis, widely regarded as the greatest novel ever written in Portuguese and one of the defining works of world literature. At its center is a question that has divided readers, scholars, and entire generations: did Capitu betray her husband, or was she condemned by a man who couldn't bear uncertainty?

Told entirely from Capitu's perspective, Eyes like the Tide follows Capitolina — Capitu, for short — from her teenage years on a quiet Rio de Janeiro street all the way through marriage, motherhood, and the unraveling that Machado de Assis only ever showed from the outside. You walk beside her through every choice.

Bentinho or Escobar? Loyalty or freedom? The ending is yours to decide.

A PERSPECTIVE A CENTURY IN THE MAKING

For over a hundred years, Capitu has been judged through someone else's words. Here, she has her own voice, sharp, self-aware, sometimes wry, always conscious of being watched.

Follow her story from lazy childhood afternoons at the wall between houses, through first love and the looming threat of the seminary, into marriage, the birth of her son Ezequiel, and the slow fractures that jealousy opens. All the while, Escobar grows larger in the narrative and in Capitu's choices.

YOUR CHOICES SHAPE HER STORY

The game tracks two invisible relationship metrics that evolve across the whole arc: affection, trust, impatience, distance. How you choose to respond, whether you comfort, challenge, go quiet, or push back, shapes not just the relationships around Capitu, but who she becomes.

She warns you herself: her memory isn't perfect. What was truth and what was longing, only you can judge.

FEATURES

  • Visual novel based on Machado de Assis's Dom Casmurro, faithful to the spirit of the original while giving voice to what it left in the margins

  • Choice system with relationship metrics that affect dialogue, scenes, and endings

  • Multiple endings that reflect not just who Capitu chooses, but how she chooses herself

  • Original artwork crafted to evoke 19th-century Rio de Janeiro with historical care — Rua de Matacavalos, the Passeio Público, the beach, period interiors and street life
