store_data.about_the_game:
The Big Owl Night is a fast-paced top-down roguelite where every night becomes a desperate fight against hordes of creatures, bizarre bosses and increasingly chaotic powers.

Explore the post-apocalyptic downtown of São Paulo in the 2000s, collect coins, buy weapons, discover upgrades and survive for as long as you can while the night becomes more dangerous.

Each run lets you create different combinations of weapons, effects, relics and passive abilities. Some choices may look simple at first, but they can completely change the way you play.

FACE AN EVER-CHANGING NIGHT

Enemy waves grow more intense over time, bringing faster monsters, more aggressive bosses and situations that become harder to control.

BUILD YOUR OWN PLAYSTYLE

Buy weapons, upgrade your character and combine effects to create unique synergies. Every run can take a different path depending on your choices.

VISIT MERCHANTS AND SHOPS

During the night, you will find merchants offering items, weapons, relics and special upgrades that can change the course of your survival.

FIGHT BIZARRE BOSSES

Each boss has its own attacks, patterns and particle-based visual effects, keeping combat intense while preserving clear action readability.

SURVIVE AS LONG AS YOU CAN

The Big Owl Night is about resisting, improving, testing new combinations and trying to go further in a night that never seems to end.

store_data.about_the_game:
Oleander-X is a pixel-art stealth action game about infiltration, evidence, sabotage, and the cost of obedience.

You play as Ethan, a special agent assigned to investigate a biotech-linked criminal network operating behind guarded facilities and classified research sites. Each mission begins with a simple order: get in, collect evidence, plant the explosive charge, and escape before the operation collapses.

Oleander-X's artwork. This artwork is not the real gameplay.

But the deeper Ethan goes, the less simple the mission becomes.

Every facility tells part of the story. Locked terminals hide patient records. Security rooms protect classified experiments. Storage wings conceal supply routes, corrupted data, and evidence that someone powerful has tried to erase. What begins as a series of covert assignments slowly becomes a trail of disturbing discoveries — one that forces Ethan to question not only the enemy, but also the system sending him in.

Move through shadowed corridors, study patrol routes, avoid vision cones, disable security systems, and decide when to stay hidden or strike. Some missions reward patience and careful observation. Others punish hesitation. A clean escape is always possible — but never guaranteed.

As the investigation escalates, the enemy adapts. Stronger guards appear. Security becomes tighter. Official equipment starts to feel inadequate. Between missions, Ethan is pushed toward dangerous alternatives: black-market weapons, hidden deals, copied evidence, and choices that may help him survive — at a cost.

Oleander-X's artwork. This artwork is not the real gameplay.

Oleander-X is not only about completing objectives. It is about what those objectives do to the person carrying them out. Every successful mission brings Ethan closer to the truth, but also closer to the edge of who he used to be. The line between duty and survival begins to blur. The line between justice and compromise becomes harder to see.

When orders are no longer enough, Ethan must decide what he is truly fighting for.

And as the truth behind Oleander-X begins to surface, one question remains:

How much of himself is he willing to lose to complete the mission?

Infiltrate Guarded Facilities

Enter restricted zones, avoid patrols, and move carefully through hostile environments. Each mission challenges you to observe the layout, understand enemy movement, and find the safest route through the facility.

Stay hidden, wait for the right moment, or take the risk and move under pressure.

Collect Evidence. Plant the Charge. Escape.

Every operation has three core objectives:

  • Collect critical evidence

  • Plant the explosive charge

  • Reach the exit before it is too late

Getting in is only half the mission. Once the charge is armed, the escape becomes a race against time.

Stealth Is a Choice

Avoid vision cones, security cameras, patrol routes, and stronger enemy types. Some situations can be solved without violence. Others may force you to decide whether staying hidden is still worth the risk.

Patience can keep Ethan alive.

Hesitation can get him killed.

Equipment Comes at a Cost

Official equipment may not always be enough.

As missions become more dangerous, black-market weapons and hidden deals become available. These tools can make survival easier — but every shortcut leaves a mark.

What you buy, what you use, and what you choose to ignore can shape Ethan’s path.

A Story of Duty, Survival, and Moral Collapse

Oleander-X follows Ethan as his mission becomes more personal, more dangerous, and harder to justify.

The deeper he goes, the more he discovers that the truth is not hidden behind one locked door. It is buried across files, bodies, experiments, debts, and choices.

Complete the mission.

Expose the truth.

Survive the consequences.

store_data.about_the_game:
Congratulations. The previous inspector of the Azika City Checkpoint has retired peacefully. As a result, you have been appointed as the new registration officer, responsible for guarding the final gate into the shelter zone.

Are You Human? is a first-person simulation game that blends identity inspection, stealth exploration, and psychological pressure. During the day, you sit behind the counter of a checkpoint and process strangers who arrive seeking entry. Check their names, ID numbers, personal records, documents, and suspicious details before deciding whether they should be allowed into the shelter. Stamping “approved” or “rejected” is easy. Living with the result is not.

Every applicant may be hiding something. Some records do not match. Some people behave strangely. Some carry forbidden items. Others look completely normal. Search the computer database, examine IDs and passes, question visitors, inspect their belongings, and make decisions with limited information. Rules may change. Records may be wrong. Your judgment will shape the safety of the camp and the dangers waiting after dark.

At night, the city outside the checkpoint is no longer safe. Leave your desk behind and explore dim streets, buildings, and rooms. Gather resources, search for clues, avoid danger, and investigate the “residents” who entered during the day. One wrong approval may become a threat you cannot undo.

This is not just a job about following rules. You must notice details, manage resources, weigh risks, and survive between doubt, fear, and responsibility.

Inspect. Judge. Approve. Reject. Then face the consequences.

Key Features

  • Inspect identities by checking documents, names, ID numbers, personal records, and abnormal clues.

  • Use the checkpoint computer to search records and compare information.

  • Question NPCs, inspect luggage, and look for suspicious behavior or forbidden items.

  • Make approval or rejection decisions by stamping documents.

  • Experience a day-and-night loop: inspect people by day, explore and survive by night.

  • Sneak through dangerous environments, gather resources, and uncover hidden truths.

  • Face consequences driven by your choices and mistakes.

  • Live under constant pressure, where rules and records cannot always be trusted.

store_data.about_the_game:
Your story begins to kill people after your "death".

Six years ago, the creator "Gasai Kanju", who was both a genius and notorious, met his social demise.

Six years later, the investigator "Igarashi" was entrusted by the police and arrived at the scene of the murder.

What was left at the crime scene was:

Four corpses, each with a distinct and bizarre death scene, lay in a gruesome state.

The summoning ritual of the "Death Angel" in fictional works, and the eight characters of a deceased person that do not belong to anyone present.

An entire school, a group of students who grew up alongside the dark past and works of "Gasai Kanju".

Together with her lively partner "Frostleaf", she is entrusted by the police to unravel this murder mystery woven from the past of others.

Facing murderers and haters who view others as symbols for consumption,

Facing the evil gathered due to this work,

The only thing she knows for sure is:

The murderer is using her "legacy" to commit a real murder.

This is the official sequel to the "Angel of Death" series after a six-year hiatus.

 

Game type: Semi-visual novel/plot exploration

Game duration: less than 4 hours

Game ending: Single ending, but various exploration achievements can be collected

Operation method: Use arrow keys to move, shift to run, and press Esc and X to pop up the menu. You can play in full screen or operate with the mouse only.

Archiving method: Manual archiving at designated locations.

store_data.about_the_game:
n00b's guide is a narrative-focused Walking-Sim told through a pre-teen's YouTube FPS let's-play series. It's an experimental game with no traditional mechanics or goals. It instead invites players to run, slide and shoot through a collection of bizarre in-world mods and community maps as the narrative unfolds.

A Short Experience

The game takes roughly 40 minutes to play through, told from the perspective of a 30-something year old revisiting her cringe YouTube videos that she made with her friends as a tween. You play out the series of let's play videos as the narrator reflects, unravelling what was really important about the time she spent online with her friends.

Retro-Inspired Movement Shooter

n00b's guide features a fun movement system inspired by early shooters and their unintented exploits. Dive, slide, roll and long jump around spaces reminscent of early 2000's community-created FPS maps. The levels are infused with esoteric and poetic in-world 'mods' that subvert expectations of the genre.

A Game About Creative Communities

The game looks at early modding culture and the relationships we form with creative communities; making videos, mods and maps to post online for your friends. n00b's guide is about interrogating the formalisation of play and how we can easily drift from our communities and creative practices.

"Let me show you these things that we made"

MOVEME

A 2–4 player co-op climb where you don't control yourself — your friend does. And you control them. You both look wherever you want; you just can't take a single step on your own. Reach the top together, or fall apart together. Realistically, the second one.

FEATURES:

  • 🎮 2–4 player online co-op (more friends = more beautiful chaos)

  • 🔄 You move your friend. Your friend moves you. Nobody moves themselves.

  • 👀 Everyone keeps full control of their own camera

  • ⏱️ A stopwatch timing exactly how long your disaster took

  • 🏔️ Hand-built levels with one goal: get to the top

  • 🎙️ Proximity voice chat 

  • 🥸 Emotes to ragebait your friends

  • 🎶 Original soundtrack 

YOU MOVE YOUR FRIEND

You're at the controls — just not your own. Every step your friend takes, that's you. And every step you take, that's them. Two people piloting each other up a mountain, both grinning, both certain they've got the better line. Call it teamwork. Call it a hostage situation with good vibes. Either way, you're in this together.

FRIENDS ONLY, OBVIOUSLY

Invite up to 3 friends straight through Steam. No matchmaking with strangers — handing your legs to a random person is basically a war crime. Minimum 2 players, because someone has to be holding the controls that ruin your life.

store_data.about_the_game:
Sandalwood Simulator is an open-world sandalwood smuggling game set in a beautiful yet dangerous forest environment. Players cut down valuable sandalwood trees, process the logs, and load them into vehicles before attempting to smuggle them across the region for massive profit.

But the jungle is never safe.

At any moment, rival gangs can launch raids to steal your cargo, ambush you on forest roads, or defend their own hidden stash locations deep inside dense jungle territory. Encounters can quickly turn into intense gunfights, and once bullets start flying, the police won’t stay far behind.

Law enforcement can arrive unexpectedly during raids, track you through intel leaks, or set up surprise operations targeting both smugglers and rival gangs alike. Survival depends on quick decisions, smart routes, and knowing when to fight or flee.

Even if you escape the jungle safely, the journey isn’t over. Check posts across the map will test your luck and strategy. You can attempt to bribe officers to pass through, but offering too little may immediately expose you and land you in jail.

Successfully delivering sandalwood to the black market rewards you with huge profits, allowing you to upgrade vehicles, buy better weapons, customize clothing, and purchase larger homes and properties.

All of this takes place inside a rich, atmospheric world that blends cozy natural beauty with constant tension, creating a unique mix of relaxing exploration and high-risk smuggling gameplay.

store_data.about_the_game:
Build a living high-rise of offices, homes, and shops, then keep people moving as elevator traffic threatens to bring it all down.

A high-rise does not work just because rooms are stacked on top of each other.

Workers, residents, shoppers, diners, and hotel guests all have different reasons to move through the building. In a tower full of people, not only what you place but how people move determines whether the whole structure succeeds.

ATLASPIA: The Tower Manager is a modern update to the spirit of legendary 1990s building simulation games. Develop floors, invite tenants, watch people move through the building, and grow a small structure into a massive urban complex.

Chasing profit too aggressively may clog your people flow and let elevator congestion stop the whole tower. Prioritizing comfort too much may leave you short on funds for expansion. In a limited vertical space, every priority shapes the future of your tower.

- Place offices, homes, shops, restaurants, hotels, and more

- Watch residents, workers, visitors, and guests move autonomously through the tower

- Combine elevators and stairs to design vertical traffic flow

- Manage elevator congestion before it spirals into failure

- Balance revenue, growth, convenience, and transport capacity

- Add tenants and grow into a busier, more valuable building

- Follow changing activity and income as time passes

- Decide how to use limited floors, space, and movement routes

store_data.about_the_game:
Short Description

Galaksia Online is an action-packed, 2D multiplayer space MMORPG blending retro pixel art aesthetics with deep role-playing mechanics. Forge alliances, custom-build your starships block by block, mine rare cosmic minerals, and engage in massive faction-based PvP wars or challenging PvE raid battles across dangerous stellar sectors.


🚀 CHOOSE YOUR ALLEGIANCE

The galaxy is divided between two massive corporate superpowers competing for stellar dominance:

  • 🔴 MoonRy C.O.S (MoonRy Corporation of Space): Operating under the fierce light of crimson suns, they specialize in aggressive, heavily-armed assault vessels.

  • 🟡 ELY Galactica A.C.O.S (ELY Galactica Alliance Corporation of Space): Thriving within golden nebulae, they leverage advanced technology to deploy high-speed, tactical fleets. Pick your company, secure your corporate borders, and conquer the frontier.

🛠️ UNLEASH YOUR CREATIVITY IN THE SHIP FACTORY

Step into Sector 3’s orbital Ship Factory and build your dream starship from scratch! Using an advanced, modular grid editor, you can drag, drop, rotate, and mirror over 200 distinct pixel art components across Hull, Wing, and Weapon categories. Craft a unique 256x256 blueprint that reflects your playstyle and display your custom composition to every other pilot in the universe!

🔫 TACTICAL COMBAT & EXPANSIVE ARSENAL

Engage enemy factions and hostile space entities using a dynamic, target-locking weapon system. Equip your slots with devastating weaponry, including:

  • ⚡ Lasers & Dual/Triple/Quad Cannons for continuous fast firing.

  • 🚀 Homing Rocket Launchers & Cluster Missiles that track moving targets smoothly.

  • Mor EMP Blasters to neutralize shields, heavy Plasma Cannons for burning damage-over-time, and Mine Deployers to trap space lanes.

🏰 BUILD, DEFEND, AND RAID CLAN BASES

Form a clan with your company allies and establish your permanent Clan Base in secure sectors.

  • Contribute & Upgrade: Donate credits and recycle weapons into raw Scrap Metal to upgrade your base's maximum Hull Points and reinforce automated defense turrets.

  • Automate Repairs: Craft specialized Repair Droids to monitor and fix your infrastructure during sieges.

  • Pillage the Enemy: Raid opposing corporate bases to crush their defenses and completely plunder their vaults, stealing accumulated credits and cargo!

💀 END-GAME PVE RAIDS & BOSS BATTLES

Hunt rare cosmic bosses across dangerous anomalies. Coordinate with your clan to forge a Raid Key and breach hyper-space into deep sectors where legendary targets await:

  • Face Phantom Bosses, gargantuan Aliens, or the ultimate end-game encounter: Knor Prime.

  • Survive hardcore Danmaku (Bullet Hell) bullet grids, dodge orbital strikes, and coordinate strategy to block healing crystal lasers before getting wiped by the enrage timer. Top damage dealers are rewarded with exclusive Phantom Equipment and Exotic Matter.

🌌 SECTOR EVENTS & PLAYER MARKET

Explore changing space sectors subject to unpredictable cosmic events. Drop into active Meteor Showers to mine raw Prometium, Endurium, Terbium, and rare Xenomit. Hunt down armed Smuggler Convoys, ambush Pirate Raids, or harvest anomalies from Dark Matter Rifts. Bring your haul back to the safe zone to trade instantly with your corporate allies, open an auction, or purchase special skins using hard-earned Crystals!

Core Features:

  • True Multiplayer MMO Network: Seamless server synchronization via advanced WebSockets.

  • Deep Pilot Progression (RYO): Gain XP, level up, unlock achievements, collect unique titles, and allocate skill points into Damage, Hull, Speed, Shield Regen, or Critical Strike Chance.

  • Party Loot Sharing: Group up with up to 4 allies to share combat XP and leverage a cycling round-robin loot system for shared cargo.

  • Bi-Weekly PvP Leaderboards: Rise through the ranks of faction combat to claim massive Crystal rewards every two weeks.

  • Cross-Platform Ready: Fully responsive design supporting desktop keyboard configurations as well as mobile touch controls, modular sub-menus, and dynamic joysticks.

store_data.about_the_game:
SlackOff Diary is a relaxed idle management game with light RPG combat. Build a home in another world, send companions and pets on adventures, process loot through various buildings, and push for stronger gear through forging and enhancement. The unique Slack Off mode pins the game to your desktop wallpaper so you can check progress during work or study breaks without constantly alt-tabbing.

Core Gameplay Loop

• Recruit companions with unique traits at the Tavern—they fight in battle and can be stationed in buildings to use their work talents.

• Dispatch companions or pets on Travel runs to earn materials, gold, and equipment.

• Process materials in normal production buildings, then craft weapons, armor, and jewelry at the Forge Workshop.

• Sell gear at the Shop for gold, then reinvest in buildings, seeds, and progression for long-term growth.

Travel & Combat

• Adventure Mode: Clear stages in combat and earn pet eggs.

• Travel Mode: Fixed 15 minutes per trip, no combat—steady resource income.

• Abyss Mode: Choose your difficulty; victory rewards scale with difficulty.

Base Building & Production

• Spend gold to build and upgrade structures; use Layout to reposition buildings—removing them does not reset their level.

• Plant wood and food seeds for crafting gear, cooking, and alchemy.

• Run production buildings including Crusher, Mine, Furnace, Advanced Furnace, Sewing Machine, Gem Mine, Alchemy Table, and Workshop.

• Station companions and pets in buildings—work talents boost output or cut costs when their conditions are met.

Crafting & Equipment

• Forge weapons, armor, and accessories with random bonus stats, plus a chance for gear with special effects.

• Enhance up to +25: success improves stats; failure may destroy the item—enhancement stones raise success rates or prevent loss on failure.

• The Cooker uses four ingredient types; certain combinations create dishes with special effects.

Pets & Companions

• Hatch pet eggs in the Incubator—higher growth means higher quality potential.

• Breed pets at the Breeding Base—offspring may differ from both parents; active talent quality is random; traits can be inherited.

• The Pet Care Hospital provides final care for pets and grants drops tied to each pet.

Slack Off Mode (Desktop-Friendly)

• Tap Work Mode to enter wallpaper mode—the game sits on your desktop layer.

• Tap Slack Off anytime to return to normal play; system tray shortcuts on Windows.

• In Slack Off mode, add desktop file shortcuts to open documents or tools while your session keeps running.

Features at a Glance

• Idle-friendly pacing; travel timers suit short sessions

• Adventure, Travel, and Abyss—combat, passive farming, and high-risk challenges

• Forging, enhancement, cooking, and bulk production for a full gear loop

• Companion recruitment, pet hatching and breeding, building assignments

• Customizable base layout and long-term building upgrades

• Built-in Adventure Guide for new players

Suggested start: Tavern recruit → Travel (right side) → materials into buildings → Forge Workshop for gear. Turn every Slack Off moment into another page of your SlackOff Diary.

• Forge weapons, armor, and accessories with random bonus stats, plus a chance for gear with special effects.

• Enhance up to +25: success improves stats; failure may destroy the item—enhancement stones raise success rates or prevent loss on failure.

• The Cooker uses four ingredient types; certain combinations create dishes with special effects.

Pets & Companions

• Hatch pet eggs in the Incubator—higher growth means higher quality potential.

• Breed pets at the Breeding Base—offspring may differ from both parents; active talent quality is random; traits can be inherited.

• The Pet Care Hospital provides final care for pets and grants drops tied to each pet.

Slack Off Mode (Desktop-Friendly)

• Tap Work Mode to enter wallpaper mode—the game sits on your desktop layer.

• Tap Slack Off anytime to return to normal play; system tray shortcuts on Windows.

• In Slack Off mode, add desktop file shortcuts to open documents or tools while your session keeps running.

Features at a Glance

• Idle-friendly pacing; travel timers suit short sessions

• Adventure, Travel, and Abyss—combat, passive farming, and high-risk challenges

• Forging, enhancement, cooking, and bulk production for a full gear loop

• Companion recruitment, pet hatching and breeding, building assignments

• Customizable base layout and long-term building upgrades

• Built-in Adventure Guide for new players

Suggested start: Tavern recruit → Travel (right side) → materials into buildings → Forge Workshop for gear. Turn every Slack Off moment into another page of your SlackOff Diary.
store_data.short_description: SlackOff Diary is a relaxed idle management game with light RPG combat. Recruit at the Tavern, breed pets, travel for loot, craft at the Forge Workshop, and pin the game to your wallpaper with Slack Off mode.

store_data.about_the_game:
In Plant Game, you start as a fragile seedling with almost no reliable information. You don’t get a clean HUD or perfect numbers at the beginning, because you haven’t grown the organs to understand them yet. Time keeps moving, the seasons turn, and the environment presses in with heat, cold, drought, shade, and sudden shifts you can only barely feel at first.

Your choices shape what you become. Spend precious energy to grow leaves for photosynthesis, roots for water access, or harden tissue to endure stress. As you survive, you can invest in biological “sensors” that gradually transform your perception: vague feelings become clearer signals, and the interface becomes part of your organism rather than a default overlay.

The goal is the payoff: a plant reveal that reflects your entire run. When you bloom, you see what you built at its best. When you fail, you still see the story your body wrote in damage, scarcity, and survival.

Planned/aiming for the full release scope includes expanding habitats and run variety, stronger sensor progression and balance, richer state-aware body text, more environmental pressure and hazards (like pests/fungal threats), and a more advanced reveal/visualizer direction - while keeping the minimum promise rooted in what the game already is today in our demo: blind survival, growth-as-identity, and the final reveal. We're also planning to allow users to grow their plants without any obstacles through sandbox mode.

Welcome back to your childhood of wave based zombies. Play with up to 3 friends to survive endless waves of zombies. How high can you go. Lets find out!

​RESURRECTION

​The dead have risen, and they are hungry. How long will you survive?

​From Bad Dev Studios comes Resurrection, an intense, fast-paced indie first-person survival shooter that pits you against endless hordes of the undead. In this adrenaline-fueled wave defense game, your survival depends entirely on your reflexes, your resource management, and your trigger finger.

​Key Features:

​Wave-Based Survival: Face off against increasingly aggressive and massive swarms of zombies. With each wave, the danger escalates. Can you make it past Wave 16, 17, and beyond?

​The Random Weapon Box: Down to your last dollar? Take a gamble! Spend points at the random weapon chest to see if you get a savior shotgun or a devastating assault rifle.

​Dynamic Combat: Swap between an arsenal of firearms, from heavy-hitting shotguns to rapid-fire automatic weapons. Watch your ammunition—you'll need to hunt for "Max Ammo" drops when your clips run dry.

​Apocalyptic Environments: Fight for your life across burning urban landscapes, industrial warehouses, and chaotic streets filled with exploding vehicles and structural fires.

​Precision Snipe Mechanics: When the chaos gets too close, take a breath, scope in, and line up the perfect headshot to thin out the crowd before they overrun your position.

​"RESURRECTION" — Lock and load. The apocalypse is waiting.

store_data.about_the_game:
「A vertical shaft, endless in space, ceaseless in torment—this is Avici.」

"ELEVATOR: AVICI" is a first-person psychological horror game wrapped in a gritty, retro Hong Kong lo-fi aesthetic.

The story roots itself in the shadowy corners of modern Hong Kong.

At 2:00 AM, you are just an ordinary delivery worker, stepping into a derelict apartment building for one last routine order.

Waiting for you is a classic, clanking cage elevator—the kind you’ve ridden a thousand times before, smelling faintly of machine oil and decay.

As you press the loose, wobbling button, the metal chassis groans and screeches into motion, just as it always does. But this time, your fate veers off the predictable track.

The routine shatters.

The elevator malfunctions violently. Imprisoned in this suffocating metal box, you have no choice but to watch the erratic floor indicator spin into chaos.

It might be suspended forever in the pitch-black shaft; or perhaps, it has already crossed the threshold into a supernatural realm that does not belong to the living…

In the dead silence, your sole lifeline is the distorted static of the emergency intercom.

A strange voice, claiming to be a "repairman," promises he can guide you to safety—if only you follow his commands.

Will you trust his orders, or forge your own path to survival?

The choice is yours.

Daily Brew Idle: Milk Tea Tycoon​ is an adorable idle tycoon that lives right on your desktop.

The Last Archive is a turn-based deck-building rogue-lite that blends Knowledge Management with Tactical Exploration. The Censor Entity has taken over the Great Library, aiming to create cosmic silence by erasing all information. As the last True Librarian, it's up to you to stop it.

Key Features:

  • Dual-Purpose Card System: Your cards aren't just for combat. Manage your Combat Grimoire and Exploration Pouch to strategize your way through locked doors and ruined paths.

  • Infinite Library: Explore procedurally generated thematic areas like the History Section, Fiction Halls, and Philosophy Department. Each run offers different room layouts, new Library Spirits, and ruthless enemies.

  • Combine Elements: Merge elements like Fire, Water, and Lightning in the same turn to unleash massive Hybrid Combos (e.g., Magma Cannon, Thunderstorm).

  • Deep Meta-Progression: Even if you fall in battle, the Wisdom Particles you collect are permanent. Upgrade your skills at the Main Hub (Central Library) and start your next run significantly stronger.

store_data.about_the_game:
BeaconBound is a 3D action-adventure about a rolling ball searching for glowing beacons in a living, procedurally generated world. Every run is unique: new hills, rivers, weather, and guardians protecting each beacon.

Your goal is to collect 15 beacons before the world wears you down. Each beacon you gather unlocks an ability: a directional pointer, a speed boost, a protective shield, and a stasis field that freezes nearby enemies. The further you go, the smarter and more aggressive the guardians become — they predict your path and cut off your escape routes.

The world is alive. Fog cuts visibility. Rain kills your traction. Wind pushes you off course. Night hides the terrain. Water slows your momentum, tall grass tugs at your sides, and shorelines force you to commit. You must read it all on the fly and pick your line fast.

Features:

  • Endless 3D procedural world with realistic ball physics.

  • 15 beacons guarded by guardians whose AI sharpens as you progress.

  • 4 unlockable abilities: pointer, boost, shield, stasis.

  • Dynamic weather: fog, rain, wind, night — each shifts the physics and your tactics.

  • Plants, rivers, and shorelines that affect movement and decisions.

  • Two modes: Normal with save/load, and Hard Mode for one clean run.

  • Atmospheric soundtrack with smooth crossfades near beacons.

Every run feels like its own short story: roll, navigate by the glow, balance speed against caution — and either collect all 15 beacons or start over.

store_data.about_the_game:
I still remember when I first joined the company—I couldn't even handle a client dinner, just smiled foolishly and said, "I'm new, I don't know the ropes."

Until that rainy night, when I walked into that private cinema for the first time—dim lighting, soft sofas, an old movie playing on the screen.
She sat next to me and whispered, "Is this your first time in a place like this?"
My heart skipped a beat. So I could be someone who knows how to date.

After that night, I started learning—how to pick a movie she'd like before it started, how to quietly move closer during the climax, how to stop trembling when she leaned on my shoulder.
Every private cinema visit was like a little life lesson:

Someone taught me, "Talk about the movie first, then talk about her."
Another said, "Don't rush to hold her hand—let her lean in first."
One even said, "She's not here for the movie. She's here to see if you're willing to be with her."

I slowly realized: a private cinema isn't a KTV or a bar. It's one of the city's gentlest secrets—
You're not a hunter. You're a companion. The "second lead" in the movie.

I started recording every night: the first time I picked a film, the first time I fed her popcorn, the first time she stayed for a double feature, the first time I whispered in her ear, "Let's do this again."
The game? That's the journey. Clearing it? That's growth.
Every "date" became a new kind of self-discovery—
From clumsy to smooth, from nervous to relaxed, from shy to knowing exactly how to let a girl feel comfortable leaning into you in a dark cinema.

I had a "secret helper"—she'd help me set up dates with the "tough" girls, even "borrow" their time from the company.
I stopped fearing rejection and started learning how to pick a better movie next time.
I stopped chasing "one-night stands" and started looking for that one girl who wants to curl up with me late at night, watch an old film, and kiss me until dawn.
That's the real magic of urban nightlife—not conquest, but companionship, growth, and heartbeats.

Are you ready to evolve from a rookie into a private cinema dating expert?

Gameplay Description

This is a single-player simulation management game centered on schedule management and character interaction, set primarily in private cinemas. Players take on the role of the protagonist, advancing through a cycle of "work to earn money → spend in cinemas → interact with characters → grow and develop", experiencing a complete journey from workplace novice to dating expert.

Core Gameplay Loop

  • Time Progression: The game advances through four time slots: Morning / Afternoon / Evening / Late Night.

  • Daytime Management: During the day, you can work, study, and other activities to earn income and consume stamina.

  • Nighttime Entertainment: Evenings are for visiting private cinemas, watching movies with characters, and triggering exclusive events and mini-games.

  • Resource Management: Manage money, stamina, intoxication, affection, and other stats to unlock movie genres and interaction options.

  • Save & Growth: Use the save system to retain progress, gradually unlocking more movies, characters, and dating skills.

Main Systems

  • Job & Rank System: Improve your career level through consistent job performance, affecting long-term income and growth rewards.

  • Private Cinema Interaction System:

    • Movie Selection: Different genres (romance, comedy, horror, arthouse, etc.) affect character mood and interaction success rates.

    • Mini-Games: Including "choose your seat," "feed," "whisper," "lean on shoulder," "kiss timing," etc., testing reflexes and emotional intelligence.

    • Story Branches: Different interaction choices lead to different date endings and hidden character routes.

  • Item & Inventory System: Use items like popcorn, drinks, blankets, perfume, etc., to enhance atmosphere or reduce interaction difficulty.

  • Languages & Settings: Supports language switching, volume/mute, and other basic settings.

  • Save & Load: Supports multiple save slots, with save records displayed by timestamp.

Gameplay Goals
Through long-term management and choices, players improve their character's abilities and career stage, unlock more movies, characters, and dating events, and experience the complete growth process from "awkward viewing companion" to "harmonious co-viewer."
Every screening is the beginning of a heartbeat.

"KNEE SLIDE" is a short time attack game where you race across rainbow courses in outer space by knee sliding.

Adjust your racing line, manage your speed, and use drifting and turbo at the right moments to reach the goal as fast as possible.

Simple Controls

The character moves forward automatically, and the only controls are steering, braking, and turbo.

Steering while braking will trigger a drift.

Short Stages Designed for Replayability

The game consists of 5 short stages designed for quick retries and repeated attempts.

Stage Clear Time and Best Records

After clearing all 5 stages, your total clear time will be recorded.

Aim for faster runs and new best times.

Be Careful Not to Fall Off the Course

If you fall off the course, you will restart from the beginning of that stage.

Your total time will continue counting, so avoiding mistakes is important for achieving better records.

Streaming and Video Uploads

Gameplay videos, livestreams, and other video content are welcome.

Monetized videos and streams are allowed for both individuals and companies.

Story

Strange sightings and reports of monstrous creatures emerging from the earth.

In MURK you play as a member of the group investigating these reports. Fight your way through intense encounters with subnatural beings. Scavenge for resources to upgrade your combat capabilities.

Gameplay

The combat loop of MURK offers an easy to learn, fun to master mix between melee and ranged combat.
Discover enemy specific interactions and exploit them to gain the advantage in a battle against overwhelming odds.

Progression

Survival is a matter of resource management.

Invest in survivability to reduce the cost of mistakes, or in damage to destroy enemies before they let you make them. Craft ammo to not let enemies get near you, or sharpen your axe because that is where you want them.

The choice is yours.

Atmosphere

Explore the otherworldly aftermath of natures' sudden reclamation of the lands.
Think twice before beeing fooled by its beauty, you never know where danger lurks.

Traversal

Buildings torn apart by natures' grasp might block your path, but can also open up unique ways to navigate levels.
Find and fight your way through surreal environments, moving from one saferoom to the next, gathering resources and upgrading your equipment along the way.

store_data.about_the_game:
Infinite Progress, Zero Punishment

No lost loot, no frustrating setbacks—only constant growth. Idlecraft blends a cozy survival-inspired universe with an addictive, tactile hover-to-mine core loop and a dynamic day/night system. Simply glide your cursor over blocks to break them, collect raw resources, and automatically transition into permanent upgrades when your run ends. Every single loop pushes you further.

Key Features:

  • Tactile Hover-to-Mine Progression: Forget tedious clicking. Just glide your mouse over blocks to shatter them. Progress from humble Wood tools all the way up to powerful Netherite gear as you push into deeper, wealthier biomes.

  • Survive the Night & Claim the Loot: When the sun sets, the real chaos begins! Battle incoming monsters that scale with your power. Defeated mobs drop crucial XP, rare gear pieces, and powerful enchantments to shape your unique combat build.

  • Your Hunger Is Your Timer: There is no traditional death here. Your hunger and health pools simply determine how long your current run lasts. When they drain, you head straight to the Upgrade Screen to permanently boost your stats and push deeper next time.

  • Deep Systems & Automation: Behind the accessible gameplay lies a complex web of incremental multipliers, tool tiers, and automation options. Optimize your mining speed, drop luck, and resource efficiency.

"Just One More Loop..."

Every reset is a step forward. Idlecraft captures that pure, satisfying dopamine hit of watching numbers skyrocket, wrapped in a nostalgic pixel aesthetic. Grab your pickaxe, set up your builds, and see how deep the mine truly goes!

store_data.about_the_game:
Your plane has crashed on a forgotten island far from civilization.

You must survive for 50 days until rescue arrives — if anyone is even looking for you.

Hunger and thirst are only the beginning. Cold rain will soak your clothes, freezing nights will drain your strength, and sickness can kill you just as fast as starvation. Hunt, gather resources, build shelters and keep your fire alive through the darkness.

But the island is not empty.

Wild animals roam the forests, strange horrors move in the shadows, and every night becomes a fight to stay alive.

The game takes around 20 hours to complete — and there is no pause or save system. Every decision matters. Plan your sleep carefully, stay alive while you take breaks in real life, and hope nothing finds you while you are gone.

How long can you survive before the island breaks you?

store_data.about_the_game:
Same Ascendant, Different Tactics

Frontactics is a strategic auto-battler roguelike where you deploy and develop Ascendants to overcome each battle.

Choose your Ascendants, form your frontline, and shape their awakening paths to complete your build.

At each awakening stage, Ascendants gain new choices: stat upgrades, skill modifications, and imprint options.

The same Ascendant can grow into a completely different role depending on your decisions.

Deploy, Observe, Rebuild

Ascendants move and attack on their own during battle.

Place durable units at the front, protect your backline damage dealers, and position your team to break the enemy’s key threats.

After each battle, analyze the result and refine your formation for the next fight.

Find the Best Build from Limited Choices

Most rewards must be chosen from a set of presented options.

Consider your current Ascendants, synergies, items, and remaining health to make the choice you need most.

Take Risks to Grow Stronger

Each run takes place on a branching map with a different route every time.

Move through battles, shops, treasures, rest points, and bosses as you complete your formation.

You can take a dangerous path for stronger rewards, or play it safe and prepare for the next battle.

Know when to push forward, and when to hold back.

store_data.about_the_game:
Silence is your armor. Speech is your only weapon.

Clairval is an online, real-time multiplayer social deduction and strategy game that translates the psychological intensity of traditional werewolf games into a modern, competitive, and deeply community-driven digital arena.

Plunge into the heart of a remote late-medieval village, a dark era ruled by paranoia, where every whisper can lead to the pyre, and the shadows of the forest conceal terrifying secrets. Every night, the Werewolf pack and sinister solo entities strike from the dark. Every day, the village gathers to debate, bluff, accuse, and vote to execute the suspected culprits. Will you be an innocent villager desperately seeking the truth, a predator devouring the community from within, or a cynical opportunist playing only for your own survival?

KEY FEATURES

A Deep, Unique, and Evolving Role Guide

Explore a roster of over 30 unique secret roles, divided into interconnected factions, thematic expansions, and historical cycles. Each role features exclusive mechanics that redefine classic deduction:

  • The Village Protectors & Investigators: From the humble Ordinary Villager to elite investigation roles. Become the Sworn Surgeon to perform crucial autopsies on even nights, or the Old Hound to track down liars. Wield the power of faith with the Guardian and the Three Nuns, or manipulate the political fate of the table as the Cursed Prince (double vote) or the Troubadour.

  • The Black Moon Pack: Coordinate your kills through a secret channel and orchestrate Clairval’s demise. Use the Abject Lycan Father to corrupt the innocent and turn them into your disciples, or invoke the Evil Eye to peer into the shadows and reveal the exact identity of your targets.

  • The Solo & Chaotic Outcasts: Unleash chaos for your own gain. Summon Lilith to bewitch and slaughter players in waves, convert the entire table into fanatical followers with the Solar Guru, or tie your fate to another player with the Knave of Hearts, whose invulnerability relies entirely on the survival of their soulmate.

A Persistent Social Ecosystem

  • The Tavern: Much more than a matchmaking lobby. It is a warm, dynamic, and multilingual social hub where you can chat, forge strategic alliances, debrief past games, and meet your next teammates.

  • The Boroughs (Guild System): Found your own community or join an existing one! Customize your Borough’s identity with a unique name, acronym, and heraldic banner. Manage an internal hierarchy of roles and use a dedicated text chat channel to coordinate your game nights and tournament strategies.

Progression & Pixel Art Customization

Earn experience with every match, complete engaging daily or weekly quests, and level up your Seasonal Pass to unlock unique cosmetics. Accumulate Aurels (in-game currency) in the Shop to craft your visual identity:

  • Advanced Paperdoll System: Create a one-of-a-kind Pixel Art avatar with over 120,000 combinations of medieval clothing, hairstyles, armor, and accessories.

  • Custom Profiles: Display exclusive color gradients, noble titles, and your favorite roles to impress or intimidate your opponents right from the loading screen.

Built for Content Creators & Streamers

Clairval features a native Stream View interface designed specifically for live broadcasting. Streamers can easily configure custom OBS overlays and isolate their discussion channels (wolf chat, dead chat) to engage their audience without ever revealing their secret role or hidden information on stream.

Absolute Game Integrity

Because a deduction game must be perfectly fair, Clairval relies on a robust architecture where 100% of the game logic is calculated and validated server-side. Guarded by our proprietary anti-cheat system (Sentry) and supported by active moderation, the game guarantees a healthy, respectful environment free of cheaters. (Autonomous AI bots can also be enabled in private lobbies for training or filling empty seats).

store_data.about_the_game:
Dead Rose is a hand-crafted 2D pixel art action-adventure game. A unique blend of Metroidvania and Zelda-like gameplay, set in a world that is both dark and vibrant, eerie and magical. Forget cozy games, convoluted interfaces, and endless cutscenes: here, your time is spent playing, exploring the world around you, and discovering unique abilities that will expand and enrich the gameplay throughout your journey.

You play as Lucky, a skeleton who awakens in a remote graveyard and discovers his own grave. Lost in the world of spirits, he will do everything in his power to find Rose, the love of his life, and uncover the occult ritual that brought him here. Fortunately, a series of unlikely encounters will help him thwart Death’s plans and grow ever stronger to face the many dangers that lie ahead.

Use your primary ranged attack to defeat hordes of monsters, and your secondary attack to trap them in bile when you are cornered. Each experience level will improve your attributes and make you more powerful.

Manage your health and mana through the Annelid Form, which allows you to replenish your energy reserves but leaves you more vulnerable than ever. It's all about balance and timing!

Seek out the Save Roses, the only way to preserve your progress. They will grant you a few precious moments of respite.

Explore a vast interconnected world to unlock new abilities and gain access to previously unreachable areas. Gather gold along the way and trade it for powerful magical items as you carve a path toward the one who brought you into this realm. But beware—you may not like the truth that awaits you...

store_data.about_the_game:
Cascadral is a gothic solitaire deckbuilder all about offering game-breaking card sequences to the demonic spirits.

Don't disappoint the spirits, or the altar will break...

Strategically order the cards on your tableau to build the highest possible sequences in combination with Jokers, Consumables, Rulebooks, Enchantments and Enhancements.

Every spirit demands an increasingly difficult score to be satisfied, but will reward you with riches of Gold for future purchases in the Shop, you will need them.

Every run is unique. The spirits will challenge you to rethink card order, sequence length and the cards you offer to them again and again.

Every choice matters, whether it be where you spend your gold, when to draw from your limited card pile, what and what not to offer or how you choose to assemble your deck as a whole. Cascadral allows for hundreds of different playstyles and strategies that can lead you to the win.

Every card offers endless synergies, be it with other enchanted cards, the jokers you buy or the mysterious Tarot Cards, which will shake things up in even more unexpected ways, challenging your creativity and skills.

At a glance...

  • Solitaire-Roguelike

  • 12 Rulebooks and 3 Card Enhancements that bend the rules of Solitaire

  • 140+ Unique Jokers

  • 35 Consumables and Tarot Cards

  • 4 Card Enchantments applicable to both Jokers and Playing Cards

  • Upgrade your card deck, buy Jokers and Consumables using 6 unique Card Packs

  • Hand-drawn, gothic pixel art style made with love for detail, sprinkled with pop-culture references

  • Mesmerizing ambient Dungeon Synth soundtrack

store_data.about_the_game:
A cat on your desktop.


Catopia is a transparent-overlay desktop pet. There's no separate game window — a pixel cat simply lives on top of your wallpaper. Click any empty space and your desktop works as usual; the cat is just there, keeping you
company.

🐾 Five cats, five personalities


Choose one of five cats — Cheese, Cloud, Pumpkin, Cotton, and Oreo. Each has its own decay rates for hunger, happiness, and cleanliness, plus unique idle chatter and behaviors.

💝 Care and affection


Feed, play, and wash to manage your cat's condition, and pet it to build affection. Play together with ball-chase and mouse-hunt mini-games. The panel records your days together and your bond.

🌈 Two kinds of goodbye


Your cat won't be with you forever. Let its condition collapse from poor care and it falls ill and crosses the rainbow bridge; let its affection run dry from neglect and it quietly leaves home. Which farewell you meet is in your hands.

✨ Features


  • Transparent overlay — your cat stays on the desktop while you work
  • 5 cats — distinct stats, lines, and behaviors per breed
  • Care system — feed ·play ·wash ·medicine ·petting
  • Two mini-games — ball-chase ·mouse-hunt
  • Affection system — 0–100, with days-together tracking
  • Living behaviors — roaming ·napping ·hiding in boxes ·bathroom needs
  • Multi-monitor support — your cat roams between displays
  • Per-cat sound effects and BGM
  • Offline progression — stat changes computed while the app was closed

🔒 Play with peace of mind


All data is stored locally on your computer. No network connection ·no data collection ·no ads.

🎨 Credits


Graphics — ToffeeCraft SPRING 2025 MEGA PACK
Sound effects — freesound (CC0)
Runtime — Electron (MIT) ·Chromium (BSD-3-Clause)

store_data.about_the_game:
Market Simulator: Miami Beach is not just another retail game; it is an immersive life sim and business management tycoon that tests your entrepreneurial spirit and survival instincts. Set against the vibrant, unforgiving backdrop of an open-world Miami Beach, you will start with empty pockets, sleeping in a tent, and work your way up to owning the city’s most profitable dual-store supermarket empire.

Master the art of resource management, navigate the complex local economy, and do whatever it takes to survive and thrive in this highly realistic sandbox environment.

Comprehensive Supermarket Management & Logistics

A successful supermarket relies on flawless logistics. Forget magic inventories—in this realistic simulation, every item matters. You must purchase your shelves, cash registers, and stock directly from the city's wholesaler. Jump into the driver’s seat of your personal vehicle, navigate the open streets of Miami to reach the warehouse, manually load the cargo into your trunk, and safely transport it back.

Unload, organize, and strategically stock your shelves to maximize your daily profits. Every step of the driving simulator and cargo transport is in your hands.

Inventory Control and Premium Expansion

What starts as a single, humble shop can evolve into a massive retail operation. You have full control to design a clean, minimalist, and highly efficient store layout with a premium interface to keep your customers happy.

Reinvest your hard-earned profits to purchase the adjacent lot, doubling your capacity to a maximum of two large stores. To handle the growing crowds, step into the role of an HR manager: hire dedicated cashiers to automate sales and cleaners to maintain a top-tier shopping environment. Balance your daily books and watch your retail empire run itself.

Deep Survival Mechanics & Street Intelligence

Before you can live the Miami dream, you must survive its reality. Monitor your character’s vital stats, managing hunger and sleep carefully while resting in a street tent. As your journey progresses, your family dynamics come into play. In a unique twist on economy and strategy, your child can hit the streets to beg, providing a crucial secondary income stream for your business.

Furthermore, knowledge is power in Miami Beach. The city is full of secrets that can influence the local market. Track down the local beggar located in specific parts of the city.

By strategically managing your resources and bribing them with spare cash, you can unlock critical street intelligence and insider information, giving your supermarket a massive competitive advantage.

Key Features

  • Immersive Tycoon Progression: Experience a dynamic day-night cycle where every decision impacts your business management and financial growth.

  • Supermarket Simulator at its Core: Build, design, and manage up to two fully functional retail stores with a clean, user-friendly layout.

  • Driving & Logistics Sandbox: Physically drive your vehicle, manage warehouse pickups, load your trunk, and handle all cargo transport yourself.

  • Realistic Survival Elements: Balance core life-sim mechanics like sleep, hunger, and homelessness while trying to run a business.

  • Unorthodox Income Strategy: Grow your family and utilize your child's street-begging earnings to fund your corporate expansion.

  • Store Automation: Hire cashiers and cleaners, optimize your daily overhead costs, and scale your operations.

Pick up your keyboard and play it like a real bass! Take on the role of Ostinata, the leader and bassist of the all-girl band Tutti Nova. Strengthen the bonds among the five band members through your performances (unlocking daily band dialogs) while staying ever ready to fend off bassist jokes. At the same time, grow your fan base (advancing the main story chapters), perform in larger venues, and set your sights on the ultimate goal—not the Budokan… but the Musikverein in Vienna!

Bass Simulation

This game can be played with any keyboard, but for the best immersive experience, hold the keyboard as if you're holding a bass or a guitar. Place the four fingers of your left hand on the number keys 1–4, and your right hand on the comma (,), L, P, and hyphen (-) keys. Press the frets with your left hand, then pluck the strings with your right hand, just like playing a real bass! Ready? You're now the official bassist of Tutti Nova!

Bassist Simulation

Knowing how to play the bass is just the first step to becoming a bassist. As the most unique presence in the band, you also need to learn how to handle all kinds of bassist jokes—whether intentional or not. Perform at shows, deepen the bonds between your bandmates, unlock more daily dialogs, and show everyone that you've truly grown into a real bassist!

Run a Girl Band

Together with four band members, each with their own distinct personality, boost your fan count, earn more money, rent bigger venues, and put on even larger live shows—your goal is the Budokan… wait, no, the Musikverein in Vienna! A quintessential girl band story begins right here!

store_data.about_the_game:
Build the ammo machine. Stack the impossible.

Hex Tower Boogie is tower defense for people who love watching a machine come alive. Your towers don't make their own ammunition — you do. Harvest bullets, push them through Grabbers, shape them in stations, and feed the right tower before the next wave hits.

But here's the real game: stacking effects until it gets ridiculous.

You want a cannon that one-shots the whole screen every 10 seconds? Sure, build it.

A homing splash tower? Take it.

More effects on a single bullet? ...okay.

Homing AND multishot AND piercing AND bonus damage, all on the same shot? Oh, you sweet summer child — yes.

Then socket punchcards on top for even more effects. Then meta-upgrades across runs.

By the end your screen isn't a tower defense — it's a fireworks factory.

The stations

What you actually do

  • Harvest & route — pull raw bullets, push them through Grabbers and belts

  • Shape your shots — damage, splash, pierce, speed, ice, burn, homing, split-shot, and stack them

  • Socket punchcards — into towers, Grabbers, stations, and bullets for even crazier effects

  • Meta-upgrades — carry power between runs and reshape your whole strategy

  • Fix the bottleneck — when storage jams and towers starve, reroute and survive

The battlefield is a compact hex globe: readable, weird, colorful, built for fast iteration. Place a machine, watch it move, find the choke point, hold the line.

How absurd can one bullet get? Find out.

Build the machine. Feed the towers. Let the whole board boogie.

store_data.about_the_game:
Jumpscare your friends!

If you write your friend's name on a page, the monster jumpscares them and they scream.
Co-op horror where you and your friends are trapped in a haunted neighborhood.
The goal is simple: scare each other out. Get jumpscared three times and you're eliminated. Last friend not crying wins and gets to escape the neighborhood.
You may also work with your friends to escape the neighborhood together... If you can manage to cooperate and not jumpscare each other out.

The signature mechanic is the notebook. You search the houses, find cursed pages, pick a friend, pick a scare — and the monster carries it out, and they never find out who wrote it, and since anyone can use a page on anyone, nobody knows who's plotting against them, or who teamed up with who.

Replayability comes from the variety of scares, and the fact that every group turns on each other differently.
You'll all decide that you want to try to escape the neighborhood together this time, but at the last moment someone will pull a jumpscare ruining everything.

The scare can be anything you can imagine - a clown in the trees, a face at the window, a hand on the shoulder. Set the timer, and the game makes it happen. The monster will spawn, haunting and chasing the player you wrote until they are jumpscared.
The notes you find can be used at anytime - you pickup the notes and can save them for just the right moment, like when your friend is the most distracted. Just make sure they didn't see you holding or writing in it right before the monster appears and jumpscares them.

  • Search the houses in the haunted neighborhood to find cursed pages from the Scream Note.

  • Write the name of the person you want to scream in the scream pages you have. Pick the player, pick the scare, and the monster will come and make them scream. The monster spawns near the player, chases them, and if it catches them - it jumpscares them in the face.

  • Get jumpscared three times and you're eliminated. Last friend not crying wins and gets to escape the neighborhood.

  • Work with your friends to escape the neighborhood together... If you can manage to cooperate and not jumpscare each other out.

  • Secretly team up with other players to eliminate others, but you may betray them at anytime, there are no rules.

  • Use proximity voice chat to communicate with each other while searching the houses.

  • Play with friends to ruin friendships, or with strangers to make new friendships and then ruin them.

store_data.about_the_game:
Goal:

Out here, there's one thing worth surviving for: getting home.

Every weapon, every ration, every scrap you drag back makes your bunker stronger.

Everyone else on the map wants to make sure you never get there.

What is Blood of Rations?

Blood of Rations is a first-person PvP tactical extraction looter shooter set on the European Front, 1944. You deploy alone onto war-scarred terrain, scavenge what you can carry, and fight whoever you meet on the way out. There are no objectives, no commanders, no medals. In any single raid, the goal is simple: reach the extraction zone, hold your ground long enough to leave, and get home alive. Across every raid, the goal is bigger — everything you carry out, you keep, and you pour it into a bunker that grows stronger and a loadout that gives you a real chance next time. Everything you fail to extract is gone for good. The greatest threat is always other players.

Key Features

• Absolute Vulnerability. 100 HP. No passive regeneration in-raid. One well-placed rifle shot to the head ends your run.

• Spatial Inventory. A Tetris grid is the only carry limit. Every slot is a decision. Finding a can of peaches is a win. A legendary MG42 is a story you'll tell tomorrow — if you extract.

• Meaningful Extraction. Reaching the extraction zone makes you visible, illuminated, and entirely vulnerable. The hardest & most intense part of a raid is the last thirty seconds.

• The Bunker Anchor. Between raids, you build. Repair. Upgrade your underground safe house station by station, using materials pulled from the field. The bunker is the only safe place in the world — and going home to it is the emotional reward of every session.

• Hunger and Thirst. Survival isn't background noise. Eat in the bunker before you deploy, or deploy weak. Drink between fights. Skip too many meals and you don't come home. Field food is loot worth fighting for.

• A World Worth Listening To. No minimap. No enemy markers. All audio is diegetic — the crack of boots on a metal hangar roof, the rustle of canvas during a search, the dead silence before extraction succeeds. Your headset is your radar.

The World

Occupied Europe in 1944 is a faded, polygon-edged battlefield: desaturated greens, ochre rust, grey fog. Even the wheat field above your bunker has gone grey — the sky over home hasn't cleared in months. The only warmth left in the world is your bunker, sealed underground: the one place the war hasn't reached. Beauty is still out there if you look for it. The war has just used most of it up.

Now in Development

Blood of Rations is being built by a small independent studio from Norway. Wishlist & follow development and be notified when the game is available.

one that respects the weight of each raid,

the cost of each death,

and the earned warmth of coming home

store_data.about_the_game:
The world ended centuries ago.

Kingdoms crumbled, knowledge vanished, and humanity was forced to begin again among the ruins of a forgotten age. In this harsh land, iron is more valuable than gold, ancient relics hold secrets no one understands, and every settlement fights to survive.

Ashborn Empires is a unique co-op RTS/RPG hybrid where two players take on distinct but interconnected roles. One commands a growing civilization through classic real-time strategy gameplay, while the other fights on the front lines as a Hero in third-person action combat.

Together, you must rebuild, explore, and uncover the lost technologies of the old world.

Two Roles. One Empire.

Coordinate with a friend in a truly asymmetrical co-op experience.

As the RTS Commander, gather resources, construct settlements, research technologies, train armies, and lead your civilization through the ages.

As the Hero, explore the wilderness, battle hostile creatures and enemy warriors, recover forgotten knowledge from ancient ruins, and influence the course of every battle through skill-based combat.

Build a Civilization From the Ashes

Establish settlements, expand your economy, and transform a fragile community of survivors into a powerful empire.

Advance through multiple ages, unlock new technologies, strengthen your military, and adapt your strategy to an ever-changing battlefield.

Master Skill-Based Melee Combat

Take direct control of a Hero inspired by classic action combat systems.

Block, parry, dodge, and strike from multiple directions in fast-paced third-person battles. Develop your Hero, improve your equipment, and become a decisive force on the battlefield.

Recover Lost Knowledge

The ruins of the old world are filled with forgotten weapons, ancient technologies, and secrets waiting to be rediscovered.

Bring these discoveries back to your people to unlock new technologies, weapons and armor, improve your civilization and gain an edge over your enemies.

Fight for a New Future

Face hostile wildlife, rival civilizations, mysterious insectoid races, and the countless dangers of a world struggling to rebuild itself after catastrophe.

Whether defending your settlement, exploring ancient ruins, or leading armies into war, every victory brings humanity one step closer to reclaiming its future.

Features

  • Unique asymmetrical co-op gameplay combining RTS and third-person RPG action

  • Build settlements, manage economies, and command armies in classic RTS fashion

  • Engage in skill-based melee combat with blocking, parrying, and directional attacks

  • Explore a post-apocalyptic medieval world filled with ruins and lost technology

  • Research discoveries recovered by the Hero to unlock powerful upgrades

  • Progress through multiple ages and expand your civilization

  • Play solo, cooperatively, or compete in multiplayer matches

  • Battle hostile creatures, enemy factions, and emerging civilizations

store_data.about_the_game:
WELCOME TO SHERWOOD VALLEY

Experience the legend like never before. Become Robin Hood and live a new life in this cozy RPG. After being a deputy for the Sheriff of Sherwood Valley for many years, Robin Hood finds his or herself (Player Choice) exiled following an act of betrayal. Alone and being hunted, Hood must survive the elements, and plot revenge to take down the now-corrupt Sheriff. All while restoring power back to the people, and enriching the local citizens of Sherwood Valley. You'll also enlist the help of the magical Merry Men to aide you on your adventure. And what good is being a hero/thief if you don't have a secret underground Hideout to decorate?

Explore the nature you've been exiled to. Want to restore your health? Go fishing and cook up some tasty fish to bring with you before you enter another portal. Need to craft a potion instead? Maybe the local farmer can gift you some of their ingredients if you help them out that is.

Right from the start you'll create your own version of Robin Hood by choosing gender and skin tone. With different variants (male, female, light skin, dark skin) you'll be able to make the legendary hero your own.

As legendary as Robin is.. Hood can't do everything. Like casting magic for example. But who can? How about the Merry Men? As you explore the world you'll recruit the Merry Men who will join your cause, help Hood during his quest, and take shelter in the customizable hideout. 

ABOUT THE GAME

Robin Hood: Sherwood Valley is an open world RPG presented in a sandbox, grid based design. Explore the diorama-style world, filled with cozy villages, lush forests, sandy beaches, snowy mountains, and windy caves. Oil painting style backgrounds give the game a cozy, warm, gorgeous vibe. Befriend the locals, explore the world, and prepare for battle.

All over the land of Sherwood Valley are portals.. created by a dark ally of the Sheriff, using ancient magic. Each portal is being used to watch over and intimidate the people. With the worry that the portals could also put their lives at risk. Robin Hood will be tasked with entering each portal, and using his or her archery skills to clear battlefields in turn-based combat. Defeat the deputies and the loyal followers of the Sheriff and his evil allies, and restore the riches back to the people of Sherwood Valley.

For the first time in a Solohack3r Studios game, there will be a 3D element! Underworld Battlefields will come to life, revealing a sinister version of the cozy and happy world above. You'll prepare for battle in a 3D view, with animated enemies. As seen in the GIF above.

Robin Hood: Sherwood Valley mixes the nostalgia of retro RPGs with modern elements and gameplay. With soothing medieval style music, colorful graphics, and oil painting inspired artwork, the goal is to make Sherwood Valley feel like a place you want to get lost in. Especially with the different biomes to discover. Plus fun features like crafting potions, fishing for ingredients, and decorating your Hideout.

Along your adventure you'll encounter paths that are blocked. There will be a few different ways to clear each path to unlock new areas, and various tools you'll pick up along the way. You can use Bombs to blow up boulders. Or play an Orcania to awaken a sleeping Orc that has decided to camp out in the middle of a path.

FEATURES:

  • Male or female character options, with light or dark skin options

  • Beautiful oil painting style backgrounds

  • Sandbox world featuring grid-based diorama graphics

  • Different biomes to explore (forest, jungle, snow, mountains, beach, desert, etc)

  • Hideout to decorate

  • Fishing minigame

  • Potion crafting

  • Medieval soundtrack

  • Large maps to explore

  • 3D scenes and animations, mixed with top-down graphics

  • Turn-based battles

  • Animated battles

  • High replayability

  • Steam Deck and Handheld Gaming PC Support

  • Steam Cloud Save Support

  • Full controller support & Xbox controller support. Also supports touch screens and full keyboard support

  • Available on GeForce Now

store_data.about_the_game:
OFFROAD Recovery: Yoho Trails is a terrain‑first off‑road simulation about keeping remote mountain routes open through recovery work, cargo hauling, and keeping remote sites accessible.

Every job begins with the route ahead. Mud, rock, water, weather, and damaged roads determine how you approach the work and whether you can reach the destination at all.

Recover stranded vehicles, deliver essential cargo, clear access routes, and keep remote sites supplied across a rugged backcountry region where changing conditions affect visibility, traction, and route planning. Success depends on reading the terrain, choosing the right equipment, and adapting to the conditions in front of you.

Your route and job decisions change how the trails evolve.

There are no on‑foot sections and no character interactions. Every challenge is solved from behind the wheel using your vehicle, your equipment, and your understanding of the terrain.

Terrain‑First Driving

Navigate mud, rock, washouts, steep grades, river crossings, and unstable roads. Ground conditions, vehicle positioning, and traction management shape every recovery.

Recovery and Route Work

Recover stuck vehicles, haul cargo, reopen access routes, move equipment, and help keep remote operations connected across the region.

Dynamic Weather and Conditions

Rain, fog, changing water levels, and shifting conditions affect visibility, traction, and route selection.

Industrial Recovery Equipment

Use winches, anchors, tow rigs, and vehicle‑mounted recovery tools to solve terrain‑driven problems and complete demanding jobs.

A Working Mountain Region

Roads, bridges, sensors, maintenance sites, and damaged infrastructure reveal which routes remain operational and which require attention. The landscape reflects ongoing use, weather damage, and the work needed to keep routes open.

Cab‑First Simulation

All gameplay is vehicle‑based. Every task, recovery, and route decision happens from the driver’s seat.

Future Plans

We’re exploring optional asymmetrical co‑op between mobile and console versions, where players take on different recovery roles across shared terrain. This is a long‑term vision and not part of the initial release.

Keeping the trails open means solving problems one route at a time.

* Visuals shown reflect early prototype art and will continue to improve as the project grows through development and Early Access.

store_data.about_the_game:
SEND THEM FLY

Short Description

SEND THEM FLY is a physics-driven bullet heaven roguelite where zombies do not simply die — they crash, tumble, explode, bounce, and fly across the battlefield in glorious low-poly chaos.

About This Game

The world has ended. Fortunately, your arsenal still works.

SEND THEM FLY is a fast-paced survival roguelite built around one simple promise: if something runs at you, you can send it flying.

Fight through waves of zombies, upgrade your weapons, stack ridiculous knockback effects, trigger explosive chain reactions, and turn the battlefield into a collapsing toybox of undead bodies, physics mayhem, and beautiful disaster.

You start each run underpowered, surrounded, and probably one bad turn away from becoming lunch. But every upgrade changes the balance. More firepower. More explosions. More knockback. More chaos. Soon, the horde that once chased you becomes a rolling, bouncing, ragdoll-powered chain reaction.

This is not just about killing zombies.

It is about launching them.

Key Features

Physics-Powered Combat

Enemies do not just disappear when defeated. They get pushed, knocked down, blasted away, launched into other enemies, and thrown across the map like undead bowling pins. Every hit has weight, motion, and impact.

Bullet Heaven Meets Ragdoll Chaos

Survive against growing zombie hordes while building increasingly absurd weapon combinations. Clear the screen, break formations, create chain reactions, and watch the battlefield spiral out of control.

Roguelite Upgrade Builds

Each run gives you new choices. Stack fire rate, explosive force, knockback power, area damage, movement upgrades, and special effects to create your own disaster machine.

Low-Poly Apocalypse Style

A bright, stylized, low-poly world turns the zombie apocalypse into a chaotic action playground. It is dangerous, ridiculous, and strangely adorable — until the horde surrounds you.

Easy to Play, Hard to Stop

Move, survive, upgrade, repeat. SEND THEM FLY is designed for quick runs, instant feedback, and that dangerous “just one more try” feeling.

You May Like This Game If You Enjoy:

  • Swarms of enemies and screen-clearing chaos

  • Survival runs with escalating upgrades

  • Physics-based combat feedback

  • Ragdoll knockback and explosive chain reactions

  • Low-poly stylized worlds

  • Simple controls with increasingly ridiculous builds

The Pitch

In most zombie games, you kill the horde.

In SEND THEM FLY, you turn the horde into projectiles.

Lock, load, survive, and send them flying.

A place that feels strangely familiar

Backrooms 95 is a surreal Backrooms horror experience blending eerie liminal spaces, low-poly visuals, and a disturbing retro aesthetic inspired by forgotten 90s technology.

Wander through unsettling environments where the flickering lights, the distant sounds, and the strange place create an overwhelming feeling that something is deeply wrong...

  • Disturbing environments and surreal atmosphere.

store_data.about_the_game:
House of Temptations

Explore a mysterious gothic mansion filled with hidden secrets, locked rooms, and seductive discoveries.

In House of Temptations, you play as a pale gothic woman trapped inside a dark and eerie manor where curiosity leads to increasingly strange encounters. Search the environment for hidden keys, unlock new areas, and uncover the secrets buried deep within the house.

Throughout the mansion, you’ll find a variety of interactive objects, each featuring its own unique animation and interaction. Every discovered interaction is permanently recorded inside the Memories menu, allowing you to revisit the moments you’ve uncovered during gameplay.

As you progress, you’ll eventually gain access to a fully customizable wardrobe room hidden somewhere inside the manor. Change your character’s appearance with different gothic-inspired outfits and personalize your experience while exploring the mansion.

But not everything inside the house is what it seems.

Behind certain locked doors, something unnatural waits in the darkness…

Features

  • Explore a large gothic mansion full of secrets

  • Search for hidden keys to unlock new areas

  • Unique interactive scenes and animations

  • In-game Memories gallery system

  • Unlock a complete wardrobe customization room

  • Dark gothic atmosphere and immersive environments

  • Hidden mysteries scattered throughout the manor

store_data.about_the_game:
BERG is a first-person co-op mountain climbing survival game where every step higher brings you closer to the summit — and closer to death.

Start your expedition at the foot of a massive alpine mountain and fight your way through ice walls, narrow ridges, deadly storms, and the thin air of the death zone. Climb alone or with friends as you establish camps, manage oxygen supplies, secure ropes, and navigate dangerous terrain where a single mistake can end hours of progress.

The mountain is not a level. It is a journey.

Choose your route carefully. Watch the weather. Conserve your energy. Adapt to changing conditions and make difficult decisions when the environment turns against you. Snowstorms can erase visibility, freezing temperatures can drain your stamina, and high altitude can slowly destroy your ability to continue climbing.

Every ascent becomes a unique story of survival, teamwork, and endurance.

Features

  • Online co-op climbing with friends

  • Large mountain built around a full expedition experience

  • Physics-based climbing using both hands

  • Rope systems, anchors, and safety equipment

  • Dynamic weather including snowstorms, strong winds, and low visibility

  • Oxygen, temperature, stamina, and altitude management

  • Multiple routes with different risks and rewards

  • Camps and checkpoints for long-term progression

  • Immersive first-person gameplay focused on tension and realism

  • Challenging summit attempts where every decision matters

The mountain doesn't care how far you've come.

Only how much further you can go.
