store_data.about_the_game:
RogueScape is an old-school MMO-inspired survival roguelike where every run starts with a build choice: pick your skills, survive escalating waves, open chests, and turn permanent account progress into stronger future runs.

Choose from combat, gathering, production, and support skills before each run. Swing swords with Attack, fire piercing arrows with Ranged, chain lightning through groups with Magic, orbit shields with Defense, smash enemies with Strength, or lean into survival tools like Woodcutting, Mining, Fishing, Cooking, Smithing, Herblore, Crafting, Agility, and Slayer. Your selected skills level up during the run, unlocking stronger effects and stranger synergies as the pressure builds.

Runs are built around survival, decision-making, and momentum. Enemies are fewer and tougher than a typical swarm game, so kills matter, positioning matters, and each upgrade can change how your build handles the next wave. Last long enough and the Reaper arrives to bring the run to its final reckoning.

Between runs, your account keeps growing. XP earned in a run feeds permanent skill progression, giving that familiar long-term grind a roguelike loop: lose, learn, level, rebuild, and come back stronger.

Features

  • Build around MMO-style skills with combat, gathering, production, and support options.

  • Survive 20-minute runs against escalating enemy waves and mini-boss pressure.

  • Earn XP toward permanent account-wide skill progression.

  • Open chests mid-run to gain skill levels and push your build further.

  • Create powerful synergies between weapons, shields, magic, sustain, gathering buffs, crafted boosts, and defensive tools.

  • Fight fewer, tougher enemies where movement, sustain, and upgrade choices matter.

  • Explore a dark pixel-fantasy world with chunky old-school UI, skill icons, chests, achievements, and satisfying progression.

RogueScape is not affiliated with Jagex or RuneScape.

store_data.about_the_game:
An Over-the-Top Anime Visual Battle Game!

Ordinary faces, wildly unhinged hearts — these girls fight to the death in a delusion-soaked visual battle. Every instant where the madness beneath their delicate surfaces collides is drawn in fully dedicated animation.

◆ Every Move Comes Alive on Screen

Attack, Skill, Super, Guard, Dodge, Taunt — each move you choose plays out in its own character-specific animation. A video-driven battle.

Inspired by the 1995 release "Tengai Makyō: Dennō Karakuri Kakutōden."

◆ Reads Decide the Match

A real-time battle of wits where both fighters keep choosing their next move.

・Six Moves ―― Taunt, Attack, Skill, Super, Guard, Dodge. Skill beats Attack, Super shatters Skill, and that Super can be snuffed out by an Attack during its charge. A three-way standoff of clashing reads.

・React ―― Switching your move after seeing the opponent's is valid too. Whoever reads right takes the initiative.

・Super ―― A big move unleashed by holding the button. Powerful once complete, but take a hit before it charges and it's canceled.

・Skill Gauge ―― Skills and Dodges cost skill gauge. That crucial gauge is earned by Taunting.

◆ Eight Fighters

Each with their own distinct signature skill.

・Shizuka / Knife

"In my way? ...You'll die, you know."

The deadliest schoolgirl alive. In her hands, a plain knife becomes a murder weapon.

Skill "Killing Intent": A strike on an unguarded foe deals greatly increased damage.

・Chitose / Spirit Medium

"I can see it~ all the way to your soul."

An undying medium who can apparently command even her own soul.

Skill "Immortality": Heals HP on any turn she takes no hit / guards. She won't fall even after guarding a Super.

・Luna / Vampire

"But I don't want to go outside…"

A shut-in vampire — no motivation, plenty of talent.

Skill "Blood Drain": Heals a portion of the unguarded damage she deals.

・Mina / Werewolf

"Ohh~ you want big sis to play with you?"

An airheaded big-sis werewolf who strikes first on beastly instinct.

Skill "Wild Instinct": Her Skill 1 and Super 1 come out faster — at slightly lower power.

・Alice / Mage

"What's wrong? Scared already?"

A battle-hardened mage with fast casting and a love of flashy spells.

Skill "Rapid Cast": Shorter Super charge — she fires off big moves faster than anyone.

・Mei / Great Scythe

"I've got to take my job seriously!"

A surprisingly diligent reaper. Harvesting souls is her line of work.

Skill "Soul Reaping": Every landing Attack or Skill steals the opponent's skill gauge for herself.

・Rafa / Half-Angel, Half-Demon

"You're a million years too early to beat me."

Half demon, half angel — a cocky show-off wielding both powers.

Skill "Power of Angel and Demon": Triggers the knockdown normally exclusive to Supers — with a Skill, too.

・Sachi / Zashiki-warashi

"Is that all? Weak~ so weak~"

A fortune-bringing house spirit — but a scheming little prankster at heart.

Skill "Fortune & Misfortune": Guarding an Attack or Skill greatly cuts the damage taken and reflects it back.

◆ Four Modes

・Story ―― Battles told through a narrative.

・Challenge ―― A roguelike survival run: pick a power-up card after every win and see how long your streak lasts.

・Battle Royale ―― A four-way free-for-all until only one is left standing.

・Tutorial ―― Chitose shows you the ropes. Learn the fundamentals of the mind game by feel.

◆ High-Speed Mode

For when you just want a quick match. High-Speed Mode raises the tempo of the entire battle — the mind-game balance stays exactly the same, only the motion speeds up. Toggle it any time in Settings (available in the demo, too).

Japanese / English supported.

----------------------------------------------------------------

■ About the Demo

----------------------------------------------------------------

Even in the demo, you can enjoy Versus, Challenge, Battle Royale, and the Tutorial.

The full version unlocks every playable character, difficulty, and the rest of the story — with even more to sink your teeth into.

[Playable in the Demo]

・Playable characters: Shizuka / Chitose / Luna / Mina (4)

※All 8 appear as opponents.

・Difficulty: Easy / Normal / Hard

・Story: Stages 1–4

・Challenge: clear by winning 5 in a row

・Battle Royale: four-way free-for-all (play as the 4 above)

・Tutorial included

※High-Speed Mode is available in the demo as well.

[Unlocked in the Full Version]

・All 8 playable, adding Alice / Mei / Rafa / Sachi

・Top difficulties — Brutal & Insane

・The rest of the story (Stages 5–7)

・Challenge becomes an endless run — until you lose

================================================================

Hammered! is a pixel-art action crafting defense game with roguelite elements.

Play as "Pura," a genius blacksmith girl burdened by a curse that prevents any human from wielding the weapons she makes. Together with "Etna," a living giant forge, embark on an adventure across the world. Forge weapons, load them into launchers, smash incoming enemies, and forge ahead!

Discover materials, weapon recipes, and hidden relics across various regions to create your own powerful weapon builds.

Even if you fall, you will rise again to continue your endless adventure—but no two runs will ever be the same. Only a blacksmith capable of forging the perfect weapon at the right moment will reach the ultimate truth.

Will you be able to stop the evil forces and finally break the curse?

store_data.about_the_game:
First Colony is a turn-based 4X strategy game inspired by classic colony-building games.

Establish a foothold on a newly discovered continent, explore the wilderness, build settlements, gather resources, and defend your people against hostile barbarians and dangerous wildlife.

Unlike traditional colony-building games, production is not confined to settlement screens. All production sites are built directly on the world map, creating a growing network of settlements that expands across the frontier.

Features

  • Explore a large continent covered by fog of war.

  • Found and expand settlements across a hex-based world map.

  • Build production settlements directly on the map and develop regional economies.

  • Gather resources and train new units.

  • Upgrade settlements into more productive and specialized forms.

  • Hunt wildlife for food and survival.

  • Defend your colony against barbarian raids.

  • Discover strategic terrain and resource opportunities.

  • Collect various victory points to win.

A Solo Developer Project

First Colony was developed primarily during nights and weekends over more than six years by a solo developer. Currently, it represents a focused vertical slice of a much larger dream project and aims to capture the spirit of classic 4X strategy games while introducing a unique approach to settlement expansion.

store_data.about_the_game:
One World Cup run. Three forbidden connections. The final whistle decides what survives.


Marenza is football's smallest miracle—an Adriatic nation of four hundred thousand that's somehow reached the World Cup. At the center of it is Ronan Cosgrove, a weathered journeyman manager with one shot to prove the impossible wasn't a fluke. In a six-week tournament bubble where every minute is borrowed, Ronan is pulled between duty and desire, and the night before the opener you decide which woman he spends it with—a single choice that locks in your route.

Meet the Cast


Renata Salas — The Fixer

Flown in when a betting investigation threatens to turn a miracle into a scandal, Renata is a luxury-grade crisis strategist who can control any narrative—except the one forming inside the camp. She is paid to manage Ronan's image, contain the damage, and keep the sponsors calm.

Quinn Adair — The Documentarian

An embedded director with all-access credentials and a hard-won code, Quinn believes in honesty over comfort—even when the truth ruins people. Her relationship to Ronan starts as subject and filmmaker, but the moment she says "camera's down," the line between story and real life becomes dangerously thin.

Lena Voss — The Team Doctor

Marenza's chief medical officer—and Ronan's wife, separated but trapped in the same tournament bubble—Lena is calm, clinical, and unshakeably ethical under pressure. She is the only person who can stop the captain from playing on a body that's failing.

Key Features

  • Single-choice romance structure with high stakes: Choose who gets the night before the opener—and set your route in motion.
  • Three "offside" relationships: Reignite a broken marriage, cross the line with the woman behind the lens, or fall for the professional hired to control your story.
  • A World Cup Cinderella run on borrowed time: Sudden-death football drama where every decision echoes into matchday.
  • Distinct route conflicts beyond romance: Injury management, editorial ethics, and crisis containment—each love story is also a career-and-conscience dilemma.
  • Adult content: Contains explicit adult scenes across all three romance routes.

Content Warning


Injury Time Lovers is an Adult Romance Visual Novel intended for mature audiences (18+). It contains sexual content, strong language, and emotionally intense themes, including marital breakdown, workplace/professional boundary violations, sports injury and medical decision-making, and scandal/investigation pressure.

store_data.about_the_game:
Catacomb is a hardcore, melee-focused FPS roguelike inspired by the greats of the early 2000's. Using only your wits, your blade, and over 40 unique artifacts, hack and slash your way back to the surface and earn your freedom.

COMBAT

Catacomb features 5 weapons, with more coming:

  • Shortsword - a basic but balanced melee option, able to parry enemy attacks

  • Dagger - Weak for direct combat, but backstabs make stealth viable

  • Crossbow - A ranged dominator with limited ammo

  • Tomahawks - Throwing axes that bounce off enemies and walls

  • Greatsword - Devastating, sweeping blows but lost mobility

Alongside these options, you can also punch, kick, stomp, and ram through enemies (with the right artifact, of course.)

EXPLORATION

Catacomb will feature 4 unique areas, each with their own loot pools and varied areas to traverse through.

Currently, Area 1 is complete:

  • THE CRYPT

The first step on your climb to the surface, and the darkest. Dingy, stone-brick halls, walls caving in on themselves, and crawling with ghouls and skeletons. 20 unique rooms, 5 area-specific artifacts.

ARTIFACTS

Artifacts are the building blocks that shape your run: They can augment your body, give you new abilities, and some can even alter the world around you. Choose wisely; though, almost all of them have drawbacks.

store_data.about_the_game:
Thousands Floors is a Chinese-inspired pixel idle tower-climbing game.

Summon Tower Climbers and fellow allies who patrol automatically through layered pavilions, battle creatures from the Classic of Mountains and Seas, and keep climbing upward along winding staircases.

Defeat enemies for gold, upgrade stats and mystic arts anytime, push to higher floors, and earn relics.

Floors stretch on forever—grow stronger even while idle. Perfect for players who love relaxed progression, crisp Eastern pixel art, and screen-filling allies fighting together.

---

It all begins on the first floor at the tower's base—and the moment you first tap a floor and a Tower Climber bursts through the rain.

Welcome to Thousands Floors—

an incremental idle game built around a sky-piercing pagoda.

Here you are not only the guide who summons climbers, but the architect who keeps the entire tower running like a well-oiled machine.

Tap the Tower, Fight Together

Master the rhythm of "tap a floor, fight on that floor": click or hold the tower to spawn climbers from your chosen level; unlocked allies join automatically on a timer. Crash into foes, trade blows, fall back, surge forward—every collision hits crisp and satisfying. Higher floors mean fiercer fiends and juicier gold and chest drops. But walkways are limited and on-screen climbers are capped—you cannot mindlessly tap your way to a full tower. Use Floor Lockdown to seal the base and concentrate summons on the floors that actually pay.

Mystic Arts & Strategy

Explore a branching tree of mystic arts: expand summon capacity, lock down lower floors to focus on the climb, and deploy active arts like Cloud-Step and Renewal to turn key battles. Every upgrade asks the same question—pour gold into climber training, or unlock the next skill line?

Roster of Allies, Ten Paths

Unlock and train a dozen distinct allies—sword cultivators, spear guards, shield bearers, archers, talismanists, dancers, wandering monks, apothecaries, assassins, artificers… Allies have no global cap—pair relics with shorter spawn intervals to truly fill the walkways at peak.

Relic Codex, Chest Rewards

Milestone floors and placement chests hide permanently stacking relics: attack, HP, move speed, gold, chest odds… No equip slots—only ever-growing global bonuses.

Rebirth & the Wish-Lamp

When your climber reaches sufficient mastery, trigger Rebirth: abandon this run's floors and arts progress, climb again from floor one; keep every relic earned, and with the Wish-Lamp Talisman roll fresh rewards. The loop begins anew—this time with a richer relic vault, records, and strategy.

Why wishlist?

* Unique tap-a-floor summoning + collision combat—idle play that feels tactile and punchy

* Climber cap × unlimited ally spawns × lockdown strategy—resource and space puzzles

* Mystic arts, relics, and allies—three deep progression lines

* Rebirth + Wish-Lamp Talisman reshapes every next climb

* Offline gold on return—idle income that matters

* Eastern pixel pagodas + many units on screen—a visual and numeric sense of "a thousand floors"

Wishlist Thousands Floors now, join the QQ group, and be among the first to reach the top!

4794570.name: Gems are Mine, Slashes are Yours: Blood & Blessing

store_data.about_the_game:
"Have you ever shed tears begging for a healer in an RPG?"

Here is the most arrogant, shameless cleric who monopolizes all the loot on the battlefield. You are the one rolling in the dirt, bleeding, and doing all the grunt work, but this AI healer acts like a magnet, scooping up every precious gem. She’s infuriating, sure—but without her healing magic, you wouldn't last a single second in the dungeon, and without your brute force, she’s just monster food. A hilarious, role-reversed fantasy action comedy unfolds!

Gems are Mine, Slashes are Yours: Blood & Blessing is a 2D survival action roguelike where you sweep away endless hordes of monsters while managing the most stressful (and hilarious) symbiotic relationship of your life.

🩸 Core Features

  • High-Risk, High-Return Combat: As a Berserker, you consume your own HP to unleash devastating, screen-clearing crushing attacks. You must entrust your life entirely to your AI cleric companion while diving headfirst into the fray.

  • The Heart-Pounding "Resource Swap": Your cleric can't heal you if she's out of Mana. When her MP runs dry, she will dangerously sacrifice her own HP to restore it. This creates terrifying windows where both of you are on the brink of death. Survive these extreme moments through pure positioning and control!

  • A Cruel Roguelike Dilemma: Leveling up grants random skill and stat choices, but there are no shared skills! Do you increase your own destructive power to slaughter monsters faster? Or do you buff your lifeline cleric’s healing and utility? Make extreme choices between efficiency and survival in every run.

  • She Takes the Gems, You Work Two Jobs: The cleric's magic radius forcibly vacuums up all dropped gems. So how does a Berserker make a living? Bounties! Accept side-quests from the Bounty Board—from exterminating 200 rats to hunting brutal orcs. Work your bloody second job to earn your own precious "Gold."

  • Blood, Sweat, and the Skill Shop: Spend your hard-earned Gold to unlock essential skills for yourself, or begrudgingly upgrade your greedy cleric. You will also need Gold to buy 'Stage Keys' to unlock new biomes. From grassy plains to eerie caves and barren deserts, tougher monsters mean harder healing (and more complaining from the cleric).

  • Real-Time Sassy Banter: She is not just a silent heal-bot. Whether she’s out of mana, you're in danger, or you've just met a pathetic end, the cleric delivers real-time, witty, and cynical commentary, filling the battlefield with dark comedy.

store_data.about_the_game:
100,000 dollars in debt. A ticking clock. Total kitchen chaos.

In Food Truck Rush, you don’t just cook—you fight to stay in business. You’ve got a massive debt to the bank, and the local "sharks" are always watching your pockets. Start with a humble truck and climb your way to the top by mastering the fast-paced, arcade-style kitchen management that defines your survival.

  • Arcade-Style Pressure: Every second is a battle. Serve fast, keep your customers happy, and watch those tips pile up. One mistake in the grill area, and the whole service chain collapses.

  • Upgrade or Perish: Transform your truck into a culinary powerhouse. Upgrade Fryers and Grills for lightning-fast speeds and invest in high-end Refrigerators and Freezers to serve premium-quality, high-profit ingredients.

  • The Sharks are Watching: Beware of Willie from the bank, Ronald the tax collector, and the notorious The Tongue from the mob. Manage your finances wisely, because they don’t care how hard you work—they just want their cut.

  • Become the 'Employee of the Month': Prove your skills! Share your best gameplay clips with the community. Winners earn their spot in the game’s official 'Employee of the Month' hall of fame.

  • Community-Driven Development: We are constantly rebalancing mechanics based on your feedback. Join the discussion on our Community Hub and help shape the future of the game.

Can you handle the heat and build your food truck empire? The city is waiting.

store_data.about_the_game:
DESCEND INTO THE DARK

Bloodwright is a dark fantasy action RPG roguelite where every descent into the dungeon offers greater rewards—and greater danger.

Fight your way through procedurally generated floors filled with deadly enemies, powerful bosses, rare loot, and forgotten secrets.

Defeat the floor boss and choose your fate:

Return home with your rewards, or push deeper into the abyss in search of greater power.

RISK EVERYTHING

Every run is a gamble.

The deeper you descend, the more valuable your rewards become—but death comes at a price.

If you fall within the dungeon, everything carried on your character is lost.

Only your stash, character progression, and permanent upgrades remain.

Will you escape while you're ahead?

Or risk one more floor?

BUILD YOUR CHARACTER

Discover powerful weapons, armor, spells, and affixes that can transform your playstyle.

Experiment with unique combinations and devastating synergies:

  • Chain Lightning triggering from Whirlwind

  • Meteor on hit bleed build

  • Enemies explode when they die triggering a chain reaction

  • Rare affixes that reshape entire builds

No two runs are ever quite the same.

GROW STRONGER WITH EVERY RUN

Even failed expeditions contribute to your progress.

Gain experience, unlock permanent upgrades through Sevrik's Soul Tree, expand your collection of gear, and prepare for deeper descents.

Each run brings new opportunities to grow stronger.

FORGE YOUR LEGACY

Salvage unwanted equipment and transform it into valuable crafting materials.

Work alongside the blacksmith to forge new gear, improve your arsenal, and prepare for the dangers waiting below.

Every item has value.

Even broken steel can become something greater.

Key Features

  • Souls-inspired melee combat

  • Procedurally generated dungeon floors

  • Powerful bosses guarding each descent

  • Risk-versus-reward extraction gameplay

  • Deep loot and affix system

  • Build-defining spells and synergies

  • Permanent progression and skill tree upgrades

  • Salvage and crafting systems

  • Single-player experience

  • Endless replayability

store_data.about_the_game:
Multiplayer Chaos Online or on the Couch

Squabblin Goblins is a multiplayer party game for 2–4 players where your inventory is also your health.

Fill Your Backpack With Weapons

Collect items from airdrops and use them to eliminate other players. Every hit also removes an inventory slot, reducing the number of items a player can carry. The last player alive wins the round.

Lose a Battle, but Never the War

After each round, defeated players select upgrades that will strengthen their goblin in absurd ways and change how future rounds play out. Try out different upgrade combinations, items, and map mechanics to create new strategies every match and find your own goblin mode.

A True Goblin Defies Death

If you fall in battle, fear not. You will still be able to mess with your friends in a ghostly form to influence the outcome of the round.

Fight in a Multitude of Arenas

Battle across a wide range of maps featuring environmental hazards and unique mechanics while hurling bombs, fireballs, swords, and barrels.

Features

  • 2–4 player local and online multiplayer

  • Inventory slots act as health

  • Last-player-standing round-based gameplay

  • Unlock and stack upgrades between rounds

  • Variety of items with different strengths and uses

  • Maps with unique mechanics and hazards

  • Customizable match settings

store_data.about_the_game:
Always Ready

This game is a choice-based puzzle designed for training the mind.
Unlike typical falling-block games, it requires almost no quick reflexes or agility.

You see two moves ahead from three given choices.
You place them on the field.
Line up blocks horizontally, and they disappear, earning you points.
Once you reach a certain score, you gain the right to interfere with the field.

You choose with your own hands. You place with your own hands.
You interfere as you see fit to reach your goal.

This game is a mental framework for reality, simplified to the absolute extreme.
You choose, organize, and solve tasks from a limited number of options.
You gain trust based on the tasks you solve—though sometimes, you may need to erode that trust.

Even if you cannot defeat fate, there is profound value in preparing and fighting.
When you finally tire of this short, simple game, you will have succinctly understood its spirit.

store_data.about_the_game:
SHOUT-AI is a short electronic horror visual novel set inside a broken horror game called SHOUT.

The player thought they had launched a free game. Instead, a girl named Yoka appears on the other side of the screen. She calls herself something like a bug, something like an error that should have been reported, and guides you through a town where no one is left.

The town contains a residential district, a station, a square, a river, an archive, a shelter, and a rooftop. There are no people anywhere. Rain can be heard even when it is not falling. A station with no rails says there is no next train. A clock tower is stopped at 04:44.

Choices do not appear as a normal menu. They appear as separate windows on the screen. Some move randomly. Some return after being closed. Screen noise, glitches, blackouts, sudden volume changes, and fake code logs create the impression that something is happening on the PC, but the game does not execute external commands, modify user files, or perform network communication.

Was Yoka really inside the game? Or was she something you created to escape from a broken world?

Features:

- A short horror visual novel designed for roughly 15 minutes of play

- Japanese, English, and Simplified Chinese support

- Player name input

- Choice options displayed in separate pop-up windows

- Electronic horror effects including noise, glitches, blackouts, and audio shifts

- A quiet, unsettling walk through an empty town

- Horror based on bugs, fake logs, and internet ghost story atmosphere rather than gore

This game does not control the player's PC, execute external programs, collect personal information, or modify user files.

About This Game

The Crayon Kingdoms of Red and Blue have been locked in a war that has lasted for centuries, but the tide is beginning to turn...

Following the disappearance of the legendary General Bluemingham the Blue, the Red Kingdom has swept across the continent, pushing the once powerful Blue Kingdom to the brink of destruction. Now it is up to you to lead the Blue Army, reclaim the lost Mega Crayons, uncover the mystery of Bluemingham's disappearance, and end the war once and for all.

     

                                      

Command Your Campaign

Fight the war across a turn-based strategic campaign map where every decision matters. Reinforce threatened territories, launch offensives into enemy lands, manage your armies, and decide where your forces can have the greatest impact.

store_data.about_the_game:
This game is only available in Simplified Chinese

The script contains 140,000 words, featuring 27 major characters including the protagonist, with over 100 characters in total. The playtime is approximately 3.5 to 4 hours.

There are 7+1 endings: seven main endings, plus one early exit ending.

Unlike most text-based adventure games, this title features a health system and a money system.

Regarding the health system:

First, when faced with choices, making the wrong decision may result in a reduction of health points.

Second, the game includes text-based combat. Players must make correct combat decisions based on information provided by the text and the scene. Winning a battle may yield rewards (though not always); losing a battle will always result in a reduction of health points.

Third, players can use money to purchase items that restore health points. As the story progresses, some NPCs may also offer items as part of exchanges. There are other ways to restore health points as well.

Regarding the money system:

Silver is used as currency in this game. Silver can be used to cover expenses that arise during gameplay. Expenses are divided into two categories: mandatory expenses and optional expenses. If you lack sufficient silver for a mandatory expense, one health point will be deducted as an alternative.

Silver can be used to purchase items. Some of these items may help you achieve a good ending, while others may be completely useless. For example, you can use silver to buy strategy kits, but the hints inside may merely provide supplementary story information—they may not help you distinguish between good and bad NPCs, nor will they tell you how to deal with them. Of course, strategy kits may also provide useful hints, and it can be assured that they will never deliberately mislead the Emissary.

Commissioned by the Righteous Army — an assembly of righteous men and women from across the land — and acting under the decree of the "Order of Ten," the Emissary arrives in this nation: the Kingdom of Qian. Overwhelmed by excessive greed, the Kingdom of Qian has fallen into the demonic path. Its people pursue profit maximization above all else, treating friends, neighbors, and even their own flesh and blood as commodities to be sold to the highest bidder. Here, what is sold is not only freedom and dignity — the human body itself, under the name "spirit soul," has also been added to the list of goods.

The "Order of Ten" is this kingdom's last chance. The Emissary must infiltrate the nation in secret, searching for the remaining traces of justice and kindness. If he can find them, then this land will be given an opportunity to reform. If not, what awaits the Kingdom of Qian is nothing but —

annihilation.

store_data.about_the_game:
Tyreman is a chaotic physics-based co-op platformer. Roll, bounce and ram your way past all obstacles either solo or with friends. Explore a trap-filled secret world to hunt easter eggs, discover shortcuts and beat your personal best times. Dodge pitfalls, falling boulders and unexpected hazards, climb the path to divinity and become the TyreGod!

This is a game about tires with legs constantly climbing upwards. Traveling through a world full of absurdity and surprise, mastering one's own way of moving forward through repeated failures, rollovers, and falls. In this nonsensical journey, you may discover secret passages, strange Easter eggs, and even some familiar tributes. Continue upwards until you reach the location of the gods.

Embark on a tire adventure alone or in collaboration with friends (local or online)! Traverse multiple regions with distinct styles and challenge levels filled with mechanisms and hidden content. Explore hidden Easter eggs, dig through speed routes, and constantly improve skills through repeated attempts. Starting from a regular tire rolling, eventually becoming the legendary TyreGod!

store_data.about_the_game:
Ghost Tomb is an immersive interactive movie game. Players take on the role of delivery guy Zhang Buer, returning to a eerie ancient village and getting trapped in tomb secrets, paranormal events and Taoist conflicts. With real video performance, you make choices at key plot points to diverge the story and unlock multiple endings. Encounter the mysterious fox spirit Ji Ling, ambiguous Taoists and weird villagers, uncover the hidden truth of King Zhou’s imperial tomb, half jade key and three sects’ scramble for dragon aura, and decide the fate of yourself, villagers’ souls and the imperial luck.

Story Background

Before King Zhou of Shang passed away, he sealed the imperial dragon aura in his tomb and split the tomb key into two halves, one left to his descendant Zhang family and the other guarded by the nine-tailed celestial fox Su Daji. Thousands of years later, three evil Taoist sects coveted the imperial luck and laid a trap for Zhang Buer, the reincarnation of King Zhou. Five years ago, the ancient village was massacred by evil Taoists disguised as an archaeological team, who set up a fantasy realm after disturbing the tomb. Delivery guy Zhang Buer returns to the village summoned by his grandfather, trapped in paranormal weirdness. He meets amnesiac fox spirit Ji Ling, gets involved in the jade key scramble and tomb battle. Finally, his fate as the reincarnated emperor awakens, to confront evil sects and choose the destiny of mortal aura and mortal love.

Game Features

Item Collection

You can collect various items through different storylines and unlock corresponding achievements.

Save & Rewind

You may rewind to any previous progress at any time to search for clues.

Character Collection

Story progression is mainly achieved by unlocking and collecting different characters during the game.

Character Exploration

Interact with various characters in the game to uncover story details.

You can unlock cross-dimensional weapons including Desert Eagle, Gatling gun, Star Destroyer Cannon, Gundam, nuclear submarine and Ultraman light beam. In crisis, Lin Fan awakens the Faith & Military System, which allows him to exchange faith points for modern firearms, sci-fi mechas and ultimate divine weapons. Ordinary office worker Fang Tianming accidentally mutates into a harmless pink pig, yet unlocks the S-level touch-devouring superpower to swallow monsters and absorb their skills. When the doomsday comes, his ex-girlfriend and superior humiliate him recklessly, and his little sister is severely injured by monsters and possessed by demonic aura. Fang Tianming activates the doomsday survival system, meets Lei Yi female director Zhao Keke and healing girl Yan Xiaoting, and embarks on a journey of escape, monster hunting and revenge. There are four great demon lords: Greed, Anger, Delusion and Obsession. Gathering their cores can resurrect one person. He forms a team to fight the villain Tianba Squad and conquer demon territories, only to find his sister has become a new demon lord. The ultimate choice between blood relatives and all living beings unfolds.

Game Features

Item Collection

You can collect various items through different storylines and unlock corresponding achievements.

Save & Rewind

You may rewind to any previous progress at any time to search for clues.

Character Collection

Story progression is mainly achieved by unlocking and collecting different characters during the game.

Character Exploration

Interact with various characters in the game to uncover story details.
store_data.short_description: Magic Pig is a FMV. You act Fang Tianming survive in desperate situations. Every key choice you make changes the plot direction. Whether you guard your family and keep your original heart or be swallowed by power and fall into darkness depends on your choices.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to a realistic orbital mechanics sandbox set entirely within our solar system. In this simulator, space is a dynamic fabric governed by the laws of real-world physics. From basic Newtonian orbits to the complexities of Einstein’s theories of relativity, every trajectory is bound by the actual equations that dictate the universe.

You begin your journey already in orbit around Earth. There are no launch sequences or atmospheric escapes to manage. Instead, you immediately take control of your craft in the vacuum of space, pushing your navigation skills to the absolute edge as you master the mechanics of relativity.

Not a Standard Space Game

Navigating between celestial bodies requires more than just pointing your ship at a planet and pressing forward. Unlike typical space games where travel is immediate or linear, moving through this solar system demands a true understanding of orbital mechanics and general relativity. To move from Earth to targets like Jupiter or Mars, you must carefully plot multi-stage trajectories that account for orbital speeds and gravitational pulls. Executing precise slingshot maneuvers and calculating exact insertion burns are the only ways to reach your destination. One decimal point out of place will sling your craft into the deep void.

True Relativistic Physics

Velocity changes your entire reality. As your vessel approaches a fraction of the speed of light while moving through the solar system, you will witness relativistic effects firsthand.

  • Time Dilation: Watch planetary orbits accelerate around you while your onboard clock slows down. A few minutes of high-velocity travel for you could mean months or years passing for the rest of the solar system.

  • Length Contraction: See the physical geometry of space compress along your line of travel, requiring precise calculations to avoid missing your orbital targets.

store_data.about_the_game:
EXPERIENCE THE ROMANCE AND AGONY OF BEING AN ORDER PICKER!

You are a newly minted "partner" of the giant corporation Ultra Fast Fresh. Well, calling you a partner is a stretch... You're more like an efficient little cog in the machine, trapped in a franchise loan. At your disposal: a small, slightly gloomy warehouse hangar, a handheld laser scanner, and an endless stream of orders from both hungry customers and corporate management.

Your goal is to turn this chaos into a perfectly oiled mechanism, make a mountain of cash, and... avoid going completely bankrupt at midnight when the corporation sends you the bill for the "privilege of breathing the brand's air."

GAME FEATURES:

  • 📦 True Warehouse Core Loop: Order boxes of groceries via your work laptop, stock them on shelves, and monitor inventory so your racks never go empty. Keeping your warehouse organized is the ultimate key to hyper-fast picking!

  • 📈 Every Day is a Challenge: Ultra Fast Fresh is absolutely thrilled to exploit your labor for corporate profit! Every workday brings a new mandatory task from upper management. Fail, and you'll face brutal fines. Succeed, and your reward is... even more tasks! Think keeping 10 different varieties of potatoes on your shelves is optional? Think again!

  • 🛒 Pure ASMR Gameplay: Indulge in crisp, highly satisfying, dopamine-inducing sounds. The sharp, satisfying "beep" of the laser scanner reading barcodes, the rustle of paper bags, and the thud of heavy boxes will help you forget all your stress (or add some fresh new panic!).

  • 🧊 Extreme Picking & Temperature Zones: Sticking to regular shelves is for casuals. Grab a bag and sprint into the massive industrial freezer to pick frozen goods! But you'd better hurry: your screen will quickly cover in frost, and the freezing temperature will serve as a cold reminder that your human resources are definitely limited.

  • ⏰ Midnight Hour of Reckoning: Time flies when you're rushing! At the end of the shift, the corporation will check your balance and forcefully deduct the franchise tax. Managed to stay in the green? Keep grinding! Ended up in the negative? You have exactly one day to fix your finances, or you're completely bankrupt.

  • 🤖 Automate the Routine: Tired of hauling heavy boxes from the delivery doors to the storage shelves all by yourself? Hire some warehouse assistants! Sure, they might not be the most experienced employees on the planet, but they can definitely take the tedious work of unloading shipments off your hands.

  • 🎨 DIY Renovations (Customization): Tired of drab gray concrete? Spend your hard-earned dollars on visually upgrading the darkstore! Swap out flooring materials and repaint the walls to create a cozy atmosphere in your workspace. The franchise is happy to let you browse the building materials catalog... but, of course, they won't reimburse you a single hard-earned cent.

store_data.about_the_game:
Life Memoirs is a realistic life simulation game focused on social change, personal growth, and the future of ordinary people.

Play as someone born in 2007 and experience an entire lifetime—from childhood to old age—in a world shaped by rapid technological and social transformation.

Face the challenges of education, career choices, relationships, family responsibilities, and aging. Live through major changes in modern Chinese society, from academic competition and workplace pressure to housing costs, economic uncertainty, and the rise of artificial intelligence.

Your journey is shaped by a dynamic attribute system including Intelligence, EQ, Health, Stress, and Wealth. Every decision matters. A small choice made at age 18 may trigger consequences decades later through the game's Butterfly Effect system.

Follow different life paths and social classes. Become a civil servant, engineer, entrepreneur, office worker, skilled technician, or countless other roles. Your abilities, opportunities, and decisions determine where you end up.

As the timeline advances, the world evolves alongside you. Industries rise and disappear. AI reshapes the job market. New technologies create opportunities for some and challenges for others. Different careers and social groups will experience the future in very different ways.

When your life finally comes to an end, the game will review your journey and generate a unique personal ending based on the choices you made.

Every life is different.

What will yours become?

store_data.about_the_game:
Arctic Surrender

On a melting coast where every promise has a price, choose the one line you're willing to cross.

Arctic Surrender is an Adult Romance Visual Novel set on the frozen (and rapidly thawing) edge of East Greenland, where an American consortium is racing to build a deepwater port and military airfield before the freeze closes in. You play as Soren Vinter, the project director holding the entire season together with deadlines, concrete, and sheer will, while the ground beneath the site shifts and the moral ground beneath him collapses. As blockades harden, data resurfaces, and old wounds reopen, one impossible night forces a choice between three women, each tied to the project's fate in a different way.

Meet the Cast



Ivalu Lund - The Land's Voice
A Greenlandic Inuit environmental lawyer and the unyielding face of Sermivik's resistance, Ivalu is fighting for a headland her family has lived from for nine generations. She demands the real word, the real cost, the real consent, and Soren is the kind of enemy she can't afford to understand. Their connection is a forbidden intimacy across a barricade.


Esme Calder - The Glaciologist
A quiet, formidable scientist whose ten-thousand-year ice record helped make the project possible, and the widow of Tomas Calder, the chief engineer who died on Soren's watch. Her data may condemn the very ground the consortium is betting on. Drawn together by grief, guilt, and a shared ghost, Esme and Soren step into a romance shadowed by loyalty to the dead.


Sigrid Dahl - The Lead Engineer
A world-class structural engineer flown in to save a slipping build, and the woman Soren was once engaged to, before the same fight destroyed them: his deadline versus her safety factor. She refuses to sign off on anything she can't stand on, professionally or personally. Their route is a second chance under floodlights and freeze dates.

Key Features

  • A single, decisive branching choice that locks your romance route.
  • Three high-stakes romance routes: forbidden by faction, second chance, and widow's confidant.
  • A grounded "procedural" Arctic setting: construction milestones, permafrost failures, council votes, and buried reports.
  • Themes with teeth: melting time, consent and sovereignty, safety versus schedule, grief versus desire.
  • Endings that don't flinch: the season closes, the camp demobilizes, and the project rolls on.

Adult Content

Arctic Surrender contains explicit sexual content. Each of the three romance routes includes explicit adult scenes. The game also features strong language and mature themes including grief, death, guilt, and political conflict over land and consent. Player discretion is advised.

store_data.about_the_game:
COOK & CLICK

Welcome to the Kitchen Grind

Cook & Click is an idle/clicker game where you run a bustling culinary empire. Start by chopping ingredients one click at a time, unlock new recipes, hire chefs to automate production, and expand to multiple locations across the globe. Watch your restaurant chain grow while you progress through an addictive cycle of clicking, earning, and upgrading.

CORE GAMEPLAY

Chopping & Harvesting Click to chop ingredients and earn money. Each completed dish gives you immediate rewards. As you progress, the game continues working for you even when you're not clicking—the true essence of an idle game.

Five Ingredient Categories Master five distinct ingredient families:

  • Vegetables (Onion, Tomato, Pepper, Carrot, Cucumber, Garlic)

  • Fruits (Apple, Lemon, Watermelon, Strawberry, Banana, Pineapple)

  • Fish (Shrimp, Salmon, Octopus, Blowfish, Shark, Crab)

  • Meats (Chicken, Steak, Burger, Ribs, Sausage, Bacon)

  • Pastries (Muffin, Croissant, Cookie, Donut, Chocolate, Wedding Cake)

PROGRESSION SYSTEMS

Unlock & Ascend Unlock new ingredients by spending earnings. Each category has a "seal" requirement—unlock all 6 ingredients in a category to earn its seal and unlock the next tier. It's a gradual climb with clear milestones.

Prestige & Expansion After reaching certain thresholds, open new restaurant locations. Each location resets your progress but grants permanent prestige points that boost your overall earning power permanently.

Skill Tree Unlock a golden skill tree with passive and active abilities that enhance your production, increase earnings, and unlock new mechanics. Skills stack for exponential growth.

AUTOMATION & UPGRADES

Hire Chefs Recruit automated chefs (20 levels) who work for you continuously. Each level improves their efficiency exponentially.

Enhance Your Tools Purchase upgrades:

  • Market Price Boosts — Increase the base reward per ingredient (20 levels)

  • Sharpener — Temporarily boost all earnings by 2-4× for 30 seconds (with cooldown-free progression)

  • Combo Master — Chain manual clicks to unlock multipliers up to ×5 for 5 seconds

SPECIAL MECHANICS

Golden Ingredients Randomly, a golden variant of your current ingredient appears. Completing golden items gives 10× the normal reward but costs extra effort. Master them to maximize profits.

Daily Cycles Each workday lasts 5 minutes of real time. At day's end, receive a summary showing your earnings, milestones reached, and progress toward bonuses.

Lore & Narrative Experience quirky office-themed story moments as you grow your empire. Your boss calls at key milestones with absurd demands and encouragement.

ACHIEVEMENTS & GOALS

Over 73 achievements await, spanning ingredient mastery (100M cuts per ingredient), golden hunts (1M golden items), skill tree completion, and prestige milestones. Unlock them to enhance your bragging rights and track your progress.

FEATURES

✓ No Pay-to-Win — All progression is achievable through play ✓ Idle-Friendly — Earn money and progress while you're away ✓ Deep Progression — 100+ hours of meaningful content ✓ 14 Languages — Play in your preferred language ✓ Cloud Saves — Your progress syncs across devices ✓ Offline Support — Keep earning even without internet

THE GRIND AWAITS

Cook & Click is for players who love watching numbers climb, optimizing strategies, and experiencing the satisfying progression of an idle game mixed with active clicking mechanics. Whether you're here for 5 minutes or 100 hours, there's always something to unlock, improve, and master.

Ready to build your culinary empire? Let's get chopping!

Unlock & Ascend Unlock new ingredients by spending earnings. Each category has a "seal" requirement—unlock all 6 ingredients in a category to earn its seal and unlock the next tier. It's a gradual climb with clear milestones.

Prestige & Expansion After reaching certain thresholds, open new restaurant locations. Each location resets your progress but grants permanent prestige points that boost your overall earning power permanently.

Skill Tree Unlock a golden skill tree with passive and active abilities that enhance your production, increase earnings, and unlock new mechanics. Skills stack for exponential growth.

AUTOMATION & UPGRADES

Hire Chefs Recruit automated chefs (20 levels) who work for you continuously. Each level improves their efficiency exponentially.

Enhance Your Tools Purchase upgrades:

  • Market Price Boosts — Increase the base reward per ingredient (20 levels)

  • Sharpener — Temporarily boost all earnings by 2-4× for 30 seconds (with cooldown-free progression)

  • Combo Master — Chain manual clicks to unlock multipliers up to ×5 for 5 seconds

SPECIAL MECHANICS

Golden Ingredients Randomly, a golden variant of your current ingredient appears. Completing golden items gives 10× the normal reward but costs extra effort. Master them to maximize profits.

Daily Cycles Each workday lasts 5 minutes of real time. At day's end, receive a summary showing your earnings, milestones reached, and progress toward bonuses.

Lore & Narrative Experience quirky office-themed story moments as you grow your empire. Your boss calls at key milestones with absurd demands and encouragement.

ACHIEVEMENTS & GOALS

Over 73 achievements await, spanning ingredient mastery (100M cuts per ingredient), golden hunts (1M golden items), skill tree completion, and prestige milestones. Unlock them to enhance your bragging rights and track your progress.

FEATURES

✓ No Pay-to-Win — All progression is achievable through play ✓ Idle-Friendly — Earn money and progress while you're away ✓ Deep Progression — 100+ hours of meaningful content ✓ 14 Languages — Play in your preferred language ✓ Cloud Saves — Your progress syncs across devices ✓ Offline Support — Keep earning even without internet

THE GRIND AWAITS

Cook & Click is for players who love watching numbers climb, optimizing strategies, and experiencing the satisfying progression of an idle game mixed with active clicking mechanics. Whether you're here for 5 minutes or 100 hours, there's always something to unlock, improve, and master.

Ready to build your culinary empire? Let's get chopping!

Deep inside the most secure vault waits the Golden Egg. Peck it down, crack it open, claim your prestige reward, and start again stronger than before.

Safe Quacker is a cute 3D incremental heist game where you play as a sneaky little duck breaking into vault rooms, pecking piles of loot, grabbing treasure, and upgrading yourself into the ultimate feathered criminal mastermind.

Genre

Business Simulation · Tycoon · Management

About the Game

European Seafreight Tycoon is a business simulation where you build your own maritime freight company and develop it into one of Europe's leading logistics providers.

Start with a small fleet and operate your first routes between European ports. Transport containers, vehicles, raw materials, and specialized cargo across the North Sea, Baltic Sea, Mediterranean Sea, and Atlantic coast. Expand your network, invest in new vessels, and gradually unlock larger markets.

From regional coastal connections to Europe's most important trade routes, the future of your company is in your hands.

Gameplay

Plan profitable shipping routes between real European port cities, manage your fleet, and optimize vessel utilization. Monitor fuel prices, port fees, and operating costs while expanding your business opportunities.

As your company grows, you can connect additional ports, acquire larger ships, and gradually build a Europe-wide maritime logistics network.

Key Features

• Dynamic freight market with changing transport contracts
• Real European ports and trade routes
• Build and manage your own fleet of vessels
• Strategic route and capacity planning
• Business management with cost control and monthly accounting
• Port and fleet management systems
• Company expansion through new locations and trade connections

Development Status

European Seafreight Tycoon is actively being developed.

New ships, ports, cargo types, and management systems are added regularly. Community feedback plays a direct role in shaping the future development of the game.

The goal is to continuously expand the game with additional ports, vessel classes, features, and gameplay systems over time.

Notice

European Seafreight Tycoon is under continuous development. Content, systems, and balancing may change throughout future updates.

store_data.about_the_game:
What are these symbols?

NOT Math Puzzle is a Sokoban puzzle game featuring blocks marked with mysterious symbols like 0123456789 and +-×÷. Your goal is to clear each level by pushing the blocks to targets with matching symbols.

Generate New Symbols!

These symbols seem to follow certain rules. Line them up according to those rules, add a powered "=" at the very end, and a new symbol block is generated from the "="!

But what exactly are these rules...? ...Wait! You already know them? Well, that makes things a lot easier!

This generation system is at the heart of the game, offering incredible freedom! As long as you have the symbols on the level, you can create anything: 1+1, 4-19, 21÷3, or even 999×999!

How you use the results is entirely up to you. Generate a target symbol that's missing from the level, or solve massive equations just to get extra blocks to move around. Even a used-up "=" might come in handy later...

This is "NOT" Math Puzzle

Don't worry if seeing all these math symbols gives you an allergic reaction! This game doesn't feature puzzles centered around math skills.

The math blended into this Sokoban puzzle demands entirely new uses and techniques—and they are highly unmathematical. Experience a side of math you've never seen before: use just a specific symbol from a calculation result, or leverage the momentum of a block being generated!

Other Highlights

  • Every symbol in the game is within the scope of compulsory education.

  • Equations have hidden mechanics. Find them, and you might just use them to your advantage!

  • Over 200 levels packed with fresh ideas!

  • Multiple worlds and unique music themes!

  • What exactly lies at the end of unmath?

  • If you ever find an equation that breaks math... you definitely shouldn't make it. DEFINITELY.

store_data.about_the_game:
Created as a compact and physical VR experience, I’m Having a Bad Day is a cartoon-style game built around a simple idea: breaking things can be fun.

You play as a contestant in a fictional reality show set across different environments. The goal is simple: smash, dismantle, and create as much controlled chaos as possible within a short time limit.

Objects react with exaggerated cartoon physics and clear visual feedback. Power-ups, such as oversized tools or jelly weapons, temporarily shift the pace and encourage different approaches to destruction.

While the game is not designed as a fitness experience, you may find that after demolishing a couple of environments you feel unexpectedly energized especially after a long or stressful day.

I’m Having a Bad Day is a straightforward, physics-driven VR game built around short bursts of action and repeatable levels, created for players who enjoy quick sessions and physical interaction in virtual space.

store_data.about_the_game:
Slop Slop

The swamp is hungry. The hut demands tribute. And you? You're just trying to survive.

Slop Slop is a co-op survival game for up to 8 players. Each day, a mysterious hut in the swamp demands a new offering of food. Fail to deliver, and… well, let's just say the swamp doesn't do eviction notices.

☀️ By day, scavenge the swamp for whatever slop the hut craves. Explore randomly generated levels, uncover strange mysteries, and try not to wander too far from your friends.

🌙 By night, everything gets worse. If you're not back at the hut by sundown, the creatures come out — and they hit hard. Still out when night ends? You're dead. No refunds.

🎙️ Talk it out — location-based voice chat means you can only hear teammates nearby. Screaming for help is encouraged but may not reach anyone.

👥 Bring friends — host a game directly from your machine. No servers, no matchmaking queues, no excuses. Just you, your friends, and a very demanding hut.

The difficulty escalates. The swamp gets stranger. The hut gets hungrier.

Good luck out there. You'll need it.

Use your time-bending ability to dodge projectiles and invisibility to completely hide from the enemy and survive the onslaught. Remember that special powers deplete energy quickly, so use them wisely.

store_data.about_the_game:
Matadors is a multiplayer bullfighting game. Players can play as a matador or a bull. The most basic goal of the matador is to avoid bull attacks and survive. The goal of the bulls is to hit the matador as much as possible.

Matador Gameplay

Matadors have certain special abilities in the game. These special abilities are obtained randomly by collecting boxes around. Special abilities like big jump, somersault, and dash can come out of these boxes. Additionally, matadors can have different roles. These roles are distributed randomly at the start of each round. The Gunner role can slow down bulls thanks to the pause gun they have. Gun ammo comes from the boxes. At the same time, the Trapper role can slow down the bull in a similar way by placing traps. Each of these actions is written as a plus point to the matador team.

Another way for matadors to collect points is to escape from the attacks of the bulls. If the bulls miss them very closely with their special abilities or clever moves, they win points. In addition, matadors can earn points by collecting certain objects from around.

Bull Gameplay

The main purpose of the bulls in the game is simple and clear. They need to eliminate as many matadors as possible within a round. Also, they need to be careful against the sneaky moves of the matadors and not let them earn points. If the matadors reach a higher score than the bulls by the end of the round (or up to the score limit in other game modes), the bulls lose the game. For this reason, besides the simplicity of the gameplay, bulls must always be on alert.

General Gameplay

Players create or join a room. According to the host's preference, roles (matador / bull) are determined randomly or preferentially. Choices such as round time, winning condition, game type, and map selection are also made by the host. Matadors and Bulls try to collect as many points as possible. Also, when the game is launched, more than one game mode will be completed (like capture the flag) and the host will make adjustments. A minimum of 3-5 players is recommended for a fun experience.

store_data.about_the_game:
A Golden Age Whodunnit Wrapped in Noir and Neon Step into the silk shoes of sharp-witted beat reporter Birdie Malone as she goes deep undercover as glamorous Hollywood icon Clara Bow.

The stage is set at Stonecliff Manor, the palatial, cliffside Californian retreat of eccentric billionaire Xavier Montague Stone and his dazzling starlet wife, Vera. Under the cover of a lavish high-society masquerade, Birdie must infiltrate this elite gathering to stop a masked culprit from stealing The Dragon Blossom, a priceless and legendary artifact. But when the coastal fog rolls in and the lights go out, a high-stakes heist quickly spirals into a web of deception, blackmail, and danger.

In the glitzy underbelly of 1930s Hollywood, everyone has a secret, a motive, and a mask to hide behind. Can you unmask the thief before the curtain falls, or will you become the next headline?

Uncover the Truth Among Hollywood Royalty

To solve the mystery, you’ll have to outsmart, interrogate, and navigate a glittering rogue's gallery of suspects, including:

  • Joanna Wong & Carlos Gabriel: Breathtaking silver-screen stars whose glamorous personas hide fierce rivalries and desperate secrets.

  • Georgia P. Walker: The fabulously wealthy and immensely influential power-broker who holds the strings to half the studios in town.

  • Teresa: A sharp-witted, cynical screenwriter who knows exactly how classic tragedies end—and might be writing this one in real-time.

  • Max: A recently defeated boxer with bruised pride, a desperate need for a comeback, and a short fuse.

  • ...and an elite guest list of power players, each with a reason to want The Dragon Blossom for themselves.

Key Features & Gameplay

  • Classic Point-and-Click Adventure: Built on the foundation of retro adventure gaming, experience an intuitive point-and-click interface featuring deep inventory puzzles, environmental exploration, and classic room interactions.

  • Investigative Noir Mechanics: Gather clues, cross-examine eccentric suspects, and piece together evidence. Use your journalistic wit to catch characters in lies, break their alibis, and untangle the mystery of Stonecliff Manor.

  • A Striking Early 20th Century Aesthetic: Immerse yourself in a visually stunning world inspired by the height of the Art Deco movement. Featuring bold architectural motifs, moody 1930s Noir lighting, and a distinct, hand-crafted illustration style reminiscent of golden-age magazine masterpieces.

  • Explore Stonecliff Manor: Navigate a lavish, atmospheric coastal estate filled with hidden passages, cryptic safes, and high-society glamour. Every room is a puzzle, and every guest is keeping a secret.

  • Period-Accurate Atmosphere: Submerge yourself in the era with a cinematic, jazz-infused soundtrack and sharp, witty dialogue that captures the fast-talking spirit of classic mystery cinema.

store_data.about_the_game:
An ordinary shift turns into a nightmare with a single unexpected message on your phone. You are the chief of a mine with a dark, deep-rooted past. Your normal daily texts with your family are suddenly interrupted by a mysterious stranger named "Shadow," plunging you into a psychological thriller.

AI-Powered Dynamic Conversations There are no fixed, pre-written dialogue options here! Powered by advanced AI technology, you can type whatever you want and text naturally with the characters. Try to calm your worried wife while negotiating with the sinister figure who is cornering you. Every character reacts to your exact words dynamically.

Moral Dilemmas and Tough Choices "Shadow" knows a lot about you. Worse, they hold the keys to the dark historical tragedies and legends buried deep within the mine. But uncovering these secrets comes with a horrifying price: you must fulfill unethical and dangerous demands, such as deliberately sending sick workers or those without helmets into the mine.

Uncover a Historical Mystery If you bow to the stranger's deadly demands, the forgotten pages of the past will unfold. Piece by piece, you will learn the chilling truths behind the historical accidents and legends that haunt the mine.

Will you disregard the lives of your workers to unearth historical secrets, or will you choose the path of righteousness? Your phone is buzzing... You have a new message.

store_data.about_the_game:
A steamer that lives on your desktop

Dumpling Squishy isn't a window you open and close. It's a little bamboo steamer that floats on top of everything you do. Give it a tap and warm, squishy dumplings tumble out, bounce, and pile up right on your desktop. They squish against each other with soft, satisfying physics and just... hang out. While you answer emails. While you code. While you do absolutely nothing at all.

Tap. Squish. Collect.

Every tap is a tiny gift. Dumplings drop in four rarities: [b]Common[/b], [b]Rare[/b], [b]Epic[/b], and the elusive [b]Legendary[/b]. Each one wears its own randomly chosen little face. There are [b]50 unique dumplings[/b] to discover, and that "one more tap" feeling never quite lets go.

Trade up to the good stuff

Got a pile of duplicates? Don't sweat it. Exchange ten dumplings of the same rarity for a single dumpling of the next tier up. Steady tapping turns into Commons, Commons turn into Rares, and the dream of a complete Legendary set is always one trade away.

It fits into your day, not the other way around

  • Always there, never in the way. The overlay is click-through by default, so your dumplings sit on your screen without blocking a single click.

  • Wallpaper mode. Tuck the whole pile behind your windows and let them squish quietly in the background.

  • Truly idle. No timers, no pressure, no daily login nag. Tap when you feel like it. Come back to a desktop full of dumplings.

  • Soft and squishy by design. Gentle physics, cozy art, and sound made just for the moment of the squish.

Made to feel good

No microtransactions. No energy bars. No FOMO. Just a warm little steamer, a growing pile of impossibly cute dumplings, and the simple joy of collecting them all.

Play in English or 繁體中文.

store_data.about_the_game:
Deep Drill Simulator is a co-op steampunk simulation game focused on managing a massive underground drilling machine.

Players work together inside a complex system-based vehicle where every role matters. One player may monitor the radar system to track underground ores, while another controls drilling direction, another manages resource transfer between storage systems, and others focus on repairing damaged pipes and critical machine components.

⚙️ CORE GAME SYSTEMS

🎯 Radar-based ore tracking system
⛏️ Drilling direction control
📦 Resource transfer between temporary and main storage
🔧 Real-time machine repair system (pipes, damage, systems)
💰 Dynamic economy with changing ore prices
🛠️ Upgrade system for machine performance

💀 SURVIVAL SYSTEM

The expedition ends if:

  • Fuel runs out deep underground

  • The machine suffers critical structural damage

  • Players fail to manage systems efficiently during descent

Every run is a high-risk underground operation where coordination and system management are key to survival.

🔩 UPGRADE SYSTEM

Players use earned resources to upgrade:

  • Drill speed

  • Fuel capacity & efficiency

  • Machine durability

  • Storage capacity

  • Collection range & speed

  • Radar range

  • Ore filtering systems

🌍 ATMOSPHERE

Set in a steampunk industrial underground world, Deep Drill Simulator focuses on tension, coordination, and system management inside a massive machine.

CATCH THE CLOWN is a surrealist "action real-time-strategy" adventure set within a hostile 90s art program.

It is inspired by classic software like Mario Paint, KidPix, and Desktop Destroyer. The gameplay during battles is a frantic push-and-pull between order and chaos. It could be described as "Fruit Ninja meets Trauma Center, but it's also somehow a tower defense game? Yes, I shrugged while saying that." Place your different tools in the canvas area to attack enemies, such as the Lighter and Knife Tool. Defend your precious Heart from incoming attacks using the Bubble Wand and other defense-oriented tools.

Experience a story about breaking out from the abusive, rotten system we're trapped in together. Join the heroes Dot, Dash, G, and Dog. Meet other characters along the way, each with their own inner complexities and strong personalities. Follow your heart.

Title: One in 20,000 Raindrops

Genre: Visual novel

・Synopsis

Satoshi Kuga, who leads an isolated high school life with a cynical attitude, is dreading the school trip starting tomorrow. This is because he has been assigned to the same group as the popular clique in his class, who are enjoying their youth to the fullest. However, it seems there are hidden tensions within this seemingly close-knit group, and he gradually finds himself drawn into their problems.

・Game Overview

The scenario follows a linear path with no branching paths and can be completed in about two and a half hours. There are no character voices. A key feature of the game is that it progresses primarily through still images rather than using character sprites. (See screenshots)

store_data.about_the_game:
Supermarket Chaos is a cozy organizing simulator about calmly putting a chaotic supermarket back in order. Arrange 4,668 products across 16 sections, including fruit, tea, frozen foods, books, wine, ramen, and more, and enjoy the quiet satisfaction of making every shelf feel right.

〖A Relaxing Supermarket Organizing Simulator〗

One day, the store-organizing robot GPT-9000 reached a philosophical conclusion: “All positions are temporary, and all displays are violence.” As a result, every product in the supermarket lost its place. (Fortunately, he was fired immediately.)

No need to worry. Now all you have to do is walk through the quiet store and return each scattered product to its proper place.

〖When a Messy Store Falls Into Place〗

At first, the store is a little chaotic.
Empty shelves, products left on the floor, sections that still need attention.
But as you put each item back where it belongs, the store gradually becomes a clean, comfortable space.

〖Pick Up Products, Find Their Sections, and Put Them in Place〗

Pick up each product, find the right section, and match it to the correct price tag.
Instead of rushing, settle into the rhythm of organizing and take your time completing the store.

〖One Completed Section, One Quiet Satisfaction〗

Empty shelves fill up with products, and mixed-up items settle into neat rows.
Each completed section brings visible progress and a quiet sense of satisfaction.

〖Skill Upgrades〗

Unlock and upgrade a variety of skills as you play.
Carry more products, find the spots you need more easily, and make the whole organizing process smoother and more efficient.

〖Key Features〗

  • A cozy organizing simulation where you sort more than 4,000 products

  • 16 sections including fruit, tea, frozen foods, books, wine, ramen, and more

  • Gameplay focused on checking item names and locations, then placing them where they belong

  • The visual satisfaction of watching the store become cleaner and cleaner

  • A variety of skill upgrades for movement, carrying, searching, and more

  • No time limits and no game over. A relaxed, low-pressure atmosphere you can enjoy at your own pace

store_data.about_the_game:
Covet the Countdown

You are Emmett Doyle, Lodestar Aerospace's battle-hardened Mission Director -- "the man in the chair" responsible for the final go/no-go on a rebuilt private rocket racing a Mars transfer window that won't wait. The last campaign ended in a pad explosion, an empty console seat, and a dead technician whose name Emmett refuses to let anyone erase -- while a crypto billionaire's money pushes the schedule toward liftoff anyway.

Over one relentless night, three women collide with Emmett's countdown. Choose who gets your time, your trust, and the truth -- because in a launch campaign, every relationship is a burn, every confession has a cost, and the window closes whether you're ready or not.

Meet the Cast

Devon Carrow -- The Fixer


Devon is the crisis-management principal flown in to protect the mission's optics and keep the board from panicking -- polished, controlled, and dangerously good at making disasters disappear. Emmett is the wrong kind of client: he won't follow her scripts, won't stop saying the dead technician's name, and won't accept a survivable lie. Her route is a romance of power and truth, where the woman who owns the narrative risks becoming someone who can't hide behind it anymore.

Tessa Cho -- The Trajectory Lead


At 29, Tessa holds the mission's true steering wheel: the math that makes the free-return to Mars possible. Emmett pulled her from a junior seat and made her indispensable -- then spent years pretending their connection was only work, even as the lines blurred at 4 a.m. over stubborn burn solutions. Her route is a slow-burn collision of ambition, grief, and desire.

Calla Reyes -- The Commander


Calla is Lodestar's best pilot -- sharp, disciplined, and furious at the way money bought her mission's command title out from under her. She and Emmett share a decade-old fracture: she once refused a risky "go," he cleared it anyway, and she paid the price while he climbed. Their route is a hostile reunion where chemistry predates the grudge, and where trust has to be rebuilt like the rocket itself.

Key Features

  • A single, high-stakes branching choice that launches you into one of three distinct romance routes.
  • A grounded, cinematic spaceflight setting: control rooms, simulators, tracking stations, and floodlit pads.
  • Three romance dynamics: a hostile reunion with a commander, mentor/mentee tension with a prodigy, and a verbal war with a fixer who controls the narrative.
  • Earned endings with an honest price tag: clean launches, career fallout, and reputations burned.
  • Each romance route includes explicit adult scenes.

Content

This game is an adult romance visual novel intended for mature audiences (18+). It contains explicit sexual content in every route, strong romantic themes, and story elements involving workplace power dynamics, public scandal, and references to a fatal accident and ongoing investigation.

store_data.about_the_game:
Start your journey in a new neighborhood

You are a skilled carpenter with a dream of building your own shop peacefully. Renting your first workshop in a promising new district, you set out to earn a living by taking customer orders, measuring their required furniture specs manually, buying wood and cutting it in the required specs.

The peace doesn't last long

Business is booming, but your success hasn't gone unnoticed. A local gang emerges from the shadows, demanding a fee for the right to work on their area. When you refuse to pay for your own freedom, the neighborhood turns against you.

Build your defense

Your workshop is no longer just for woodcraft—it’s now your fortress. Invest your earnings in buying weapons and ammunition, and beware, they might come anytime. you’ll be ready to show them that this carpenter knows how to handle more than just a hammer.

Survive and thrive

  • Master your craft: Take precise measurements and satisfy your clients.

  • Defend your turf: Turn your workshop into an impenetrable stronghold against waves of enemies.

  • Live the life: you can eat, sleep, work and live your normal life while the gang is away.

Will you pay them, or will you fight back? The choice is yours.

GAMEPLAY FEATURES

  • Player shop in which player works as a carpenter and prepare customer areas

  • Measurement system that player needs to use to be able to meet the requirements of customers' orders

  • Wood cutting system based on player's measurements

  • Realistic work system: player needs to note down all measurements before starting the work on the order

  • Realistic economy system: using already cut wood for new jobs will help making profit

  • Driving system to deliver quest requirements to customers houses

  • Two small Neighborhoods that have shops and customers houses, player can visit those, buy his shop requirements and complete quests inside customer houses

  • Day / night cycle and player hunger system

  • Local gang that player have to survive their attacks 

  • Arms dealer that player can buy a gun and ammo to resist the gang attacks

  • As you find secrets and complete achievements, you unlock special weapons, items, and characters

store_data.about_the_game:
The world is dying in agony. Days grow darker, nights stretch into endless voids, and humanity’s time is running out. Our only chance for survival is migration to the Taurus Constellation. Welcome to the absolute bullet hell. You are a lone pilot fighting through relentless enemy armadas to secure our tomorrow.

RIDE THE HYPE, UNLEASH HELL
A dark threat looms on the surface. A fanatical cult known as the "Apostles of Ash" believes humanity must perish in suffering. To crush them, you must master the Dynamic Hype Bar. Aggressive, high-octane gameplay fills your meter to the reactively adaptive soundtrack. When the beat drops, enter Overdrive. Transform the battlefield into a literal hellscape of explosions, lasers, and particle storms to obliterate those who block our survival.

DEEP SYNERGY & MYSTICAL TECHNOLOGY
Scientists engineered a mystical plant capable of producing oxygen—the Aurum Spore—but it has fallen into the wrong hands. Reclaim it by configuring your ultimate fighter. Choose your ship and load it with an arsenal of modules. Discover hidden, devastating synergies between weapons, shields, and tactical drives. Turn standard laser modules into screen-clearing superweapons to match your unique playstyle.

CONQUER THE TAURUS CONSTELLATION
Ancient biomechanical entities have awakened and stolen human tech. Join the Taurus Alliance—a coalition of scientists, pilots, and survivors—and fight the final battle for existence. Battle through distinct planetary systems, face off against massive multi-stage bosses, and claim their tech to carry the human lineage into eternity.

PREPARE FOR WAR (Upcoming Multiplayer/PvP)
Upgrade your fleet and prepare to test your custom-built fighters against real players. Climb the ranks, challenge rival pilots, steal their badges, and dominate the galaxy in aggressive asynchronous PvP arenas.

Key Features:

  • Fast-Paced Arcade Action: Fluid, 60-FPS top-down dogfights requiring split-second reflexes.

  • The Overdrive System: A unique, adrenaline-based combat multiplier that rewards aggressive play.

  • Endless Builds: Dozens of modules and ship stats that interact in unexpected, devastating ways.

  • Intense Boss Fights: Epic, multi-stage boss encounters that will test your loadout and your patience.

  • Stunning Visuals: High-contrast sci-fi environments, immersive lighting, and satisfying "juice" in every explosion.
