store_data.about_the_game:
Overview:

In the future, a massive space station suffers a disaster. You play as a scientist whose ship crashes into the station. Once, you were studying alien life, but now those creatures have escaped and turned hostile. The station is crawling with enemies, and your job is to clear it room by room until all the enemies are gone. Each room is a new level, with layouts, enemies, and obstacles that change every time you play. Some enemies rush you, others hide and hunt. This makes combat fast and dynamic. Fight through the stations and gain upgrades to descend to the planet and destroy the source of the outbreak!
Cleanup Crew is a top-down sci-fi roguelite shooter where you clean up procedurally generated stations room by room, collecting upgrades and pushing deeper. you then descend to the alien planets below to destroy the outbreak at its source.

Gameplay

Each run begins on the station, which is divided into a series of rooms with randomly arranged layouts, obstacles, and enemies. Clearing every enemy in a room rewards you with one upgrade, chosen at random that range from boosting your health, damage, fire rate, armor, movement speed, and more. Upgrades carry over between rooms and stations, You'll need to stack them as high as you can before tackling what waits at the end.

Enemies

Four enemy types populate the station and the planets, each requiring a different approach:

  • Chasers rush you head-on and use pathfinding to navigate around furniture and debris.

  • Rangers keep their distance and fire homing projectiles that track your movement.

  • Turrets hold position and fire in cardinal and diagonal patterns, controlling large areas.

  • The Reaper a powerful boss that appears if you stall too long. In the final room, you must defeat it to advance.

Enemy health and fire rates scale with each room cleared, so the deeper you push, the harder the fight.

Who knows what the future holds...

Weapons

You start with the Zapper a reliable sidearm, but the station and planets hold seven more weapons to discover and earn:

  • Beam Rifle — rapid-fire with very quick projectile travel

  • Cryo Blaster: slows enemies' movement and fire rate on hit

  • Homing Dart: tracking projectiles that seek targets

  • Bounce Dart: ricochets off walls up to three times

  • Scatter Blaster: five-pellet spread for close-range suppression

  • Burst Pistol: three-shot burst with high per-burst damage

  • Plasma Charge: explosive AoE with a blast radius that damages clusters

New weapons are locked behind planet bosses and hidden vaults, with the rarest unlocks requiring completing the hardest difficulties.

Environmental Hazards

The station's air systems are still active and fragile. Rooms have live air pressure, and explosions can shatter windows, causing vacuum breaches. A broken window pulls air into space, and if pressure drops too low, you start losing oxygen. Players with an Air Tank upgrade can survive longer in depressurized areas; those without cannot.

Two types of explosive crates litter the environment: red crates detonate on damage, dealing blast damage and a shockwave that sends furniture and enemies flying; blue cryo crates detonate to slow every enemy in the blast radius. Both can be pushed with your melee broom and enemy shots can set them off too so be carful where you're standing! Your broom can also deflect enemy projectiles back at them and repair shattered windows.

Planet Missions

After clearing the support stations, you descend to one of three alien planets to strike at the source of the outbreak. Each planet is a handcrafted interconnected map with puzzle gates. You must gather codes, match colors, align symbols, and dial in frequencies to unlock the path to the boss arena. Defeat the planetary boss to earn a weapon upgrade and mark the outbreak zone neutralized. Conquer all three planets and see how many stations you can clean up!

Key Features at the moment

  • Procedurally generated room layouts with randomized enemy spawns every run

  • 11 stackable upgrades that persist throughout a full run

  • 8 weapons, most unlocked by difficulty-gated boss kills and hidden vaults

  • Live fluid-simulation air pressure with vacuum hazards and explosive shockwaves

  • 3 unique planet missions with puzzle-locked boss encounters

  • Scaling enemy difficulty the deeper you go, the harder the fight

  • Three difficulty settings Easy, Medium, and Hard each unlocking different weapons



    If you have read this far thank you for checking it out!

store_data.about_the_game:
This is the story of two losers with nothing to lose but their conscience—and even that's long gone.

The wooden Pinochet and his sidekick, the wolf Gloomy, live in a world where everyone they meet is a stranger, every old woman is armed, and any harmless request can end in an epilogue with your name on a tombstone. And so, when life has finally pushed them to the wall, the heroes hatch a brilliant plan: rob a post office. The plan is as simple as a felt boot, and the executors are even simpler.

You'll have to lead this duo through entryways, garages, underground clubs, and the apartments of people no one in their right mind would ever visit. You'll have to rip off their socks, knock out guns, search for bullets, and earn the job with your fists—all in the company of psychos, drug dealers, and veteran crocodiles. Chat, solve riddles, choose your blows in a fight, trust the wrong people, and make decisions you'll regret until the credits roll.

This isn't a game about kindness. It's a game about surviving among idiots while being an idiot yourself.

GAME FEATURES

Crazy characters. Every person you meet is a different diagnosis with a story you'd rather not hear, but you will.

Dialogues worth playing for. Lively swearing, absurd monologues, tales of the circus, Vietnam, and varnished bathtubs.

Choices decide everything. The wrong answer means instant death and a mocking epilogue. The right one means more problems.

Short-form episodes and challenges. Riddles, fights, bargaining with dealers—every episode breaks the fourth wall and common sense.

Old-school point-and-click. Dirty entryways, smoke-filled kitchens, rusty garages—an atmosphere you can smell through your monitor.

18+. Hardcore 18+. Dark humor, profanity, absurd violence, and a complete lack of political correctness. If you're looking for a feel-good fairy tale, you've come to the wrong door.

WARNING

The game contains profanity, dark humor, scenes of absurd violence, and references to alcohol. All characters are fictitious. Any similarities are purely coincidental. All claims are directed at Pinochet.

About Seeking Home

Strange machines have taken over a small town and the surrounding forest in northern Sweden. Navigate, explore and evade as Viji the cat, with the goal of reuniting her with her lost human.

Find out what really happened to the people of the town through details of the environment, flashbacks, and occasional perspective shifts to other characters who help Viji on her journey.

Seeking Home gameplay focuses on:

  • Exploration: Navigate through handcrafted environments using your senses.

  • Puzzle-Solving: Manipulate objects, find hidden triggers, deactivate traps, or create pathways.

  • Encounter: Utilize stealth and timing to avoid enemy detection and interact with helpful characters.

  • Story Progression: Uncover pieces of the game's narrative, piece by piece.

Seeking Home is in pre-development, driven by a passion for emotional storytelling and atmospheric worldbuilding. Inspired by the deep bond between humans and their pets, players uncover the mystery of a vanished society through the misty forests of northern Sweden. Our goal is to create an environment you want to stay in, with characters and relationships that feel genuine and memorable.

store_data.about_the_game:
Gravehollow is a pixel-art survival RPG set in a procedurally generated world where creatures and characters act independently of the player. Gather resources, craft equipment, build shelters, and fight to survive while exploring various biomes filled with danger and opportunity.

The world does not revolve around the player. Creatures hunt each other, hostile encounters can emerge unexpectedly, and wandering characters pursue their own goals as you carve out a place to survive.

Key Features

• Dynamic World Simulation
Creatures and characters hunt, fight, flee, sleep, and interact with the world independently.

• Survival, Crafting, and Building
Gather resources, learn recipes, craft equipment, construct shelters, and maintain the tools needed to stay alive.

• Real-Time Combat
Fight hostile creatures and agents using directional melee and ranged combat.

• Explore a Procedurally Generated World
Travel through detailed landscapes where every world offers new opportunities and dangers.

• Character Progression
Level up your survivor, equip new gear, improve your capabilities, and adapt to changing challenges.

• Dialogue and Encounters
Meet wandering characters, respond to threats, and interact with a world that continues whether you are present or not.

Step into a dark roguelike strategy experience where poker combinations become deadly weapons.

In every battle, carefully play your cards to create powerful hands such as Pairs, Straights, Flushes, and even stronger combinations. Crush your enemies with devastating effects, critical strikes, and powerful synergies.

Throughout each run, collect runes to continuously strengthen your character. Some builds focus on overwhelming attack power, while others revolve around life steal, armor generation, damage reflection, or devastating multi-hit chains. With the right combination of upgrades, even an ordinary deck can become powerful enough to break the game.

But every choice comes with a risk. As the creatures you face grow increasingly deadly, you must manage your resources wisely, choose your rewards carefully, and constantly adapt your build to survive.

Every run is different.

Every hand is a new strategy.

And a single mistake can bring everything to an end.

Features:

• Unique poker-based combat system

• Powerful rune synergies

• Diverse build options and playstyles

• Dark fantasy atmosphere and deadly creatures

• Freedom to create game-breaking combinations

• High replayability with ever-changing runs

The Fly’s Fantastic Adventure is a 2D run-and-gun platformer where you play as an innocent little fly who finds an unusual weapon: a fruit fly that shoots for him.

Run, jump, shoot, and fight your way through colorful worlds filled with strange enemies, tricky platforming, chaotic bosses, and plenty of insect-sized danger. store_data.about_the_game:
Become a manager. Build your squad. Activate synergies. Let your team do the talking.

BlipKick is a tactical football auto-battler where strategy happens before the whistle blows. Grow your squad by drafting players from a rotating shop, position them on the pitch, and combine the right players to unlock powerful synergies.

Each session is a 9-round battle against a rival manager. Every signing matters. Every position counts. Develop synergies like Tiki-Taka, Gegenpressing or Catenaccio to turn the tide, and use comeback gold to rebuild your squad after a tough round.

No direct control. No reflexes required. Just pure tactical depth with retro football soul. Every match is a different challenge, and the same solution rarely works twice.

Key features:

  • Draft and fuse players to build your ultimate squad

  • 9 tactical synergies inspired by real football philosophies

  • Fast matches — a full session in minutes

  • Pixel art aesthetic with classic football charm

  • Online 1v1 matchmaking

About This Game

A remote space station has fallen silent after a mysterious outbreak spread through its corridors. The remaining crew is missing, and infected creatures now roam the facility.

In Dead Station Together, you must recover DNA samples, uncover the truth behind the disaster, and rescue what remains of the crew before it's too late.

Play solo or team up with up to 4 players in a cooperative survival horror experience. Use your radar to locate objectives, explore dark sectors of the station, and fight your way through dangerous encounters using a variety of weapons, including shotguns, rifles, automatic firearms, and flamethrowers.

With multiple game modes, PvE and PvP gameplay, dynamic combat, and detailed enemy damage systems, every mission offers a new challenge.

store_data.about_the_game:
===================== The Story =====================

Your character is named Mason. After a tragic event, you wake up in the middle of the night unable to leave your room. Your computer screen lights up;

"Catch all of the anomalies and we will let you out"

Left with no other choice Mason boots up the first level.

===================== Character Controls =====================

W,A,S,D - Move

E - Basic Interactions

ESC - Opens your clipboard

===================== The Gameplay Loop =====================

Once a level is loaded up, there will be no anomalies present. Get used to the surrounding environment and once you're comfortable, use your clipboard to mark "No Anomalies" and click "Done, then Confirm". You will be sent back to the start of the level with the chance of an anomaly appearing. Be very careful, somethings might not actually be anomalies. If something disappears over time it is a false anomaly. 


Anomalies can appear in groups larger than 1, keep an eye out.

===================== Playtime =====================

The playtime depends on the player, submitting a wrong answer resets your progress for the run. Once you complete the level your game will save that data. Which will then unlock the next area and prompt the past level as "Completed"

store_data.about_the_game:
Think awakening superpowers means life on easy mode? Think again! Welcome to the bitter reality of a cross-border smuggler!

Right after finishing her internship, Qiqi's boss pulled a vanishing act. Now she's so broke she's selling her second-hand junk in Shenzhen's Huaqiangbei electronics market. Just when she thought she'd hit rock bottom, a mysterious app appears on her cheap, used phone: As long as you have a photo of a location in your gallery, you can teleport there instantly!

As a true otaku, a brilliant get-rich-quick scheme instantly flashed through her mind: "I'm going to Japan! To Akihabara! I'm going to scalp limited-edition anime figures!"

But this isn't some overpowered protagonist fantasy. It's an immersive, painfully realistic superpower slice-of-life simulator. In this ~3-hour light narrative experience, you'll join Qiqi on a hilariously absurd and nerve-wracking journey of cross-border daigou (surrogate shopping).

 Core Features:

The "Physical Cheat" Grind: Teleportation has its limits! To visit a new coordinate for the first time, you have to do it the hard way. Snatch up cheap flights, apply for visas, or take the high-speed rail to Chengdu, Beijing, Xi'an, and Shanghai to physically scout and unlock the map.

Hardcore Inventory Crisis: Your backpack isn't a bottomless pit! Face strict volume and weight limits. Do you stuff it with high-profit fragile goods, or pack self-defense gear for the back-alley thugs? Hustle for cash, upgrade your bag, and master extreme resource management.

Frantic Domestic Sourcing: Travel across the country in person just to hoard top-tier scalping goods! Sweep up wild mushrooms and panda plushies in Chengdu; grab "high-quality fake" Terracotta Warrior blind boxes in Xi'an; snag local specialties in Beijing, and return to Huaqiangbei to stock up on out-of-print electronic junk.

"Dead-on-Sight" Stealth Teleporting: Teleporting into a crowded shopping district in broad daylight? Warping into a restroom stall that's already occupied? If your power is exposed, the consequences are disastrous. Timing it perfectly and finding hidden corners is the golden rule of smuggler survival.

Tightrope Customs Interrogation—One Wrong Step and You're Done: You flew out with a ticket, but secretly teleported back home? Without an entry record, you face deadly random checks from customs! There are no forgiving "alert bars" here. Faced with interrogation, your bizarre excuses will only work two or three times. Once your logic crumbles and the smuggling is exposed, get ready for a "complimentary pair of silver bracelets" (handcuffs) or a "permanent visa ban" in a variety of spectacular Game Over endings.

Black Market Deals & Absurd Encounters: A crazy chef craving fresh Sichuan truffles, a Chinese mom missing hometown hotpot base, a secretive thrift store manager... Use dialogue choices to cater to their tastes and cover up the true origins of your goods with a hundred lies. Sell to the wrong country or the wrong person, and over 40 hilarious death endings await you!

An Ever-Expanding Global Hustle: Get your passport ready! You'll gradually unlock Tokyo, Japan, the flea markets of Paris, France, and the wild black markets of New York, USA!

store_data.about_the_game:
Fight. Loot. Grow. Repeat.

Step into the blood-soaked sands of the arena and carve your legend in **Gold & Glory**, a dark fantasy hack & slash incremental game where the fight never stops and the rewards never end.

Take control of a gladiator thrown into a merciless arena teeming with orcs, goblins, and creatures of the dark. Every swing of your blade brings gold, glory, and power. The more you fight, the stronger you become — and the stronger you become, the further you can push.

An Ever-Expanding Skill Tree

Unlock and upgrade a vast skill tree to shape your gladiator your way. Boost your damage, enhance your survivability, unlock devastating abilities, and discover powerful synergies that keep every run feeling fresh and rewarding.

## Endless Incremental Progression

Like all great incrementals, Gold & Glory is built on the satisfying loop of constant growth. Watch your numbers climb, your enemies fall faster, and your power scale beyond imagination. No run is ever wasted — every fight pushes you forward.

Dark Fantasy Atmosphere

Immerse yourself in a gritty, dark fantasy world where the crowd roars for blood and the arena floor is stained with the remnants of those who came before. Stylized visuals and a brooding aesthetic set the tone for a brutal, addictive experience.

Simple Controls, Deep Systems

Designed for mouse control, Gold & Glory is easy to pick up but endlessly deep. Whether you're actively slashing through waves or letting your upgrades do the work, there's always something to unlock, something to optimize, something to conquer.

---

*How much gold is glory worth? Step into the arena and find out.*

store_data.about_the_game:
A Ruin Exploration CRPG

The setting is Manhattan, New York, once a great metropolis.
You are suddenly thrown into a world where order and civilization have collapsed.

There is a main story, but how you adventure is up to you.
You can save people, become a thief, or simply complete missions.
How you approach the world, how you develop your character, and what weapons you use are all up to you.

Develop your character freely from 17 types of abilities and over 40 types of skills, and face the world!

And will you become the savior...?

◆Character Build

17 types of abilities and over 40 types of skills are available.
Allocate points according to the style you want to achieve.
Of course, it's impossible to maximize all abilities.
Create your own specialty and aim for your own unique role-playing!

◆Skill Checks

During your adventure, many skill checks await you.
You will be forced to choose whether to overcome or avoid them, depending on your role. Enjoy an experience that changes depending on your role.

◆Combat

A JRPG-like turn-based combat system.
The game employs a time-progress battle system where a gauge fills up according to the character's speed, determining their actions.
There are several attack methods, including melee combat, gunfights, and throwing weapons, which you can use according to your role.
You can solve problems with your strength, your marksmanship, or break through with throwing knives and grenades.
It all depends on your character's role.

◆Armor Class

Both allies and enemies have armor.
Attacks have penetration power, and damage decreases depending on the penetration power.
You can either deal with them appropriately using high-penetration attacks, or you can overpower them by dealing massive damage.
Armor classes will create strategic combat.

◆Changing Clothes

During your adventure, you can acquire various outfits.
Changing your clothes will alter your appearance.
There are over 40 different outfits in total.
Enjoy role-playing in your favorite outfit!

◆Exploration

Explore over 100 locations of varying sizes. Stadiums, subways, hospitals, restaurants, apartments, office buildings, and more await you.
Explore these locations to collect supplies, sell them for money, and equip yourself. Of course, enemies roam these locations.
Enemies are encountered via symbol encounters, so you're free to defeat them all or avoid them.

◆Survival

Food is needed as you continue exploring and fighting.
Obtain food, eat it, and survive in the ruined city. Survival mode can be freely switched ON/OFF.
If you like survival, try turning it ON and playing!

◆Difficulty Level

Seven difficulty levels are available.
Designed to be enjoyable for a wide range of players, from those skilled at games to those who are not.
Play freely in your own style!

store_data.about_the_game:
You stand alone against an endless tide of darkness. In this 3D top-down Roguelike survival shooter, wield glowing bla

des and devastating magic to carve a path through swarming monsters. Auto-aim keeps the pressure on—your job is to mov

e, dodge, and craft the ultimate build from over 20 upgradable skills. How long can you survive?

──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

About This Game

───────────────

Night falls, and the horde never ends. Your only weapons are a radiant sword, a battle axe, and the survival instincts

you sharpen with every wave.

Night Raider is a 3D top-down Vampire Survivors-inspired survival shooter. Built in Godot 4.5 with the Forward Plus re

nderer, every battle unfolds across detailed 3D arenas—brick floors, breakable barrels, and dynamic lighting that make

s each fight a test of both strategy and spectacle.

Auto-Fire, Focus on Tactics

───────────────────────────

Your character automatically locks onto and fires at the nearest threat. All you control is movement and decision-maki

ng. WASD to dodge, mouse to pick upgrades. Easy to learn, but mastery demands tactical thinking.

20+ Roguelike Skill Builds

──────────────────────────

Every level-up offers a random three-card choice to reshape your run:

• Barrage Branch: Multishot, Fan Spread, Giant Bullet, Double Strike—drown the horde in raw firepower.

• Elemental Destruction: Frost Bolts to slow, Burning Rounds to sear, Explosive Shells for screen-wide clears, and Tox

Clouds that eat away health over time.

• Precision Strikes: Homing bullets that never miss, Pierce rounds that tear through formations, Chain Lightning that

cs between foes, and Critical Hits that shake the camera.

• Survival Layers: Cell Regeneration for passive healing, Thorns Aura to punish attackers, Orbiting Shields for active

efense, and Vampiric Fangs that heal on every kill.

• Power Awakenings: Blood Frenzy, Recoil Burst, Devotion, Amulets of Strength—every pick redefines your playstyle.

A Bestiary of Threats

store_data.about_the_game:
The Collector’s Curio Cabinet: Toy Soldiers

Step into a warm, mysterious collector’s room filled with antique boxes, glass cabinets, velvet trays, tiny medals, forgotten catalogues, and beautifully crafted vintage toy soldiers.

In The Collector’s Curio Cabinet: Toy Soldiers, every piece has a story. Open dusty attic boxes, discover rare tin officers, restore chipped figures, arrange your collection in display cabinets, build tabletop dioramas, and command your miniature army in charming simulated battles.

But every battle has consequences.

After the fighting ends, your soldiers may return safely, earn medals, suffer damage, or be captured by rival collectors. Captured does not mean gone forever — your missing pieces wait inside a rival’s cabinet until you win them back.

Build the collection. Command the army. Complete the set.

Key Features

Collect Vintage Toy Soldiers

Open mystery boxes, estate-sale trunks, auction lots, and collector cases to discover plastic riflemen, painted tin officers, cavalry riders, field cannons, flag bearers, rare trophies, and legendary special editions.

Restore Rare Finds

Repair broken bases, chipped paint, bent weapons, cracked cannons, and damaged figures. Improve condition from Broken to Pristine and increase the value of your collection.

Display Your Collection

Arrange your best pieces in cabinets, albums, and tabletop dioramas. Watch your collection grow from a few dusty finds into a prestigious miniature museum.

Command Your Men in Battle

Send selected soldiers into tabletop battles against rival collectors. Your squad’s condition, rarity, medals, and diorama bonuses all affect the outcome.

Tidy Up the Aftermath

After battle, discover who returned safely, who was damaged, who earned medals, and who was captured. Every fight creates new stories for your collection.

Win Back Captured Pieces

If a rival collector captures one of your soldiers, he is displayed in their cabinet as a trophy. Challenge the rival again, trade trophies, or recover your missing piece through special opportunities.

Complete Legendary Sets

Fill album slots, recover missing soldiers, restore rare pieces, and claim rewards for completing full collections.

Open vintage toy boxes, restore rare soldiers, build beautiful dioramas, battle rival collectors, and win back the missing pieces from their cabinets .Every soldier has a story. Every battle leaves a mess. Every missing piece waits to be found. Collect. Restore. Display. Command. Battle. Tidy Up. Complete the Set.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to Age of Clicks, an innovative global strategy game that combines two genres: global strategy and clicker games! In this game, world domination, infrastructure development, and military expansion depend not only on planning, but also on your direct actions. Choose your country, plan your tactics, and lead your people to greatness using the unique clicker mechanics that are seamlessly integrated into the deep strategic gameplay.

Conquer territories

Forget about long and tedious positional battles! In Age of Clicks, you can literally click your way to victory. Use the power of your country to defeat your opponents: each tap you make breaks through the enemy's defenses and captures their lands. Build up your strength for massive click attacks and wipe out your enemies!

Click-based Economy

The foundation of any superpower is a strong and independent economy. Click to extract resources, build new factories, and launch production. Your clicks directly contribute to your country's wealth. As you progress, you can automate processes by setting up passive income to free up your hands for global warfare.

Unique mechanics and development

The game offers a variety of non-standard click-based upgrade paths. Improve the power of your click, unlock devastating active skills, and master powerful weapons. Upgrade your country to make every click 10, 100, or 1000 times more effective on the global stage.

Global Domination

Balance between aggressive expansion and economic prosperity. Will you become a peaceful industrial machine that can trade with half the world and provide a better life for its citizens, or a ruthless tyrant that can conquer an entire continent in a matter of minutes? The choice is yours!

store_data.about_the_game:
London, November 1889. A freezing autumn night blankets a city on the brink of social revolt during the turbulent elections. Deep within the elegant, high-society walls of Seraphim House, an anonymous dead body is found. The door to his private study is locked firmly from the inside.

You are a young inspector freshly arrived at Scotland Yard from the countryside. Being the only detective left at the station tonight, the grim duty falls to you. Explore the haunting depths of the estate, brave the overgrown shadows of the adjacent Botanical Garden, and uncover a truth that everyone else wants buried.

FEATURES

  • A living interactive graphic novel: Step into a striking, monochrome world entirely hand-drawn on physical paper using ink and brush. MurderAt features the unique calligraphic and textured art style of creative director Patrick Garbit, transforming every frame into a piece of dark, tactile art.

  • Investigation & deduction: Inspired by the observation of Return of the Obra Dinn and the point-and-click pacing of Rusty Lake, MurderAt leaves the mystery entirely in your hands. There are no intrusive tutorials or highlighted clues. You must examine documents, observe crime scenes, and connect the dots yourself.

  • Bring light to the case: In a mansion swallowed by darkness, light is your ultimate tool. Scrounge for matches, light candles, and move lamps to reveal hidden clues. But beware—the dark hides secrets that some would kill to protect.

  • A web of 19th-Century conspiracy: Dig through a dense narrative of familial trauma, political blackmail, and hidden identities. Interrogate a cast of deeply layered suspects—from ruthless industrialists to loyal confidants—using an organic, topic-based notebook system.

  • Two ways to investigate:

    • Sergeant Mode (Normal): Your in-game journal automatically logs discovered facts and maps out explored areas.

    • Detective Mode (Hard): The in-game journal is completely disabled. You must grab a real-life pen and paper at your desk to crack the case.

  • The weight of justice: Every suspect has an ending. MurderAt leaves the final verdict to your moral compass, forcing you to answer a haunting question: is solving a crime truly the same as rendering justice?

content_descriptors.notes:
MurderAt is an atmospheric historical thriller set in the gritty underbelly of Victorian London. It features mature themes and content intended for adult audiences.

Violence and Death: Players must investigate a hand-drawn, graphic crime scene featuring a deceased character with a visible gunshot wound and blood. The narrative also includes descriptions and depictions of physical assault, drowning, suicide, and capital punishment.

Substance Abuse: The game depicts historical substance abuse, including opium with period-accurate drug paraphernalia, and characters dealing with alcoholism.

Sensitive Themes: The plot heavily involves the discussion of suicide. It also touches on systemic corruption, political manipulation, and the kidnapping/exploitation of vulnerable, impoverished populations.

Note: There are absolutely no depictions or themes of sexual violence or non-consensual sexual acts in the game.

Do you remember how you got here? Step by step, corridor by corridor... But this place feels foreign. The walls seem to whisper, and reality is tearing at the seams. The only way out is to trust your eyes... and your ears.

Find Anomalies to Survive

Floor 12 is a psychological horror anomaly-hunting game where your powers of observation are the only key to salvation. Examine your surroundings closely. Notice something strange? Turn around and run back. Does everything seem normal? Move forward. Every correct choice brings you closer to the exit, but the slightest mistake will plunge you right back into the warm nightmare of where you started.

Trust All Your Senses

You cannot let your guard down for a single second. Anomalies are cunning and can manifest in different ways:

  • Audio Anomalies: Do you hear a strange whisper behind your back, heavy breathing in the dark, or footsteps that shouldn’t be there?

  • Lighting Anomalies: Flickering lamps, a suddenly shifting tint in the illumination, or shadows living a life of their own.

  • Spatial and Visual Distortions: Shape-shifting objects, disappearing doors, or portraits that follow your every move.

The game features 40 unique anomalies. Will you be able to maintain your sanity and find your way to freedom?

store_data.about_the_game:
Critical Load

Critical Load is an adult romance visual novel set in the high desert outside Pinto Wells, Arizona, where a 1.2-gigawatt hyperscale AI data center drinks the aquifer and pulls more power than the surrounding county combined. You play as Wade Hollis, the local-born Critical-Facilities Director who signs the load-shed log and decides who stays lit when the grid runs short.

Six weeks before a record heat dome peaks, an inquiry hangs over the last shed order, one that left a man dead in a 118-degree trailer, yet the company's go-live deadline won't move. In a town that remembers your name, three women pull you in three incompatible directions, each romance a different way of answering the same question: who gets carried when there isn't enough to carry everyone?

Meet the Cast


Dahlia Reyes — The Grid Operator
Dahlia is the regional grid operations director whose dispatch order can carry Wade's campus through an emergency, or curtail it to black with one calm sentence. She and Wade were almost a life once: the shared apartment, the future half-built, the split neither of them would bend for. She knows his past, holds his present in her hands, and still has to be fair when the system demands a sacrifice.


Sawyer Vance — The Hydrologist
Sawyer is the county hydrologist measuring the basin as it drains, field by field, well by well, until the numbers become a verdict. She grew up two streets over from Wade, stayed when he left, and now stands at the microphone reading drawdown figures at the man he's become. To Wade, she's equal parts history and hard truth.


Nadia Sokol — The Cooling Engineer
Nadia is the lead cooling engineer who keeps a billion dollars of servers from cooking when the heat dome hits and the plant starts to fail. She's Wade's sharpest ally on the floor: deadpan, relentless, and fluent in the same late-night crisis shorthand that makes them dangerously close.

Key Features

  • A high-stakes systems romance: Power and water are treated as the same scarcity in two forms, every megawatt and every gallon with a human name attached.
  • One decisive branch, three distinct routes: Choose which front you face first, campus, town, or grid, then follow a focused route built around that relationship's unique conflict.
  • Procedural tension with personal consequences: Load shedding, curtailment calls, permit hearings, audits, and logs are the pressure that shapes intimacy and trust.
  • Three romance dynamics, three moods: Slow-burn coworkers under crisis fatigue, hostile reunion with old hometown history, and a second chance with the person who still knows your shorthand.
  • A mature, bittersweet tone: No easy heroes, no clean wins, just the heat breaking, the system stabilizing, and the uneasy truth that the machine keeps running.

Adult Content

Critical Load is an adult visual novel intended for mature audiences. Each romance route includes explicit adult scenes. It also contains strong language and story themes involving power and water scarcity, civic conflict, corporate pressure, and a death referenced as part of the central plot.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to your new favorite nightmare.

One More Try is a 2D precision platformer built from the ground up to make you laugh, cry, and question your life choices. You will jump. You will miss. You will fall. And the game will absolutely make fun of you for it.

We stripped away the hand-holding, the checkpoints, and the mercy, leaving behind a pure, distilled, and hilariously frustrating challenge. It’s easy to understand, impossible to master, and dangerously addictive.

Key Features:

  • Brutal, Unforgiving Level Design: Every jump is a math problem. Every landing is a miracle.

  • Hilarious Failure: Dying isn't just a mechanic; it's a punchline. Expect to be mocked, taunted, and generally disrespected by the game itself.

  • Tight, Responsive Controls: When you fall into the abyss, you won't be able to blame the physics. The controls are precise - it really is just your fault.

  • The "Just One More" Loop: A respawn system so fast you’ll be back to failing before you’ve even finished screaming at your monitor.

Take a deep breath, stretch your fingers, and prepare to apologize to your keyboard. You've got this. Probably.

store_data.about_the_game:
Totally Safe Delivery NOT is a chaotic rage game where everything is totally safe. Well… almost.

As a freshly hired rookie, you have one simple task:
Bring the platform carrying atomic material safely to the core.

Sounds easy? Of course it isn’t.

The catch: The canister must never fall off the platform. If it does, your workday ends with a very unprofessional explosion.

On your way to the goal, your coworkers have placed all kinds of traps just to ruin your day. Slippery floors, nasty obstacles, cruel surprises, and situations that will make you wonder who approved this workplace in the first place.

Will you reach the goal in one piece?
I highly doubt it.

Find cute rubber ducks along the way and add them to your collection. Because even during a nuclear workplace disaster, a little cuteness can’t hurt.

Discover helpful items that might make survival slightly easier:

  • A watch that lets you activate slow motion for a short time.

  • Special boots that allow you to jump higher.

  • Other useful items that may help. Maybe.

Totally Safe Delivery NOT is a game about patience, chaos, physics, and the important question of how many times one person can make the same mistake before yelling, “That was not my fault!”

store_data.about_the_game:
Enter Brume, a plague-town where death has become doctrine.

LunaGenesis is a single-player psychological horror adventure set in Brume, a megastructure town of rat-folk living in the twilight band of a tidally locked world.

When Rill's sister is taken by the secretive Collegium Eudamonia, Rill performs a forbidden ritual and tears the Student's Moon from the sky. From that act comes Scary Moonchild: an avatar of Will, bound to everyone who ever believed in the moon.

Move between third-person exploration in Brume and first-person dream sequences. In town, avoid observation, gather clues, and learn who still has the courage to resist. In dreams, navigate surreal memories, impossible spaces, and nightmarish intrusions where lucidity is both power and danger.

  • Sneak through a theocratic plague-town - hide from clerics, observers, informants, and other forces watching the lower streets of Brume.

  • Enter surreal dreams - explore the memories, fears, and strange inner worlds of plague-stricken townsfolk.

  • Manage Lucidity - use dream power carefully. Lucidity gives you more power but heightened awareness can push you too close to waking.

  • Commune with Dream Eggs - rekindle Will in the sick and strengthen Scary Moonchild's connection to Brume.

  • Uncover the Collegium's conspiracy - follow conversations, memories, and clues toward the truth hidden in the upper city.

store_data.about_the_game:
underworld. No food. No water. No road back to the living world.

When you are nearly at your limit, you find a camp of living people. They give you food and water, and then tell you an even crueler truth: this place is still only a forgotten corner of the Eighteenth Hell. Many have tried to leave. None have returned.

You can stay, surviving day after day under fear and despair. Or you can take up your weapon and step onto the road no one has ever finished.

“The Return” focuses on side-scrolling action combat, skill builds, artifact synergy, and hand-crafted room progression. The full game is planned to include a prologue and eighteen layers of hell, for a total of nineteen chapter nodes. Each main chapter with its own infernal theme, enemy set, visual motifs, and combat rhythm.

At the start of each run, choose one character, enter the underworld, collect spiritual essence, learn skills, obtain artifacts, and shape your build as the run unfolds.

Rewards in hell are not random gifts. They are remnants left behind by those who came before: rebels, the wrongly dead, and powerful beings swallowed by the underworld. By claiming these relics, you borrow the strength of past failures and grow from a mortal into someone capable of challenging the order of hell itself.

After the prologue, the eighteen layers of hell are planned around 3 enemy types and 1 boss per layer, creating 57 themed regular enemies and 18 major boss battles. From the Soul-Forging Furnace and Tongue-Ripping Hell to the Scissor Hell, Iron Tree Hell, Mirror of Sin, Mountain of Blades, River of Forgetfulness, Court of Judgment, and finally the Palace of Yama, each layer reveals more of the world through enemy ecology, distant monuments, instruments of punishment, and short boss dialogues.

As you climb through the layers, the truth slowly comes into focus: spiritual essence is not a natural resource. It is manufactured from living people who were never meant to die.

“The Return” is the path of the dead, but also the road by which the living fight their way back from hell.

You are not here to await judgment.

You are here to climb all the way up and ask Yama one question:

By what right?

A detective-mystery adventure game with 2 modes of gameplay:

Interrogation mode: Listen to suspects, press them, and present them with evidence and questions in order to confront their lies and expose the truth. Requires precise attention to details to find the weak spots in their stories and evaluate if everything adds up.

Investigation mode: Go snooping around apartments, work-places, and the mean streets of Spring Hill City. Read people's private letters and go through their trash to uncover their secrets and identify subjects. 

The game presents you with puzzles that require deductive reasoning at times, application of real detective skills at times, and good-old adventure game moon logic when things don't make sense.

Uncover the secret behind the disapperance of the municipality worker.

store_data.about_the_game:
Build Your Second-Hand Electronics Empire

Start with a small store and grow it into the city's most successful second-hand electronics shop. Buy mystery boxes, uncover valuable items, stock your shelves, and attract customers looking for their next great find.

Every crate is a gamble. Will you discover hidden treasures or end up with a pile of junk?

 

Unboxing & Shelving

Purchase mystery boxes packed with random second-hand electronics.

From everyday gadgets to rare collectibles, every box contains surprises. The better your store becomes, the more valuable boxes you'll unlock.

Design Your Store

Arrange shelves and merchandise however you like.

Create a neat and professional shopping experience, or pack your store floor-to-ceiling with products. The layout is entirely up to you!

Buy Low, Sell High

Search the second-hand market for bargains and profitable deals.

A lucky purchase could bring huge profits, but bad deals can cost you dearly.

Serve Customers

Ring up customers at the register using both cash and card payments.

Manage checkout efficiently and keep your customers happy as your business grows.

Keep Your Store Attractive

Clean floors, take out the trash, and maintain a welcoming environment.

A cleaner, more attractive store will draw in more customers and increase sales.

Checkout & Payment

The checkout supports both card and cash payments, giving you a real-life cashier experience.

Expand Your Business

Purchase additional shelves, unlock larger store layouts, and increase your inventory capacity.

Grow from a small local shop into a thriving second-hand electronics empire！

A Living Store Experience

Your store is part of a bustling neighborhood with other shops to visit and explore.

Business slow today? Grab your in-game tablet and challenge yourself to a minigame while you wait for customers to arrive.

And Much More

More features, discoveries, and valuable finds await. Open your next box and see what treasures are hiding inside!

About This Game

The world is gone.

What remains is an endless wasteland filled with sand, ruins, and the infected.

In Zombie Wasteland Together, you must fight through relentless hordes of zombies alone or with up to 4 players. Explore abandoned locations, hold your ground against increasingly dangerous waves, and survive for as long as possible in a harsh post-apocalyptic world.

There is no rescue mission.

No safe haven.

Only survival.

1–4 Player Co-op Survival

Play solo or team up with friends online in a cooperative zombie survival experience. Work together, share resources, and defend each other against overwhelming enemy numbers.

As the horde grows larger, teamwork becomes essential.

Fight Endless Hordes

Face a variety of infected enemies, each presenting a different threat.

  • Standard Zombies that overwhelm through numbers

  • Ranged Infected that attack from a distance

  • Powerful Tank Zombies with high durability

  • Explosive Bombers that rush toward players

  • Special Mutants with unique abilities

Every wave brings new challenges and unexpected encounters.

Powerful Weapons

Equip a wide range of weapons to survive the apocalypse:

  • Assault Rifles

  • Shotguns

  • Sniper Rifles

  • Flamethrowers

  • Rocket Launchers

Choose the right tool for every situation and hold the line against the horde.

Explore the Wasteland

Battle across dangerous locations throughout the desert wasteland:

  • Abandoned Settlements

  • Desert Outposts

  • Industrial Facilities

  • Scrap-Metal Fortresses

  • Forgotten Highways

Every area offers new challenges and opportunities for survival.

Features

  • 1–4 Player Online Co-op

  • Large Post-Apocalyptic Maps

  • Assault Rifles, Shotguns, Flamethrowers, and Rocket Launchers

  • Endless Survival Gameplay

  • Fast-Paced Action Combat

  • High Replayability

  • Designed for Cooperative Play

Gather your team, load your weapons, and see how long you can survive.

store_data.about_the_game:
Imperium of the Stars is a real-time 4X grand strategy set in a vast procedural Grimdark galaxy. Build an empire, manage the economy, and push your fleets across thousands of star systems.

The great factions wage unending war, and there is no peace between them, only pressure and territory. Remnant systems drift across the stars, worlds that were once part of the Imperium but lost contact when the warp lanes went silent. Now independent, they can be brought back into Imperial rule or consumed by the Void. Play as the Imperium of the Stars, a faith-empire rebuilding its grip on the galaxy under its ancient sovereign, or as the Void Eternal, spreading corruption and remaking worlds in the image of its gods. Across the stars, the Grokhar packs fight and pick through the wreckage. More factions become playable over time.

The Game Director governs rival empires and keeps pressure moving across the galaxy from first expansion to final war. No two runs play the same. No downtime. No dull moments.

Key Features

  • Every faction plays differently - each faction has its own mechanics to manage. The Imperium governs through a court of great offices and rules on faith. The Void Eternal balances the favor of four gods while spreading corruption across the galaxy. The Grokhar build from salvage and prove their Pack-Lord through war and ritual. More factions, more systems, more to come.

  • No diplomacy between factions. Only war. - the Imperium, Void Eternal, and Grokhar are permanently at war with each other. Remnant systems (worlds that drifted during the Long Silence) can be reclaimed or consumed, but the great factions have no table to sit at.

  • Procedurally generated galaxies - choose your scale, from 1k to 10k star systems, across a configurable Grimdark galaxy.

  • Layered economy - faction-specific resources, per-planet building queues, infrastructure tiers, sector-level governors, edicts, and income deltas broken down to the planet.

  • Sector-level command - build and govern at the sector level, and group fleets into task forces that operate across entire sectors. Set priorities, define objectives, and let the task force handle the details. Full control when you want it, high-level automation when you don't.

  • Naval and ground combat - fleet battles between dozens of ship classes, ground sieges with regiment-level warfare, terrain modifiers, and morale systems.

  • Unique asymmetric tech systems - each faction advances through a completely different research structure, unlike anything in traditional 4X games.

  • The Ordinator - choose your Game Director: Balanced, Aggressive, Chaotic, and more. The unseen force shaping the epoch answers to you. Change it mid-game whenever the galaxy needs a different hand.

The Factions

The Imperium of the Stars

A hierarchical faith-empire that has ruled ten thousand worlds and intends to rule ten thousand more. At its head: the Eternal Emperor, an ancient immortal who issues rare, final edicts. Not a god. An emperor. The Creed of Stars claims sovereignty and eternity, not divinity, and the distinction is one the Synod enforces carefully. The court of great offices (Warmaster, Cardinal, Forgemaster, Admiral, and more) translates his will into policy. Appointed Governors administer each sector.

The Choir is the Imperium's warp infrastructure. Synchronized collective faith has real, physical effects on the warp, and the Choir exists to harness that at scale. It looks like a church. It functions like a utility grid. It operates like a military. Faith is not just belief. It is infrastructure.

Current doctrine: the Pragmatic Crusade. Speak first. Strike when speech fails. Burn only what cannot be saved.

The Void Eternal

There is no name for what they are. That is the first verse. The Void Eternal invades and conquers like any empire, but where the Imperium builds on faith, the Void runs on corruption. Worlds are not merely occupied; they are remade. Four gods move through the Void: the Hollow Moon, lord of entropy and erasure; the Carrion Choir, voice of slaughter and endless war; the Unwritten, who rewrites warp lanes and unmakes maps; and the Glutton Below, who devours worlds whole. Balancing their competing hungers shapes every decision you make.

Leading them is Ahnor-Vex, the Sleepless. An immortal human granted eternal life by the Four. A dark mirror of the Eternal Emperor: both ancient, both sustaining a civilization, neither willing to die. The Imperium has never seen them. They have watched the Imperium fall apart before, and waited.

The Grokhar

Multiple packs, each with its own lord, its own iron, its own way of making war. They build from what others die in, salvage stripped from wreckage, hammered into crude weapons that work because they have to. At the heart of every pack is the Pack-Lord, and the Lord must be proven. Through war, through ritual, through blood. A pack whose Lord grows weak falls apart. A pack whose Lord is strong takes everything.

The Lattice

The Lattice are not a hive mind. They are not biological. Crystalline. A void-energy entity with no history in this galaxy before the Long Silence. They don't communicate. They don't negotiate. When their assessment of a region is complete, they advance.

"Crystal does not hunger. Crystal simply grows."

The Lattice turns up in every campaign. Every faction will run into it. It is not playable at release.

The Galaxy

Before the first fleet moves, you shape the galaxy. Choose your scale, from 1k to 10k star systems, then set your scenario and choose your Game Director. The Ordinator, the unseen force shaping the epoch, answers to you. You decide the pace and pressure, and you can change it mid-game. Dial it up, pull it back, and the galaxy responds.

Rival empires expand, remnant systems rise and fall, crises come in without asking. There is always a situation demanding attention, always a fire somewhere on the map. And when the last system finally falls, the game does not end. New threats emerge. You decide how long you play, and how hard you want it to be.

Situations and Events

The galaxy doesn't wait. Story events surface without warning: a Cardinal's petition, a Void whisper taking hold on a frontier world, a faction situation demanding a call right now. Some resolve in a single decision. Others escalate over months into something much harder to contain. A galaxy-wide crisis can shift the balance of power overnight. And faction situations cut deeper: gods grow restless when neglected, courts fracture when unattended, Pack-Lords grow bold when they go too long without blood.

Other 4X games give every faction the same tools with different numbers. This one doesn't. The Imperium's court, the Void's gods, the Grokhar's Pack-Lord are not flavour. They are the game. The Ordinator is yours to configure. Some players want constant tension and rivals that never stop pushing. Others want to build at their own pace and pick their fights. Choose your Game Director before you start, change it whenever you need to. The galaxy responds to what you ask of it.

Economy and Buildings

The economy runs at every level. Planets generate resources, house populations in the billions, and run their own building queues. Buildings unlock at infrastructure thresholds, scale through upgrade tiers, and feed into sector-level accounting. Appointed Governors manage each sector, pooling and redistributing resources across their worlds. Sector and empire edicts stack further modifiers on top of all of it.

Faith and loyalty are resources too. A world with falling loyalty bleeds output and invites unrest. Faith sustains the Choir, enables edicts, and holds the Imperium's grip on distant systems. The spiritual health of your empire is as important as its ledgers.

Combat

Naval battles pit fleets of cruisers, battleships, destroyers, and capital ships against each other. Ships carry autocannons, lance arrays, torpedo salvos, and launch bays. Ground warfare runs through regimental armies of infantry, artillery, armour, and recon battalions, with planet type shaping the fight. Fortress Worlds give defenders heavy armour. Sprawl Worlds turn every district into a kill zone.

At the centre of the galaxy, the largest black hole turns. The Void Eternal calls it a door. The Imperium calls it a heresy. Every fleet in the galaxy orbits the same point.

Ten thousand worlds. One throne. The largest door is at the centre of everything.

store_data.about_the_game:
Scavenge Protocol is a multiplayer co-op horror game where you land on alien worlds, infiltrate high-risk facilities, and strip them of valuable scrap. Convert your haul into energy, gamble that energy on highly questionable upgrades, and try to make it back to orbit alive.

The goal is simple:

  • Land.

  • Loot.

  • Panic.

  • Leave.

Unfortunately, the local wildlife strongly disagrees with this plan.

Explore procedurally generated complexes filled with lethal traps, terrifying monsters, and life choices you will immediately regret. Work together to survive, or abandon your friends the exact second something starts screaming in the dark. Every expedition is different, every shadow wants you dead, and every teammate suddenly becomes an Olympic sprinter when things go wrong.

Procedurally Generated Facilities

  • Infinite Layouts: Every run generates a completely new facility grid.

  • No Map, No Help: Even we don't know where the exit is. Good luck.

Hazardous Alien Planets

  • Themed Environments: Different planets house vastly different facility types.

  • Unique Vibes: Because getting hunted in an industrial factory hits entirely differently than getting chased through the Backrooms.

Horrifying Entities

  • Unpredictable AI: Every monster hunts with completely distinct behavior.

  • The Mimic Effect: Some creatures can disguise themselves or sound like safety.

  • Visual Triggers: Some monsters attack if you look at them; others attack if you break eye contact.

  • The Unknown: And some are just plain weird.

The Energy Economy

  • Scrap to Power: Melt down your collected junk into raw energy.

  • Fuel the Ship: Keep the lights on and your life support running.

  • Upgrade Equipment: Buy better gear to survive deeper dives.

  • Waste It All: Spend it on something completely stupid. Your choice.

Advanced Movement System

  • Run. Dash. Slide. Panic.

  • ...sometimes in that exact order.

The Company does not value your survival. Happy hunting.

As such, the game depicts social attitudes, laws, and prejudices that existed during the period. While certain events and characters have been dramatized for storytelling purposes, the challenges faced by Prince Hall and his community are grounded in historical realities.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Call of Fate and an Age-Old Mystery

Centuries after the last keeper, who secluded himself in this eerie lighthouse after losing his wife, arrives with a letter saying, "Something is happening," calling you to discover what lies within this eerie structure that no one dares approach. Stepping through the doors of this monolithic building will not be met with frightening anxieties, but with a horror that will gnaw at your mind.

Light is Your Only Refuge

In this massive structure where darkness is your greatest enemy, your only chance of survival lies in the resources you find within the lighthouse. Carefully utilize the four light sources, each with varying brightness and burning time; once your light runs out, you are completely defenseless against the unknown within the darkness.

Death is Only the Beginning

When you succumb to darkness, you wake up in your bed, but this is only the beginning. Every time you remain in darkness, you leave your corpse there. It is up to you to discover what to do with your corpse, or what it will do to you.

Key Features:

  • Atmospheric and Cosmic Horror: A completely immersive experience focused on profound loneliness and psychological tension, far removed from cheap jump scare tactics.

  • Strategic Lighting Management: Survive the darkness with 4 different light sources that vary in brightness and duration.

store_data.detailed_description:
The Call of Fate and an Age-Old Mystery

Centuries after the last keeper, who secluded himself in this eerie lighthouse after losing his wife, arrives with a letter saying, "Something is happening," calling you to discover what lies within this eerie structure that no one dares approach. Stepping through the doors of this monolithic building will not be met with frightening anxieties, but with a horror that will gnaw at your mind.

Light is Your Only Refuge

In this massive structure where darkness is your greatest enemy, your only chance of survival lies in the resources you find within the lighthouse. Carefully utilize the four light sources, each with varying brightness and burning time; once your light runs out, you are completely defenseless against the unknown within the darkness.

Death is Only the Beginning

When you succumb to darkness, you wake up in your bed, but this is only the beginning. Every time you remain in darkness, you leave your corpse there. It is up to you to discover what to do with your corpse, or what it will do to you.

store_data.about_the_game:
DRIDENT is a first-person survival horror experience set in a remote, fog-drowned forest in Argentina.

You play as Gabriel, an agent sent to investigate the disappearance of several young women. What begins as a search through abandoned cabins, old notes, and forgotten paths soon turns into something far more disturbing. The forest is hiding a secret, and the deeper you go, the less human the truth becomes.

Explore dark environments, manage limited resources, solve environmental puzzles, and survive encounters against infected creatures and malformed horrors. Every note, cassette, and clue reveals another piece of a story buried beneath fear, guilt, and experimentation.

The atmosphere is oppressive, the visibility is low, and danger rarely announces itself twice.

Features:

- First-person survival horror gameplay

- Dark forest, cabins, caves, labyrinths, and coastal areas

- Resource management with firearms and melee combat

- Notes, cassettes, and environmental storytelling

- Puzzles, locked doors, keys, and exploration-based progression

- Grotesque enemies and boss encounters

- Optional retro/low-poly visual mode

- A grim story inspired by classic horror pacing and atmosphere

You came looking for the missing.

Now something is looking back.

store_data.about_the_game:
🔥 WELCOME TO THE BOMB MADNESS

It's Not a Bomb is the explosive local party game where the goal is simple: blow up your friends before they blow up you. Grab up to 4 controllers, pick your fighter, and unleash total chaos on the couch. No internet. No excuses. Just you, your friends, and a whole lot of explosions.

💥 EVERYTHING EXPLODES (EXCEPT WHAT YOU'D EXPECT)

Forget boring bombs. Here, the most innocent objects are deadly. Bottles, chickens, gas cans... it's NOT a bomb...until it goes BOOM right in someone's face. Read the chaos, predict the blast, and turn the whole arena into your weapon.

👥 UP TO 4 PLAYERS — ONLY ONE FRIENDSHIP SURVIVES

Pure couch multiplayer madness. Gather 4 friends, split the controllers, and fight to be the last one standing. Easy to pick up, impossible to put down, and guaranteed to start at least one argument.

⚡ GRAB GAME-CHANGING POWER-UPS

Turn the tide in an instant with wild power-ups scattered across the arena:

  • 🐔 The Chicken Cannon: a chicken that lays exploding eggs NON-STOP for the entire round. Rain destruction on everyone.

  • 🛡️ The Shield: soak up the blast and walk away laughing.

  • 💨 Speed Boost: move faster, dodge harder, dominate the chaos.

🎨 MAKE YOUR FIGHTER YOURS

Stand out in the madness. Customize your character with a wild collection of

hats and colors. Look ridiculous. Look intimidating. Look unforgettable while

you blow your friends to bits.

🗺️ FRESH ARENAS, ENDLESS CHAOS

Battle across a variety of crazy, colorful arenas — from sunny towns to desert

mazes. Every map changes how you play, where you hide, and how things explode.

🎉 EASY TO LEARN, IMPOSSIBLE TO MASTER

Anyone can grab a controller and start blasting in seconds. But mastering the timing, the power-ups, and the perfect explosive trap? That takes a true Bomb Master. The perfect game night chaos for friends, family, and frenemies.

👉 WISHLIST NOW and be ready when the Bomb Madness begins!

Kev-Inn's Packaging Facility is a strategy roguelike inspired by your favorite block-dropping games!

Build a deck of multiple types of boxes, place them on a grid, and watch them cause a chain reaction of different effects! Earn points and combo to beat each ever-harder score goal, and climb the promotions to become the CEO of the Packaging Facility!

  • Multiple playable characters!

VOIDSWARM is a spacefaring roguelike RTS of massive scale. Your fleet is the last hope standing between civilization and the endless swarm devastating our homeworlds.

Build your arsenal 

The swarm descends from the void in unimaginable numbers. But with every enemy eliminated we build our knowledge, capabilities, and unit designs. Our hangars hold a variety of fighters, destroyers, and utility ships like radar scouts and mining platforms - you can choose whether to be the tip of the spear, a slow but menacing dreadnought, or an invaluable support providing information and resource to your fleet to maximise their effectiveness.

Adapt your strategy

The enemy is cunning, and no system is the same. Resources, hazards, enemy commands, all are factors to consider in your strategy. Every engagement is a chance to learn. Even in defeat we can send designs and upgrades forward to other systems to help them in the next fight.


Awaiting your orders, Commander

Experience the scale of stellar warfare where every split-second choice will make or break our survival. Outfit your units, build your planetary defenses, and coordinate your fleet to send them back to the void.

store_data.about_the_game:
You were never a great detective. Your photos are blurry, your clients are angry, and your rent is overdue. Then one day, after helping a strange old man in an alley, you receive a battered old digital watch with a single button.

Press it, and your superpower changes instantly.

Press it, and your wallet gets lighter too.

With the crooked watch on your wrist, you start taking bizarre investigation jobs across a city overflowing with secrets. Stake out luxury apartments, tail suspicious targets through neon streets, sneak into private rooms, uncover scandals, and capture the proof that really matters. Fly to rooftops, climb sheer walls, turn invisible for a few seconds, slow time, read thoughts, or even transform into a small dog to slip through tight spaces.

But the watch never works for free. Every power switch costs cash, and the price rises each time you use it in the same in-game day. That means every mission becomes a balancing act between reward, route planning, and ability timing. Spend too much and you go broke. Spend too little and you may miss the perfect shot.

In this city, everyone is hiding something. Your job is to get the evidence, then decide what that evidence is worth.

### Key Features

- 8 random superpowers: flight, wall-climbing, mind reading, super strength, invisibility, time slow, dog transformation, and rolling slide.

- Evidence-driven photography gameplay focused on angles, access routes, timing, and risk.

- A money-powered ability system where every switch costs cash and gets more expensive each day.

- A variety of investigation scenarios including hotels, warehouses, pet shops, mansions, rooftops, alleys, and labs.

- Light stealth and traversal puzzles built around patrol patterns, vertical spaces, and short-duration powers.

- A darkly comedic detective story about a loser investigator and a very expensive magical watch.

store_data.about_the_game:
"The Curiosity Clerk" is a narrative puzzle game that seamlessly blends Victorian fantasy with item identification and psychological deduction.

Amidst the swirling industrial smog, you take the helm of a mysterious curiosity shop. Facing eccentric visitors, each harboring deep secrets, the bizarre artifacts in your hands will become the ultimate keys to altering their destinies.

Key Features

🎭 The Map of Fate: 20 Days of Multi-Branching Judgment

During your 20-day tenure, every artifact you hand over will trigger a massive butterfly effect. Your choices and moral resolve will steer you toward vastly different endings on the Judgment Day of Day 20:

🏆 【The Royal Purveyor】
🖤 【The Fallen Dealer】
🔍 【The New Master of the Gallery】
⚖️ 【The Ordinary Shopkeeper】

👥 Tales of the Mortal World: The Interwoven Karma of a Victorian Town

Beyond the storefront lies a world turbulent with industrial pollution. Every transaction you make ripples across a hidden web of human relationships:

🧪 The Scholar & Wilderness Exploration
⛰️ The Alpinist’s Sin and Salvation
📖 The Seminarist’s Crossroads
🖼️ High Society Intrigue and Swaps

🔍 Daytime Scavenging & Wilderness Exploration: Rich Strategic Puzzles

The game features not only a gripping narrative but also highly replayable logic deduction and collection mechanics:

🃏 5x5 Matrix Card Scavenging
🤖 Automaton's Text Adventure
🐶 The Puppy’s "Calming Space"

🌌 Nightfall Visitors: Blind Box Deals Ruling "Past" & "Future"

As night falls, mysterious visitors knock on your gallery door with absolute karmic demands:

👁️ The Midnight Merchant: A classic authenticity test. Cross-reference the "Craftsman’s Manual" with his cryptic lore to spot flaws, expose his lies, and win rare curios.
🔮 The Mysterious Witch: Submit items that align with historical logic to receive prophecies—she will foretell the traits or the exact grid coordinates of tomorrow's key items.
🧙‍♂️ The Dark Mage: Demanding a unique, irreplaceable artifact, he will light the beacon for your main storyline quest.

👁️‍🗨️ The Vanished Day 21

Once you have traveled through the four rivers of fate and unlocked all salvation achievements, the dust-laden Day 21 will quietly dawn. Are you ready to uncover the ultimate secret of this shop?

store_data.about_the_game:
Depths is a casual "friend-slop" cooperative experience where you and up to three friends descend into the mines on behalf of the Dwarven Mining Company. Your mission is simple: collect gems, meet your quota, and make it back alive. The last part is optional.

Navigate a procedurally generated maze of caves, avoid environmental hazards, and try not to become a goblin's lunch. At least one of you needs to make it back with the loot, so choose wisely who gets left behind. Each dive is different, each quota is higher, and the company's patience is finite. Don't disappoint the suits upstairs.

FEATURES:

DWARVES!

Cool little guys. That's it. That's the feature.

PROCEDURALLY GENERATED CAVES

No two dives are the same. New layouts, new loot, new ways to get hopelessly lost and blame your teammates.

PROXIMITY CHAT

Coordinate with your team, panic together, or simply scream into the void as something chases you. Your call.

PLAY YOUR WAY

Full online co-op with lobby searching and hosting, or go it alone in offline singleplayer if you have no friends (we don't judge).

EVIL ENEMIES

  • Greedy little goblins who want your gold and will not hesitate to take it

  • Creepy little spiders (ew)

SHOP AND ITEMS

Spend your hard earned gold on trinkets and tools between dives. We encourage you to participate in our beautiful capitalistic society. The Dwarven Mining Company thanks you for your consumption.

LEGALLY REQUIRED EMPLOYEE BENEFITS (Minigames!)

The company, in full compliance with local labor law, provides a recreational area featuring basketball, soccer, and a full playground. Employees are permitted up to 15 minutes of leisure time per shift. After that, get back to work. The quota won't fill itself.

After a brutal war, super soldiers known as Draugrs successfully saved the world, but they needed to find a job. Upon returning home.   • Flip gravity to fight both on the ground and the roof!

  • Cycle cards to get the units you want!

  • Buy combos to get multiple units at once!

  • Activate skills to get an edge in battle

  • Play a series of levels to defeat the evil hot dog bosses.

  • Upgrade your units and pick the right ones for the mission!

You are Sari Oaks, a spunky college girl who just wants to take your healer's exam.

But the three romanceable idiots in your life destroy the school while brawling!

What's a girl to do?

Nozomu School Daze is a 90s-shonen-anime-inspired romance visual novel with comedy, drama, and…

Violence?!

And YOU pick who wins!

  • 3 romanceable male leads, all martial artists 

  • Approx 40k words with 8 endings 

  • Hand-drawn art, human writing, NO AI 

  • 2.5 himbos: pure of heart, strong of chest, dumb of butt

Nozomu School Daze features a rambunctious cast of characters. First, let's meet our female protagonist, Sari Oaks.

Sari is a smart, motivated college girl who wants to become the nation's top healer so she can care for her parents.

She also has a secret that could end in her family being persecuted if it's discovered!

Seki Fujury is one of our heroes, a martial-arts expert who defends the vulnerable.

He's honestly a bit of a goofball, but when you get a big-hearted guy who loves kids and animals, well...

Julius Van der Geest, the perfect man™, is a kind, compassionate, stupidly rich knight who wants nothing more than to spoil you.

He's dapper, wearing a top hat regardless of the weather, and only loses his coat when he drapes it over Sari's shoulders.

Seth is a prince of the Beastman, but he couldn’t be further from royal stereotypes.

As a rough-and-tumble brawler rejected by his martial arts master, Seth’s main goal???

KILL SEKI FUJURY

store_data.about_the_game:
STEER, DON'T SHOOT

Your drone orbits the vault core and fires on its own. You only steer  the circle which way it spins and how tight it cuts. Ride close and the outer ring shreds in seconds, but a missed read costs your hull. Ride wide and you'll outlast anything, but you'll be down there a long time. Every vault is a question of where the line is.

CRACK THE CORE, DROP DOWN

Strip the outer ring of debris and defenders, then break the core  underneath. The floor opens and you fall into the next vault. Each one is denser than the last new core types, harder break patterns,  new biomes with their own hazards. The deeper you go, the better the haul, and the meaner the floor.


EVERY RUN MAKES THE NEXT ONE LOUDER

Everything you tear loose comes back up with you. Spend it between  runs on upgrade cards fire rate, hull, orbit precision, magnet  pull, crit and a full skill tree that rewrites how runs play.  Nothing is wasted. Every run pushes the floor down a little further.

store_data.about_the_game:
🚛 Post-apocalyptic wasteland × tank romance

After the legendary "Intelligent Machinery Crisis", civilization crumbled into dust, with ferocious monsters and powerful bounty hunters roaming the world. As an extraterrestrial visitor, your only companion is a rumbling tank. Drive it through barren deserts and dilapidated ruins, challenge enemies with vastly different strengths, and uncover the secrets buried deep beneath the wasteland - this is the romance of a tough guy, and also the beginning of your story.

💔 Despite the simple plot, there are plenty of heart-stirring moments

The game narrative returns to a "concise yet touching" style, without redundant dialogue to disrupt the pace. The world is cruel, but the girl around you is warm. On your adventure journey, you will encounter cute sisters, taciturn warriors, and arrogant rich girls... and embark on a series of life-and-death adventures. *With a clear harem plotline, there is no need for concern. Both combat and emotions are part of your journey.

🛸 Combat Vehicle System: The Romance of Men

As a tribute to the classic, the game's core returns to the "dual system of human and tank". You can deeply customize the tank in the modification workshop: activate acupoints, replace the engine, equip the main and secondary guns, transforming it into a steel beast that crushes everything. Different tank chassis have different characteristics and configurations. When facing a specific bounty hunter, choosing the right armament will determine the outcome of the battle.

🔥 Rich Bounty: A Life-and-Death Battle

Hunting is the only law of survival. On the vast wasteland lurk more than 20 unique bounties - from gigantic sharks that inhabit the depths of the ocean to vicious war machines with fierce firepower hidden deep in the desert. Some enemies even require you to flexibly switch between melee combat and tank battles, seeking vulnerabilities. Every duel is an extreme test of equipment and courage.

📖 Featured System

Free exploration and nonlinear narrative: Go wherever you want, without mandatory quest lines.

Elemental Reactions: Innovatively added some elemental reactions (new reactions will continue to be added in subsequent works), making team speed matching and tank equipment configuration more interesting, rather than simply stacking high-value equipment.

Painting & Transformation System: Customize the body and weapons of your tank freely; dismantled tank weapons can be used for transformation: freely modify your cool tank!

War Tank Manufacturing: Players can obtain war tank blueprints during their adventures and craft some enemy war tanks!

Weapon crafting: Obtain weapon blueprints through adventures, and create more personalized characters and war vehicle equipment!

💾 "Wild Romance: Wasteland Expedition" is a love letter to classic tank RPGs, and also a personally crafted adventure in a romantic harem setting. Add it to your wishlist, lead your girl squad, and crush this silent world!

💔 Despite the simple plot, there are plenty of heart-stirring moments

The game narrative returns to a "concise yet touching" style, without redundant dialogue to disrupt the pace. The world is cruel, but the girl around you is warm. On your adventure journey, you will encounter cute sisters, taciturn warriors, and arrogant rich girls... and embark on a series of life-and-death adventures. *With a clear harem plotline, there is no need for concern. Both combat and emotions are part of your journey.

🛸 Combat Vehicle System: The Romance of Men

As a tribute to the classic, the game's core returns to the "dual system of human and tank". You can deeply customize the tank in the modification workshop: activate acupoints, replace the engine, equip the main and secondary guns, transforming it into a steel beast that crushes everything. Different tank chassis have different characteristics and configurations. When facing a specific bounty hunter, choosing the right armament will determine the outcome of the battle.

🔥 Rich Bounty: A Life-and-Death Battle

Hunting is the only law of survival. On the vast wasteland lurk more than 20 unique bounties - from gigantic sharks that inhabit the depths of the ocean to vicious war machines with fierce firepower hidden deep in the desert. Some enemies even require you to flexibly switch between melee combat and tank battles, seeking vulnerabilities. Every duel is an extreme test of equipment and courage.

📖 Featured System

Free exploration and nonlinear narrative: Go wherever you want, without mandatory quest lines.

Elemental Reactions: Innovatively added some elemental reactions (new reactions will continue to be added in subsequent works), making team speed matching and tank equipment configuration more interesting, rather than simply stacking high-value equipment.

Painting & Transformation System: Customize the body and weapons of your tank freely; dismantled tank weapons can be used for transformation: freely modify your cool tank!

War Tank Manufacturing: Players can obtain war tank blueprints during their adventures and craft some enemy war tanks!

Weapon crafting: Obtain weapon blueprints through adventures, and create more personalized characters and war vehicle equipment!

💾 "Wild Romance: Wasteland Expedition" is a love letter to classic tank RPGs, and also a personally crafted adventure in a romantic harem setting. Add it to your wishlist, lead your girl squad, and crush this silent world!
store_data.short_description: On the wasteland, tanks rumble. In this post-apocalyptic adventure RPG, you will become a bounty hunter, driving a tank deep into the forbidden zone to face the brutal bounty hunter leader.
