store_data.about_the_game:
Unearth the Past. Build Its Future.

As a paleontology student, you really never cared much for the academic world. Research papers, lectures, and those endless studies were never what drew you to paleontology in the first place. You wanted something different; you wanted a place where the average person could experience the wonder of prehistoric life for themselves.

After a professor notices your lack of interest in traditional research and studying, he offers you an unexpected opportunity: leave the university behind and start searching for fossils in the real world. With his support, you begin a journey across ancient landscapes, uncovering creatures and building a world-renowned museum that brings the distant past back to life.

FIND FOSSILS!

Sieve, dig, grab, and break your way through layers of earth to recover rare fossils hidden beneath the surface. From the windswept beaches of Maasvlakte to the chalk cliffs of Cap Blanc-Nez, every location uncovers a different chapter of Earth’s history. Explore ancient environments from the frozen Ice Age tundra to warm Devonian seas and the mighty Cretaceous period, each filled with unique prehistoric creatures waiting to be discovered.

PREPARE YOUR FINDS

Finding a fossil is only half the work. Wash sediment through sieves, carefully chip away stubborn rock, and gently brush fragile bones clean in satisfying hands-on preparation gameplay. Every fossil requires a different approach, and patience can turn rubble into a museum centerpiece.

BUILD A MUSEUM WORTH VISITING

Create the museum that you want to build. Place display cases, glass shelves, stands, decorations, and scenic pieces to design a space visitors will remember. As your collection grows, more guests arrive, your museum rating increases, and word begins to spread. A great collection draws a crowd, and a crowd keeps the lights on.

A WORLD THAT BREATHES

Watch days roll into nights as dynamic weather and time systems bring the world to life. Experience shifting moon phases, heavy rain, strong winds, and distant thunder as every expedition feels a little different from the last. No two mornings at the dig site are ever the same.

store_data.about_the_game:
One player runs.

The other makes their life miserable.

Race through fast-paced multiplayer platforming levels where every jump could be your last. While runners dodge hazards and fight to stay alive, another player takes control of the map itself, triggering traps, creating holes, dropping bombs, and turning safe ground into a disaster zone.

Nothing stays safe for long.

Run. Dodge. Survive.

Every level is packed with handcrafted chaos designed to test your reflexes, timing, and ability to adapt when the world suddenly changes beneath your feet. Reach the finish line, keep hold of the crown, and try not to get launched into the void by a player whose only goal is to ruin your day.

Whether you're racing as a runner or controlling the chaos from above, every match becomes a battle of skill, strategy, and increasingly personal grudges.

You'll rage.

A lot.

You'll swear that jump was possible. You'll blame the map controller, the bombs, the disappearing floor, and maybe your friends. Then you'll queue for another round because somehow the chaos never stops being fun.

Features

  • Asymmetric multiplayer gameplay

  • Race through fast-paced platforming challenges

  • Control the map and sabotage other players with traps and hazards

  • Bombs, collapsing platforms, holes, and environmental chaos

  • Handcrafted levels designed for maximum mayhem

  • Competitive crown-chasing gameplay

  • Endless opportunities to betray your friends

  • Equal parts frustration, laughter, and "one more round"

The runners want to survive.

The map controller wants them to fail.

Who wins depends on who's better at ruining someone else's day.

store_data.about_the_game:
Plot your way through an American political campaign as you go head-to-head against a rival political party. Participate in debates and travel to battleground states as you try to win a Presidential Election. 

PRESIDENTIAL CAMPAIGN:

Plot your way through an intense campaign of momentum, gaffes, and unexpected surprises.  Keep track of the polls and launch national advertising campaigns to stay ahead! Challenge your opponent to policy debates or avoid the debate stage and focus on your own political rallies instead!

Take risks throughout your campaign, or play it safe... The choice is yours!

Balance your time in each of the battleground states or target reliable states for the other political party to try to unexpectedly flip one of them. Take advantage of gaffes or scandals on each turn of the campaign. Do you have what it takes to win the election and become the next President of the United States?

ELECTION NIGHT SIMULATION:

When the campaign is over, you can watch the votes get counted in real-time just like a real election night. View election results from battleground states as the ballots are tabulated and watch the results come in for all fifty states as the race to 270 electoral votes intensifies. Watch for key race alerts and important projections in battleground states.

NEW 2026 VOTER DATA:

Revamped voter data has been integrated into the Simulation Engine to emulate what the 2026 turnout projections are expected to be. Additionally, new voter registration data and election data from recent elections have been implemented into every single state to create the most realistic simulation possible.

HISTORICAL ELECTORAL MAPS:

Want to play on an old electoral map where the electoral vote values match a historical decade? Play on any electoral map dating back to 1980 and try to face off against the same challenge that some of the greatest American Presidents had to face in their very own elections back in the day.

store_data.about_the_game:
[Underworld Monsters Pinball] is a 3D pinball game where you aim for a high score by bouncing the figurine monsters riding on the ball.

Experience the mini-story of the protagonist playing a pinball machine tucked away in the back of a run-down variety store, and the figurine monsters trapped inside it. The game is simple—you can play just by moving the left and right flippers—making it accessible even to those who aren’t great at games.

#Game Features

Unusually for a pinball game, figurine monsters ride on top of the ball.

The figurine monsters have skills; when their skill gauge fills up, they can activate their skills to defeat enemy monsters and bosses, or earn more points.

You can also form a party of up to four monsters and switch between them at any time.

#Game Flow

Your goal is to aim for a high score while collecting monsters. First, pass through either the BAT or FRI mode gate—located on the left or right paths of the pinball table—three times to activate BAT or FRI mode. Once activated, complete battles against enemy monsters and collect items within the time limit to proceed to the boss battle.

Defeating tough bosses earns you more points than usual, so keep defeating them!

store_data.about_the_game:
Jingjie: Probability Cloud - Nagumo's Dilemma is a Pacific carrier command simulation set against the carrier battles of World War II. "Nagumo" refers to Chuichi Nagumo, the Japanese admiral who commanded the First Air Fleet during the opening Pacific War operations and the Battle of Midway. The game is not a biography or a celebration of any wartime regime; it uses this historical command problem as a frame for uncertainty, delayed reports, deck pressure, and decisions made before the truth is fully known.

You are not piloting aircraft or clicking through a fully revealed map. You are reading contact reports, judging confidence, managing a flight deck, and deciding when an uncertain position is good enough to risk a strike.

Every report has age, error, and consequence. A scout can find a possible enemy carrier, lose the trail, return low on fuel, or feed the command chain with information that is already going stale.

The opponent is built for fair adaptation, not omniscience. It can react to visible exposure, learn pressure patterns from after-action evidence, and test repeated habits without reading hidden player intent.

- Imperfect intelligence instead of an omniscient map.

- Carrier command built around time, deck space, CAP, scouts, and strike windows.

- A fairness-bounded adaptive opponent that acts on its own belief picture, not hidden omniscience.

- Evidence-based tactical wagers with visible causes and consequences.

- Compact scenarios built for replayable command problems.

store_data.about_the_game:
SCP: Good Night, Mr. Jupiter

A containment breach has begun. The alarms are blaring. Reality is falling apart.

And you've been sitting on the toilet.

SCP: Mr. Jupiter is a first-person horror-comedy adventure set inside a collapsing SCP Foundation facility. You play as a Class-D personnel member who emerges from a bathroom stall at the absolute worst possible moment. The site is already in chaos, security systems are failing, and the anomalous entity known as Mr. Jupiter is now roaming free.

Armed with nothing but your wits, questionable luck, and a strong desire to survive, you must navigate the facility, avoid deadly threats, solve environmental challenges, and find a way out before everything goes from bad to worse.

Combining tense horror, absurd humor, and unpredictable encounters, Mr. Jupiter delivers a unique SCP experience where survival is never guaranteed and dignity is usually the first casualty.

Features

  • First-person horror with dark comedy and absurd situations

  • Explore a collapsing SCP Foundation facility during an active containment breach

  • Evade and survive encounters with the mysterious Mr. Jupiter

  • Environmental storytelling and interactive exploration

  • Randomized elements that make each playthrough different

  • Physics-driven interactions and emergent moments

  • Multiple secrets and hidden details to discover

  • Fully single-player experience

Content Warning

This game contains:

  • Horror themes

  • Gore and blood

  • Strong language

  • Crude humor

  • References to bodily functions

Can You Escape?

Most people prepare for a containment breach.

You were busy in the bathroom.

Now the only question is whether you'll make it out alive.

store_data.about_the_game:
Build Your Automotive Empire from the Ground Up

Auto Empire Tycoon is a focused automotive business simulation spanning the 1950s to the 2000s.

You start with a modest factory, a small engineering team, and a single dealership. Rival companies are already competing for the same market. Your goal is clear: research new technologies, design superior cars, produce them efficiently, keep your dealership stocked, offer competitive prices, and outsell your rivals to become the market leader.

Every car you create and every dollar you earn helps you unlock new technologies and stay ahead of the competition.

Research New Automotive Technologies

Your success depends on smart research decisions.

Invest your profits in new engines, transmissions, suspensions, body styles, comfort features, and efficiency improvements. Each new technology opens the door to more competitive vehicle models.

A well-timed research decision can give you the edge you need to overtake your rivals.

Design Cars the Market Wants

Don’t build the car you like. Build the car the market is ready to buy.

Combine researched technologies to create new models that match customer expectations for quality, price, fuel efficiency, and style.

A smart design can boost your sales and push you ahead of rival brands. An outdated model can give them a chance to catch up.

Manage Efficient Production

Your cars don’t build themselves.

Run your factory with precision:

  • Set up and retool production lines

  • Control manufacturing costs

  • Manage worker efficiency

  • Balance output with demand

Produce too few cars and you lose sales to your rivals.

Produce too many and your money gets stuck in unsold inventory.

A well-run company turns good designs into real profits.

Keep Your Dealership Stocked and Ready to Sell

A great car means nothing if customers can’t buy it.

Manage your dealership:

  • Control inventory levels

  • Set competitive prices and discounts

  • Hire sales staff

  • Match the right models to the right customers

The better you read local demand, the more cars you sell and the faster you leave your rivals behind.

Outsell Rival Brands

You are not alone in the market.

AI-controlled rival companies design their own cars, run their factories, stock their dealerships, and fight you for every customer.

Study their moves every month:

  • Compare sales reports

  • See which categories they dominate

  • Find their weaknesses

If one rival leads in budget cars, strike back with a better alternative.

If your sales fall behind, improve your models, adjust production, and rethink your strategy.

Only the company that adapts fastest wins.

Read the Market and Stay Ahead

Use detailed reports to make sharp decisions:

  • Which vehicle categories are growing

  • How your models perform against your rivals

  • Which technologies to research next

  • Whether your prices and stock levels are helping or hurting sales

The game rewards clear thinking and timely action. Think like a CEO and stay one step ahead of the competition.

Grow Step by Step into the Market Leader

Start small in the 1950s.

Research better technologies.

Design stronger vehicles.

Optimize production.

Keep your dealership stocked.

Adjust prices.

Study the market.

Outsell your rivals.

Your empire grows through hundreds of smart decisions. In Auto Empire Tycoon, you don’t just manage a car company; you outsmart the competition and build the strongest automotive brand in the city.

Planned Features

  • Vehicle model design using researched technologies and components

  • Automotive technology research tree

  • Factory production management and production line retooling

  • Dealership inventory, pricing, and staff management

  • Rival companies with their own strategies

  • Detailed monthly and yearly sales reports

  • Category and company performance comparisons

  • Bank loans and advertising campaigns

  • Brand reputation and fuel consumption systems

  • Parts suppliers and economic events

  • Isometric city view with live traffic and district overlays

  • Minimap, wealth zones, and demand overlays

  • Save system, tutorial, and multiple scenarios

store_data.about_the_game:
Doomsday Tryst

When the world above goes dark, Gage Renner locks down the Bastion: a decommissioned missile silo turned luxury fallout compound for the ultra-wealthy. Inside, every breath is counted, every gallon is rationed, and every decision is political—especially when the headcount comes up one over, and the "extra" is a woman who isn't on any manifest.

As the company keeps extending the reseal on unverifiable information, Gage is pulled between duty and desire: the stowaway trucker who keeps the silo alive with a wrench and a grin, the founder's widow holding a faith she no longer believes, and the investor who holds his contract—and wants to hold him, too. In a sealed world built to profit from fear, romance becomes its own kind of rebellion.

Meet the Cast

Birdie Kovac — The One Who Got In


A long-haul trucker who slipped through the closing door, Birdie is the Bastion's living contradiction—uninvited, unpaid, and essential. She refuses to beg for air in a place where the rich bought comfort, and she has the hands to fix what their money can't. To Gage, she's both a moral problem and a lifeline: an equal in the depths, daring him to decide whether survival is earned, purchased… or simply taken.

Lavinia Sterling — The Patron


Lavinia didn't come to the Bastion to be saved—she came to own the one asset that appreciates when everything else fails. As chair of the continuity council and the investor who holds the paper on Gage's contract, she can reshape policy, rations, and outcomes with a single vote. To Gage, she's danger dressed as competence: the one person who understands the math as coldly as he does, and the one person testing whether he can be desired without being bought.

Cordelia Voss — The Founder's Widow


Cordelia is the face the members want: composed, gracious, and carrying her late husband's certainty like a shield. But behind the welcome loop and the curated faith, she's a woman trapped inside a monument to a belief she never fully shared. Gage was the man her husband trusted most—now he's the only one who sees the cracks in her performance, and the only one she's terrified to want in her husband's shadow.

Key Features

  • Three distinct romance routes—choose the first door Gage walks through and shape the emotional center of the lockdown.
  • A luxury apocalypse with hard math: finite air, water, and power, and a tiered membership system that turns survival into a service plan.
  • Three love interests, three power dynamics: outsider equality in the mechanical depths, grief and guilt in the founder's penthouse, and high-stakes leverage games in the council suite.
  • No easy villains and no clean outcomes—every route forces choices where stability, truth, and human cost can't all be saved.
  • Full voice-acted dialogue for the three love interests.
  • Contains adult content: 9 explicit adult scenes across the three romance routes (3 per route).

Mature Content

Doomsday Tryst is an adult romance visual novel intended for adults 18+. It contains explicit sexual content, depictions of alcohol consumption, and references to grief and a prior off-screen death, a fictional in-story emergency that keeps the characters confined, and themes of institutional deception within the story world.

store_data.about_the_game:
Descend into an endless layers of resource-rich caves and tunnels, gather the ores and deposit them at the furnace in your base, and purchase incremental and automatic upgrades to push how deep you can go

An idle/incremental indie game with a minimalistic pixel theme focused on a balance between manual exploration and mining, and automation and progression systems

Mine

Break through randomly generated caverns filled with valuable ore
Store it in your falling sand simulation inventory
Deposit it back at base for credits to purchase various upgrades

Automate

Deploy autonomous drones to prospect, excavate and mine the ores and treasures deep in the caves
Expand your operation and use it to gather resources and improve yields for you as you continue digging

Upgrade

Spend credits across multiple upgrade systems to improve your speed, damage, inventory capacity, information gathering, explosive ordinance, automated drones, and much more

Prestige

Collect rare Ancient Ore and reset your progress to unlock permanent upgrades, new technology tiers, and increasingly powerful systems.

Expand the size of the explorable world, destroy thousands of blocks at once with explosives, instanty teleport at the click of a button, and deploy swarms of automated drones as your power scales further and further

Steam achievements have some extra fun challenges to tackle for when you're powerful enough

store_data.about_the_game:
A short first-person psychological horror game about spotting anomalies inside a house party that feels just a little too familiar.

You wake up in a bedroom during a late-night party. Guests are scattered around the house, and everything seems normal at first. But each loop through the house may reveal something wrong: an object out of place, a strange figure, a room that changed, or something watching you when it should not be.

Your goal is simple: explore the house, pay attention, and decide whether something has changed.

If you notice an anomaly, return to the bedroom.

If everything seems normal, leave through the front door.

Make the wrong choice, and the loop begins again.

Observe Carefully

Every room can hide subtle or disturbing changes. Some anomalies are easy to notice. Others may only reveal themselves if you remember how the house looked before.

A Familiar Party Turned Wrong

The house is full of young adults enjoying what should be a normal night. But the longer you stay, the more the party begins to feel empty, strange, and impossible to trust.

Short Psychological Horror Experience

House Party 8 is designed as a compact anomaly-hunting horror game with a tense atmosphere, simple controls, and a focus on observation rather than combat.

Features

• First-person anomaly detection gameplay
• A looping house party setting
• Multiple anomalies to discover
• Atmospheric psychological horror
• No combat, only observation and decision-making
• Short, focused horror experience

store_data.about_the_game:
An alien drone horde has launched an airstrike targeting Earth.

RushGirl LUCA is an action-shooting roguelike game where you, with a mouse in one hand, aim and dodge on your own

as you fight your way back to the enemy’s base in space.

Forget about shooters where you just build a setup and let it run.

Every bullet is fired from your aim, and every dodge begins at your fingertips.

Read enemy patterns, target boss weaknesses, and fend off the alien onslaught.

Key Features

  • No auto-fire, just you — every shot and every dodge starts at your hand

  • 10+ weapons and parts, endlessly mixed — saw-blade swords, homing missiles, afterimage strikes, all yours to combine

  • 5-tier rank system, D to S — chain kills push your rank up: enemies hit harder, but so does your gold

  • 5 signature boss fights

  • One-handed mouse controls — left-click fires, right-click dodges, that's it

  • Retro pixel art at modern shooter tempo — 16-bit detail with arcade pacing

Add it to your wishlist now and be the first to try the RushGirl LUCA demo!

store_data.about_the_game:
You find yourself alone in a facility during the Cretaceous Period after traveling back in time to work as a scientist for a large corporation. Discover what happened to the people who worked there, why it looks like it was abandoned years ago, and find a way to escape while surviving the dinosaurs that now roam the facility and its surroundings.

Dinosaurs with Unique Behaviors

Compy

  • Steal items from player

  • Attack the player

  • Can call the Raptor if you find them in the facility

  • Can be bribed so then don't call the raptors

Raptor

  • Hunts and attacks the player

  • Can ambush the player 

T-Rex

  • A deadly apex predator

Frequency detector

  • The T-Rex produces low-frequency sounds that are difficult to hear. Keep a Frequency Detector with you to detect it before it's too late.

Randomized Elements  (with each run)

  • Item locations

  • Key codes

  • Other gameplay elements

PAD (Portable Application Device)

  • An essential survival tool. Access and connect to terminals, download data from terminals, review logs, manage your inventory, and gather information needed to stay alive.

Multiple Endings

  • 4 different endings to unlock (Ways to escape)

Difficulty Settings

Survival Horror Gameplay

  • Limited resources

  • Manage supplies carefully to survive

Limited Save System

  • The number of available save slots depends on the selected difficulty level.

  • Run-Based Save System

store_data.about_the_game:
In Brickwork you are the architect of your own defense. On a blank grid of plastic bricks, you decide everything. Where the enemies walk, where your towers stand, and how your world takes shape. Gather powerful relics as you push deeper into each run, stacking abilities that transform your strategy in ways you never planned for. Every wave hits harder than the last, and the only thing standing between you and defeat is the world you build.

Key Features:

  • Your World, Your Rules - Place bricks freely across the entire battlefield with no restrictions. Wind the enemy's path into a maze of your own making and punish every step they take.

  • Power Hidden in the Bricks - Towers grow stronger based on the bricks beneath them. Think carefully about where you build, because placement is everything.

  • Relics of Untold Power - Discover mysterious relics over the course of each run that twist and amplify your strategy in unexpected ways. Stack them, combine them, and watch your defenses transform.

  • No Two Runs Alike - Procedurally generated layouts and a roguelike progression system mean every run deals you a fresh hand. Master the bricks, adapt your strategy, and go again.

  • Hold The Line - Each run pits you against escalating waves of toy invaders, each one testing the strength of everything you have built. Plan your defenses, survive the oncoming assault, and fight your way to the end.

store_data.about_the_game:
Stuck in a terrible storm, you crash down out of the sky. You find yourself with a broken wing, on a small island in a giant pond. Not knowing what to do, or how to heal your wing, you venture out into the pond...

You'll meet a group of scattered friends, with some animosity lingering between them. As you work on healing your wing, maybe you could help heal their wounds to; creating unbreakable bonds which you will share forever with you're new friends!

------------

Once Apond a Time features 4 unique regions for you to explore, with 4 animal friends for you to meet. Every region has been hand made, down to every last model and texture, all made in house by our amazing artists! And we are proud to say no AI has been used at any point in the art development process!

We made this game as a small team (Team E-Quail) of 8 people, working part time, over the course of half a year. We are happy to get to work with TOTEM to publish our game and share it with you. We hope you will enjoy it as much as we enjoyed making it!

Wishing you fun,
Lauren, Tim, Lars, Lin, Robin, Karem, Lea, & Dinis

store_data.about_the_game:
Dead men tell no tales. The living only scream.

A new era of survival horror arrives with Black Tides: Draga's Wake. Step into the boots of Draga, a hardened smuggler and pirate first mate whose ultimate heist has gone catastrophically wrong. Trapped aboard the Ormora—a decaying 1900s steamship icelocked in unpredictable waters—you must navigate a labyrinth of iron to find your missing crew while fighting a losing battle against the ritualistic, cosmic horrors that have breached our reality.

Nightmare of Flesh and Steel

Step into an oppressive landscape dominated by riveted steel, hiss-venting steam pipes, and failing turn-of-the-century machinery. The Ormora isn't just a backdrop—it's a claustrophobic, labyrinthine character in itself, built to disorient you and harbor ritualistic, cosmic horrors that have manifested within the ship's flooded lower decks.

DRAGA BOLIVAR

A hardened sailor and career thief who has spent his life following Caleb's orders without question — until the Ormora forces him to question everything. Draga is not a hero. He is a survivor, a loyalist, and a man whose moral code was built for a simpler world. As the ship's horrors consume his crew one by one and an ancient god takes root in his body, Draga must choose between the man he was and the something terrifying he is becoming.

Izzy Koleva

A former cultist who escaped the Children of Gaia's grip — but not its influence. Izzy knows the rituals, the doctrine, and the lies. Skilled in alchemy, she is one of the few people alive who truly understands what the cult is trying to do, and what it will cost if they succeed. Draga doesn't trust her. He may not have a choice.

VISCERAL, HIGH-STAKES BRAWLER COMBAT

Survival isn't just about running away; it's about fighting back with everything you have. Engage in brutal, close-quarters combat against twisted, mutated entities. Every strike has weight, every impact is visceral, and every mistake is costly.

KEY GAMEPLAY FEATURES

  • Master the Melee & Dodge: Rely on your reflexes and wits. Perfect your timing to dodge devastating enemy attacks and unleash heavy brawler-style combos to tear through flesh and bone.

  • Quick-Fire Under Pressure: Seamlessly weave ranged quick-fire attacks into your melee flow to keep aggressive monstrosities at bay or exploit sudden openings in their defenses.

  • Ruthless Resource Management: Ammo, health, and power are scarce. Every encounter requires you to calculate the cost of engagement. Will you burn your precious resources to guarantee a kill, or risk getting up close and personal to save them?

  • An Unforgiving Body Horror Nightmare: Navigate a grim, custom-built world steeped in atmospheric dread, graphic gore, and grotesque anatomical terrors where danger lurks in every shadow and victory is bought in blood.

Sanctuary of Small Things

A ball of light pulled you into a quiet, fading world - and now it's counting on you.

The creatures here have fallen ill. Lumen, your glowing companion, can light the way and cheer you on, but can't lift a finger to help. So you'll wander, gather, and heal the small things no one else will - and slowly bring a broken world back to life.

Heal. Gather. Explore. Relax. The future of the sanctuary is what you make of it.

✨ Save the Small Things

Find a creature in need, shrink it small enough to cradle in your hands, and carry it somewhere safe. Every life you mend grows the sanctuary population.

🍄 Heal together

Tend your sanctuary alone, or open it up to friends and heal side by side. The world you rebuild is one you build together.

🌿 Grow your gifts

Forage, craft, and brew your way to becoming the healer this world needs. The more you care for it, the more it gives back.

✨ Explore a world worth saving

Journey from misty forests to sun-warmed shores, each home to creatures all its own - common little wanderers and rare, wondrous ones alike.

🍄 Meet your guide

Lumen is always with you - glowing, pulsing, never quite silent. Part navigator, part cheerleader, wholly devoted to the small things you save together.

🌿 A sanctuary that grows

Watch your quiet refuge come alive as the creatures you rescue make it home. The more you heal, the more it blooms.

Lumen will guide you. The sanctuary will grow. And the world will bloom once more - one small thing at a time.

store_data.about_the_game:
Build the most annoying, profit-hungry AI Slop empire on the planet and reach the singularity (or just ruin the internet forever).

AI Slop is a single-player anti-AI incremental economy simulator about scaling a single poorly-rendered, 6-fingered anime girl into a relentless, world-dominating digital landfill. Start with a basic prompt, reinvest every VC dollar, trade worthless meme coins, and hire specialized grifters to automate your botnets. Turn raw, scraped datasets into high-volume garbage for a living market that rewards hype, outrage, and total disregard for copyright laws.

This isn’t just about making "art." It’s about killing dead-end jobs and replacing them with algorithms.

Prompt, scrape, hallucinate, deepfake, and expand until your operation becomes a tightly linked network of tech-bros feeding a shared GPU Cluster. Every upgrade pushes you further from manual typing and closer to a fully automated slop engine that keeps generating garbage while you count your venture capital funding.

Master the Meme Coins, Hype Cycle, and the Casino.

Trends shift. Twitter/X outrage peaks. Reddit mods write 10,000-word essays on ethics. Sell AI-written SEO articles for steady cash, hold high-profile deepfakes for blackmail leverage, or capitalize on lucrative corporate defense contracts when the anti-AI crowd gets too loud. And when the market is lagging? Play a high-stakes, Balatro-style Joker Poker card game to multiply your earnings while your bots hallucinate the future. In AI Slop, success comes from knowing what to prompt, when to pump, and when to play a Joker card on a flush.

Build your syndicate of grifters, not just your GPU count.

Unlock a massive, highly unqualified roster of 10 specialized operatives to run your expanding empire. Level their professions, improve their rigs, and shape a production network:

  • The AI Artist: Start with a 6-Fingered Waifu Generator, upgrade to an AI-Generated Children's Book Author, and automate a Stolen-Style Art Theft Bot.

  • The Hallucination Bot: Run a Crap SEO Blog Writer, scale to a Fake History LinkedIn Guru, and deploy an AI Political Speech Generator.

  • The Deepfaker: Produce Fake CEO Apology Videos, resurrect dead actors for Deceased Celebrity Hologram Ads, and run Politician Voice-Cloning Scams.

  • The Bot Farmer: Manage a Twitter Engagement Pod, run Dead Internet Theory Facebook Admins, and launch a Subreddit Takeover Network.

  • The Dataset Bro: Deploy a Reddit API Scraper, build an Unconsenting Artist Portfolio Vacuum, and operate a Copyright-Infringement Hard-Drive Laundry.

  • The AI Grifter: Hire a Web3/AI Pivot Specialist, watch a "I Made $10k in 5 Mins" YouTuber, and pitch VC Pitch-Deck Vaporware.

  • The Jailbreaker: Type "Do Anything Now" (DAN) Prompts, consult an Uncensored Chemistry-Lab Advisor, and fund a Skynet Containment Breacher.

  • The Roboticist: Build an Unstable Dog-Bot Welder, operate an AI-Powered Fast-Food Fryer, and unleash an Autonomous Crowd-Control Mech.

  • The Canceler: Run a Deepfake-Exposing Drama Channel, coordinate an Anti-AI Twitter Mob, and launch a Corporate Boycott Botnet.

  • The Slop Recycler: Set up an AI-Scraping-AI Bot, trigger a Recursive Model-Collapse Extractor, and generate a Post-Singularity Echo Chamber.

From prompt engineer to silicon kingpin.

Early gains come from smart prompts and steady VC reinvestment. Mid-game momentum comes from better deepfakes, massive botnets, and making the anti-AI community cry. Late-game power comes from chaining systems together into a self-feeding, recursive loop of pure, unadulterated slop that ruins the concept of reality.

And when the synthetic numbers are climbing, the atmosphere carries the grind:

AI Slop is backed by a 40-hour futuristic, synthetic lofi techno variety soundtrack built to fuel long grinding sessions, deep focus, and that "one-more-prompt" dopamine hit.

Key Features:

  • Single-player cynical incremental economy gameplay featuring both active prompt engineering and passive passive server farming.

  • Manage a 10-person roster of wildly unqualified specialist crews with 3 distinct, hilarious career paths each.

  • Play Joker Poker: A deep, poker-style deck-building roguelite card game to multiply your profits while your bots automate the slop.

  • Trade meme coins: buy low, sell high, have diamond hands. Avoid getting rugged by your own AI.

  • Use your GPU Clusters to connect your expanding operation and support bigger, dumber production goals.

  • Trade on the living Hype Cycle, where fluctuating public outrage rewards timing and shamelessness.

  • Complete lucrative corporate sponsor contracts to convert stolen datasets into premium payouts.

  • Level professions, upgrade your server racks, unlock jailbreaks, and push toward a fully post-truth society.

  • Sink into a 40-hour synthetic soundtrack designed to power long-form, caffeine-fueled play sessions.

  • base and community management;

  • strange characters and even stranger events;

  • achievements;

  • Russian and English localization.

Pookie's Lingerie Shop 2 is a flirty and fast-paced dating sim with expanded business management elements. Having finally ditched your old job, the Sweet Pookie is back to launch her very own independent lingerie brand and she’s chosen you as her co-founder! Build a startup from the ground up, handle elite new clientele, and face off against ruthless corporate rivals, including your old boss Regina. Your choices will shape the future of the brand and your personal relationships. Will you conquer the fashion world as the ultimate power couple or go bankrupt trying?

  • Stock trendy inventory and manage the brand's growing reputation

  • Make key dialogue choices that influence relationships and business deals

  • Outsmart corporate rivals and manage finances to unlock new story events

Romance Paths:

  • Deepen trust through high-stakes business decisions, events, and romantic dates

  • Multiple romance routes, including building a "power couple" dynamic with Pookie or exploring new sparks with rival characters and wealthy investors

Built around online co-op, melee combat, exploration, and replayable missions, each run sends players into dangerous areas where they must survive, complete objectives, gather rewards, and grow stronger before heading back out again.

Play alone or with a friend as you take on enemy encounters, discover randomized objectives, and push deeper into the wilderness.

    Team up with a friend and fight through medieval environments together.

  • Third-Person Melee Combat
    Equip your sword, engage enemies, dodge danger, and survive close-range battles.

    Enter dangerous areas filled with enemies, objectives, and encounters.

  • Progression and Upgrades
    Earn rewards, improve your knight, and prepare for harder challenges.

  • Medieval Fantasy Atmosphere
    Explore castles, forests, villages, and dark paths inspired by grounded medieval fantasy.

store_data.about_the_game:
A Sea of Ashen Tulips is a narrative adventure role-playing game in which players take on the role of a Eoin, a former mercenary attempting to navigate a peaceful life in the aftermath of war as the people make ends meet and forces of empire prepare to reignite conflict. Players will follow Eoin as he interacts with the people of northeastern Wyeland, helps them in their struggles, contends with his past, uncovers sinister conspiracies that threaten the recently acquired freedom the people fought tooth and nail for, and succeeds or fails by how much faith he places in the bonds he forges along the way.

Forge Bonds

Encounter the diverse array of people living throughout the nation of Wyeland and hear their stories of pain, joy, love, loss, and struggle against the encroaching Matregaelian forces. Forge bonds with interesting characters just as multifaceted as Eoin himself and discover and aid in their journeys of growth and grief.

Uncover Secrets

Dive into a mystery at the heart of a land gripped in the pollution of colonialism. Follow leads and carry threads as you find who is trustworthy in a land where motivation is subject to the whims of the boots around the common person’s neck. Fight against impossible odds or circumvent them and work from the shadows.

Face Your Past

You may not be able to change the world but you are in charge of the individual destinies laid out before you. Find out what kind of person Eoin was and shape what kind of person he will become as you control the way he responds to the people and situations throughout Wyeland.

Experience the World

Hand-drawn pixel art and gorgeously composed original music form the atmosphere for a land with infinite depth and wonder to encounter.

Welcome to Your Hearthside

Hearthside: Your Custom Fireplace is a relaxing simulation designed to be a digital comfort zone. Whether you need a backdrop while studying, reading, or relaxing after work, Hearthside is built for you.

Customization Options

Control the exact look of your environment with a highly customizable setup.

  • 66 Wall Styles: Cycle through 66 wall variations across 7 material groups including Brick, Wood, Tile, Marble, Metal, and Festive. (More textures are constantly being added)

  • Build Your Fire: Choose between multiple log arrangements and adjust the physical size of the fire—from a glowing ember to a roaring blaze.

  • Fire Dynamics: Fine-tune the behavior of the flames by adjusting the fire's speed, opacity, and overall intensity.

  • Smoke & Embers: Toggle smoke and glowing embers on or off, and customize their specific visual options to match your preference.

  • Color Control: Adjust the exact color of the flames, logs, and walls using full RGB sliders, or quickly swap between a library of prechosen color palettes.

  • Custom Image Gallery: Import your own photos or artwork from your PC directly into the game. Set a single image, or load multiple to create a beautiful carousel slideshow that cycles through your memories on the wall.

Ambience and Audio

Layer different sounds together to create your ideal background noise.

  • 4 Nature Sounds: Mix and match ambient tracks including a thunderstorm, winter wind, babbling brook, and wildlands. (More soundscapes coming soon)

  • Included Music: Listen to over 1 hour of built-in music featuring genres like Celtic, Lo-Fi, and Piano Lo-Fi. (More tracks on the way)

  • Import Your Own Music: Import your own local audio files directly into the game to play through Hearthside's built-in audio player.

Presets and Controls

  • Save Your Presets: Save your exact configuration to a preset slot to load it again later.

  • Premade Occasions: Load premade presets designed for specific moods and occasions.

  • Camera Controls: Zoom in close to the coals or pull back to view the whole room.

Upcoming Features

Hearthside is currently focused on atmosphere, but the development roadmap includes introducing productivity tools:

  • Pomodoro Integration: Built-in focus timers to help you study or work.

  • To-Do Lists: Keep track of your daily tasks while the app runs in the background.

  • Custom Timers: Set alarms to remind you to take breaks or drink water.

  • Widget Mode: Snap Hearthside to the corner of your monitor while you use other apps.

store_data.about_the_game:
You are stranded and alone on a boat in the middle of a sunken world, fighting to escape the jaws of a god-like leviathan. You must keep the boat moving fast, by feeding fish you catch with your harpoon to the boat's bio-engine. If its power gets too low, the leviathan will start getting closer.

Inspired by the haunting artwork of Simon Stålenhag, this hand-drawn side-scroller forces you to think strategically and work quickly under pressure in order to evade a watery death. As you sail onwards in hope of eventual rescue, you will encounter massive megastructures and the giant rotting frames of mysterious machines. Within them hide dangerous creatures and deadly obstacles, their numbers and hostility increasing and you venture further into this strange and uncaring world.

Catch fish and floating debris with your harpoon.

Feed fish to the bio-engine.

Repair holes in the boat with gathered scrap-metal.

Fight off dangerous enemies with your harpoon.

Don't let the leviathan catch up.

store_data.about_the_game:
You run a technology company as its CEO, CTO, and CFO at the same time. The interface is a dashboard of tables, charts, and a scrolling event log.

Each campaign begins from one of five hand-built scenarios — a bootstrapped garage with no outside funding, a seed-stage accelerator startup, an established mid-size firm, an inherited company in decline, or a public giant — or from a randomized company drawn somewhere in between.

Roles

As CEO you set company strategy and handle the board, shareholders, and press. As CTO you run R&D, choose product architectures, and manage technical debt. As CFO you set pricing, raise capital, run payroll and taxes, and manage cash flow. The three roles overlap and trade off against each other.

Products and research

You build products in several categories — consumer apps, enterprise software, cloud, AI, hardware, and games — from more than 50 templates. Each build is configured before release: monetization, privacy setting, launch scope, quality target, and tech stack. Those choices set its cost, revenue, maintenance, and risk. Research follows a tech tree of about 50 nodes across five branches, gated by cash, headcount, prerequisites, and time. The company also begins with an undisclosed advantage in matrix multiplication that lowers the cost of AI research until it leaks.

Systems

Ten company functions — engineering, design, support, marketing, PR, legal, HR, and finance among them — share a set of values: quality, technical debt, customer satisfaction, morale, public image, cash, and investor confidence. The functions feed back on one another. An understaffed support desk lowers morale, which raises attrition, lowers product quality, reduces revenue, and shortens the runway. Difficulty is mostly emergent.

The IPO

The IPO is a multi-stage event: select underwriters, file the S-1 and set a disclosure level, choose a price range, run the roadshow, and receive a listing-day result. Afterward you manage a live market cap, attend quarterly earnings calls, and report to a seven-seat board that can vote to remove you.

Competitors

Competing firms build their own product lines and contest yours. A product released into a category a competitor already leads earns reduced revenue until you outbuild it. You can outcompete a rival or acquire it. Removing all competitors grants a monopoly pricing premium, raises antitrust risk, and tends to push the remaining firms to merge.

Failure conditions

Most threats are internal. The game includes more than 100 written crisis events — staff walkouts, regulatory findings, security breaches, financial shocks, board disputes, and occasional positive events — each with branching choices and lasting effects. There are three failure conditions: bankruptcy (cash reaches zero), board recall (approval falls below the threshold and the recall vote fails), and investor ouster (confidence reaches zero before the IPO). There is no win condition. The long-term targets — a one-trillion-dollar valuation, a market monopoly, or surviving a set number of days — are milestones, not endings.

Summary

1. Five hand-built starting scenarios plus a randomizer, from a bootstrapped garage to a public giant.

2. 50+ product templates with per-build configuration; a tech tree of roughly 50 nodes.

3. Five-stage IPO, quarterly earnings calls, seven-seat board of directors.

4. 100+ crisis events, a macro-economy and per-sector market sentiment that shift over time.

5. Keyboard-driven dashboard interface, dark theme.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Door Factory is a first-person horror game where you work as an inspector in a strange factory where doors arrive one by one.

Each door leads to a different place. Your job is to bring the door in, step inside, carefully inspect the room, and decide if everything looks normal. If the area seems safe, you can approve the door for production. If something feels wrong, you must report it.

The gameplay is built around observation, tension, and decision-making. Some rooms may look normal at first glance, but small details can reveal that something is wrong. Objects out of place, strange presences, subtle changes, or impossible situations can turn a routine inspection into something far more disturbing.

Every decision matters: approving a defective door can have consequences, but reporting a safe one can also hurt your performance.

Features


  • Inspect doors that lead to unknown places.
  • Explore each room and look for anomalies.
  • Approve safe doors or report suspicious ones.
  • Psychological horror focused on atmosphere, tension, and subtle details.
  • First-person gameplay built around observation and inspection.

store_data.about_the_game:
Return to Planet Zoveka is a physics-first incremental space-mining game about rebuilding hope from cosmic dust.

- Herd, merge, and collect glowing cosmic dust with physics-driven tools.

- Upgrade a rugged family mining ship from humble beginnings into a powerful operation.

- Build automation and support devices that keep resources flowing.

- Expand into manufacturing, trading, and space-side resource management.

- Invest your progress into visible homeworld restoration.

- Play at your own pace: relax, optimize, tinker, or push for faster growth. If/when you can return home is up to you :-)

Herd And Merge Cosmic Dust

Start with a small family mining ship. Pull drifting dust through space, merge particles into stronger tiers, and turn tiny gains into real momentum.

Upgrade From Manual Mining To Automation

Expand your tools, improve the ship, and deploy systems that keep your dust economy growing as the screen fills with activity.

Build Automation And Resource Flow

Push beyond simple dust collection into automation, resource flow, trade, and management choices that give the game its depth.

Restore Planet Zoveka From Space

Your progress is not only bigger numbers. Invest your growing economy into healing a damaged homeworld and watch Zoveka start to recover.

And Also From The Surface, As It Come Back To Life

Look closer at the planet you are saving, from polluted coastlines and damaged habitats toward a cleaner future worth returning to.

store_data.about_the_game:
Three jobs. One life. Zero savings.

Keeping Up is a satirical British life sim, a spiritual successor to the 1991 classic Jones in the Fast Lane. Move your marble token around a 16-building city. Work the till at McSking Guys or pull a graveyard shift at GMW Vehicle  Factory. Study for a degree at a university or upskill online with a digital online course. Eat from CheapCo or splash out at Tate Rose. Save your money, invest, gamble. Upgrade your whip from banger to beast! Check out the latest news, dodge the Algorithm, and try to come out ahead.

Features

  • A city of 16 buildings, each with its own characters and bespoke pixel-art faces. Pick where you live, where you work, where you study, where you eat.

  • Real jobs at real employers. Climb the ladder at Yahoogle. Get fired from McSking Guys. Quit the factory because Jordan just walked into a corner office.

  • Gigs to scrape by between jobs: deliver leaflets, ride for food apps, drive courier runs. Each one gated by what you own.

  • A weekly newspaper with markets, weather, sports and classifieds, plus an unpredictable Algorithm that can up-end the economy for a month at a time.

  • An AI rival named Jordan playing the same game by the same rules. Race them to the top, or play solo and just see how far you get.

  • Two difficulties, hidden win conditions, and the kind of slow drip of small choices that compound into a life.

A Game About Status, Not Stats

You won't find a UI full of progress bars and percentages here. Keeping Up runs on vibes: the way a good week feels different from a bad one, the way envy creeps in, the way the dream you started with keeps quietly rewriting itself. The numbers are there. We just don't think they're the point.

store_data.about_the_game:
Endless Defense is a roguelite sci-fi tower defense game where every run becomes a new build.

Place turrets, upgrade your defense, choose powerful traits, draw upgrade cards, and survive against endless waves of enemies. Each run gives you different choices, different synergies, and a new chance to push your score even higher.

Build Your Defense

Place sci-fi turrets with different roles and strengths. Some deal reliable damage, some burn enemies over time, some slow and freeze, some chain lightning between targets, some fire continuous lasers, and some support nearby towers.

store_data.about_the_game:
SURVIVE THE BLACKOUT

Neon Blackfall is a fast-paced deckbuilding card game set in Neurovale, a city divided between two eras. The Neon Era represents life before the blackout. Blackfall begins when the lights go out and survival becomes the only law.

Build your deck, choose your faction, and fight for the future of the city.

TWO ERAS, ONE BATTLE

Every match evolves as the game progresses.

The Neon Era represents the city before the catastrophe. Blackfall represents the collapse that followed. Many cards gain different abilities depending on the current era, encouraging players to build decks designed to dominate the early game, survive the darkness, or thrive in both.

PROGRESS OR SABOTAGE

Victory can be achieved in different ways.

Use the Wisdom of your creatures to develop your base and earn Progress Points. Use Attack to eliminate enemy cards and sabotage rival bases.

Should you invest in your own future or destroy that of your enemies? In Neurovale, both paths can lead to victory.

FOUR RIVAL FACTIONS

Choose the faction that best matches your playstyle.

  • Neon Syndicate – Corporate power, technology and economic dominance.

  • Blackout Raiders – Aggressive survivors who thrive in chaos.

  • Null Hospital – Experiments, mutations and relentless recovery.

  • Synaptic Order – Knowledge, control and strategic superiority.

Each faction features unique cards, mechanics and deckbuilding possibilities.

FAST-PACED MATCHES

Designed for quick and intense battles.

Turns are limited to 60 seconds, but experienced players can act much faster. Every decision matters, and hesitation can cost you the game.

Think fast. Adapt faster.

LEARN THROUGH THE STORY

Discover the world of Neurovale through more than 50 single-player chapters.

Learn the mechanics naturally while uncovering the events that led to the Blackout and the struggles that followed.

What really happened to Neurovale?

BUILD YOUR DECK

Create decks focused on Progress, Sabotage, battlefield control or hybrid strategies.

Bases cannot be protected directly, forcing players to constantly decide whether to advance their own objectives or disrupt their opponent's plans.

Experiment with different archetypes and find your path to victory.

ONLINE MULTIPLAYER

Challenge other players online and test your decks against real opponents.

Climb the rankings, experiment with new strategies and prove that your faction deserves to rule Neurovale.

UNLOCK EVERYTHING BY PLAYING

No microtransactions.

The purchase of the game includes access to every card. Earn Victory Points by playing Single Player or Multiplayer matches and use them to unlock booster packs or acquire specific cards directly from the collection.

Play. Earn. Unlock.

No pay-to-win mechanics. Ever.

store_data.about_the_game:
You're the CEO of Santa's Workshop, the North Pole tracks the toy making season as 24 days. Your job is simple: assign elves to toy production lines, manage your Christmas Spirit, and deliver enough toys to make Christmas happen. But "simple" is a lie. Every day brings surprises. Santa takes extra long "Cookie Breaks". Elves get tired. Rudolph show up and blinds everyone. The daily production quota ramps up. And somehow, it all has to work out by Christmas.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Assign Elves - You have 24 elves across three production tables. Decide which toys they'll make and try to keep them happy. Overwork them and morale drops. Pamper them and your production suffers.

  • Manage Production - Choose between an array of different presents, toy soldiers, teddy bears, dolls, and rocking horses. Each has different production times and values. Produce what gets you closest to your delivery quota.

  • Track Christmas Spirit - Earn Christmas Spirit from completed orders, and get a bit from Santa Ho-Ho-Ho's. Spend it on materials, decor, and improving your elves.

  • Navigate Random Events - About 20 different events can trigger each day. Tied Elves. Weather problems. Reindeer-related chaos. You don't control them, but you decide how to respond.

  • Make Quick Decisions - When something goes wrong, you decide your next move. It's not a deep moral choice—it's practical. Do you pay extra to fix the equipment or work around it? Your budget and schedule adjust accordingly.

WHY PLAY?

This is management stripped to its essentials: assign workers, track resources, hit deadlines, deal with unexpected problems. It's relaxing in its simplicity but challenging in its execution. Push for meeting your daily toy production quota to earn reward for the next year's work.

THE PROMISE

This isn't a complex business simulator. It's a focused, friendly management game about running a toy factory under pressure. Make your decisions, see the results, and play again. That's it. That's the game.

Can you deliver Christmas?
